source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 1 ṣú-pu-um i li-bi ḫu-ur-šú-nu-ma-an
target: 15 shekels of silver and 1 white sheep are owed by Huršun-uman.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-am ší-im ANŠE i li-bi₄ a-šur-DU₁₀
target: 40 minas of refined copper, the price of a donkey, are due from Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù lu gi₅-mì-lúm i-a-tí ḫa-ra-ni a-na a-lim(ki)
target: Let it be a favor to me - my journey is to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na-ku a-we-el gi₅-mì-lim
target: and I am a man of favors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na a-na šu-ku-bi₄-im
target: 1 mina for Šu-Kubum

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na a-na a-pu-ut-ri-a
target: 1.5 minas for Aputriya

source: translate Akkadian to English: ANŠE ša be-la-nim i-nu-mì a-wi-il₅-tum me-ta-at-ni a-na 15 ma-na URUDU ṣa-la-mì-im il₅-qé-šu
target: He took the donkey of Bēlānum for 15 minas of black copper when the lady had died.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù a-mur-IŠTAR
target: To Pilah-Ištar and Amur-Ištar;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: specifically to Pilah-Ištar, thus says Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá ú-ṭá-tám a-na a-wi-il₅-tim ta-du-nu ti-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma
target: Let word from you come to me as to how much grain you will give to the lady.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí ší-im ra-qá-tí-im lu-šé-bi₄-la-ku-um
target: So that I may send it to you with the proceeds from the thin textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 (TÚG)ra-qá-tám SIG₅ ša a-na ší-mì-im a-dí-na-ku-ni
target: My brother, regarding the one fine thin textile that I gave you for sale,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta a-na ma-la a-we-lu-tí-kà ra-qá-tám dí-in-ma
target: sell the thin textile as a true gentleman,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-uk-ma KI a-mur-IŠTAR šé-bi-lam
target: seal the silver, and send it with Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ma ra-qá-tum lá ta-ad-na-at-ma a-dí-ni i-ba-ší
target: But if the thin textile has not been sold and is still available,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a ší-mì-ša ú-bu-lu KÙ.BABBAR i ra-ma-tí-kà i-dí-ma
target: put down silver yourself as much as its value,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-mur-IŠTAR lu-ub-lam
target: and let Amur-Ištar bring it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-mur-IŠTAR lá i-bi-a-at
target: Amur-Ištar should not delay;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭur₄-da-šu šu-a-tí ú-qá-a-šu
target: send him, for I am waiting for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É šál-ma-a-šùr a-na a-wa-tim né-ru-ub-ma
target: We entered Šalma-Aššur's house for legal proceedings,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma ke-na ša ÌR-dí-a a-bu-ša-lim al-qé
target: Šu-Bēlum answered: "Yes, I have taken what belongs to my slave Abu-šalim."

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-na-da DUMU a-mur-lu-sú
target: Seal of Aššur-nādā, son of Āmur-ilūssu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-di-(d)IŠKUR DUMU a-šur-DU₁₀
target: Seal of Iddin-Adad, son of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-ta-aḫ-šu ša 16 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-lá-at a-ta-aḫ-šu-ú iš-ti KÙ.BABBAR uk-ta-al
target: Seal of Atahšu, concerning 16 shekels of silver, the working capital of Atahšu, which is held with the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI sú-kà-lí-a DUMU a-mur-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Sukkalliya son of Amur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ku-za DUMU šu-a-nim
target: By Akuza son of Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ú-ra-a DUMU ma-na na
target: By Uraya son of Manana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: For these proceedings, the Kanesh colony gave us authority.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: We gave the tablet of our testimony before the dagger of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-sú-ri-ik a-na a-lim(ki) i-lá-ak-ma
target: Issu-arik is going to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É-tí-šu ša bu-ri-im a-šar a-ni ša-lim-a-šùr wa-áš-bu-ni a-na tù-ud-ḫi-li-a a-ḫu tù-li a-na ší-mì-im i-dí-šu-nu
target: He has sold his houses by the well, where currently Šalim-Aššur is living, to Tudhiliya, the brother of Tuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šur ša ni-iš a-lim(ki) úz-na-tí-ni il₅-pu-ut
target: Šalim-Aššur informed us of the oath of the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-a-tí a-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim i-na ma-ak-sú-im a-na ḫu-bu-ul ÌR a-bu-ša-lim ša-qá-lim i-ra-de₈-ú-ni
target: While they are leading me to Burušhaddum in shackles to pay the debt of the slave Abu-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta 30 (TÚG)ku-ta-ni ù ANŠE ṣa-lá-ma-am ša ÌR tal-qé
target: You have taken 30 kutānu-textiles and a black donkey belonging to the slave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar ÌR a-na wa-ar-dí-kà lá i-tù-ru
target: Since the slave does not claim against your slave,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-a a-na wa-ar-dí-a i-tù-ar
target: will he then claim against my slave?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma šu-ma a-na ku-a-im i-tù-ar a-na TÚG.ḪI.A ù ANŠE a-za-za-kum
target: Šu-Bēlum answered: "If he claims against yours, I shall guarantee the textiles and the donkey for you."

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ú-ra-a IGI ì-lí-dan IGI ma-nu-um-ba-lúm-a-šur
target: Witnessed by Uraya, by Ilī-dan, by Mannum-balum-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÍR ša a-šùr ú-ta-me-šu
target: He made them swear by the dagger of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-né-eš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: For these proceedings, the Kanesh colony gave us authority.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before the dagger of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lim(ki) ša-ak-šu-dí wa-ar-ki-a qá-bí-a-tí
target: You have been ordered to forward 0.5 shekels of silver to the City after my departure.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 ma-na URUDU KI i-ku-pí-a-šur DUMU šu-IŠTAR
target: 40 minas of copper due by Ikūn-pī-Aššur, son of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na-am 12 GÍN i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: Per 1 mina he will add as interest 12 shekels per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma wa-ar-ki-tí a-na a-lim(ki) lá tù-ša-ak-ší-dí
target: If after my departure you do not forward it to the City,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na-um 0.66666 ma-na i-na a-lim(ki) ta-ša-qá-lam
target: you will pay 0.66666 mina per mina in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 37.33333 ma-na URUDU KI DINGIR-ba-ni DUMU ib-ni-lí
target: 37.33333 minas of copper due from Ilī-bāni, son of Ibni-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM na-ar-ma-ak a-šur
target: Month of Narmak Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 9 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša É ḫa-ar-ta ù 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫa-al-ki-a-šu ù kà-ri-a me-er-ú da-la-áš
target: Regarding the 9 minas of silver from Harta's house and the 10 minas of silver from Halkiaššu and Karriya, the sons of Dalaš,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lim-a-šùr ù me-er-e-šu ú-lá i-tù-ru
target: they shall not claim against Šalim-Aššur and his sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tim ša ta-ta-wu-ni la-ší-na-ma
target: The words you spoke are improper;

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na É-a-ba-áš-tí šu-qú-ul-ma
target: pay the silver to Ea-bāštī

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu at-ḫu-a-ni
target: and let us be brothers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta KÙ.BABBAR a-na É-a-ba-áš-tí šu-qú-ul-ma
target: Please, my brother, pay the silver to Ea-bāštī

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-ar-ki-tí a-na a-lim(ki) ša-ak-ší-dí
target: and forward it to the City after me

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-mu-un li-bi₄-im a-ra-ší-a-ku-um
target: lest I get angry with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí šál-ma-a-šur DUMU up-ḫa-qí-im
target: 1 mina 15 shekels of silver due from Šalim-Aššur, son of Uphāqum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu i-na a-lim(ki) lu i-na GÁN-lim a-le ni-na-mu-ru i-ša-qal
target: He shall pay wherever we meet, either in the City or in the countryside.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR KI a-šur-SIPA
target: 0.5 mina of silver due from Aššur-rē'ī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na um 10 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: He will add an interest of 10 shekels per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ma-ḫu-ur-ì-lí a-na 6 ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
target: Month Mahhur-ilī, he will pay within 6 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 18 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí i-zi-iz-mì-šar
target: 18 shekels of silver due from Izziz-Mīšar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB MAR.TU-ba-ni DUMU ma-na-na
target: Seal of Amurrum-bāni son of Manana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ú-ra-a ŠEŠ-šu
target: Seal of Uraya his brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ḫa-da-a DUMU kà-ra-wa
target: Seal of Hadaya son of Karawa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-na-aḫ-DINGIR DUMU ḫi-šar
target: Seal of Anah-ilī son of Hišar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-da-da DUMU (d)IM.GAL
target: Seal of Adada son of Adad-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-dí-(d)UTU me-er-e da-la-áš
target: Seal of Iddin-Šamaš, the sons of Dalaš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: re-eš₁₅ ITU.KAM ḫu-bu-ur
target: Beginning of month Hubur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 ma-na 10 GÍN URUDU iš-tí en-nam-ì-lí DUMU du-uk-ší-im
target: 9 minas 10 shekels of copper due from Ennam-ilī, son of Dukšum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 ma-na URUDU iš-tí ib-ni-(d)IŠKUR ma-za-zi-im
target: 9 minas of copper due from Ibni-Adad, the attendant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na URUDU iš-tí šu-be-lim DUMU da-a-a
target: 20 minas of copper due from Šu-Bēlum, son of Dāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ITU.1.KAM i-ša-qal
target: Within one month he will pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šál-ma-(d)IŠKUR nu-a-ri-im
target: In the presence of Šalim-Ištar, the musician.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-lá-at a-šur-SIPA DUMU i-dí-IŠTAR
target: 0.66666 mina of silver, the working capital of Aššur-rē'ī, son of Iddin-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-dí-sú-in DUMU a-ta-na-aḫ
target: In the presence of Iddin-Suen, son of Atanah.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-be-lim DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im
target: Seal of Šu-Bēlum, son of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum speak, thus says Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-ku-nim DUMU (d)UTU-ba-ni e-ni-iš-ta-ri-im ù a-lu-wa
target: To Ikūnum, son of Šamaš-bāni, Eniš-tarum, and Aluwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-aṣ KÙ ta-lá-qé
target: You will receive the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 19 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR SAḪAR.BA ší-im 1.8333300000000001 ma-na LÁ 2 GÍN AN.NA
target: 19 shekels of 'dust silver', the price of 1 mina and 48 shekels of tin,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša kà-nu-tim i li-bi a-mur-IŠTAR DUMU i-da-a
target: which Kannutum has as a claim on Amur-Ištar, son of Idaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na KÙ.BABBAR-pì-a a-na-ku-ma
target: 10 shekels of silver are from my own silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ad-ri-im i-ša-qal
target: At the time of the threshing floor he will weigh it out.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ LÁ 10 ma-na URUDU i-ṣé-er PUZUR₄-(d)EN.ZU e-lá-ma i-šu
target: 50 minas of copper Puzur-Suen owes to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ILLAT-tim ša IGI ú-ṣú-ra-nim iz-ku-a-ni
target: the 10 shekels of silver from the caravan that became available to me with Uṣurānum as witness.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU ta-pá-ša-ta-i-am za-ak-wa-am
target: Pure copper of the Tappašatta standard.

source: translate Akkadian to English: an-ma-ma tí-ir-tí i-sú-ri-ik a-na ṣé-ri-a i-li-kam-ma
target: Issu-arik's instructions arrived to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pé ša a-bi-kà lu-lá-mì-id-kà-ma
target: and let me inform you of your father's tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫa-ma i-na ku-bu-ur ú-ṭí-tí-im i-na kà-ni-iš i-ša-qal
target: Separately he will pay 10 shekels of silver in Kanesh, when the barley is ripe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul
target: If he does not pay

source: translate Akkadian to English: i tù-ur-ḫu-mì-it i-ṣé-ri-šu a-lá-qé
target: I will collect it in Durhumit for his account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ú-me-šu lá iš-qú-ul
target: If he does not pay when his term is up,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im tù-ur-ḫu-mì-it ṣí-ib-ta-am ú-ṣa-áb
target: he will add interest in accordance with the rule of the Durhumit colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš(ki) i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma-ba KÙ.BABBAR tù-ša-qí-il₅
target: If you have had the silver paid

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà ni-ta-pá-al
target: then we shall satisfy your silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma mì-nam we-dam i-a-tí tù-la-ma-da-ni
target: He said: 'Why do you inform me alone?'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-úa lá-šu-ú
target: My brothers are not present.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu i-na a-lim(ki) KÙ.BABBAR lu ta-ad-mì-qá-tim lu ḫu-bu-ul a-bi-kà KÙ.BABBAR ma-sà-am ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: Whether in the City, silver from free loans or from the debt of your father, I had the refined silver paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am IGI GÍR ša a-šùr i-ba-ab DINGIR-lim ni-dí-in
target: We gave a tablet in front of Aššur's dagger in the Gate of the God.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-DU₁₀-ma a-na a-na-na qí-bi-ma
target: Thus says Aššur-ṭāb to Anna-anna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: sà-áp-tí-nu-um i-na ra-mì-ni-a ú-ba-la-am
target: I personally bring you a saptinnum-cloth.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma šu-(d)DUMU.ZI-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum speak, thus says Šu-Tammuzi:

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI na-áb-sú-in DUMU (d)AB-ba-ni
target: before Nab-Suen son of Il-bāni

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-ku-pí-a-šùr DUMU šu-IŠTAR
target: before Ikuppi-Aššur son of Šu-Ištar

source: translate Akkadian to English: 16 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi-lá-ni
target: As to the 16 shekels of silver that you sent me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im li-bi₄-šu šu-ut-ma iš-a-am la iš-e-li
target: he made purchases according to his own heart without asking me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ša-me-ma e-pì-iš-tí a-we-lim ša-aḫ-lá-at
target: I hear that the man's activities are in disorder.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-we-lúm É-tám i-šu-ma
target: Whether the man has a house

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-ru-qú-šu šál-ma-at
target: and his joint-stock capital is safe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 né-nu na-al-pu-ta-ni
target: and both of us have been recorded.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ni-tum lá a-ni-tum tí-ir-ta-ak-nu za-ku-tum li-li-kam
target: Whether this is so or not, let your clear report come to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-lá-ḫi-im i li-be a-ni-na
target: 10 shekels of silver belonging to Ali-ahum is owed by Annina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ḫu-úa a-tù-nu-ma ta-ra-a-ma-ni
target: If you are my brothers and love me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-na-ku a-na-kam ki-ma ku-nu-tí am-ta-ḫu-ṣú-ma a-na a-wa-tí-ku-nu a-za-zu
target: just as I here fight for you and stand for your affairs.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-we-lam₅ ta-da-ga-lá-ma lá i-dum
target: If you observe that the man has no sense,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma i-a-tí mì-ta-aḫ-ṣa-ma
target: then fight for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na al x a-na u₄-mu e-ṭá-ri-im iṭ-ra-ni
target: Save me while I can still be saved.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 21.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni a-na ḫi-na-a ni-ip-qí-id
target: We entrusted 21.33333 minas of silver under our seals to Hinnaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU lu-zi-na
target: Before Šu-Ištar son of Luzina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-na-nim DUMU am-ri-a
target: Before Ennānum son of Amria.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-… AN.NA ù TÚG.ḪI.A a-na KÙ.BABBAR dí-na
target: Sell the tin and textiles for silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ba-a-ba-tí-a ša nu-a-e i-ḫi-id-ma
target: Pay attention to my outstanding claims with Anatolians,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-il₅-ma šé-bi₄-lam
target: have the silver paid and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-ta-ni SIG₅ ú ḫu-sà-ra-am lá-áš-a-ma-kum-ma
target: I shall buy good textiles and lapis lazuli for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma i-na e-lá-i-a KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na ni-lá-qé-ú ú-ša-bi-ru ta-ma-ar
target: You will see that we shall take 10 minas of silver when I come up.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-bi₄-a DUMU be-e-be ù a-šùr-DU₁₀
target: to Abiya son of Bebe and Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da
target: If you are truly my brothers, take care!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-mu-tám SIG₅ ḫu-sà-ra-am SIG₅ É a-lim(ki) a-mu-ur-ma
target: I have seen good iron and good lapis lazuli here in the City Hall.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí KÙ.BABBAR lá iš-qú-lu-ni a-mu-tám ù ḫu-sà-ra-am lá u-šu-ru
target: But as long as they have not paid the silver, they will not release the iron and lapis lazuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lim-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma (d)IM.GAL-ma
target: To Šalim-Aššur from Adad-rabi:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-sú-ri-ik i-na ma-aḫ-ri-ni e-tù-wu
target: Issu-arik spoke (thus) with us as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-IŠTAR a-wa-tám i-šu
target: Šu-Ištar raised the matter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta i-ḫi-id-ma AN.NA ù TÚG.ḪI.A a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-e-er-ma
target: My dear brother, take care to convert the tin and textiles to silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i-na ba-ab-tí-a KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na ša-áš-qí-lá-ma
target: Then have some 10 minas of silver from my outstanding claims paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi-lam-ma a-mu-tám ù ḫu-sà-ra-am lu-šé-ṣí-a-ma
target: Send me the silver so I can take out the iron and the lapis lazuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tum a-ni-tum a ma-lá ša ṭup-pí-šu ša iš-pu-ra-ni ke-na
target: This matter is correct as he wrote about it in his letter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam šu-IŠTAR a-šur-ma-lik ù ša-lim-a-šùr iš-me-ú-ma
target: Here Šu-Ištar, Aššur-malik and Šalim-Aššur heard (your letter).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 me-at 56 (TÚG)ku-ta-nu 12 ma-na 18 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 156 textiles cost 12 minas 18 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ANŠE ṣa-lá-me 0.83333 ma-na 5 GÍN it-bu-lu
target: 6 black donkeys cost 0.83333 mina 5 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.33333 ma-n
target: Cost 2.3333 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma šu-IŠTAR a-wa-sú li-il₅-qé-a-ma
target: and they said: "Let Šu-Ištar take a lawsuit

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ba-áb DINGIR nu-ri-id-ma ṭup-pá-am lu ni-dí-na-kum
target: and we shall go down to the Gate of the God and give you a tablet."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-dí-a-bi-im i-tur₄-DINGIR ku-ku-wa a-dí-da ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To Iddin-abum, Itūr-ilī, Kukawa, Adida and Ali-ahum from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-tù-nu-ma a-šar ša-lá-am lu-qú-tim ša a-bi-kà mì-li-ik
target: You wrote: Decide about the safety of your father's goods!

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na tí-ir-tí-ku-nu ḫa-ra-an sú-qí-ni-ma a-šé-ru-ub lu-qú-tim ta-áš-ta-na-pá-ra-nim
target: In your instructions you keep writing to me about bringing the goods on the Narrow Track.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na tí-ri a ma-lá lu-qú-tim ša a-bi-ni ša-lá-mì-ša ša i-x x-…
target: Every mina of silver as saving our father's goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iḫ-da-ma lá a-sá-ḫu-ur
target: Take care so I am not delayed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú i-na ḫa-ra-an sú-qí-nim-ma DUMU a-zu-za-a iṣ-bu-tù-ma
target: So, they have seized Azuzaya's son on the narrow track.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim kà-li-i
target: And he is detained until this day.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na-kam a-wa-at e-kál-li ša ša-lá-ša-at šu-nu-tí da-na-ma
target: However, here the orders of the palaces, three of them, are strict.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar iš-té-en₆ a-wa-sú-nu ša-ak-na-at
target: And they have made common cause.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí KÙ.BABBAR ša a-dí ší-ni-šu áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí-ni-ma šu-ut ú-lá e-zi-ba-ni
target: As to the silver that I wrote you about twice, and which he has not left for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ú-a bé-lu-a a-tù-nu
target: My dear fathers, my lords, you are!

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-bi-a iští ba-tí-qí-im šé-bí-lá-nim-ma lu-qú-tám lá-áš-lu-ùḫ
target: Send me some of my father's silver with an express caravan so I can dispatch the goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-lu-a-ma a-na sú-e-a qí-bi-ma
target: From Iluwa to Sueyya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì lu-qú-tim ša a-bi-ni a-šar ša-lá-mì-ša a-ṣé-er ša ki-ma a-bi-ni ù a-ṣé-ri-ku-nu a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí
target: Once or twice I have written to our father's representatives and to you about how to deal with our father's goods in a safe manner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: pá-zu-ur-tám ša-bu
target: He has been paid the smuggling-fee.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-ki ša sí-sí-kà-tim pí-iq-da
target: Entrust them with sealings on the hems.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì 2 TÚG ša ḫa-al-qú-ni a-na šu-IŠTAR ù e-lā-li lá kà-áš-du
target: Concerning 2 textiles that were lost they have not reached Šu-Ištar and Elāli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-ta ù i-na-sú-in ki-ma ni-a-tí i-ša-ḫa-at zu-ba
target: You and Enna-Suen should assist Zuba there on our behalf.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-zi-za-ma TÚG.ḪI.A a-na ḫura-ṣa-nim pí-iq-da
target: And entrust the textiles to huraṣānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-ta-na-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Šāt-Anna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 49 TÚG.ḪI.A ša a-šùr-i-mì-tí
target: 49 textiles belonging to Aššur-imittī

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ša bu-ur-sú-in
target: 1 textile belonging to Būr-Suen

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ša la-qé-ep
target: 1 textile belonging to Lā-qēp

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 TÚG ša i-ku-pí-a
target: 1 textile belonging to Ikūn-pīya

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 52 TÚG.ḪI.A qá-dum ša ta-ad-mì-qá-tim ù 2 ANŠE ù ú-nu-sú-nu a-na zu-ba ap-qí-id-ma
target: In all I entrusted to Zuba 52 textiles including those of the, plus 2 donkeys and their harness.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er ḫura-ṣa-nim i-ra-dí
target: And he leads it to huraṣānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x (TÚG)ku-ta-ni x 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na 2 ma-na 6.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ir-nu-id a-dí-in
target: I sold x kutānu-textiles at x + 1.5 shekels a piece for 2 minas 6.5 shekels of silver to Irnuid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ku-nu-ki-a a-lu-ú-a na-áš-a-ku-um
target: Aluwa brings you 30 minas of good copper under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ma-lá ta-le-e-ú a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-e-er-ma
target: Convert it to silver there as best you can.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ú zu-ku-a qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum and Zukuwa from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 ma-na AN.NA en-nam-a-šur a-mì-ša-am ub-lam
target: Ennam-Aššur brought 13 minas of tin there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ar-ší-aḫ-šú ù pè-ru-wa qí-bí₄-ma
target: To Aršiahšu and Peruwa say:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma AN.NA i-dí-na-ku-nu-ti
target: if he has given you the tin,

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA ku-un-kà-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: then seal the tin and send it here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu
target: You are my brothers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-lu-a a-tù-nu
target: You are my lords.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma dam-qá-a a-na a-lim(ki) ḫara-šu
target: If Damqaya is on his way to the City,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-šu-ma
target: then give him a mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-na-ku AN.NA a-ma-kam ú-šé-li-a-ku-ni
target: Just as I brought up tin for him,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ut AN.NA šál-ma-am lu-šé-li-am
target: he too should bring up tin without deductions for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: SÍG.ḪI.A za-ku-tim ša-ma-nim
target: Buy for me cleaned wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 0.5 GÍN lá ta-be-e-lá
target: Do not try to save even half a shekel of silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR qá-dí AN.NA i-dí-na-ku-nu-ti
target: If he has given you silver together with the tin,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-am ša ba-lá-ṭí-a ša-ma-ma
target: then make a profitable purchase for me

source: translate Akkadian to English: iští a-li-ki pá-ni-ú-tí-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: and send it here with the very first travellers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 0.33333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 15 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-a-am ku-nu-ki-a be-lúm-ba-ni na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Bēlum-bāni is bringing you 30.3333 shekels of silver and 15 minas of purified copper under my seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ar-ḫi-iš ṭù-ur-da-ni-šú
target: Send him to me quickly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur lá-ak-ru-ba-ku-nu-tí
target: I will pray for you before Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-er-ú me-tim né-nu
target: We are the sons of a dead man.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur a-na a-la-ḫi-im-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur said to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá e-ta-wu a-na KÙ.BABBAR-pí-šú sí-kà-áš-nu ú-kà-al
target: If he does not speak, they will hold their hem for his silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-a-ni
target: Do not cheat me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša tám-kà-ru a-bi-ni sí-ki-ni ú-kà-lu
target: Why is it that our father's merchants detain us?

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um dí-nam i-dí-in-ma
target: The colony has rendered a verdict,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr ma-la KÙ.BABBAR a-na i-dí-a-bi-im ú-ša-qí-lu
target: stating that whatever silver Šalim-Aššur has paid for Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-a-ni
target: Do not cheat me

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù sí-ki-ni lá ú-kà-lu
target: lest they detain us

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a-am a-na tám-kà-ri a-bi-ni lu nu-sà-li-ma
target: Come, let us plead with our father's merchants.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tám-kà-ri a-bi-ni lu nu-ṭá-ib
target: Let us satisfy our father's merchants.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-ḫa-ni
target: Do not obstruct me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù-ma ša a-ḫi-im ù ib-ri-im lá ta-ša-me-ú
target: Since you will not listen to what brother and friend say.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí 5-ší-šu ù 10-ri-šu a-ḫa-am ù ib-ra-am nu-šé-ší-ib-ma
target: Five or ten times we have arranged meetings with brothers and friends.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta qá-tám ta-am-ta-na-ḫa-aṣ
target: But you keep refusing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá ri-ig-ma-tum
target: This is not a lawsuit

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bu-tum
target: it is a witnessed statement

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN lá tù-ša-ag-ma-ra-ni
target: And do not let me incur an expense of even a single shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum say:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a-am a-ṣé-er 4 um-me-a-ni ša ki-ma a-bi-ni lu ni-li-ik-ma
target: Come, let us go to the 4 investors who represent our father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-šé-ší-ru-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Let them set us straight.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tám-kà-ri a-bi-ni lu nu-ṭá-ib-ma
target: Let us satisfy our father's merchants.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na a-lim(ki) a-na ṣé-er a-ḫa-tí-ni gu₅-ba-áb-tim lu ni-li-ik-ma
target: and then let us go to the City to our sister, the priestess,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-lá ší-ma-at a-bi-ni ša a-lim(ki) lu ni-iz-ku
target: and let us clear ourselves in accordance with our father's will that is in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu
target: You are my brothers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG SIG₅ a-lu-a ub-lá-ku-nu-tí
target: Aluwa brought you 1 fine textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki-a e-ni-iš-ta-ru-um ub-lá-ku-nu-tí
target: Eništārum brought 10 minas of tin under my seal to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-lik lu-qú-tim ša tám-kà-ri-im mì-il₅-kà
target: Take a decision concerning the merchant's goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ší-im AN.NA-ki ú ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-a šé-bi-lá-nim-ma
target: Send me the silver, the price of the tin and the price of my textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: gi-mì-lá-am i-na ṣé-ri-a šu-uk-na
target: Do me a favor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí-in i-na ṣú-ḫa-ri-ku-nu ša ki-ma qá-qí-dí-ku-nu iš-tí-šu ṭù-ur-da-ni-ma
target: Send with him one of your servants, whom you trust like yourselves.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ni-tám lá a-ni-tám tí-ir-ta-ak-nu li-li-kam-ma
target: Let your report reach me whether it is so or not.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iḫ-da lá ta-ša-lá-ta
target: Be careful, do not act rashly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tám-kà-ru-um a-na pá-ni-a i-da-gal
target: The merchant is relying on me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ḫa-nu-nu ù en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: To Hanunu and Ennam-Aššur say:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù tí-ir-ta-ku-nu a-na tám-kà-ri-im li-li-kà-am
target: And let your report reach the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na (d)UTU-ši ú-ṣur-ša-IŠTAR e-ra-ba-ni na-áš-pé-ra-tim ší-ta-me-a-ma
target: Listen to the missives the very day Uṣur-ša-Ištar arrives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ma-kàl lá i-sà-ḫu-ur
target: And let him not delay a single day.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-na qá-ra-bi-tim er-ba-ma
target: Enter the interior of the house there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na na-áš-pé-er-tí-ku-nu ú-dí-a-nim
target: Inform me in your missive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ta-aḫ-sí-is-tám en-nam-a-šur lu-kà-il₅-ši
target: And Ennam-Aššur should keep the memorandum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ta-aḫ-sí-is-tám ša a-na ṣí-it en-um-a-šur ú-ša-qí-lu am-ra-ma
target: Also, look at the memorandum stating that he paid for Ennam-Aššur's various expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša bé-ú-lá-at da-ra-áš en-um-a-šur na-ší i-na li-bi ṭup-pí-a šu-uk-na
target: Place the tablet concerning the working-capital of Daraš which Ennam-Aššur carries among my other tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur said to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-ni-ma-ma na-áš-pé-er-tám ku-nu-ki-kà IGI 3 ú-kà-lim-kà-ma
target: Now here I have shown you the missive sealed by you in front of 3 (witnesses).

source: translate Akkadian to English: am-ma a-wi-lu a-ni-ú-tum li-iš-me-ú
target: Now, may these men hear it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tù-kà-i-ni-ma
target: You have confirmed it to me

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-nu-tí-ma ni-ip-qí-sí
target: and we have entrusted it to them

source: translate Akkadian to English: am-ma ta-aḫ-sí-sà-tù-ni ku-nu-ku-a ú ku-nu-ku-kà i-ki-ir ú-ul kà-in
target: Contest or confirm that it is our memoranda sealed by me and by you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ni-kà-sī a-na-ku ù a-ta ni-sí-ú-ma ni-iz-ku-ú
target: stating that I and you have settled accounts and cleared the affair.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-aḫ-sí-sà-tum ku-nu-ku-kà ú ku-nu-ku-a
target: The memoranda are sealed by you and by me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a-am 3 šál-ša-at lu ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma
target: Come, let us seize 3 persons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá ta-aḫ-sí-sà-tim ša i-na ku-nu-ki-ni kán-kà-ni lu ni-iz-ku
target: And let us settle in accordance with the memoranda that are sealed by us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR a-bu-ni i li-bí₄-a ù i li-bi-kà i-dí-ú-ma
target: Further, our father left a tablet behind about how much silver he set down as owed by me and you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-ku-za DUMU šu-a-nim
target: Sealed by Akuza son of Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB lá-qé-ep DUMU (d)AB-ba-ni
target: Sealed by Lā-qēp son of Illil-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR té-ṣú-bu bi-il₅-tám ik-šu-ud
target: The additions amounted to 7.25 shekels of silver per talent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a-am u₄-ma-ma ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR i ṭup-pí-im lá-áp-ta-ni-ni lu ni-iš-qúl-ma
target: Come, let us pay even today as much silver as we are booked for on the tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 2 me-et ri-ik-sí ša qá-nu-e ša ḫa-ší-ú-ma-an
target: 10.5 shekels of silver, 200 bundles of reeds of Hašiuman.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá dí-in a-lim(ki) KÙ.BABBAR lu ni-ik-nu-uk-ma
target: Let us seal the silver in accordance with the verdict of the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lim lu ni-lik
target: and go to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ba-áb DINGIR ša IGI GÍR ša a-šùr
target: The tablet from the Gate of the God from before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am um-me-a-nu a-bí₄-ni ú-kà-i-lu-ni-ma
target: Our father's investors kept the tablet

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na IGI kà-ri-im ṣa-ḫe-er GAL iš-ku-nu-šú-ma
target: and have placed it before the plenary assembly of the colony

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um a-na ra-bi-ṣí-im ip-qí-du-ni
target: and the colony has entrusted it to the attorney

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-na-sú-in ú a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Enna-Suen and Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: áš-me-ma li-bi₄ im-ta-ra-aṣ
target: When I heard I was unhappy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ta-da-nam lá a-le-e
target: I cannot pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 0.66666 ag-ri a-gu₅-ur-ma
target: For 3 shekels of silver - for 2.5 shekels of silver I rented 0.6666 of a hired man.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ša e-ba-ru-tí-a lá a-dí-ší
target: By my friends! - I have not sold her here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÉME i-na wa-áš-ḫa-ni-a e-zi-ib-ma
target: I left the maid in Wašhaniya,

source: translate Akkadian to English: áš-pu-ur-šu-nu-tí-ma GÉME lá i-ta-ru-ú-ni-ší
target: and I wrote to them but they do not bring her here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-tù-nu ta-áš-ta-pu-a-ma
target: But as for you, you kept quiet

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na lá a-we-lim ta-áš-ku-na-ni
target: and made me a non-gentleman.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta GÉME li-it-ru-ni-ší
target: My dear brother, let him bring the maid here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na (d)UTU-ši ṭup-pì ta-ša-me-a-ni
target: The very day you hear my letter,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR lu 5 GÍN ma-lá ta-le-e-a-ni gu₅-um-ra-ma
target: spend some 5 shekels of silver, whatever you can,

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÉME li-it-ru-ni-ší
target: so they can bring the maid here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-mur-(d)UTU DUMU mì-šu-ra-bi
target: Seal of Amur-Šamaš son of Miššu-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-um-A-šur wa-ar-dum ša ḫu-ra-ṣa-nim
target: Seal of Ennam-Aššur, huraṣānum's slave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN a-na a-šur-ma-lik DUMU ili₅-ma-al-ki
target: 1 shekel for Aššur-malik son of Ilima-alki.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 na-ru-uq lu ŠE um lu ar-ša-tum ša a-we-el-tum i-ta-dí-nu-ma
target: For 5 sacks, both barley and wheat, which the lady delivered,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-lá-ḫu-um il₅-qé
target: Ali-ahum received 1 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN du-um-qá-a
target: 1 shekel for Dumqaya

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-al-DU₁₀ DUMU a-mur-a-šur ša-bu
target: If Āl-ṭāb, son of Amur-Aššur, has already been satisfied,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 12.16666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR-im 1 ma-na-um 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR en-nam-a-šur DUMU a-al-DU₁₀ a-na a-al-DU₁₀ DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀ i-ša-qal
target: Ennam-Aššur, son of Āl-ṭāb, shall pay 0.5 mina of silver per mina, totalling 12.166 shekels of silver, to Āl-ṭāb, son of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN a-na ku-zal-lim DUMU i-li-a
target: 1.5 shekel for Kuzallum son of Iliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim i-nu-mì a-na a-lim(ki) ur-du-ni a-na ni-qé-šu-nu a-ta-dí-in-šu-nu-tí
target: all this I gave for their sacrifices when they came down to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na ša-lim-a-šùr ḫa-bu-lá-ni-ni ŠÀ.BA
target: Concerning 2 minas 10 shekels of silver that we owed to Šalim-Aššur, of that:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí qí-bi-ma
target: Say to my representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 LÁ 0.25 GÍN i-ku-num
target: 12 minus 1/4 shekels: Ikūnum

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 8.25 GÍN a-šùr-ta-ak-lá-ku DUMU šu-(d)EN.LÍL
target: 28 1/4 shekels: Aššur-taklāku son of Šu-Illil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá ta-ga-mì-lá-šu
target: Have no consideration with him!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-šur-ták-lá-ku pí-šu li-ip-té-ma
target: Here Assur-taklaku should make a statement

source: translate Akkadian to English: x ma-na LÁ 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
target: and then make him pay x mina minus 1 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù 1 (TÚG)ku-ta-nam ša-lim-a-šur a-na a-šu-wa-an i-dí-in-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur gave 1 mina of silver and 1 kutānu-textile to Aššuwan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-tù-ru lá-am-nu-ut a-na a-šùr ru-ba-im ù GAL sí-ki-tim
target: If they raise claim, it is an evil against Anna, Aššur, the king and the rabi sikkitim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er šu-mì-abi₄-a e-lá-ma i-šu
target: 0.5 mina of refined silver Šumi-abiya owes to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-štimm ša DINGIR-na-da 1 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám i ITU.1.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
target: From the week of Ilī-nādā he will add 1 shekel as interest per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-wa-an ù a-ḫu-šu me-er-ú ḫa-ar-ša-a a-na ša-lim-a-šùr me-er-e-šu ù me-er-e i-dí-a-bi-im a-na mì-ma šu-um-šu ú-lá i-tù-ru
target: Aššuwan and his brothers, sons of Harša, will not raise claim against Šalim-Aššur, his sons and Iddin-abum's sons for anything whatsoever.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM bé-el-tí-É.GAL-lim li-mu-um PUZUR₄-(d)MUŠ
target: Month: Belet-ekallim, eponymy: Puzur-Nirah.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr ù a-šu-wa-an i-mì-ig-ru-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur and Aššuwan reached an agreement

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-iš a-na ni-iš (d)a-šùr ni-iš ru-ba-im ni-iš GAL sí-ki-tim wa-li-iš-ra ù ni-iš e-ba-ru-tim ša a-wa-tí-šu-nu ig-mu-ru-ni it-mu-ú-ma
target: and they swore an oath by Anna, Aššur, the king, the rabi sikkitim Wališra and by the colleagues who settled their affair, so that

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr DUMU i-sú-rik₁₃ ù a-šu-wa-an-zi DUMU ḫa-ar-ša
target: Šalim-Aššur son of Issu-arik and Aššuwan(zi) son of Harša,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša dí-nam ru-ba-um ù GAL sí-ki-tim dí-nam i-dí-nu-ni-ma
target: for whom the king and the rabi sikkitim had given a verdict,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ḫa-ra-am ša šál-ma-a-šùr a-na i-id i-dí-nu-ni
target: stating that they should give a servant of Šalim-Aššur to the river ordeal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-um-a-šur DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šur
target: Witnessed by Ennam-Aššur son of Puzur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim i li-bi be-lúm-ba-ni DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: All this Bēlum-bāni son of Aššur-bēl-awātim owes to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ 0.83334 GÍN.TA 0.5 SÌLA Ì.GIŠ 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: 10 minas of good copper at the rate of 0.83334 shekel, 0.5 litre of oil, and 1 shekel of silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: a šu-mì zu-ku-a e-pu-li
target: he balanced for the sake of Zukuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 2 ANŠE.ḪI.A ša e-lá-ma ù lá-qé-ep a-lá-ḫu-um ù ḫi-na-a uk-ta-nu-ma
target: Concerning 2 donkeys belonging to Elamma and Lā-qēp, Ali-ahum and Hinnaya will establish the facts.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-nu-nu DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR
target: Seal of Šu-Nūnu son of Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar i-bu-ru-ni 0.5 ma-na.TA KÙ.BABBAR e-la-ma ú la-qé-ep i-la-qé-ú
target: Wherever they establish liability, Elamma and Lā-qēp will take 0.5 mina of silver each.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ší-bu-tí-a ša IGI šu-ga-ri-a-im ša a-šùr
target: Tablet of my testimony before the šugarri'ā'um of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-bar-tum ša ša-mu-ḫa i-dí-ni-ma
target: The station of Šamuha gave it to me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am a-dí-in
target: and I gave the tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 22 šu-ru-tum 11 ma-na 10 GÍN AN.NA 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 0.5 ku-ta-nim
target: 22 dark textiles, 11 minas 10 shekels of tin, 12 shekels of silver the price of 0.5 textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 5 ANŠE.ḪI.A i li-bi₄ a-lá-ḫi-im
target: And 2.5 minas of silver, the price of 5 donkeys, are due by Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ku-bu-um a-na a-šùr-DU₁₀ qí-bi₄-ma
target: Thus says Šu-Kūbum: say to Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša a-dí KÙ.BABBAR ta-áš-ta-na-pá-ra-ni
target: Why is it that you keep writing to me about the silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR a-na kur-ub-IŠTAR áš-qúl
target: The rest of the silver I have now paid to Kurub-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bu-ša-lim mì-ma lá il₅-qé
target: Abu-šalim has taken nothing of it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tù-a IGI a-bu-ša-lim-ma i-gi₅-im-ra
target: My affairs were actually settled in the presence of Abu-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ku-ra-áš-mì-iš DUMU GAL-na-pá-ḫi-im
target: Seal of Kurašmiš son of the chief of smiths.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB bu-li-na DUMU ra-bi₄-ša-qí-im
target: Seal of Bulina son of the chief cupbearer.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šé-zu-ur DUMU kà-zu-ba
target: Seal of Šezur son of Kazuba.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šu-wa-an DUMU ḫa-ar-ša
target: Seal of Ašuwan son of Harša.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-zu DUMU kà-zu
target: Seal of Azu son of Kazu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ú-ra-a KIŠIB (d)MAR.TU-ba-ni me-er-ú ma-na-na
target: Seal of Uraya and the seal of Amurrum-bāni, sons of Manana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB zu-ba DUMU IŠTAR-pá-li-il₅
target: Seal of Zuba son of Ištar-pālil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-de₈-lá-at DUMU (d)IM-ba-ni
target: Seal of Adad-ellat son of Adad-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu té-er-tí i-li-kà-kum
target: And as my instructions went to you twice:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma lá ta-áš-ta-na-pá-ra-am
target: Do not keep writing to me at all about the silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tí-a a-šur-ma-lik ù kur-ub-IŠTAR ú-ga-me-ru-ma
target: Aššur-mālik and Kurub-Ištar have settled my case,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-nu-mì-šu-ma a-na kur-ub-IŠTAR áš-qúl
target: and at that time I paid 3 minas of silver to Kurub-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-tur₄-DINGIR-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
target: Thus says Itūr-ilī: say to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum KÙ.BABBAR 5 ma-na lá ús-ma-sà-a
target: Urgent! Is silver up to 5 minas not fitting?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma šu-pu-ur-ma me-er-ú a-we-lim li-li-ku-ni-ma
target: They said: Write so that the man's sons come here,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-li ús-ma-at-ni a-ta-ma mì-li-ik
target: and then you yourself decide what is fitting.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí a-wa-tim ša a-bi-kà
target: As for the matter of your father

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša a-na be-el KÙ.BABBAR ú-ma-li-ú-ma ma-ga-ra-am lá i-mu-ú-ni-ni
target: for which I paid the owners of the silver and they would not agree with me

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ma-am a-wi-lu im-ta-ag-ru-ni
target: today the men have agreed

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-at-ku-nu le-qé-a-ni
target: and take up your matter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am ša É ša-ni-a-am SIG₅ x ša x x ù ḫa-ra-ni-a šé-bi₄-lam-ma
target: Send me 1 talent of washed copper of the second house, of good quality, for my journey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma mì x ma-na.TA URUDU ú e-li-iš ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR URUDU ma-as-a-am le-qé-a-ma
target: And take washed copper for 10 minas of silver at the rate of x minas of copper or higher.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-šu ḫa-ar-ma-am ú-kà-al
target: I hold his certified tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR i-tù-wa-ar
target: The silver will return in full.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU a-zu-za-a ḫa-bu-lam
target: Aššur-ṭāb son of Azuzaya owes me 1 mina 10 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma
target: Let your report come to me

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na-kam lá-áš-qú-ul
target: so I may pay the silver here

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ANŠE lu-šé-ri-a-kum
target: and I shall send a donkey to you

source: translate Akkadian to English: GAN-lam a šu-m
target: It should pass overland in his name.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 DUG GIG KI wa-lá-a
target: 2 jars of wheat are with Walā.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 DUG GIG KI ša-pu-na-aḫ-šu
target: 3 jars of wheat are with Šapunahšu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 DUG ŠE-um KI wa-lá-ma
target: 3 jars of barley are also with Walā.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DUG GIG KI wa-al-ku
target: 1 jar of wheat is with Walku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ma-i lu-qú-sú a KÙ.BABBAR i-da-ma
target: If Ama'ī sells his goods for silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-ra-an sú-ki-ni-ma i-ta-lá-ak
target: and has departed on the narrow track.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir ù SIG₅-pí-a-šur a-na a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur
target: Thus say Man-mahir and Damiq-pī-Aššur to Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 DUG GIG KI ḫu-da
target: 3 jars of wheat are with Huda.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ta ú šu-ut ku-un-kà-ma
target: Then you and he seal 2.33333 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-ri-a ú a-ṣé-er ša ki-ma šu-a-tí šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: And send it to me and to his representative.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 DUG GIG 3 a-za-mì-lá-tum tí-ib-nim KI a-šur-ma-lik DUMU (d)a-šur-(d)UTU-ši
target: 1 jar of wheat and 3 sacks of straw are with Aššur-malik son of Aššur-šamšī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 na-ru-uq 2 DUG ŠE-um KI i-na-ar DUMU e-lá-lí
target: 1 sack and 2 jars of barley are with Inar son of Elālī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 7 na-ru-uq lu ŠE-um lu ar-ša-tum
target: Total: 7 sacks, whether barley or wheat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí um-mì-iš-ḫa-ra ù en-um-a-šùr pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù šu-be-lúm i-mì-ig-ru-ma
target: Pilah-Ištar and Šu-Bēlum reached an agreement with Ummī-Išhara and Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 3 ša-na-tim qá-qí-ri-šu-nu ú-bu-bu-šu-nu-tí
target: They will effectuate the clearance of their plot for them within three years.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 na-ru-uq 3 DUG ŠE-um ŠÀ.BA 2 DUG ar-ša-tum
target: 1 sack and 3 jars of barley, including 2 jars of wheat,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KI du-nu-um-na ṣú-ḫa-ri-im ša ḫa-šu-i GAL re-i
target: are with Dunumna, the servant of Hašui the chief shepherd.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-um en-na-sú-en₆ DUMU šu-a-šùr
target: eponymy: Enna-Suen son of Šu-Aššur

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ú-bi-bu-ú
target: If they fail to do so,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na ša kur-ub-IŠTAR i-lá-qé-ú-ma
target: they will take 3 minas of silver from that of Kurub-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí um-mì-a-an e-lá-ma a-bi-šu-nu um-mì-iš-ḫa-ra ù en-um-a-šùr ú-bu-bu
target: When Ummī-Išhara and Ennam-Aššur effectuate a clearance with the investors of their father Elamma,

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-qí-ri-šu-nu i-lá-qé-ú
target: they will take their plot.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im qá-qí-ri-šu-nu ušt-ta-bu-ú-ma
target: They will be satisfied with the price of their plot

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na qá-qí-ri-šu-nu ù-lá i-tù-ru
target: and will not return to claim their plot.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša kur-ub-IŠTAR qá-tí pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù šu-be-lim ša-ak-na-at
target: A claim of Pilah-Ištar and Šu-Bēlum rests upon the 3 minas of silver of Kurub-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-nàm pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù šu-be-lúm a-na um-mì-iš-ḫa-ra ù en-um-a-šur qá-sú-nu ik-bu-sú-ma
target: Regarding this silver, Pilah-Ištar and Šu-Bēlum waived their claim in favor of Ummī-Išhara and Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lá-áš šu-ba-tim qá-qí-ri ša 5-tum i-dí-nu-šu-nu-tí-ni
target: for 3 house-units of land which the committee of five had given them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma té-bi-ib-tum i-tab-ší qá-dí a-ḫi-šun
target: If a clearance occurs, they will be cleared along with their brothers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 6.66666 ma-na ša É ḫi-na-a
target: 6.66666 minas of silver of the house of Hinnaya

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša kur-ub-IŠTAR DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im
target: 4 minas of silver of Kurub-Ištar son of Ali-ahum

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i-na ku-ur-sí-nim ša IŠTAR-pì-lá-aḫ 1.3333300000000001 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR na-dí-šu-nu-tí
target: and 1.33333 mina of silver from the pot of Ištar-pilah have been deposited for them

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ir-ma-a-šur a-na a-lim(ki) a-šur ú-ba-al-šu
target: Ir'am-Aššur will bring that silver to the City, Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ḫu-bu-ul en-um-a-šur a-na DAM.GÀR i-ša-qal
target: He will pay it to the merchant for the debt of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a šu-mì en-um-a-šur GÁN-lam e-tí-iq
target: The silver will cross the territory in the name of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ANŠE ṣa-lá-ma-am a-na-nu-um a-na šé-bu-lim le-qé-am
target: Take a black donkey from here for the shipment.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na bu-ur-sú-in a-lá-ḫi-im a-lá-bi₄-ma ù ì-lí-mì-tí qí-bi₄-ma um-ma tám-kà-ru-ma
target: To Būr-Suen, Alāhum, Alā-abum, and Ilī-imittī say: thus the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR DUMU e-lá-ma
target: Witnessed by Pilah-Ištar son of Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-ba-ni DUMU du-mu-uq-IŠTAR
target: Witnessed by Aššur-bāni son of Dumuq-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a bu-ur-sú-in ù ì-lí-mì-tí na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: Būr-Suen and Ilī-imittī are bringing you 1.5 minas of silver under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta lá i-sà-ri-ru
target: My dear brother, they should not delay;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭù-ur-da-nu-šú
target: send them to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a qá-tí bu-ur-sú-in ù ì-lí-mì-tí di-in
target: and give it to Būr-Suen and Ilī-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 45 na-ru-uq ŠE-am x na-ru-uq ar-ša-tim
target: 45 sacks of barley, x sacks of wheat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma ša ša-da-aq-tí 45 na-ru-uq ŠE-am 5 na-ru-uq ar-ša-tum
target: Further, from last year, 45 sacks of barley and 5 sacks of wheat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta i-ḫi-id-ma URUDU a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-e-ra-ma
target: My dear brother, take care to convert the copper into silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ší-im URUDU ša ṣú-ḫa-ru i-qá-bi₄-ú-ni-ku-ni i-na ša-ḫa-tí-šú-nu i-zi-iz-ma
target: and assist the servants with the proceeds from the copper which they mention to you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-am ša-ma-am
target: and then carry out a purchase.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ú-li-id ší-im-tám al-qé
target: In the presence of Ulid, I took the inheritance.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ar-ša-tim ŠE-am al-qé
target: I took barley instead of wheat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11.5 ma-na URUDU ší-ku-um i-ṣé-er sú-kà-li-im lu-zi i-šu
target: Sukkallum owes 11.5 minas of šiku-copper to Luzi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ú-zu-a IGI i-dí-a-bi₄-im
target: Witnessed by Uzuwa, by Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am 4 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu ù 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù a-ḫa-ma 0.66666 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-lá-at ṣú-ḫa-ri-im
target: 10 talents of washed copper, 4 black donkeys and 2 minas of silver, plus further 0.6666 mina 2 shekels of silver, the working-capital for the servant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-ni-im bu-ur-sú-in a-lá-bu-um ù ì-lí-mì-tí na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: Būr-Suen, Alī-abum and Ilī-imittī are bringing all this to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a qá-tí-šú a-dí-in
target: 3 shekels of silver I gave him for expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù u₄-mì-im ša AN.NA i-lá-qé-ú 15 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-lá-ak-ma
target: From the day he receives the tin, fifteen weeks will pass and then

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-ḫu-wa-qar i-ša-qal
target: Ahu-waqar will pay 8.3333 minas of refined silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ITU.1.KAM áb-ša-ra-ni li-mu-um ku-bi-a-a
target: Reckoned from the month Ab-šarrāni, eponymy Kūbiya,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tam ú-ṣa-áb
target: he must add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-a be-lá-lá-a ú-bi₄-il₅
target: Belalaya brought 2.3333 minas of refined silver under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a pá-ni-ri
target: 2 shekels of silver for paniru-garments.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì a-ḫu-wa-qar iš-tù a-lim(ki) i-tù-ra-ni
target: When Ahu-waqar returns from the City,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-uq-lam ku-nu-ki ša a-lim(ki) xxx ù e-lá-ma i-pá-ṭù-ru-ma
target: [PN and] Elamma will open the packet with the seals of the City and

source: translate Akkadian to English: 50 ma-na AN.NA i-du-nu-šú-ma
target: they will give him 50 minas of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.5 ma-na URUDU ša 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR sà-ḫe-er-tám
target: 3.5 minas of copper with a value of 4 shekels of silver for small wares.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-ni-im xx ú a-šùr-mu-ta-pì-il₅ ub-lu
target: Aššur-mūtappil brought all this.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI (d)I-ba-ni DUMU ga-na-a
target: In the presence of Adad-bāni, son of Ganaya,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-šur-SIPA-ma
target: Say to Elamma, thus Aššur-rē’ī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-i-mì-tí 0.33333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN KÙ.GI a-ta-aḫ-šú ú-bi₄-il₅-šú-um
target: As for Aššur-imittī, 25 shekels of silver and 1 shekel of gold Atahšu brought him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša a-lim(ki) i-li-kam
target: A letter of the City has arrived.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ 20 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki
target: 4 talents and 20 minas of tin under seal

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 me-at 21 TÚG mì-ma a-ni-im a-ra-de₈-a-kum
target: and 121 textiles, all this I am leading to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-ḫe-er ṭup-pì-ni a-na kà-ar kà-ar-ma ú wa-bar-ra-tim šé-bi₄-lá
target: Send a copy of this letter of ours to every colony and to all the trading stations.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš-ma
target: Thus the colony of Kanesh:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-qí-il₅ da-tim ší-ip-ri-ni kà-ar kà-ar-ma ú wa-bar-ra-tim qí-bi₄-ma
target: say to the payers of the datu-contribution, to our messengers, and to every colony and trading station:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.AN lu a-na DAM.GÀR-ru-tim i-dí-in
target: Even when somebody has sold amūtu-iron via a trading agent,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-mì a-wi-lim lu-up-ta-nim
target: register the name of that man.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṭup-pì-im ša a-lim(ki) iš-tù u₄-mì-im a-nim ma-ma-an KÙ.AN i-ša-ú-mu-ni
target: In the letter of the City (it says): from this day on, whoever buys amūtu-iron.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na né-mè-lim da-šùr ú-lá e-WA iš-ra-tí-šú
target: (the City of) Aššur will not share in the profit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-lá-qé
target: the colony of Kanesh will collect the tithe of it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i-na a-lim(ki) 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR bé-ú-lá-at ḫa-al-gi-a-šú a-šur-i-mì-tí il₅-qé
target: And in the City, Aššur-imittī took 0.5 mina of silver, the working capital of Halgiaššu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: Send me your report.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì a-šur-i-mì-tí a-na a-lim(ki) i-li-ku
target: When Aššur-imittī went to the City,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 2 ma-na ú 3 ma-na a-na ra-mì-ni-šú na-ší
target: he brought some 2 or 3 minas of silver on his own.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na na-áp-ṭá-ar ku-pá-im i-ša-qú-lu
target: they are to pay at the melting of the snow.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá ṣú-ba-tí ù AN.NA a-na ra-mì-ni-šú na-áš-ú za-ki-ma
target: Clear whatever textiles and tin he brings on his own.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí-šú li-ib-ší
target: Let it remain with him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ša qá-qí-dí-kà lu-qú-tí ù e-ma-ri-a
target: and guard my goods and my donkeys like your own life

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá a-wi-lu-tí-kà ša-ṣí-ir
target: as you are a gentleman.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ṣí-ba-tim ša a-šur-i-mì-tí mì-ma lá i-sà-li-ma
target: Also, with respect to the matters of Aššur-imittī, he must not lie,

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-bi₄ lá i-ma-ra-ṣa-kum
target: lest I become angry with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ṭup-pì-ni ta-áš-me-a-ni
target: As soon as you have heard our letter,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam lu a-na ší-mì-im a-na É.GAL-lim i-dí-in lu té-ra-at É.GAL-lim ú-kà-lim lu na-ší-ma a-dí-ni lá i-dí-in
target: whoever there has either sold it to a palace, or has offered it to palace officials, or still carries it with him without having yet sold it -

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá KÙ.AN na-áš-ú ni-bi₄-it a-ší-im šu-um-šú ú šu-mì a-bi₄-šú i-na ṭup-pì-im lu-up-ta-nim-ma
target: for all the amūtu-iron he carries, write the exact amount of every piece, his name and his father's name on a tablet and

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí ší-ip-ri-ni šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: send it here with our messenger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp ú-zu-a i-na li-bi-a ḫi-na-a il₅-qé
target: Hinnāya took 3.5 minas of Uzua's silver at my expense.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-mì-a-nu-šú a-na ší-a-ma-tim ú-ra-ki-sú-ni
target: His investors had contractually bound me for making purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-na-a-ma a-na a-šur-DU₁₀ ú MAN-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Innaya to Aššur-ṭāb and Puzur-Aššur: Speak!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 4.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na li-bi wa-al-di-lim i-na e-ra-bi-šú-ma ú-šé-ba-lam
target: Furthermore, he will send 4.5 shekels of silver from the assets of Wald-Ilim upon his arrival.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ru-ba-um ù ru-ba-tum a-na ḫa-ra-na-tim ša pá-zu-ur-tim iš-pu-ru-ma
target: The king and queen here have written to the road-guards concerning smuggling.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na ša ḫa-ra-an sú-ki-nim iš-ta-áp-ru
target: Also, they have written to those of the Narrow Track.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim DUMU šu-a-nim
target: In the presence of Aššur-bēl-awātim son of Šu-Anum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-nam-(d)IŠKUR DUMU zi-ra
target: and of Ennam-Adad son of Zira.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na ḫa-ra-an sú-ki-nim mì-ma lá ta-ša-kà-na
target: And do not commit anything to the Narrow Track.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum AN.NA ù TÚG.ḪI.A lá tù-pá-za-ra
target: Urgent: do not smuggle tin and textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum a-wa-tum da-na-at
target: Urgent: the orders are strict.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma ša i ma-tim TÚG.ḪI.A ù AN.NA na-áš-ú ma ta-ma ra ni ṣa-áb-ta-ma
target: They said: "Seize anyone you observe carrying textiles and tin in the land."

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA ú TÚG.ḪI.A a-tù-nu kà-i-lá-ma ra-ga am i-a-tí ri-id-a-am
target: And then withhold the tin and textiles and lead the criminal to me."

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma e šé-bi₄-lá-ma
target: Do not send anything

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-ba-ak-nu e im-ra-aṣ
target: lest you be sorry

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ší-ta-me-šu-ma
target: Hear the letter repeatedly

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-DU₁₀ šé-bi₄-il₅-šu
target: and send it to Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-bi₄-ma a-na bé-lá-num DUMU šu-a-šur AN.NA ip-qí-id
target: Kubiya entrusted the tin to Belanum, the son of Šu-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na wa-ar-ki-tim lu-qú-tum i-ṣí-bi-it-ma
target: Afterwards merchandise was seized

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tám ša a-sà-nim É.GAL-lúm i-ta-ba-al
target: and the palace took away Asanum's merchandise.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ḫu-ra-ma a-na É ku-bi-a iš-té-ni-iš e-ru-bu-ma
target: In Hurama they together entered Kubiya's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-is-ḫa-tí-šu-nu É.GAL-lúm iš-té-ni-iš i-sú-úḫ
target: The palace levied the import-tax from them together.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ḫa-ru-ú a-sà-nim ša É ás-qú-dim ú pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR DUMU e-lá-ma ḫa-ra-nam iš-té-ni-iš i-li-ku-nim-ma
target: The servants of Asanum, who belongs to the house of Asqudum, and Pilah-Ištar, son of Elamma, together went on a journey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA ša pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR É ku-bi-a ú-pá-zi-ru-ma
target: The tin that Pilah-Ištar had hidden in Kubiya's house

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na É ub-ri iš-lim-ma
target: was safe in the guest house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR im-ṣí-ma AN.NA il₅-qé
target: and he was entitled in the name of Pilah-Ištar to take the tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: And we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá ṭup-pí-im ša a-lim(ki) kà-ru-um ḫu-ra-ma ṣa-ḫe-er GAL i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: In accordance with the tablet of the City, the plenary Hurama colony gave us (as witnesses).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um iš-tí PUZUR₄-a-na ni-a-im iš-tù-i-ša-qal
target: 10 minas of refined silver is owed by our own Puzur-Anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i da-na-ma
target: He will give 20 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-tí a-ša-kà-an
target: I shall lay claim to it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku ù kà-sí-a a-na 30 ḫa-am-ša-tim
target: From the week of Aššur-taklaku and Kasiya the term is for 30 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ir-ma-a-šur DUMU a-šur-ma-lik
target: by Ir'am-Aššur, son of Aššur-malik,

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-bu-ša-lim DUMU šu-IŠTAR
target: and by Abu-šalim, son of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qúl 0.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM a-na 1 ma-na-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid, he will add interest at the rate of 0.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PUZUR₄-(d)IM DUMU i-dí-IŠTAR
target: Witnessed by Puzur-Adad son of Iddin-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI du-um-qá-a DUMU kur-ub-a-a
target: Witnessed by Dumqaya son of Kurub-aya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-ku-za DUMU šu-a-nim
target: Sealed by Akuza son of Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB lá-qé-ep DUMU (d)AB-ba-ni
target: By La-qep son of Enlil-bani.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ṣí-lu-lu DUMU ú-ku
target: By Silulu son of Uku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-né-eš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr i-na ba-áb DINGIR ṭup-pá-am ni-dí-in
target: And we gave a tablet before Aššur's dagger in the Gate of the God.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi-we-du-um i-ra-dí-a-ku-um
target: Abi-wedum is now leading that to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-ut-kà ša i-na a-pí-im té-zi-bu-ma lá-ta-ra-ak iṣ-ba-at
target: Latarak has seized your merchandise that you left behind in Apum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì a-wa-tim ša É sà-ba-sí-a a-wu-tum ša ma-aḫ-ri-kà lá iz-ku-ú
target: Concerning the matter of Sabasiya's house, the case that was not settled in your presence.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-ša-dí-li-ma a-na ku-li-a ù a-šur-la-ma-sí
target: Thus says Aššur-šadu-ili to Kuliya and Aššur-lamassi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma
target: To Kuliya specifically speak.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-et-kà URUDU KÙ.GI ú-ṣú-ra-num ta-da-nam lá i-mu-a
target: As for your house, Usuranum refuses to give either copper or gold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ša-qú-ul
target: saying: "All has already been paid!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: áš-me-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ší-bu-tim ú ší-ip-ra-am al-qé-ma
target: I heard it and I obtained a tablet of the elders and a messenger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-pí-im i-li-ik-ma lu-qú-tám ú-ší-ir-ma
target: He went to Apum and released the merchandise.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma li-ba-kà lá i-pá-ri-id
target: There is absolutely no reason to get nervous.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-pí-ra-am ša ša-ku-ul-tim ú ku-ku-ba-tim É DAM.GÀR ni-il₅-qé-ma
target: We took beer bread for the banquet and flasks from a merchant's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na DAM ili₅-ba-ni ni-dí-in
target: We gave them to Ili-bani's wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-wi-lu-tí-kà lu-qú-ut-kà a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-e-er-ma
target: Gentleman as you are, convert your merchandise into silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: and come here immediately.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta tí-de₈-e ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN ša qá-tim a-na ša-ku-ul-tim
target: My brother, realize that every single shekel of silver at hand is for the banquet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im SIG₅ a-na a-šur-ṣú-lu-lí dí-in
target: Give the yield of the good quality textiles to Aššur-sululi;

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-bu-šu lá tù-lá-ma-an
target: do not make him angry.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 24 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-dí-a-bu-um a-na a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim ḫa-bu-lu
target: Concerning the fact that Iddin-abum owes 24 minas of silver to Aššur-bēl-awātim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É-tí am-tám ù ÌR-dí-e a-na ša ki-ma ša-lim-a-šùr ú-wa-šé-er
target: He will release the houses, the maid and the slaves to Šalim-Aššur's representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ku-bu-um me-ra-šu É-tí ša ša-lim-a-šùr wa-áš-bu ik-nu-uk-ma
target: His son Šu-Kubum has sealed the houses where Šalim-Aššur lives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: am-tám ù ÌR-dí ú-šé-ṣí-ma
target: And taken out the maid and the slaves.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-al-DU₁₀ iš-qú-ul
target: Al-ṭāb has paid that silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-tám ša ša-lim-a-šur šu-ku-bu-um DUMU a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim a-na ḫu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi-im il₅-qé-ma
target: Šu-Kubum son of Aššur-bēl-awātim has taken Šalim-Aššur's share to cover Iddin-abum's debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony has given us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before the dagger of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ší-il₅-ma-šu IGI šu-pu-nu-ma-an
target: In the presence of Šilmašu and Šuppunuman.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na a-mu-tim ša É a-lim(ki) ša-lim-a-šur i-sí-ú-ma
target: But out of the iron that Šalim-Aššur claimed at the City Hall

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí i-dí-a-šùr DUMU a-šùr-ma-lik ad-mu-ma
target: and invested with Iddin-Aššur son of Aššur-malik

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na kà-ni-iš ú-šé-bi₄-lu-ni-ni
target: and which they brought to Kanesh

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.83333 ma-na 6.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša sú-ḫu-ur-pì-a-lá a-na sú-e-ta-ta ḫa-bu-lu
target: 56.5 shekels of silver which Suhurpiyala owes to Suettata.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-al-DU₁₀ i-lá-ak-ma
target: He will make a business trip

source: translate Akkadian to English: né-mu-lu-um i-ta-áb-ší
target: and if there is profit

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-né-mì-li-im i-lá-qé
target: he will take it from the profit

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-ak-nu ḫa-ar-ma-am ú-kà-al
target: I hold your certified tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-ma-li-ib-ší ù Ì-lí-a-lim qí-bi-ma
target: Specifically to Šuma-libši and Ilī-ālum: Speak!

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma né-mu-lu-um lá-šu KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú a-li-a ù ḫa-ar-ša a-na a-al-DU₁₀ i-ša-qú-lu
target: If there is no profit, Aliya and Harša will pay the silver and the interest on it to Al-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ḫa-bu-lá-tù-nu
target: You owe 14 shekels of refined silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma a-na šu-ma-li-ib-ší Ì-lí-a-lim ù a-mur-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma
target: From Šu-Ištar to Šuma-libši, Ilī-ālum and Amur-Ištar: Speak!

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-mu-ku-nu ša-na-at e-tí-qú
target: Your terms are overdue by a year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR KÙ.BABBAR-áp tám-kà-ri-im
target: The silver was merchant-silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú a-na a-mur-IŠTAR šu-qú-ul
target: Pay the silver and its interest there to Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-bu-šu lá i-lá-mì-in
target: Lest he gets angry.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ši-a-im i-ma-gu₅-ru
