source: translate Akkadian to English: a-da-šu-ma
target: I will sell it

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta-lá-kam
target: and leave for you

source: translate Akkadian to English: i ší-be-a a-zu kà-ṣa-ar PUZUR₄-a-mur
target: Among my witnesses is Azu, the transporter of Puzur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na lá i-da-i-a a-mì-ša-am i-tal-kam
target: Without my knowledge he has left for there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na e-lá-lí a-lá-ak
target: He said: 'I am going to Elalī.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-i na-áš-pè-er-tí-kà ša a-šu-mì kà-lá-pí-im i-li-kà-ni
target: As for your letter which arrived here concerning the axe,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bé-e a-dí-ni lá ah-ri-im
target: I have not yet recorded the witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-lí a-ta a-na a-na PUZUR₄-a-mur pu-nu-ma
target: Please, my lord, approach Puzur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-zu-ú li-ìṭ-ru-dam
target: Let him send Azu to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ša-lá-ší-šu qá-dum ša ha-ra-an a-lim(ki) ha-ra-nam ú-qá
target: Three times I waited for the caravan together with those on the road to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-dí-na-kum
target: I gave you 10 shekels of refined silver for purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur ù SIG₅-pí-a-šur
target: To Ennam-Aššur and Damiq-pī-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na SIG₅-pí-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-ta-na-ma
target: Specifically to Damiq-pī-Aššur, from Šāt-Anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-ta-na-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Šāt-Anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam KÙ.BABBAR ú ší-a-ma-tí-šu a-na en-um-a-šur šu-qál
target: Pay the silver or the goods bought with it there to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU šál-ma-a-šur
target: To Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 12.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-dí-na-ku-ni
target: Concerning the 2 minas 12.5 shekels of silver that I gave you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x lá ša ku-lu ša aq-bi₄-a-ku-ni lu TÚG-ba-tí lu AN.NA ša-dí-šu-ma šé-bi₄-lam
target: As for everything I told you, sell either the textiles or the tin and send (the silver) to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-hi a-ta be-lí a-ta
target: My dear brother, my dear lord,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-am e-pu-uš-ma
target: carry out the purchase yourself

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-ni-im-ma šé-bi-lam
target: and send it with the very first transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša hu-bu-ul a-šur-ba-ni DUMU sú-ku-ku
target: Of the debt of Aššur-bāni, son of Sukkuku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na e-tí-šu i-ša-qal
target: He will pay 0.66666 mina of silver at the agreed time.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM áb-ša-ra-ni li-mu-um ip-hu-ru-um
target: Month Ab-šarrāni, eponymy of Iphurum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR hi-na-a i-šé-e-šu
target: Hinnāya will sue him for 1 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: (TÚG)pá-ra-kà-nu-kà ú ší-tí Ì.GIŠ a-na-kam a-dí-in
target: I have given your parakannu-textiles and the rest of the oil here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ba-ší-ú ša ki-ma ša-zu-za-tí-kà a-mì-ša-am i-ta-al-ku-nim
target: Those who represent your agents have departed for there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ìš-qú-ul
target: If he does not pay,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na-um 0.33333 ma-na i-lá-ak-šu-um
target: 0.33333 mina per mina will accrue for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN lá a-kà-al
target: I do not consume even one shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ni-ki-iš-tám ša kà-ri-im ša ki-ma a-na nu-a-im mì-ma ší-mì-im ma-ma-an lá i-du-nu
target: Here, (due to) the decree of the colony, no one gives any price to the native.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-hi a-ta
target: You are my brother

source: translate Akkadian to English: té-er-ta-kà a-ni-tum lá a-ni-tum li-li-kam
target: let your report come to me whether this or not

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šùr na-áš-a-kum
target: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur is bringing to you 0.33333 mina and 1 shekel of silver under our seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá AN.NA ù (TÚG)ṣú-ba-tí ša qá-tim i-na ba-áb DINGIR-lim i-za-ku-ú
target: As much tin and ordinary textiles as they clear at the Gate of the God.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ITU.2.KAM i-ša-qal
target: He will pay the silver in 2 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma um-me-a-an ša-lim-a-šur a-na AN.NA ù x x x na ší TÚG ša en-na-nim x zu
target: If the investors of Šalim-Aššur and Ennam-Aššur raise claims against Ennānum concerning the tin and the textiles of Ennānum.

target: Ennam-Aššur will clear Ennānum son of Amriya with the investors of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-eh-ra-at ta-ah-sí-is-tim a-ni-tim ša ší-be-e-kà
target: A copy of this memorandum with your witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU ta-ha-zi-ra DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šùr DUMU lu-lu i-šu
target: Aššur-malik son of Tahazira owes 0.33333 mina of refined silver to Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur son of Lulu.

target: eponymy Dan-Ea son of Abu-waqar

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul
target: If he does not pay,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR a-na x i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: he shall add interest at 1 shekel of silver per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-mu-ta-bi₄-il₅ DUMU en-um-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Aššur-muttabbil son of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ma-num-ba-lúm-a-šùr DUMU i-ku-nim
target: Witnessed by Mannum-balum-Aššur son of Ikūnum.

target: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur seized the hem of Šu-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-mur-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Aššur-imittī son of Amur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá iš-ta-qal
target: If he has not paid the silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-sú-en-ma a-na mì-nim tù-kà-la-ni
target: Thus says Šu-Suen: 'Why are you holding me?'

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur-ma a-na gám-ri-im ú-kà-al-kà
target: Thus says Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur: 'I hold you for the expenses!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma mì-ma lá ha-bu-lá-ak-šu-ni-ma ú-kà-li-ni
target: Since I owe him nothing, yet he holds me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ni-ìš a-lim(ki) ta-mu-ú lu ú-kà-al
target: 'Let him indeed hold (to) that which was sworn by the life of the City.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-na-sú-in DUMU a-šur-DU₁₀
target: Witnessed by Ennam-Suen, son of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-bu-ša-lim DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim
target: Witnessed by Abu-šalim, son of Aššur-bēl-awātim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tù-um iš-tí-šu-nu i-ba-ší
target: The remainder is with them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 25 ma-na URUDU a-šur-na-da il₅-qé
target: Aššur-nādā took 25 minas of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na a-lá-hu-um ku-ri-um il₅-qé
target: Ali-ahum, the short one, took 10 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 17 ma-na URUDU ù 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ki-iš-da-tí-a ša a-na a-šur-na-da ù ú-zu-a e-zi-bu
target: 1 talent 17 minas of copper and 0.5 mina of silver are my acquisitions which I left to Aššur-nādā and Uzuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ma-na URUDU ší-im ep-ri a-na ú-zu-a e-zi-ib
target: I left 6 minas of copper, the price of rations, to Uzuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi ša-ri-ša a-lá-hi-nim
target: Šariša the miller owes 1 mina 15 shekels of silver.

target: He will pay 0.66666 mina 5 shekels of silver now.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 e-re-qá-tim ša e-ṣé-e a-ni i-ša-da-dam
target: He will now haul 5 wagons of wood.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša ú-sú-me-e i-ša-qal
target: He will pay 0.5 mina of silver at the festival of Usmû.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ší-im 2 UDU iš-tí PUZUR₄-e-nam
target: Puzur-Ennam owes 5 shekels of silver for the price of 2 sheep.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ba-tám iš-tí-in ú ší-na dí-na-ma
target: Sell one or two textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-dí-da ú a-lá-hi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pì-a-šur-ma
target: To Adida and Ali-ahum speak: thus says Damiq-pī-Aššur.

target: Let the silver, the price of 1 textile, and the copper be available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na (d)UTU-ši a-ba-a e-ra-ba-ni
target: On the day Abāya arrives,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ANŠE-ri ú ṣú-ha-ru lá i-bi-tù
target: do not let the donkeys and servants spend the night;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭur₄-da-ni-šu-nu
target: send them to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na um-mì-a-ni-a a-la-hi-im a-šur-re-ṣí da-dí-a ù en-nam-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma um-ma e-la-ma-ma
target: To my principals, Ali-ahum, Aššur-rēṣī, Dadiya and Ennam-Aššur, thus Elamma:

target: Kadutala brings you 15 shekels under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-a-bu-um-ma a-na ša-lim-ma mu-za ù kà-du-ta-lá qí-bi-ma

target: Aššur-nādā is bringing to you 16.6666 minas of refined silver, under my seals, its excise added, his transport fee paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: SÍG.ḤI.A a-ší-ni-pì-a na-ás-ha
target: The wool has been deducted for my two-thirds.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na ma-la té-er-tí i-li-kà-ku-nu-tí-ni 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ṣí-ib-tim ta-al-qé-a-nim
target: If, following my instruction that reached you, you have indeed borrowed 30 minas of silver at interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ší-ma-am ta-áš-a-ma-nim
target: And you have made purchases for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-šar ta-al-qé-a-ni ta-e-ra
target: Then pay back the silver where you have borrowed it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma la ta-al-qé-a-nim
target: If you have not (yet) borrowed it,

source: translate Akkadian to English: x a-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-šur-na-da na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí-ni ku-ta-ni ša-ma-ni-ma
target: then buy for me kutanu-textiles for the silver which Aššur-nādā is bringing you

source: translate Akkadian to English: iḥ-da-ma a-na ba-ra-im li-ik-šu-du-nim
target: and take care that they reach me before the suspension of traffic.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ITU-x-KAM a-li-kam-ma
target: I came here x months ago

source: translate Akkadian to English: tù-na-a-ni
target: and you cheat me!

source: translate Akkadian to English: pí-a ša ni-iš a-lim(ki) ú ru-ba-im ta-mu-ú lu ú-kà-al
target: Keep in mind what was sworn by the City and the king!

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-šé-ra-ku-nu-tí
target: I shall release it for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iḥ-da-ma i-na ša-am-ší ṭup-pí-i ta-ša-me-a-ni i-zi-za-ma
target: Take care to be ready the very day you hear my letter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-ki ša ša-lim-ma a-na kà-du-ta-lá dí-na-ma
target: Give it to Kadutala under Šalimma's seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-ub-lam
target: So he may bring it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a-anim (d)UTU 1 u₄-ma-am a-nim a-šar URUDU ú KÙ.BABBAR ša a-bi-ku-nu ú-kà-lu-ni kà-li-ma-ni
target: Come, show me this very day where they keep your father's copper and silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-bi-ṣú-um ša É ša-lim-a-šur a-na en-um-a-šùr ú a-lá-hi-im me-er-e ša-lim-a-šur iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The attorney of Šalim-Aššur's firm seized us against Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum, Šalim-Aššur's sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ra-bi-ṣú-um-ma
target: And the attorney said:

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá ri-ig-ma-tum ší-bu-tum ra-bi-ṣú-um iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: This is not a formal lawsuit but a witnessed statement; the attorney seized us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma uš-kà-in a-na ší-pár be-lí-a
target: Ennam-Aššur answered: "I submit to the messenger of my lord."

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-a-ni-ma
target: Do not cheat me

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 12 ma-na lá tù-ša-ag-me-ra-ni
target: lest I have an extra expense of at least 12 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 23 tár-dí-ú-tum
target: 23 of smaller size

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-hu-um-ma a-pu-tí-a a-ba-ba e-pu-ul-ma
target: Ali-ahum said: "I answered Ababa right away,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na dur₄-hu-mì-it ú-lá a-lá-ak
target: and I shall not go to Durhumit."

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu nu-ṣí
target: and let us leave

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-ha-ni
target: do not obstruct me

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 le-ú GAL-tum
target: 6 large wooden boards

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 tár-dí-ú-tum
target: 8 of smaller size

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KI ḥa-ma-li-a
target: 10 minas owed by hamalia

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 me-at 27 ma-na URUDU iš-tí ma-li-tí-il₅
target: 127 minas of copper owed by Malitil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 me-at 21 ma-na URUDU ší-ku-um iš-tí i-tur₄-DINGIR ú a-hi-šu
target: 221 minas of šikku-copper owed by Itūr-ilī and his brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 kà-ar-pát kà-mu-né ku-nu-ki-šu
target: Two jars of cumin, with his seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 ú-kà-pè wa-dí-ú-tum mì-ma a-nim ša ku-li-a
target: 13 saddlecloths — all this belongs to Kuliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ i li-bi ur-dim ša i re-eš kà-ri-im dur₄-hu-mì-iš i-za-zu
target: 9 minas of refined copper due from Urdum, who serves karum Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na URUDU ší-kam i li-bi₄ a-šur-i-dí DUMU IŠTAR-ba-ni
target: 1 mina of sikku-copper due from Assur-idi, son of Istar-bani.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ší-na ni-is-ha-tim i-na É.GAL-lim i-le-qé
target: Two (items) were taken as excise by the palace.

source: translate Akkadian to English: pì-ri-kà-nu-um ḥa-lá-aq
target: one pirikannu is lost

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 4 pì-ri-kà-ni ṣú-ha-ru-ú a-na lu-bu-ší-šu-nu il₅-qé
target: Thereof the servants took 4 pirikannus for their clothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 93 pì-ri-kà-ni 7 ma-na.TA a-na SIG₅ im-qú-tù-nim
target: 93 pirikannus fell to (the lot of) the quality (lot) at 7 minas each.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1 me-at pì-ri-kà-ni ú 4 ANŠE.ḤI ṣa-lá-me ša a-na dur₄-hu-mì-it a-na ṣé-er a-bi-ni ub-lu-ni
target: Of the 100 pirikannus and 4 black donkeys that they brought to our father in Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ANŠE me-et
target: 1 donkey is dead

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ANŠE a-na 30 ma-na ta-dín
target: 1 donkey was sold for 30 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 4 ANŠE.ḤI.A 1 ANŠE a-na a-bi₄-ni ni-im-ha-aṣ
target: Of the 4 donkeys, we reserved 1 donkey for our father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá li-bi i-lim-ma um-mì-ki ú ki-lá-lá-ma a-hu-ú-a me-tù
target: Unfortunately your mother and both your brothers are dead.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ì-lí-a a-hi-ki ta-dín
target: 37 shekels of silver she gave to your brother Iliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na (d)NIN.ŠUBUR-ba-ni ta-dín
target: 20 shekels of silver she gave to Ilabrat-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.25 GÍN KÙ.GI ú 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ku-a-tí ta-dín
target: She gave 2 1/4 shekels of gold and 8 shekels of silver to you.

target: Thus Lamassutum, Puzur-Aššur and Ennam-Aššur, say to Ataya, Ir'am-Aššur, Ummī-Išhara and Šīmat-Ištar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ba-áb mu-wa-tim ša um-mì-ki
target: When your mother was on her deathbed,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 me-er-e um-mì-a-ni ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma
target: we seized three affiliated traders

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṣé-er um-mì-ki né-ru-ub-ma
target: and brought them inside to your mother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na bu-lu-uṭ um-mì-ki-ma lá-ma a-na sí-kà-tim nu-úṣ-ú
target: While your mother was still alive, before we left for the campaign.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ì-lí-a i-na ki-ša-ar-ší-im i-ni-dí
target: Iliya was thrown into jail.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI 3 me-er-e um-mì-a-ni ta-ma-lá-ke-ša IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí um-mì-ki i-na bu-ul-ṭí-ša-ma ta-ap-ṭù-ur-ma
target: In the presence of these three affiliated traders your mother Ištar-lamassī, while she was alive, opened her coffers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN i-šu qá-tí-ša ša ib-ší-ú e-mu-ru-ma

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù nu-a-im ga-ma-ar-šu il₅-qé-ú

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu a-na bi-ki-tim ša um-mì-ki ù a-ḣe-ki 0.333
target: 27 shekels of silver have been spent for the bewailing of your mother and your brothers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù i-šu qá-tí-šu ig-mu-ru
target: After he had spent all he had available

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù nu-a-um ša um-mì-ki e-ḣu-zu ì-lí-a me-er-a-sú a-ḣi-iz
target: and (since) Iliya was married with the daughter of the Anatolian, who had married your mother

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er i-dí-IŠTAR i-sú-rik₁₃ i-šu
target: Iddin-Ištar owes 1 mina 10 shekels of silver to Issu-arik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš TUR GAL dí-nam i-dí-ma
target: The plenary Kanesh colony passed the following verdict:

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-de₈-šu-ma e-kál ù i-ša-ti
target: and will eat and drink together with him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÉME a ší-mì-im lá i-da-an
target: He shall not sell the maid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÉME ki-ma aḣ-zu-ni a-ḣi-iz
target: He stays married to the maid just as he has married (her).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-lá qá-bi-ú-ni ú-ṣur-pì-a-šur iš-tí a-ḣi-šu en-um-a-šùr a-na be-et a-bi₄-šu-nu e-ra-ab ú ú-ṣí-ma
target: In conformity with what they have promised, Uṣur-pī-Aššur will enter and leave their paternal house together with his brother Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: té-er-tum a-na a-lim(ki) a-ṣé-er a-ḣa-tí-šu ú a-ḣi-šu i-lá-ak-ma
target: A report will go to the City, to his sisters and his brothers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na a-lá-ki-a lá eš-ta-aq-lu
target: If he has not paid 15 shekels of silver when I arrive

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu ša-ki-li ú-u₄-me-a a-tù-wa-ar-šum
target: then I shall raise claim against him for the silver and the accrued interest for the entire period

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ma-an a ší-mì-im lá i-da-an
target: Nobody shall sell (anything).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí té-er-tum i-tù-ra-ni
target: Until a notice has come back

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-tum₈ ú ú-tù-up-tum i ba-ri-šu-nu
target: the house and its inventory is their common property

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN AN.NA a-lu-wa na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Aluwa brings you 10 shekels of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-gi-im-lí-ma a-na a-zu-ú iš-ta-ah-šu ú ni-wa-la qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Aššur-gimlī to Azu, Ištahšu and Niwala:

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-ah-lá-áp-tám ša ṣú-uh-ri-im a-mur-a-šur ub-lá-ku-nu-tí
target: Amur-Aššur brought you a children's dress.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-tí ma-lá ú 2 ší-ni-šu i-li-kà-ku-nu-tí
target: I sent you word once or twice.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-tù-nu šu-lu-um-ku-nu ma-tí-ma lá i-li-x-kam
target: As for you, no greeting whatever came from you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú šu-ma ša-bi-re-en lá tù-šé-lá-nim tí-ir-ta-ak-nu-ma li-li-kam
target: However, send me word if you do not bring the boots up here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-ni-im-ma ki-ma ṭup-pá-am ta-áš-me-a-ni tí-ir-ta-ak-nu li-li-kam
target: Send me word with the very first transport, as soon as you have heard the letter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-hi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ú-zu-bi-iš-kum DUMU šu-a-nim i-na ší-im SÍG.HI.A ša ú-ší-na-lam il₅-qé
target: Uzub-iškum son of Šu-Anum has received 5 minas of refined silver from the proceeds of Ušinalam's wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-lá-bi-im DUMU šu-a-šùr
target: by Ali-abum son of Šu-Aššur,

source: translate Akkadian to English: pí-ri-kà-nam a-na am-tim ša-a-am
target: and buy a pirikannu-textile for the maid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: áš-pu-ra-ku a-dí ma-lá ù ší-ni-šu um-ma a-na-ku-ma
target: I have written to you both once and twice saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.83333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-dí-da li-dí-na-ku
target: Adida should give you 0.83333 mina 1 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-hi a-ta KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu-nu-ma
target: My dear brother, make them pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: And send me word.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šál sà-ar-dam a-zu lu-ub-lam
target: Azu should bring half (a jar?) of olives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-sà-ba-am ṣú-ba-sà a-zu a-na li-ta-áb-ší-a lu-ub-lam
target: Azu should bring her a tisābu-textile for my dress.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.33333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šur-i-dí DUMU a-mur-a-šur ha-bu-lam e-ri-šu-ma
target: Aššur-idī son of Amur-Aššur owes me 3.3333 shekels of silver; demand it from him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-du-ri DUMU PUZUR₄.IŠTAR
target: Before Aššur-dūrī, son of Puzur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ší-im-ta-ša ta-ší-im-ma
target: Ištar-lamassī made her will as follows:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na ma-nu-ba 0.33333 ma-na 1 GÍN a-lā-hu-um ša É pá-na-kà KÙ.BABBAR i-dí-nu-ni-ku lá i-dí-nu-ni-ku
target: As to 0.5 mina from Manuba, 0.3333 mina 1 shekel from Ali-ahum of Panaka's firm, whether or not they gave it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-ta-kà ma-tí-ma lá i-li-kam
target: No message ever came from you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na (d)NIN.ŠUBUR-ba-ni i-lá-qé
target: Ilabrat-bāni will take 20 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tum ša a-bi-šu-nu a-na ki-lá-le-šu-nu i-za-zu
target: The merchandise of their father belongs to the two of them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša É-tù uk-ta-lu
target: 0.5 mina of silver, for which the house is held (as security).

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1 ma-na LÁ 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša i-ba-ší-ú-ni
target: Of the 57 shekels of silver that are available,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 7 GÍN ì-lí-a i-lá-qé
target: Iliya will take 37 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1-ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na a-lim(ki) a ší-a-ma-tim be-lá-num ú-šé-bi-lá-ni
target: From the 1 mina of silver which I had Bēlānum bring to the City for making purchases,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ik-ri-bi₄-a ša a-šur i-lá-ak
target: 0.6666 mina silver thereof will go to my ikribū-offering belonging to Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.25 GÍN KÙ.GI ù 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù ku-nu-kam a-na DUMU.MÍ-i-a gu₅-ba-ab-tim ú-šé-bu-lu
target: 2 1/4 shekels of gold and 7.5 shekels of silver plus the seal one will send to my daughter who is a gubabtu-priestess.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-šu-nu a-na ì-lí-a i-za-zu
target: The relevant tablets belong to [Iliya?].

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-áb-li-tám ša 1 ma-na ì-lí-a i-lá-qé
target: A qablītu-bowl weighing 1 mina [Iliya] will take.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mu-ša-lam ù šu-ga-ri-a-am (d)NIN.ŠUBUR-ba-ni i-lá-qé
target: The mirror and the šugarriā'um Ilabrat-bāni will take.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ma-ṣí-ì-lí IGI PUZUR₄.IŠTAR IGI en-um-a-šur
target: In the presence of Maṣi-ilī, of Puzur-Ištar, of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um dur₄-hu-mì-it ni-dí-in
target: The Durhumit colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN a-na UDU
target: 1.5 shekel for a sheep.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 DUG GIG 3.6666600000000003 GÍN 15 ŠE áš-qúl
target: For 3 jars of wheat I paid 3 3/4 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 na-ru-uq še-im x 3 GÍN áš-qúl
target: For 1 sack of barley, 3 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ba-ba-zu-a IGI DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur IGI šu-IŠTAR
target: Witnessed by Babazua, Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur, by Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ša um-me-a-nu i li-bi₄-kà iṣ-bu-tù-ni
target: Concerning the 40 talents of good copper that the investors seized in your possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku a-hu-a ù É a-bi₄-a ú-lá ni-tù-ra-kum
target: Neither I nor my brother nor my paternal house will raise further claim against you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN a qá-nu-e ša šu-ru-up-tim áš-qúl
target: 0.5 shekel I paid for reed used as fuel.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN a-na bi-lá-tim e-ṣé áš-qúl
target: 0.5 shekel I paid for a few loads of firewood.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ku-pí-a a-na i-dí-a-šur iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Ikūn-pīya seized us against Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na i-dí-a-šùr-ma
target: Ikūn-pīya said to Iddin-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.16666 GÍN a Ì.NUN áš-qúl
target: 1 / 6 shekel I paid for ghee;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN a-na še-im 2 DUG áš-qúl
target: 1.5 shekel I paid for two jars of barley.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.25 GÍN a-na 1 DUG GIG áš-qúl
target: 1 1/4 shekel I paid for 1 jar of wheat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 GÍN a-na e-ṣé bi-lá-tim áš-qúl
target: 0.3333 shekel I paid for a few loads of firewood.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na tù-wa-ri-šu KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qal
target: He will pay the silver upon his return.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim am-hur
target: I received all this.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÚ 50 ma-na bé-lá-num i-dí-nam
target: Bēlānum gave me 5 talents 50 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na a-na qá-ra-bi-tim
target: 30 minas for the storage area

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 16 maš-ki a-ha-ma
target: and 16 fleeces separately

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 ma-na a-na i-dí-sú-in a-dí-in
target: I gave 40 minas to Iddin-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí-tum ku-nu-ku-a i-ba-ší-ú
target: The remainder is under my seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša hu-bu-ul a-šùr-na-da DUMU ha-pu-a-lá
target: of the debt of Assur-nada, son of Happuala.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 5 GÚ a-na ir-i-bi-im a-dí-in
target: Thereof I gave 5 talents for the replenishment.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ 1 GÚ SÍG.HI.A a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR
target: Thereof: 1 talent of wool for Itūr-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ en-na-num il₅-qé
target: 1 talent of wool Ennānum took.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 5 ha-me-eš qá-ta-tim ša i-tur₄-DINGIR ù en-na-nim
target: Of the five shares belonging to Itūr-ilī and Ennānum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 GÚ.TA SÍG 65 GÚ SÍG.HI.A
target: 13 talents of wool each, (giving) 65 talents of wool;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù 56 maš-ku-TA ŠU.NÍGIN 2 me-at 80 maš-ku
target: and 56 fleeces each share - in all: 280 fleeces.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR SAHAR.BA i-ṣé-er a-šùr-na-da DAM.GÀR i-šu
target: 10 shekels of 'dust silver' Assur-nada owes to the creditor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ITU.6.KAM i-ša-qal
target: He will pay within 6 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-ták-lá-ku DUMU i-ku-nim
target: Seal of Assur-taklaku, son of Ikunum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ki-nam-a-šùr DUMU ba-ba-lim
target: Seal of Kinam-Assur, son of Babalum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-na-da DUMU ha-pu-a-lá
target: Seal of Assur-nada, son of Happuala.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM hu-bu-ur li-mu-um ša qá-té a-bu-ša-lim DUMU ì-lí-a-lim
target: Month I (Hubur), eponymy of the successor of Abu-salim, son of Ili-alum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-bi-il₅ ṭup-pí-im šu-ut DAM.GÀR-ru-um
target: The bearer of this tablet is the creditor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Enna-Suen to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam tí-ir-tí a-ṣé-er i-tur₄-DINGIR i-li-kam
target: There my message has come to Itūr-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam tù-ur-IŠTAR DUMU zu-ma-x be-lá-a-wa-tim ša-i-il₅-šu
target: Over there Turi-Istar, son of Zuma-x, (is) the litigant, ask him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qál 1.5 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR i-na ITU.1.KAM-im ṣí-ib-tám a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: if he does not pay he will add 1.5 shekel of silver per month as interest per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí a-wa-tim ša ma-šu-ḫa-ku-ni
target: Concerning the matter where I have been treated badly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ta a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR pu-nu-ma
target: You too should turn to Itūr-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: gi-mì-lam x i-na ṣé-ri-a šu-ku-un
target: Do me a great favour.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-la-ḫu-um a-na i-na-sú-in iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Ali-ahum seized us against Enna-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ku-zu-za-ri-im ù a-lá-ḫi-im …
target: Concerning Kuzuzārum and Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-IR-uš-tim ša e-dí-na-a a-na 15 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: From the week of Edināya he will pay within 15 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ìš-qúl ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he does not pay he will add (interest) in accordance with the regulation of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-uk i-na-sú-in ša a-lá-ḫa-am a-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu ú-bu-bu-ú
target: Ali-ahum gave a tablet sealed by Enna-Suen, stating that he will clear Ali-ahum for the silver and interest to Enna-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-la-ḫu-um a-na i-na-sú-in i-dí-in-ma i-du-uk
target: He has invalidated it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.KI ku-pu-ur-ší-ni-IN SIG₅
target: 2 shekels of gold of fine quality

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ṣé-er im-lik-a-šùr ir-ma-a-šur i-šu
target: Imlik-Aššur owes to Ir'am-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM qá-ra-a-tim li-mu-um e-lá-lí DUMU i-ku-nim
target: Month VIII, year eponymy of Elālī, son of Ikūnum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ṭup-pá-am ša 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu a-la-ḫu-um a-na iṣ-mì-dí-lim i-ḫi-ib-lu
target: Also, the tablet stating that Ali-ahum owes 20 minas of silver plus interest to Iṣmid-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na-sú-in ṭup-pá-am a-na a-lá-ḫi-im i-dí-ma i-du-uk
target: Enna-Suen gave (that) tablet to Ali-ahum and he has invalidated it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-na-a a-na zu-zu ú PUZUR₄-a-šùr qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Innaya to Zuzu and Puzur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI pí-lá-ḫ-a-šur DUMU da-nu-um-ì-lí
target: In the presence of Pilah-Aššur, son of Dannum-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-zu-za
target: In the presence of Aššur-mālik, son of Azuza.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta a-ma-kam bu-za-num ki-ma i-a-tí
target: My dear brother, Buṣānum represents me there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-kà ḫa-ar-ma-am ša 0.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na-kam ú-kà-al
target: I hold your certified tablet here concerning 0.6666 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 1 MU.ŠÈ ša-qá-lam qá-bi₄-a-tí
target: You promised to pay within one year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-dí-a-bi₄-im
target: In the presence of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er ma-lá-wa-áš-ḫe DAM.GÀR i-šu
target: 15 shekels of silver Malawašhe owes to the creditor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na bu-za-nim dí-in-ma
target: Give the silver to Buṣānum

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ki-ma ku-wa-tí šu-up-ra-ma ṭup-pá-kà li-iṣ-bu-tù
target: and write to your representatives that they should seize your tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša a-mur-a-šur ITU.KAM ša ke-na-tim li-mu-um ša qá-tí i-na-a a-na ša-na-at ta-ša-qal
target: She will pay within a year, reckoning from the week eponymy of Amur-Aššur, month III, year eponymy of the successor of Innāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-ma-lá u₄-me-ša lá ta-áš-qú-ul
target: If she has not paid when her term is over

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám tù-ṣa-áb
target: she will add interest in accordance with the regulation of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im KÙ.GI ša ik-ri-bi ša ta-ta-wu
target: As to the price of the gold from the votive offering that you mentioned.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí … lá a-kà-šadam-ma
target: I shall not achieve the 4.6666 minas of silver for my representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-bi lá ú-ša-am-ra-aṣ
target: He shall not make me angry.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-uk i-na-sú-in ša 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-la-ḫu-um a-na iṣ-mì-dí-lim i-ḫi-ib-lu
target: Concerning a tablet sealed by Enna-Suen stating that Ali-ahum owes 20 minas of silver to Iṣmid-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na-sú-in ki-ma a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im um-me-a-ni-šu a-wa-tim ú-ga-me-ru-ma
target: Enna-Suen settled the matter on behalf of his investor Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu a-lá-ḫu-um a-na iṣ-mì-dí-lim i-ḫi-ib-lu
target: So that with respect to the 20 minas of silver plus interest for which Ali-ahum was indebted to Iṣmid-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ma-ma-an a-na a-lá-ḫi-im i-tù-a-ar i-na-sú-in ki-ma a-šur-ma-lik um-me-a-ni-šu a-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu a-lá-ḫa-am ú-bu-bu-ú
target: If anyone raises claim against Ali-ahum, Enna-Suen will clear Ali-ahum for the silver and interest on behalf of his investor Aššur-malik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫi … lá ú-ša-bi₄
target: he did not pay in full

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-nam ší-… ta-šé-e
target: Why do you sue?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na tám-kà-ri-im qí-bi-ma um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma
target: To the merchant from Šu-Ištar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI kur-ub-IŠTAR DUMU PUZUR₄-ì-lí
target: Witnessed by Kurub-Ištar son of Puzur-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-tí x-x-… i-na-pá-al
target: he will balance with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 3.5 ma-na a qá-tí-šu-nu
target: 2 shekels of silver (and) 3.5 minas (of copper) for their expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ku-bu-um KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu uš-ta-ba

source: translate Akkadian to English: bu-zu-ta-a ša-li-iš-ni

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ha-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ha-ma 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ha-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-tí-ma tí-ir-tí ú-lá e-zi-ba-am-ma

source: translate Akkadian to English: úz-ni lá ta-pá-tí-i ù li-ba-am ú-lá ta-dí-ni-im

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì ší-ma-tim ša a-bi-ni tí-ir-tí a-dí 5-ší-šu áš-pu-ra-ki-ma
target: Concerning our father's testament I have written to you five times.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku a-lá-nu-tí a-hatám ú bé-el-tám ša-ni-tám ma-nam i-šu-ú
target: As for me, apart from you, what sister and lady do I have?

target: From the day our father died, may Aššur and our father's god be my witnesses - have I not exerted myself to the utmost night and day?

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-da-tum ub-lá-ki-im

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-tí ma-tí-ma tí-ir-tí-ki lá i-li-kam-ma

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na li-bi4 lu-lu

source: translate Akkadian to English: bé-el-tí a-tí mu-ši ù ú-ri ša-zu-za-tí-a ša-am-tí-i-ma

source: translate Akkadian to English: tup-pá-am ha-ar-ma-am ú-kà-al

target: The Kanesh colony gave us judgement for these proceedings.

target: And we gave a tablet with our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É-tí am-tám ù ÌR ša i-dí-a-bi4-im a-na a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU a-mur-DINGIR ša ki-ma šál-ma-a-šùr ú-šé-ru

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-ta-nam ni-iš-ru-ut
target: We tore one kutānu-textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 13.33333 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ a-na ga-am-ri-šu-nu
target: Furthermore, I paid 13 1/3 minas of good copper for their expenses

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-šu-nu a-dí-in
target: and 5 shekels of silver for their food.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣí-ba-at KÙ.GI ša ší-ip-kà-at a-šur-bé-el-a-wa-tim i-ší-tù
target: The interest on the gold that remained of Aššur-bēl-awātim's investment.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ili₅-ba-ni DUMU ba-ší-lam
target: Witnessed by Ilī-bāni son of Baši-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ḫu-qar DUMU zu-ur-zu-ur
target: by Ahu-qar son of Zurzur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI tù-ra-am-ì-lí DUMU e-dí-na-a-šùr
target: by Tūram-ilī son of Eddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ku-ta-ni a-na tù-um-li-a-i-im ni-dí-in
target: We gave 2 kutānu-textiles to the man from Tumliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN ṣí-ba-tim ša i-na ṣé-ri-a il₅-qé-ú-ni
target: 1/2 shekel interest that they took on my account,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ḫu-bu-li-šu a-na kà-ri-im wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na áš-qúl
target: I paid for his debt to the Waḫšušana colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN a-na i-ku-pí-a
target: 3 shekels for Ikūn-pīya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a me-er-i-šu
target: 1 shekel of silver for his son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ni-qí-šu a-na en-na-sú-in ni-a-im ù i-sá-a
target: 5 shekels of silver for his sacrifice for our own Enna-Suen and Isaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 50 ma-na URUDU KI ḫa-ar-lu-ú
target: 50 minas of copper is with Harlu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 18 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 2 TÚG.ḪI.A i-na li-bi me-er-e-šu
target: Further, 18 shekels of silver, the proceeds from 2 textiles, is owed by his son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ḫa-ar-pé i-ša-qá-lá
target: She will pay the silver at harvest time.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na mì-ma a-nim DAM ša-ar-pá qá-ta-tum
target: For all of this, the wife of Šarpa is guarantor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 1 na-ru-uq GIG iš-tí DAM en-um-a-šùr
target: Further, 4 shekels of silver, the price of 1 sack of wheat, is with the wife of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 28 (TÚG)ku-ta-ni ù 1 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mu-um šu-bé-lúm il₅-qé
target: Šu-Bēlum received 28 kutānu-textiles and 1 black donkey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 2 na-ru-uq ù 2 DUG GIG
target: 10 shekels of silver, the price of 2 sacks and 2 jars of wheat,

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tám ša PUZUR₄-a-šùr DUMU i-šar-ki-da-a-šur ú-šé-li-a-ni-ni
target: Goods that Puzur-Aššur son of Išār-kitt-Aššur brought up here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.66666 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lu pá-zu-ur-tám lu ni-ip-lá-tim šu-bé-lúm iš-qú-ul
target: Of this, Šu-Bēlum has paid 42 shekels of silver, either smuggler's goods or balance payments.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ku-zi-zi-a IGI en-um-a-šùr DUMU ba-ba-a
target: Witnessed by Kuziziya, by Ennam-Aššur son of Babaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI lá-qé-pì-im IGI a-šur-ma-lik
target: In the presence of Lā-qēpum, of Aššur-mālik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lu-qú-tum a-na ša a-we-lá-tim ù šu-bé-lim lá i-tù-ar
target: If the goods do not become the property of the woman and Šu-Bēlum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im-šu-nu KÙ.BABBAR šu-bé-lúm a-na ša-lim-a-šùr i-ša-qá-al
target: he must pay the proceeds from their sale in silver to Šalim-Assur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša a-lim(ki) ša be-ú-lá-tí-šu sà-ar
target: The tablet in the City concerning his working capital is invalid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 3.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am be-ú-lá-at a-šùr-i-mì-ti
target: 1 mina and 3.5 shekels of refined silver, is the working capital of Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí KÙ uk-ta-al
target: He is held by the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-nu-ki-a-šur ù a-na-na qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: To Mannum-kī-Aššur and Anna-anna from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam iš-tí a-na-na li-ib-ší-ú
target: Let them remain there with Anna-anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam im-ra-mu-ša a-na ba-áb-tim ša tù-um-li-a-i-im li-ḫi-id
target: There Ewarimuša should take care of the outstanding claims of the man from Tumliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na a-lim(ki) lá ik-šu-dam-ma iš-tí-a lá is-ri-dam
target: If he does not arrive in the City and does not pack together with me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tí-im ša ì-lí-ìš-tí-kál ù šu-a-nim 1.5 GÍN.TA 1 ma-na-im i ITU.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
target: then from the week of Iliš-tikal and Šu-Anum he will add an interest of 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ṭup-pí-šu-nu lu ni-il₅-ta-qé
target: We have taken their tablet here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: za-ku-ú-um e-zi-ib 2 ma-na ša DAM.GÀR
target: purified, apart from 2 minas of the customer.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-ta-kà le-zi-ba-am
target: and leave your instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 8.5 GÍN a-na ḫi-na-a ú a-ta-a-a
target: 2 minas 8.5 shekels for Hinnāya and Ataya;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na a-na a-šur-DU₁₀
target: 0.5 mina for Aššur-ṭāb

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ba-áb DINGIR ša 9.5 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ší-bu-tí a-lu-lá-a ù lá-qé-ep
target: Akali, Aššur-malik's slave is bringing you under my seal 1 tablet from the Gate of the God concerning 9.5 minas 3 shekels of silver, with the testimony of Alulaya and Lā-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù 1 ṭup-pu-um ša 5 GÚ URUDU ša ḫu-bu-ul ku-ra ku-nu-ki-a a-kà-li ÈR ša a-šur-ma-lik na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: plus 1 tablet concerning 5 talents of copper from Kura's debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na 1 GÍN a-na a-ta-a-a
target: 41 shekels for Ataya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na a-na i-da-ZU
target: 0.3333 mina for I-da-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA a ma-lá té-er-tí-kà 4 ma-na 10 GÍN ša ik-ri-bi₄ a-na a-ta-a-a ù GAL-a-šur
target: Thereof, in accordance with your instruction, 4 minas 10 shekels of temple funds for Ataya and Rabi-Aššur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na a-na a-šùr-ba-ni
target: 0.3333 mina for Aššur-bāni

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-ma-kam ṣí-lu-lu ḫa-sí-is-ma na-áš-pé-er-tù-šu ù na-áš-pé-er-ta-kà a-na ṣé-er a-we-li tap-pá-e-šu lu a-na ša ki-ma šu-a-tí
target: Also, remind Ṣilulu there that his missive as well as your missive to the men who are his partners or his representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: xxx x … x ṭup-pá-am xx-dí-ú le-qé … i-na xxx kà-ri … i-zi-iz xxx ma-lá x-xxx-tí-ni i-na … a-lim(ki) lu lá xx ku ma a dí-in a-lim(ki)
target: Take the tablet, stand in the colony, as much as possible, a verdict of the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 2 ANŠE 0.33333 ma-na 3 GÍN ni-iš-qúl
target: For 2 donkeys we paid 23 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim ku-nu-ki GAL-a-šur na-ší
target: All this under my seals Rabi-Aššur is bringing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na dan-a-šur ù uš-ma-a qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Dan-Aššur and Ušmaya from Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-tí-ik-tám ku-nu-ki ša a-ki-a DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur brings it to you sealed by Akiya for testing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na x x ga a li-il₅-qé
target: Let him take 8 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.33333 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: Thereof 26 shekels of silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ma 2 ma-na ni-ga-li na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Further, he brings you 2 minas of sickles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma AN.NA a-na a-ki-a ta-ta-ší-a-ni
target: As you brought tin to Akiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam IGI a-ki-a a-ta-ší-ma
target: I have brought it here before Akiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na AN.NA ba-tí-iq
target: And there is 2 minas too little of the tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam l�á i-šu
target: I do not have it here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam iš-tí áb-nim ša tù-ša-qí-lá-ni ma-aḫ-ṣa-ma
target: Check it there with the weight-stone that you weigh with.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ba-tí-iq i-li i-ṣé-ri-šu id-a
target: If there is too little, add bags on top of it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na a-tù-nu le-qé-a-ma
target: You yourselves should take 20 minas

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na na-áb-ri-tí e-ma-ri-a dí-na
target: and give it for the paddock of my donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-ki-a 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na be-a-lim ta-da-na-am qá-bi₄-a-ku
target: I promised to give 0.3333 mina of silver as a working capital to Akiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi₄ a-ki-a
target: 5 shekels of silver is owed by Akiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù a-lim(ki) KÙ.BABBAR-pì ú-ta-ra-am
target: I shall return my silver from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur brings you 15 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-šu-ma
target: Give him the silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṭup-pu-šu lu-up-ta
target: and write his tablet for 0.3333 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur brings you 4 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì tí-ri-ku-nu-ni dí-na-ší-im
target: When she asks you for it, give it to her.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí-ni TÚG.ḪI.A SIG₅-tim DIRI a-na ša-lim-be-lí dí-na
target: In accordance with what I wrote you, give good, extra-fine textiles to Šalim-bēli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na-ku a-we-el gi₅-mì-lim
target: And I am a man of favor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-na-sú-in-ma a-na a-šur-mu-ta-bi₄-il₅ ú a-šur-SIG₅ x qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Enna-Suen to Aššur-muttabbil and Aššur-damiq:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum i-ḫi-id-ma ší-ma-am ša ba-lá-ṭí-a ša-ma-a
target: Please, pay attention and buy merchandise that makes me profit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ḫa-ru-a lá i-sà-ḫu-ur
target: My employees must not delay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭur-da-ni-šu-nu
target: Send them to me!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu i-na (d)UTU-ši na-áš-pé-er-tí ta-ša-me-a-ni
target: My brothers, on the day you hear my missive,

source: translate Akkadian to English: x ma-na KÙ ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-šur-lá-ma-sí la-ma-sà-tum tí-šu
target: [x] mina of refined silver Aššur-lamassī owes to Lamassutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kur-ub-IŠTAR ù ì-lí-ìš-ta-kál a-na 4 ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
target: From the week of Kurub-Ištar and Iliš-tikal he will pay in 4 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x x ma a-bu-a na-áš-a-ku-šu
target: Abuwa brings that to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qúl ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he does not pay, he will add interest in accordance with the regulation of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR ša a-ta ta-ni-iš-ú
target: In addition to the silver that you yourself are bringing,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú 5 GÍN KÙ.KI a-na en-na-nim ú e-ni-ša-ru-um ku-nu-ki-a a-dí-in-ma
target: I have given 1.5 minas of silver and 5 shekels of gold to Ennānum and Eniš-Aššur under my seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṣé-ri-ku-nu na-ší
target: and they are bringing it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pì lu-ša-ak-ší-id
target: He shall conduct the case concerning my tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na u₄-mì-im ša e-ra-ba-ni a-na a-lim(ki) ṭù-ru-sú
target: The very same day he arrives you must send him to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-(d)UTU-ši DUMU šu-IŠTAR
target: Seal of Aššur-šamšī, son of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB dan-a-šur DUMU ku-sú-sà-ri-im
target: Seal of Dān-Aššur, son of Kususārum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na URUDU a-na ší-bi₄ šé-ru-bi₄-im ù a-na ba-áb DINGIR šé-ru-dim áš-qú-ul
target: I paid 15 minas of copper to have the witnesses brought here and led to the Gate of the God.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-šu lá ta-be-i-il₅
target: Do not deny him 10 shekels of silver for his expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: dí-šu-um
target: Give it to him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na URUDU a-na qá-tí-šu a-dí-in
target: I gave 2.5 minas of copper for his expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 20.5 ma-na URUDU a šu-mì-kà áš-qú-ul
target: In all I have paid 20.5 minas of copper for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na URUDU da-a-sú ša a-bu-a ša iš-tù kà-ni-ìš a-dí wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na áš-qú-ul
target: 3 minas of copper, the fee for Abuwa for the stretch from Kanesh to Wahšušana, I paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA ša e-zi-ba-ku-ni
target: the tin I left for you

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na URUDU i-na wa-áš-ḫa-ni-a iš-tí a-ša-at da-na-a
target: 2.5 minas of copper is owed by Dannaya's wife in Wašhaniya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na DAM.GÀR qí-bi-ma um-ma a-da-a ù a-šùr-DU₁₀-ma
target: To the merchant say, thus Adaya and Aššur-ṭāb:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 9 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà
target: Total: 9 minas of your silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ku-nu-ki-kà a-da-a ub-lam
target: Adaya brought 4 minas of silver, its import duty added and under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ku-nu-ki-kà a-šùr-DU₁₀ ub-lam
target: Aššur-ṭāb brought 5 minas of silver, its import duty added and under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14.16666 GÍN.TA KÙ.BI … 8 ma-na
target: At the rate of 14.1666 to 1, its value in silver was 8 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 GÚ 54 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki a-šùr-DU₁₀ na-áš-a-kum
target: Thereof Aššur-ṭāb is bringing you 1 talent 54 minas of sealed tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ANŠE ù ú-nu-sú 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR it-ba-al
target: 1 donkey and its harness cost 0.33333 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR té-ṣú-bi a-šùr-DU₁₀ il₅-qé
target: Aššur-ṭāb received additions of 2 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà gám-ra-kum
target: Your silver has been spent for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.5 ma-na 2 GÍN AN.NA qá-tim
target: 4.5 minas 2 shekels of hand-tin

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14.16666 GÍN.TA KÙ.BI 19 GÍN
target: at the rate of 14.1666 to 1, its price in silver was 19 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na a-lá-ak šu-(d)EN.LÍL i-ša-qal
target: He will pay refined silver before the arrival of Šu-Illil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-kà da-da-a-a ù lá-dí-a ub-lu-nim
target: Dādaya and Ladiya brought 20 minas of silver under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul
target: If he has not paid,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-na-im 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
target: he will pay interest at the rate of 1.5 shekels per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ... AN.NA 16 GÍN.TA 9.83333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR
target: Tin at the rate of 16 to 1 cost 9.83333 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šùr-na-da ù en-nam-a-šùr a-na en-nam-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
target: to Aššur-nādā and Ennam-Aššur, specifically to Ennam-Aššur say:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ku-pí-a DUMU šu-a-nim i-na ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A ša ú-ší-na-lam il₅-qé
target: Ikūn-pīya son of Šu-Anum has received 8 minas of refined silver from the proceeds of the wool of Ušinalam.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ba-tí-a a-šar ša-ṣú-ru šu-uk-na
target: Place my textiles where they will be under guard.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU-ri-i a-na KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-ma
target: Sell my copper for silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ú-zu-bi₄-iš-ki-im a-ḫi-šu
target: by Uzub-iškum his brother

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-dí-da ú a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pì-a-šur-ma
target: To Adida and Ali-ahum say, thus says Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 na-ru-qá-tim TÚG.ḪI.A ku-nu-ki-a i-na ḫu-ur-ší-im e-zi-ib
target: I left 6 sacks with textiles under my seal in the store-room.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-a ku-un-kà-ma
target: And then seal the proceeds in silver from my textiles

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-ib-ší
target: and let it remain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ḫu-ša-ḫi-ku-nu lá tù-ma-na
target: Do not consider the silver for your own needs

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-ib-ší
target: let it remain intact

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 12 TÚG.ḪI.A SIG₅
target: Among those were 12 good quality textiles,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 TÚG.ḪI.A tár-dí-ú-tim
target: 8 second quality textiles,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 TÚG.ḪI.A ša uš-ma-a
target: and 4 textiles belonging to Ušmaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ṣú-ba-tim
target: I left with you 0.33333 mina 1 shekel of silver, the price of a textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 21 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR e-zi-ba-ku-nu-tí
target: and 21 minas 10 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR GAL a-ta-na-lá-ak-ma
target: I keep going for much silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma ta-da-na-am lá i-mu-a-am
target: but he refuses to give me anything.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR lá ta-da-gal
target: Do not expect silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum URUDU ša e-me-ri-im šé-bi-lá-am
target: Urgent, send me copper belonging to Emmerum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma lá i-da-na-am
target: He gives me nothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-šur-DU₁₀ ù ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-a ša ta-al-ta-áb-šú ma-lá i ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-a a-ṣé-er 5 GÍN tù-ra-du-ú
target: In addition to the 5 shekels of silver from Aššur-ṭāb plus the price of my textile that she put on, announce to Aluwa with Šu-Kūbum as witness how much you will add to the 5 shekels for the price of my textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: dí-in-ma iš-tí ḫu-du-be-lí li-li-kam
target: And give it, so it may come with Hudubēlī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma be-lí a-ta KÙ.BABBAR ša nu-a-im šabi₄-i
target: If you are truly my lord, satisfy me with the silver from the Anatolian.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN iští e-wa-ri-mu-ša
target: 1 shekel is with Ewāri-muša.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 1.3333300000000001 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i li-bi šé-ep-IŠTAR
target: 0.3333 mina 1.3333 shekel of refined silver is in Šēp-Ištar's possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 TÚG ša en-na-sú-in
target: 15 textiles of Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-ší-tí-šu a-dí-in
target: I gave 3 shekels of silver to his wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì zu-zu-a DUMU i-tur₄-DINGIR a-ša-sú e-hu-zu
target: When Zuzuwa son of Itūr-ilī married his wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 4 TÚG i-na li-wi-tim
target: Thereof: 4 textiles used for wrapping.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 29 (TÚG)šu-ru-tum ša šu-IŠTAR
target: 29 dark textiles of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 TÚG i ší-mì-im
target: 4 textiles by pre-emption.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 44 (TÚG)šu-ru-tum ša šu-IŠTAR ù en-na-sú-in
target: In all 44 dark textiles of Šu-Ištar and Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-lá-ma ù kur-ub-IŠTAR qí-bi₄-ma um-ma e-na-ah-DINGIR-ma
target: Say to Elamma and Kurub-Ištar, thus Ēnah-ilī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bu-ša-lim iští-a i-lá-ak
target: Abu-šalim travels with me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14 LÁ 0.33333 GÍN.TA AN.NA-ku-nu ša-im
target: Your tin was bought at a rate of 13.6666 (shekels) per (shekel silver).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a pá-ni-a šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: Send 2 minas of silver to reach me en route.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma a-na SIG₅-pí-i-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Ennam-Aššur to Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 me-at 60 ku-ta-nu 7 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu a-ra-de₈-a-kum
target: 160 kutānu-textiles, 7 black donkeys, I am leading to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú sà-he-er-tám ša KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: Send me also small wares for a value of 10 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na pá-ni-tim-ma áš-pu-ra-kum um-ma a-na-ku-ma
target: I wrote to you earlier, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ni na-ab-ri-tum i-na ur-šu i-ṣa-ba-at-ku-nu
target: Now, winter has caught you in Uršu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ 20 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ku
target: 4 talents 20 minas of tin under seals

source: translate Akkadian to English: 72 ku-ta-nu qá-dum ša li-wi-tim
target: 72 textiles, including those for wrapping

source: translate Akkadian to English: 29.33334 ma-na AN.NA qá-tim
target: 29.33334 minas of loose tin

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-ra-de₈-a-ku-nu-tí
target: all this I am leading to you

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a-nim i-a-tí ta-ša-pá-ra-am
target: Come on, it is to me you write!

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma tì-ir-tí DAM.GÀR hi-mì-tum i-li-kam
target: Why did you write, saying: 'A heated letter from the merchant came.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ku-pá-um ma-du-ni a-na lu-qú-ut DAM.GÀR-ri-im ša ki-ma qá-qí-dí-a ú-lá áš-tap-ra-am
target: Since there is a lot of snow I have not sent anyone on whom I could rely for the goods of the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku sà-ah-ra-ku-ma a-na lu-qú-tim ša DAM.GÀR mì-li-ik-ša ma-lá-kam lá a-al-té-e
target: I have personally been delayed and been unable to take any decision about the merchant's goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na na-áp-ṭí-ir ku-nu-tí
target: When you are released (from the cold),

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na-ku ú-lá ša ki-ma qá-qí-dí-a a-ṭa-ra-dam-ma
target: then I shall send either myself or someone I can rely on,

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-li-ik lu-qú-tim ša DAM.GÀR a-ma-lik
target: and I shall take a decision about the merchant's goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-er-ú me-tim né-nu
target: We are the children of a dead man (inheritors).

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá ni-ip-ta-ar
target: We have not divided (the estate).

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šùr ra-bi₄-ṣa-am ù a-lá-ha-am e-pu-ul
target: Ennam-Aššur answered the attorney and Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-na a-lá-hi-im-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur said to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-bi ša-zu-úz-tí a-bi-ni ù li-bi-ni i-de₈
target: The agents of our father and we know.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-lá-an lu-qú-tim a-ni-tim ša šé-pì-kà
target: Apart from this merchandise transported by you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma lu-qú-tám šál-ma-a-šùr ú-lá ú-šé-bi₄-lam
target: Šalim-Aššur did not send any other merchandise.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na lu-qú-tim a-ni-tim qá-tí ša-zu-za-at a-bi-ni i-ta-dí-nu ni-a-tí-ma
target: A claim to these goods has been made against us by our father's agents.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá lu-qú-tum a-ni-tám x ša a-ta tù-šé-li-a-ni-ma
target: As much as these goods which you brought up

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tum ší-it i-na É-šu-nu iz-ku-a-ni
target: and these goods were cleared in their house

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù me-he-er-ni a-na a-lim(ki) a-na ṣé-er a-bi-ni iš-tù u₄-mì-im ša lu-qú-tám tù-šé-li-a-ni i-li-ik-šu-ma
target: Also our answer went to the City, to our father, the very day you brought the goods up here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na a-lim(ki) i-ba-ší
target: And it is in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-nam-a-šùr ù a-lá-hu-um-ma
target: thus Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-(d)DUMU.ZI e-lá-a a-dí-da lá-ma-sí ù en-nam-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
target: To Šu-Tammuzī, Elaya, Adida, Lamassī and Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ILLAT-at-kà i-sà-ri-dam ù a-ta qá-dí-ma ILLAT-tí-kà sí-ir-dam-ma lu-qú-tám
target: If your caravan is being packed, then you too should pack together with your caravan, and choose textiles of good quality from the goods of the merchant that you are leading.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša DAM.GÀR ša ta-ra-dí-ú TÚG.HI.A SIG₅-tim bi-ir-ma i-na ma-a-ma ú-lá i-na ú-na-ap-sé e-zi-ib-ma
target: Leave them in Mamma or in Unapse.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí TÚG.HI.A ma-ṭí-ú-tim lu i-na ša DAM.GÀR i-ba-ší-ú lu ša bé-ú-lá-tí-kà ù-lu i-na ša bé-ú-lá-at ṣú-ha-re-e i-ba-ší-ú qá-dí-ma tap-pá-e-kà a-na É.GAL-lim le-ru-bu-nim
target: The rest of the less good textiles - both from what remains of the merchant's and from your own working capital and from the working capital of the servants - should enter the palace together with your partners.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá lu-qú-tám i-a-tí i-šu-ru-ni-ni
target: As for the goods they took care of for me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-ta-er-ma
target: I converted them to silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-we-lu-ú ú-nu-hu
target: The men make trouble.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na dur₄-hu-mì-it 40 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am bu-lá-tí ša a-bu-ni e-zi-bu um-me-a-nu ša a-bi₄-ni i-ṣa-áb-tù
target: In Durhumit our father's investors have seized 40 talents of washed copper, assets that our father left.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù sí-ki-ni ú-kà-lu
target: They also detain us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì a-bu-ni i-na a-lim(ki) lu-qú-tám ip-qí-da-ku-ni-ma x a-na ṣé-er ša-zu-za-tí-šu i-dí-a-bi-im DUMU a-šur-GAL i-tur₄-DINGIR DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR en-na-nim DUMU am-ri-a e-na-ah-DINGIR DUMU šu-a-šur i-a-tí ù ku-a-tí qá-dí-šu-nu-ma
target: When our father in the City entrusted merchandise to you and sent it to his representatives - Iddin-abum son of Aššur-rabi, Itūr-ilī son of Amur-Ištar, Ennānum son of Amriya, Enah-ilī son of Šu-Aššur, myself and you together with them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù né-nu ša-zu-úz-tum ša šál-ma-a-šur a-bi-ni
target: We were the representation of Šalim-Aššur, our father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma né-nu-ma a-lá-an URUDU a-nim mì-ma bu-lá-tí ša-ni-a-am a-bu-ni ú-lá e-zi-ib
target: We said: "Apart from this copper our father left no other assets."

source: translate Akkadian to English: 25 TÚG i-ku-num DUMU DINGIR.ILLAT
target: 25 textiles: Ikūnum son of Ilī-ellat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ih-da-ma a-lam mu-ùh-ra-ma
target: Take care to confront the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá ik-ri-bu ša a-šùr lá i-ha-li-qú-ni ep-ša-ma
target: and act so that the votive offerings for Aššur are not lost

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ú-ni be-lu-ni a-tù-nu a-we-lu NA₄.ZA.GÌN ik-ri-bi₄ ša a-bi₄-ni a-na e-ṭá-ri-ni i-za-zu
target: Our dear fathers and lords, the men are ready to remove the lapis lazuli, our father's votive offering from us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU a-na KÙ.BABBAR li-tù-ur-ma
target: Have the copper converted to silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lim(ki) li-li-ik-ma
target: and let the silver go to the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tum iš-tù a-lim(ki) li-ba-al-ki-tám-ma
target: and then let goods be transported from the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er 40 GÚ URUDU bu-lá-tí ša a-bi₄-ni ú-kà-lu-ni
target: Not only do they hold the 40 talents of copper, our father's assets,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma ù NA₄.ZA.GÌN ik-ri-bu ša a-bi₄-ku-nu … lu ni-sú-uh
target: but they say: "Let us also take away the lapis lazuli, your father's votive offering."

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 TÚG šu-la-ba-an DUMU a-mur-DINGIR
target: 17 textiles: Šu-Laban son of Amur-ilī

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim(ki) le-qé-a-ma
target: get a tablet from the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma NA₄.ZA.GÌN a-na KÙ.BABBAR i-tù-ru-ma
target: stating that the lapis lazuli must be converted to silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí … ik-ri-bu … uš-té-ru-bu
target: and until the votive offerings are brought in

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 TÚG a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU pá-na-kà
target: 8 textiles: Aššur-malik son of Panaka.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 TÚG e-la-ma DUMU i-ku-nim
target: 20 textiles: Elamma son of Ikūnum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 25 ku-ta-nu 12 ma-na.TA ta-ad-nu
target: 25 textiles were sold at 12 minas each.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 1 me-at 20 TÚG ILLAT-at i-ku-nim DUMU DINGIR.ILLAT
target: In all 120 textiles in the caravan of Ikūnum son of Ilī-ellat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 25 ku-ta-nu 13 ma-na.TA ta-ad-nu
target: Thereof 25 textiles were sold at 13 minas each.

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-ar-ki ILLAT-at PUZUR₄-ì-lí i-lá-qé-ú
target: After the caravan of Puzur-ilī (has come) they will receive them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pí-a dan-a-šùr ša-lim-wa-ardu ù šu-nu-nu-ma a-na en-nam-a-šùr qí-bí-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya, Dan-Aššur, Šalim-wardī and Šu-Nūnu to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 55 ma-na ší-im ANŠE.HI-kà
target: 55 minas was the price of your donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí AN.NA-ki-kà 3 ma-na 15 GÍN na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: the rest of your tin, 3 minas 15 shekels, they bring to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 18 ma-na AN.NA 10 ma-na.TA
target: 18 minas of tin at 10 minas each

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na LÁ 15 GÍN 9 ma-na.TA ta-dí-in
target: and 4 minas less 15 shekels at 9 minas each were sold

source: translate Akkadian to English: 50 (TÚG)(HI)ku-ta-ni 25 ma-na AN.NA 0.33333 ma-na 0.66666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 2 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu
target: 50 textiles, 25 minas of tin, 0.33333 mina 0.66666 shekel of silver, 2 black donkeys

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim tù-šé-bi₄-lam
target: all this you sent

source: translate Akkadian to English: 31 ma-na ší-im KÙ.BABBAR ša li-bi₄ dan-a-šùr
target: 31 minas the price of the silver in Dan-Aššur's possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 6 GÚ šu-nu-nu i pá-ni-tim ub-lá-kum
target: Thereof Šu-Nūnu earlier brought you 6 talents.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN URUDU-i-kà 20 GÚ 24.66666 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-um
target: the total of your copper: 20 talents 24.66666 minas of washed copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 18 ma-na SIG₅ ša-du-a-at URUDU-i-kà ù ANŠE.HI-kà ni-iš-qúl
target: 18 minas good copper we paid as the transport tariff on your copper and your donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ-tum 1 ma-na.TA i-na ša-bu-ri-im im-ṭí
target: 1 mina per talent was lost during the breaking up.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am ša-lim-wa-ardí ù šu-nu-nu ku-nu-ki-ni na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: Šalim-wardī and Šu-Nūnu bring you 8 talents of washed copper under our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ i li-bi₄ URUDU-i-kà ni-dí
target: 2.5 minas of good copper we deposited out of your copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: gám-ra-am ù ú-ku-ul-tám mì-ma ú-lá ni-dí-šu-nu-tí
target: We did not give them anything for expenses and food.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ta-ší-a-at URUDU ša áb-ša-lim ù dan-a-šùr a-na áb-ša-lim ni-dí-in
target: and gave to Ab-šalim for the carriage of Ab-šalim's and Dan-Aššur's copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 na-ru-qá-tim a-ḫa-ma a-dí-šu-nu-tí
target: 5 sacks, separately, I gave to them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ANŠE ṣa-la-me ù ú-nu-sú-nu a-dí-šu-nu-tí
target: 4 black donkeys and their harness I gave to them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-as-kà-ri-nam lu ta-dí-na-ší-ma
target: Also, do give her the boxwood log.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pár-tám ša a-šur-ma-lik gu₅-ba-áb-tám ša ma-ḫu-ra-at É ku-ra ša-áš-me-ma
target: Make the priestess who lives opposite Kura's house hear the missive from Aššur-malik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-na-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im
target: Witnessed by Enna-Suen son of Idi-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI dan-a-šùr DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Dan-Aššur son of Puzur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6.5 GÍN 22.5 ŠE KÙ.GI pá-ša-lúm SIG₅ 10 GÍN.TA a-na KÙ.BABBAR
target: 6.5 shekels 22.5 grains of pašallu-gold at the rate 1:10 in silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šé-ep-IŠTAR ù lu-lu a-ḫa-ma
target: to Šēp-Ištar and Lullu, and further

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá ta-aḫ-sí-is-tám a-dí-na-ku-ni
target: since I gave you a memorandum

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta a tí-ir-tí-a i-ḫi-id
target: My dear brother, pay heed to my message.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na en-nam-a-šùr qí-bí-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ni-ša-am ḫa-ra-kà al-kam-ma lu ni-iz-ku
target: If your journey takes you here, then come and let us clear accounts.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-mì-ša-am ḫa-ra-ni
target: My journey will take me there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma sà-aḫ-ra-tí tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: If you are delayed, then send word.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pár-tum ša a-we-lim lu ša É ub-ri-ni i-li-kam
target: and ask there whether the missive from the man or from our guest-house has come

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ša-il₅-ma šé-bi₄-lam
target: and send it to me

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-aḫ-sí-is-tum a-ni-tum ar-ki-at
target: This memo is a later one.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x dan-a-šùr DUMU ša-lim-ma-ḫi-im
target: Dan-Aššur son of Šalim-ahum

source: translate Akkadian to English: ANŠE ša ba-ri-ni ša-lim-a-šùr il₅-qé
target: Šalim-Aššur has taken a donkey owned by us both.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 2 GÍN AN.NA šu-ku-bu-um iḫ-bu-lam
target: For 1 mina 2 shekels of tin Šu-Kūbum became indebted to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-du-da ú šu-IŠTAR ú-šé-bi₄-il₅
target: Aduda and Šu-Ištar sent them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ku-ta-ni ki-ma šu a-tí pu-šu-ki-in i-dí-nam
target: Pūšu-kēn has given me 6 textiles on his own.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na LÁ 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i pá-ni-tim iš-tù ḫa-tim iš-tí šu-sú-en₆ ú-šé-bi-lá-ku-ma
target: Previously I sent you 2 minas 57 shekels of silver from Hattum with Šu-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i ra-mì-ni-šu x x x x-na 0.83333
target: he has 0.3333 mina of silver of his own funds.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na x ku-ta-ni ša šu-IŠTAR DUMU da-da-nim ir-dí-a-ni
target: Of the textiles that Šu-Ištar son of Dadānum conducted here,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-bi šu-ut i-lá-ak-ma iš-tù a-lim(ki) AN.NA 10 ma-na ú-šé-ba-lá-ma li-ba-am i-da-nam
target: and I thought: 'He is my father, he will go and send me from the City at least 10 minas of tin and thereby encourage me.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ir-ma-a-šur ù (d)UTU-ba-ni
target: To Ir'am-Aššur and Šamaš-bāni,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ir-ma-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: and in particular to Ir'am-Aššur, say as follows,

target: I set down 12.5 minas 7 shekels of refined silver as owed by Lā-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma ṭup-pu-šu al-pu-ut
target: And then you have written, saying: "I have written his tablet."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta ib-ri a-ta a-lá-nu-kà-ma a-ḫa-am GAL i-šu-ú
target: My dear brother and friend, apart from you do I have any older brother?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-a-tí ú-ša-zi-za-ku-šu-ma

target: so when he arrives from Purušhaddum he will pay the silver to you as my representative

target: I and Lā-qēp son of Šu-Aššur settled accounts in the house of the official.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam KÙ.BABBAR lá-qé-pá-am e-ta-ri-šu-ma
target: Here I have repeatedly demanded the silver from Lā-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-qá-lam ú-lá i-mu-a
target: But he would not pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ki-iš-ma a-na a-lu-wa DUMU um-me-a-nim p
target: Wrap the tablet and entrust it to Aluwa and an affiliated trader so they bring it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pí lu-šé-tí-qú-nim-ma
target: "Let them bring my tablet,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà le-qé
target: and then take your silver!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-ḫa-ar-šu a-na šu-nu-tí dí-in
target: then give the copy to them

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ša-nàm me-eḫ-ra-am a-ta kà-il₅
target: while you yourself keep the other copy

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum a-pu-tum i ša-am-ší ša a-ma-kam e-ra-ba-ni

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-šu-nu a-dí-šu-nu-tí

target: I owe 10 shekels of silver to Aššur-lamaša son of Lā-qēp.

target: Further, 0.6666 mina 1 shekel of silver, its transport tariff - all this I entrusted to Šu-Nūnu and Ilī-ašrannī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṣé-er ša-lim-a-šur a-na a-lim(ki) ub-lu
target: And they brought it to Šalim-Aššur in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-lá-lí-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma

target: From the deposits of Lā-qēp his father, I have subtracted the silver from his deposits.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ḫu-wa-qar DUMU šu-IŠTAR
target: Witnessed by Ahu-waqar son of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI e-na-nim DUMU a-bi-a

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-na-sú-in DUMU a-na-aḫ-DINGIR
target: By Enna-Suen son of Anah-ili.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ì-lí-áš-ra-ni ma-ḫri-šu-nu a-dí-in

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG ša a-ki-dí-e lá-qé-ep na-áš-a-kum

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá-ma ra-bi₄-ṣú-um i-li-kà-ku-ni-ma i-pì-kà iṣ-bu-tù-kà-ni
target: Clear yourself before the attorney arrives and seizes you for a statement.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-ma-kà za-ki-ma tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: Set out and come.

target: If they have not paid they will add interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i-na qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu ra-ki-is
target: They are jointly responsible for the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na qí-bi-tí-ni lá-áš-ta-al-šu-ma ú lu-ša-sí-ḫa-šu
target: and then have him extradited.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša ma-nu-ki-a-šur ù i-ku-nim
target: Reckoned from the week of Mannu-kī-Aššur and Ikūnum

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 6 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
target: they must pay within 6 weeks.
