target: They should not rest a single night.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú du-ug-li uṣ-ra-šú-nu-tí
target: Also, as to the implements, guard them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: bi-tám i-na ku-nu-ki-ku-nu ku-un-kà
target: Seal the house with your own seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam šá-áp-tám ú maš-ki i ḫu-ur-ší-im pí-iḫ-a-ma

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ú-ṣur-ša-a-šur DUMU a-šur-ma-lik
target: by Uṣur-ša-Aššur son of Aššur-malik

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-da-da DUMU (d)IM.GAL
target: by Adada son of Adad-rabi

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU sá-da-a
target: by Aššur-ṭāb son of Sadaya

source: translate Akkadian to English: bé-tám e-li-am ku-nu-ki-a pé-té-a-ma
target: Open the upper storey sealed by me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 2 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A ku-nu-ki-a
target: 22 talents of wool under my seal

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mì ú ú-nu-sú-nu
target: 10 black donkeys and their harness

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim ša-lim-ar-dí ú šé-ep-IŠTAR i-ra-dí-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
target: all this Šalim-wardī and Šēp-Ištar lead to you

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum a-na a-wa-at ṭup-pì-im iḫ-da
target: Urgent! Pay attention to the words of the letter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 1 (TÚG)tí-sà-ba-am SIG₅ ú-tù-ur-tám ša a-na li-tab-ší-a a-šùr-DU₁₀ iq-bi-a-ni a-na ší-mì-šu a-šùr-DU₁₀ li-dí-na-ku-nu-tí-ma
target: also, Aššur-ṭāb should give you for sale 1 textile of extra-fine quality which he promised me for my clothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iští KÙ.BABBAR a-na ṣú-ḫa-ri dí-na-ma lu-ub-lu-nim
target: and then give it together with the silver to the servants so they may bring it.

target: thereof 1 talent 1.3333 mina of good copper

target: To Nini and Ilabrat-bāni.

target: Atata seized us against Ennam-Suen, son of Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI na-áb-sú-in DUMU pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR IGI ma-lik-e-nam DUB.SAR
target: In the presence of Nab-Suen, son of Pilah-Ištar, of Malik-ennam, the scribe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ší-im-šu a-na a-lim(ki) tù-ša-ak-ša-dam
target: You would see to it that the silver paid for it would reach me in the City.

target: You would enjoy the profit on it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im-tám a-na-ku a-lá-qé

target: Further, you received 6 shekels of silver from Ennam-Aššur.

target: send it to me

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM kán-wár-ta li-mu-um i-dí-a-šùr DUMU ku-bi-dí

target: I gave you x minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-sà-bi-i ma-du-tim a-ta-ma-ar
target: I have experienced great losses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a be-lu-a a-tù-nu lá li-bi₄ DINGIR-li-ma i-be-sà-e ma-du-tim a-ta-ma-ar
target: My dear brothers and lords, unfortunately I have suffered great losses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur a-na i-dí-a-bi-im i-tur₄-DINGIR e-na-nim i-na-aḫ-DINGIR ú en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Iddin-abum, Itūr-ilī, Ennānum, Inah-ilī and Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i li-bi a-mur-IŠTAR lá uk-ta-in

target: Elamma will pay the silver and its interest to Imdī-ilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-mur-(d)UTU DUMU mì-šar-GAL

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB la-qé-pí-im DUMU (d)AB-ba-ni
target: Seal of Lā-qēpum, son of Ellil-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB e-la-ma DUMU i-dí-sú-in

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ḫu-bu-ul e-la-ma DUMU i-dí-sú-in

target: My dear brothers, withdraw at my accounting in the office of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú qá-tí mì-ma lá ta-na-dí-a
target: And do not deposit anything on my account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 TÚG ša ma-e SIG₅-tum 1 (TÚG)lu-bu-šú-am ku-nu-ki-a a-ṣé-er ku-zi-zi-a
target: Šu-Bēlum and Aluwa bring 3 good waterproof textiles and 1 garment under my seal to Kuziziya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i-na a-wa-tim i-bu-a-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-pá-al
target: and he will give in with respect to the silver in a lawsuit and balance the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG ra-qá-tim 0.5 ma-na 3 GÍN ḫu-sà-ru-um ša-lim-wa-ar-dí ú šé-ep-IŠTAR a-ṣé-er ku-zi-zi-a ub-lu-nim
target: Šalim-wardī and Šēp-Ištar brought 2 thin textiles and 33 shekels of lapis lazuli to Kuziziya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú mì-šú ša a-dí pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR áš-pu-ku-nu-tí-ni ṣú-ḫa-ru-a a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim wa-áš-bu-ni
target: But why is it that although I wrote to you about Pilah-Ištar, my servants have stayed until today?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam KÙ.BABBAR li-ìš-qú-lu
target: They can pay the silver here

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-šu a-na ša ki-ma šu-a-tí lá-dí-in
target: I shall (then) give his tablet to his representatives

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na gám-ri-im ú ḫu-lu-qá-e ša ILLAT ì-lí-a-lim a-na mì-ma šu-um-šú ku-na-a a-na e-lá-ma ú-lá i-tù-ar
target: For expenses and losses of the caravan of Ilī-ālum, whatsoever, Kunnāya shall not raise claim against Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma SIG₅-pì-a-šur-ma a-na PUZUR₄-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Damiq-pī-Aššur to Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-ku-bi₄-im DUMU qá-a-tim
target: Seal of Šu-Kūbum, son of Qa'atum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU a-šur-ma-lik
target: Seal of Ali-ahum, son of Aššur-mālik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ku-na-a DUMU ma-na-na
target: Seal of Kunnāya, son of Manana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-lá tí-ir-tí-a iḫ-da-ma
target: Pay heed to my instructions

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR li-dí-ku-nu-tí-ma
target: and let him give you the silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ku-nu iští a-li-ki-im pá-ni-ú-tim-ma ú ṣú-ḫa-ri-a šé-bi₄-lá-ma
target: send the silver under your seals with the very first transport and with my servants

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÁN-lam a šu-mì-šú le-tí-iq

target: you brought it into Kanesh.

target: As for the 30 minas of tin, for which Kunnāya served Ilī-ālum's caravan a notice, it will belong to him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-de₈ ILLAT-ma a-na a-wi-tí-šú i-za-sú-um
target: together with (the other members of) the caravan according to its declared value.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na NINDA
target: 0.5 shekel of silver for bread.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im an-ni-ki-kà a-dí a-na-ku a-na ša-lá-tù-wa-ar e-ru-bu
target: As to the price for your tin, before I arrived at Šalatuwar

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR lá i-ší-qí-il₅
target: the silver was not paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-ki ša šu-ki-tim šu-ḫu-bur na-áš-a-kum
target: Šu-Hubur brings that under Šukkutum's seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ša ṭup-pí-šu 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR šu-kà-tám ú-ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu
target: I made Šukkutum pay 4 minas of silver from what is in his tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÁN-lam₅ a-šu-mì šu-ki-tim a-dí kà-ni-iš(ki) e-tí-qám
target: The silver should pass overland in the name of Šukkutum to Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà 2 ma-na ša li-bi šu-ki-tim KÙ.BABBAR-kà
target: The rest of your silver, 2 minas owed by Šukkutum — is your silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11 ma-na 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR e-zi-ib ša-du-e-tí-im ší-im AN.NA-ki-kà iz-ku-wa-ku
target: 11 minas 12 shekels of silver apart from the transport tariff was cleared for you as the proceeds from your tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú lá-ma a-li-kà-ni AN.NA ta-dí-in
target: But before I came the tin was sold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 GÍN LÁ 22.5 ŠE.TA ta-dí-in
target: "It was sold at the rate of 8 shekels minus 22.5 grains."

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11 ma-na 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR AN.NA-ki-kà ma-ma-ḫi-ir i-ku-pí-a a-na šu-ki-tim i-dí-nu-ma
target: 11 minas 12 shekels of silver (the price of) your tin, Man-mahir (and) Ikūn-pīya gave to Šukkutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DUMU šàl-ma-(d)IM na-áš-a-kum
target: The son of Šalim-Adad brings it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà lu ší-im AN.NA lu ša šu-ki-tim
target: Total of your silver, both the proceeds from the tin and that from Šukkutum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šu-ḫu-bur na-áš-a-kum
target: 15 minas 12 shekels of silver, Šu-Hubur brings to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma a-na-na-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Anna-anna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ší-a-ma-tim šu-ut
target: Silver for purchases and he

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ma tí iš-tí šu-ḫu-bur iš-ku-nu-ni a-ma-kam i li-bi-kà
target: set down with Šu-Hubur there in your possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù a-bu-kà me-tù
target: After your father died

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-kà a-na a-lim(ki) ṭup-pám ú-šé-bi-lá-ma
target: your brother sent a letter to the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: pá-al-ḫa-ku-ma mì-ma ú-lá e-pá-áš
target: I am afraid and shall do nothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù mì-šu ša ta-áš-ta-na-pá-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma
target: Also, why do you constantly write to me, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma ú-nu-tám i-na É a-bi-kà i-ba-ší-ú
target: All the goods that were in your father's house

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na qá-at a-ḫi-kà a-na ki-dim tù-uš-té-ṣí
target: she brought outside into your brother's hands.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta a-na ú-nu-tim ša qá-at-kà ik-šu-du
target: As for you, for the goods that you got hold of

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ki-ma ša-zu-úz-tám tù-ša-zi-zu-ú
target: since you yourself appointed an agent

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na … a-na bi₄-ki-tim i-dí-nu
target: 0.3333 mina of silver they paid for the mourning ceremony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x x tí-x x x ma-a-ma we-dí-kà-ma a-na a-bi₄-kà lá-am-da-tí
target: And you alone have been known by your father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ak šu-(d)EN.LÍL i-ša-qal
target: He is to pay before Šu-Illil arrives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-nam-a-šur DUMU me-na-a
target: by Ennam-Aššur son of Menaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 22 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-šur-ma-lik i-šu
target: Iddin-abum owes 22 minas 10 shekels of refined silver to Aššur-malik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 3 ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
target: He is to pay within 3 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul
target: If he has not paid in time,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM a-na ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: he will add interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ku-zal-le li-mu-um a-šur-i-mì-tí ma-lá-ḫu-um
target: Month Kuzallu, eponymy Aššur-imittī, the skipper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU dan-a-šur a-šur-iš-ta-kál i-šu
target: Puzur-Ištar son of Dan-Aššur owes 2.5 minas of refined silver to Aššuriš-takal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: If he has not paid in time, he shall add interest according to the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-le-e ni-na-mu-ru-ú i-ša-qal
target: He is to pay the silver wherever we meet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU ša-lim-a-šur
target: by Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ṣí-lu-šu-da-ga-an DUMU IŠTAR-pí-lá-aḫ
target: Witnessed by Ṣilluš-Dagān son of Ištar-pilah.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-lá-nu-um a-na li-ip-it-IŠTAR DUMU lá-li-im iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Bēlānum seized us against Lipit-Ištar, son of Lalum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ṣa-ba-ku-um
target: "I will add it for you".

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM qá-ra-tim li-mu-um en-na-sú-in DUMU šu-IŠTAR
target: Month VIII, year eponymy of Ennam-Suen, son of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dín
target: And before Aššur's dagger we gave our testimony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ta-áš-qú-lam
target: If you have not paid me

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 GÍN 15 ŠE.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im i-na ITU.KAM-im ṣí-ib-tám tù-ṣa-ba-am
target: you will add for me an interest of 3/4 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um ḫu-ra-ma i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: For these words the hurama colony made us available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša šu-IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-ba-ni a-na 6 ḫa-am-ša-tim ta-ša-qá-lam
target: You will pay me 1.5 mina of silver within 6 weeks reckoned from the week eponymy of Šu-Ištar, son of Aššur-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-um-a-šur DUMU e-lá-ma
target: of Ennam-Aššur, son of Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-zu-zu DUMU a-šur-SIPA
target: In the presence of Šuzuzu, son of Aššur-rē'ī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-ku-pí-a DUMU a-šur-ba-ni
target: Seal of Ikūn-pīya son of Aššur-bāni

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma um-ma ḫu-na-ḫu-na
target: To Kuliya, thus says Hunahuna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-aḫ-DINGIR ú PÚZUR-a-šur i-li-ku-nim
target: Anah-ilī and Puzur-Aššur came here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DUB a-na-ku lá a-mu-a ú-šu-ra-am
target: But I refused to release that tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša-ni-im pá-qí-id
target: 1 mina 6 shekels has been entrusted to somebody else.

source: translate Akkadian to English: PÚZUR-a-šur áš-ra-kam-ma 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ip-ta-an
target: Puzur-Aššur consumed (for) 14 shekels of silver over there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1.3333300000000001 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na-aḫ-DINGIR i-ṭi-ib-lu
target: As for the silver, 1.33333 mina of silver for which Anah-ilī had become indebted.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-na-tum ri-ig-ma-am lá ni-na-dí DUMU i-na-a lá i-ša-me-e
target: Ennānātum said: "We will not file a complaint lest Innaya's son hears about it."

source: translate Akkadian to English: DUB ša ku-nu-ki-a bi-lá-nim-ma
target: "Bring me the tablet with my seal

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR li-qí-a
target: then take the silver."

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku ú-kà-al
target: The 1 mina 6 shekels of silver I have in my possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ma-an i-na ša-zu-za-tí-kà lá i-zi-iz
target: Not one of your representatives came into action.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma i qá-tí-šu lá i-ba-ší
target: but he had absolutely nothing available

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá-kà
target: It is now up to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ta-da-nam lá i-le-e
target: He was unable to give even 1 single shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 na-áš-pè-ra-tí-kà lá i-dí-nam
target: Since he did not give me your two letters

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na-ku DUB ša a-šur-DU₁₀ lá ú-šé-er-šu-um
target: I also did not release to him the tablet of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ṣú-ḫa-ru-ú i-li-ku-ni-ni
target: When the servants had come here,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ur-ki KÙ.BABBAR e-na-na-tim i-sà-ḫu-ru-ú
target: they were looking for the silver of Ennānātum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-ip-lá-aḫ-ma e-na-na-tum ú a-na-ku
target: Since we became afraid, Ennānātum and I myself,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫu-ur-šam ni-ip-té-e-ma
target: we opened the storeroom

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ta-ma-lá-ki-kà ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-šu nu-šé-li-ma
target: and took out of your tablet coffer the tablet with his seal,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-dí-šu-um
target: which we gave him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.GI 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR
target: 1 mina of gold, 8 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku al-qé
target: I myself obtained 4 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.33333 GÍN ša sà
target: I also took 2.3333 shekels of Samaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-is-ḫa-at KÙ.BABBAR ù KÙ.GI i-na a-lim(ki) sú-in-na-da i-da-an
target: Suen-nādā will give the import duty for the silver and gold in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-li-a qí-bi-ma um-ma a-sà-num-ma
target: To Kuliya, thus says Asānum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-a dam-qá-tù-šu ša al-pì-lí ša i-na té-ga-ra-ma ú-ta-mì-ú
target: Really, this is the friendliness of Alpilī whom I made swear an oath in Tegarama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-di-iš li-bi-i im-ra-aṣ
target: He has really hurt me terribly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-am i-ša-ú-mu-ma KÙ.BABBAR-pí uš-ta-ba
target: They will buy merchandise and I will be satisfied with my silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-ku-bi-im IGI PUZUR₄.SA.TU IGI a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU en-na-ma-nim
target: Before Šukubum, before Puzur-šadue, before Aššur-ṭāb son of Ennam-Anim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: aq-bi-a-ku-um um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-wa-tí-kà al-pì-lí lá tù-lá-ma-ad
target: I had told you: "Do not inform Alpilī about your affairs."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi a-ta be-lí a-ta lá ta-qá-bi um-ma a-ta-ma i-qí-in-im a-šu-mì ta-pá-i-šu-ú na-áš-pè-er-tám uš-té-bi-lam
target: Please my father, my lord, do not think: 'Out of jealousy he has sent me a letter about his partner!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: pa-ar-sà-ti-kà a-wa-tim u-šé-ṣí-i
target: He has disclosed confidential matters of you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú šu-um-ka SIG₅ ṭá-pu-ul
target: And also your good reputation has been besmirched.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na-ku iš-tí-kà-ma ṭá-pu-lá-ku
target: And I have been besmirched together with you!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša en-num-a-šur DUMU sú-in-na-da ša qá-tí ša-ak-na-at-ni
target: its transport tariff paid - belonging to Ennam-Aššur son of Suen-nādā, on which I have lodged a claim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na sú-in-na-da áp-qí-id-ma
target: I have entrusted to Suen-nādā.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er Ì-lí-a ù en-num-a-šur ú-bi-il₅
target: He brought it to Iliya and Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim ša a-áš-ta-me-ú a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim DINGIR lu i-de₈ a-na al-pì-lí
target: For the rumors I keep hearing, for these matters god be my witness against Alpilī!

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-lá-an 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma wa-at-ra-am lá i-dí-ší-im
target: Apart from 3 shekels of silver he gave her nothing extra.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-ma-tum ra-qá-ma uš-ba
target: Moreover, the slave-girls are idle and do nothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ŠÀ.BA 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR šu-ḫu-bur ub-lá-ku-um
target: In addition, Šuhubur brought you 1 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ku-zi-zi-a a-šur-ma-lik ú a-mur-IŠTAR a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Kiziziya, Aššur-malik and Amur-Ištar to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 TÚG.ḪI.A a-na 2.33333 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-dí-in
target: we sold 6 textiles for 2.33333 minas 4 shekels of silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam lu-ba-li-ṭá-kum
target: He should credit it to you there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí URUDU 5 GÚ 12 ma-na URUDU
target: The rest of the copper is 5 talents 12 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG.ḪI.A a-na 1 GÚ 10 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-im a-mur-IŠTAR i-dí-in
target: Amur-Ištar sold 2 textiles for 1 talent 10 minas of washed copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.33333 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni ú 3.33333 GÍN KÙ.GI ku-nu-ki ša ku-zi-zi-a a-zu na-áš-a-kum
target: Azu brings you 2.33333 minas 4 shekels of silver under our seals and 3.33333 shekels of gold under Kuziziya's seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 20 TÚG.ḪI.A 5 TÚG.ḪI.A a-na 5 GÚ 50 ma-na URUDU ší-ki-im
target: Kiziziya has sold 5 textiles out of the 20 textiles for 5 talents of 50 minas of šikku-copper

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 1 TÚG a-na 3.33333 GÍN KÙ.GI ku-zi-zi-a i-dí-in
target: and 1 textile for 3.3333 shekels of gold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ba-tù-kà gám-ru-ni-kum
target: Your textiles have been sold for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na URUDU a-na ša TÚG.ḪI.A ub-lá-ni a-na ma-ri-it-ḫi-im a-mur-IŠTAR i-dí-in
target: Amur-Ištar gave 5 minas of copper to the one who brought the textiles to Marithum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-mur-IŠTAR ú ì-lí-áš-ra-ni sú-ub-ra-am iš-ú-mu-ma
target: Amur-Ištar and Ilī-ašrannī have bought a slave

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na du-ur-ḫu-mì-it i-ta-al-ku
target: and have left for Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí TÚG.ḪI-ba-tí-kà 6 a-zu na-áš-a-kum
target: Azu brings you the rest of your textiles: 6 pieces.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ URUDU ší-ku-um ší-im 4 TÚG.ḪI.A ša en-um-a-šur i-na li-bi₄ ku-zi-zi-a
target: 2 talents of šikku-copper, the price of 4 textiles belonging to Ennam-Aššur, is in Kuziziya's possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša ḫi-na-a a-na 3 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: He is to pay in 3 weeks, reckoned from the week of Hinnaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ma-lá u₄-me-šu lá iš-qúl
target: If he has not paid at the completion of his term

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: he will add interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ša sà-ra-tim li-mu-um ša qá-tí šu-ḫu-bur
target: Month of Sarātum, eponymate of Šuhubur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-ku-bi₄-im DUMU šu-sú-in
target: Witnessed by Šukubum son of Šu-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-ku-pì-a DUMU pì-lá-aḫ-a-šur
target: Witnessed by Ikupiya son of Pilah-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Man-mahir to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i ra-mì-ni-a a-na ḫa-mu-uš-tim áš-qúl
target: I paid the silver personally to the week-eponym.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-ša-at a-mur-IŠTAR a-dí-in
target: I gave 4 shekels of silver to Amur-Ištar's wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šu-IŠTAR a-na ḫa-mu-uš-tim ḫa-bu-ul-ma
target: Šu-Ištar owed x shekel of silver to the week-eponym.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-ta-nam ù 2 TÚG x kà-ru-um wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na il₅-qé
target: The colony of Wahšušana took 1 kutānu-textile and 2 textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI šu-ku-bi₄-im lá ki-dí-im IGI PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU i-kà-a
target: 2 shekels of silver with Šukubum (witnessed by Puzur-Ištar son of Ikaya).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN 20 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-am SIG₅ a-ni-na DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim ub-lam
target: Annina son of Aššur-bēl-awātim brought 1 talent 20 minas of washed fine copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 ma-na URUDU KI i-zi-zi-a
target: 9 minas of copper with Iziziya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na AN.NA KI en-nam-a-a áš-kà-pì-im
target: 0.66666 mina of tin with Ennamaya the leather-worker.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI ú-ṣú-ra-nim
target: 3 shekels of silver with Uṣurānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-šu a-na a-bi₄-kà e-zi-ib
target: He left his tablet for your father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na-ku 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ḫa-bu-lá-ak-šu-um
target: Also, I personally owe him 1 mina 10 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-ni-na URUDU ú ṣí-ba-sú li-iš-qú-lá-kum-ma
target: Have Annina pay you the copper and its accrued interest there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a šé-lu-um-ar-dí na-áš-a-kum
target: Šalim-wardī brings you the 1 mina 10 shekels of silver under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR e-lá-ma ù ša-lim-a-ḫu-um
target: 2 minas 8 shekels of silver (of) Elamma and Šalim-ahum

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 3.5 GÍN e-lá-ma i-na ILLAT id-na-a
target: 93.5 shekels (of silver) of Elamma from the caravan of Idnaya.

target: When you pay the silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar ša-pár-tum kà-an-ku ku-nu-ki ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a lu-dí-ma
target: let him identify Mannum-kī-iliya's seal where the security is sealed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ma-nu-ki-DINGIR i-zi-za-ma
target: Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-iliya, stand by

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ma-nu-ki-a-šur ú-lá a-na ša ki-ma ma-nu-ki-a-šur šu-qlá-ma
target: and pay the silver to Mannum-kī-Aššur or to his representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá a-na-kam ša-lim-ar-dí nu-na-hi-du-ni le-pu-uš-šu-nu-tí
target: Let them do for them what we instructed Šalim-wardī here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú i-ša-qá-al KÙ.BABBAR
target: Also, when the silver is paid,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ša-áp-tum i-a-tù-ni ší-be šu-uk-na
target: set witnesses to prove that the wool is mine.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-na a-lá-hi-im-ma
target: Thus said Ennam-Aššur to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-ha-ni
target: Do not obstruct me!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma a-we-lu a-ni-ú-tum li-iš-me-ú
target: Now, may these men listen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ša-áp-tám a-na ša-lim-wa-ar-dí ù ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a sà-ni-qá-ma
target: Also, check the wool for Šalim-wardī and Mannum-kī-iliya,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá ša-áp-tám i-za-ku-a-ni ší-bé-e šu-uk-na-šu-nu-tí
target: and set witnesses for them about how much wool is cleared.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ša-áp-tum ú 7 ANŠE.HI.A ša en-um-a-šur ša-áp-tám kà-ni-kà-ma ku-nu-ki-ku-nu iš-tí lu-qú-tí-a-ma pí-iq-da-ma li-ir-dí-ú-nim
target: Seal the wool, (stating that) the wool and 7 donkeys belong to Ennam-Aššur, and entrust it under your seals with my other goods so they may conduct it here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-ni-ma-ma na-áš-pé-er-tum ku-nu-ki-kà IGI 3 ší-be ú-kà-lim-kà-ma
target: Now here I have shown you the missive sealed by you in front of 3 witnesses,

source: translate Akkadian to English: tù-kà-i-ni-ma
target: and you have confirmed it

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-nu-tí-ma ni-ip-qí-sú
target: and we have entrusted it to them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-ah-sí-sá-tum ku-nu-ku-kà ú ku-nu-ku-ú-a
target: They are the memoranda with your seal and my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma ta-ah-sí-sá-tù-ni ku-nu-ku-ú-a ú ku-nu-ku-kà i-ki-ir
target: Confirm or deny our memorandum with my seal and your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-lá kà-i-in ša ni-kà-sí a-na-ku ú a-ta ni-sí-ú-ma ni-iz-ku-ú
target: Concerning which you and I settled accounts and were cleared.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR a-bu-ni i li-bi-a ú i li-bi₄-kà i-dí-ú-ma
target: As much silver as our father set down as owed by me and by you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-am u₄-ma-am ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR i-na tuppu-im lá-áp-ta-ni-ni lu nim-gu₅-ra-ma
target: Come on, even today let us agree on how much silver we are booked for in that tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-am 3 lu ni-iç-ba-at-ma
target: Come on, let us seize three men

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá ta-ah-sí-sá-tim ša i-na ku-nu-ki-ni kà-an-kà-ni lu ni-iz-ku
target: and let us settle in accordance with the memoranda that are sealed with our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tuppu-am a-bu-ni e-zi-bu-ma
target: And concerning which our father left a tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tuppu-am um-me-a-nu a-bi-ni ú-kà-i-lu-ni-ma
target: And our father's investors held the tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na IGI kà-ri-im ça-hi-ir GAL i-šku-nu-šu-ma
target: Which they deposited before the plenary assembly of the colony,

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ra-am a-na ra-bi₄-çí-im ip-qí-du-ni
target: and which the colony entrusted to an attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ští na-na-a
target: 5 shekels of silver is owed by Nanaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ça-ru-pá-am i-ští i-ku-pí-a-šur DUMU PUZUR₄.IŠTAR
target: 10 shekels of refined silver is owed by Ikūn-pī-Aššur son of Puzur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá dí-in a-lim(ki) KÙ.BABBAR lu ni-ik-nu-uk-ma
target: Let us seal the silver in accordance with the verdict of the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lim(ki) lu ni-li-ik
target: and let us go to the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ça-ru-pá-am i-ští a-šur-GAL
target: 10 shekels of refined silver is owed by Aššur-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-hi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma
target: To Ali-ahum speak, thus said Damiq-pī-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na DUB ša a-lim(ki) ša ni-il₅-qé-ú DUMU.MÍ šál-ma-a-šur ra-bi₄-ça-am ta-ça-ba-at-ma
target: According to the tablet of the City that we received, Šalim-Aššur's daughter will take an attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-i a-wa-tum ku-a-tù-n
target: Since the matter is indeed yours.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá na-áš-pé-er-tí-kà ša ta-dí-na-ni
target: In accordance with your missives that you gave me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ša-ha-at a-ha-tí-kà ni-zi-iz-ma a-lam ni-im-hu-ur-ma
target: we stood by your sister and confronted the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ha-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu
target: 15 minas of silver, its excise added, its transport fee paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma me-eh-ra-at DUB ša-ni-im ú i ma-ah-ri-a-ma
target: Now, copies of the second tablet exist and in my presence.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ba ra-bi₄-ça-am ni-iç-ba-da-kum
target: We have seized the attorney Ababa for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-ki-a a-na (d)IŠKUR-pì-lá-ah DUMU a-ni-nim áp-qí-id
target: Under my seal I entrusted it to Adad-pilah, son of Anīnum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ki-ma ku-a-tí ip-nu-ú-ni-ma um-ma šu-nu-ma
target: Your representatives turned to me and said:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wi-lu-um a-hu-kà KÙ.BABBAR a-na ig-ri ra-bi-çí-im šu-qú-ul
target: The man is your colleague; pay the silver for the attorney's fee.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu KÙ.BABBAR lu tuppu-ú lu tuppu-um ša šál-ma-a-šur i dur₄-hu-mì-it
target: Concerning the silver, the tablets, and the tablet of Šalim-Aššur in Durhumit

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša hu-bu-ul en-um-a-šur ú a-lá-hi-im
target: regarding the debt of Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša um-me-a-nu a-na i-li-a ip-qí-du-ni
target: which the investors entrusted to Iliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša i-na ba-ri-ku-nu i-qá-bi₄-ú um-ma šu-ut-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá-áš-qú-ul
target: He among you who says "I will pay the silver"

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ša-ha-at ra-bi-çí-im i-za-az-ma
target: shall assist the attorney

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša lá iš-qú-lu ú-ša-áš-qal
target: and make the one who did not pay pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-la-bi-im DUMU sú-li-a
target: Seal of Ali-abum son of Suliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-ki-tim
target: Witnessed by Šu-Ištar, son of Šukutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ki-li-a DUMU en-na-nim
target: Seal of Kiliya son of Ennānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-ma-lik DUMU ša-ba-ha-nim
target: Witnessed by Aššur-mālik, son of Šabahānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá DUB šu-a-tí ša šál-ma-a-šur ú-lá-pí-tù
target: In accordance with that tablet that Šalim-Aššur wrote,

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šur ú a-lá-hi-im KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qú-lu-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum must pay the silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ra-bi₄-çí-im i-du-nu-ma
target: and give it to the attorney,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-lim(ki) i-lá-ak
target: so the silver goes to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tuppu-um ša IGI GÍR ša (d)a-šùr
target: Tablet from before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x ma-na URUDU SIG₅ a-bu-um-DINGIR
target: x minas of good copper: Abum-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um dur₄-hu-mì-it i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Durhumit colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dín
target: We gave our testimony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ DUMU i-ku-nim
target: 2 minas of good copper: Ikūnum's son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ (d)UTU-ba-ni
target: 4 minas of good copper: Šamaš-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÚ URUDU ištī Kurziya u Šu-Nisaba
target: 5 talents of copper is owed by Kurziya and Šu-Nisaba.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-šar-be-lí ša É en-um-a-šur a ni-qí-a i-dí-nu-nim
target: 2 shekels of silver: Išar-belī of Ennam-Aššur's house gave for the sacrifice.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ištū hamuštim ša Abī-ilī ana 4 hamšātim išaqqulū
target: Reckoned from the week of Abī-ilī they are to pay within 4 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šumma lā išqulū kīma awāt kārim ṣibtam uṣṣubū
target: If they have not paid (in time) they are to add interest according to the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ 23 mana URUDU ištī Ilī-ištakal
target: 3 talents 23 minas of copper is owed by Iliš-tikal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ URUDU KI Aššur-imittī
target: 4 talents of copper is owed by Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ištū hamuštim ša Kuluklu ana 3 hamšātim išaqqal
target: Reckoned from the week of Kuluklu he is to pay within 3 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šumma lā išqul kīma awāt kārim ṣibtam uṣṣabb
target: If he has not paid (in time) he is to add interest according to the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÚ URUDU ištī Kura
target: 5 talents of copper is owed by Kura

source: translate Akkadian to English: ūmūšu 1 ITU.KAM ētiqū
target: his terms are overdue by 1 month

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ša sarrātim limum ša i qātī Ali-ṭāb ilqēū
target: Month ša sarrātim, eponymy he who took over from Ali-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI Ah-šalim DUMU Iddin-Ištar
target: Witnessed by Ah-šalim son of Iddin-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša mīma awēlī anniūtim ṭuppīšunu harumūtim ana Atata DUMU LUGAL-Suen ezib
target: With respect to all these men I have left their certified tablets with Atata son of Šar-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 (TÚG) nahlāptam ana bēl ālim ana Buzuliya ukāll
target: 1 cloak for the lord of the town I offered to Buzuliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB Dadaya DUMU Šukubim
target: Seal of Dadaya son of Šu-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ištī Suettata
target: 8.5 shekels of silver due from Suettata.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 (TÚG) maku-huan ištī Šukubim
target: 2 maku-huan textiles due from Šu-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB Ilī-tappā'ī DUMU Aššur-ṭāb
target: Seal of Ilī-tappā'ī son of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB Aššur-rē'ī DUMU Aššur-ištikal
target: Seal of Aššur-rē'ī son of Aššur-ištikal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 mana.TA ina šatim išaqqal
target: He will pay 0.3333 mina per year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 mana KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣēr Aššur-rē'ī DUMU Aššur-ištikal Ali-ahum išu
target: Aššur-rē'ī son of Aššur-ištikal owes 1 mina of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ša sarrātim limum ša qātī Aššur-imittī malāhim
target: Month ša sarrātim, eponymy after that of Aššur-imittī the skipper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB Dadaya DUMU Buzi
target: Seal of Dadaya son of Buzi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB Kukuwa DUMU Mannu-kī-iliya
target: Seal of Kukuwa son of Mannum-kī-iliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB Ilī-dan DUMU Iddin-Aššur
target: Seal of Ilī-dan son of Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣuhāru ša Ennum-Aššur Šalim-ardī 21 GÚ SÍG.HI.A ina Kuburnat usannaq-šū-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur's servant Šalim-wardī shall check the 21 talents of wool in Kuburnat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ANŠE.HI.A ša Ennam-Aššur SÍG.HI.A ana Tukubtu ušēru-ū
target: And on Ennam-Aššur's donkeys they will have brought the wool to Tukubtu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB Šu-Anum DUMU Akuza
target: Seal of Šu-Anum son of Akuza.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šumma ina malā ūmēšu 0.33333 mana KÙ.BABBAR lā išqul
target: If he has not paid 0.3333 mina of silver when his term is up,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN.TA ana 0.33333 manaim ṣibtam ina ITU.1.KAM uṣṣab
target: he will add interest at the rate 0.5 shekel per 0.3333 mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 21 GÚ šaptam ša Kānēš ša É.GAL-lim Ennum-Aššur DUMU Šalmah-Aššur ana Ilī-dan ina Kuburnat išaqqal-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur shall give 21 talents of wool from Kanesh, from the palace, to Ilī-dan in Kuburnat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB Šamaš-bāni a-hī-šu
target: Seal of Šamaš-bāni his brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB Ennam-Aššur DUMU Puzur-Ištar
target: Seal of Ennam-Aššur son of Puzur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ina rīš SÍG.HI.A ša išaqqulušuni 6.66666 mana KÙ.BABBAR litī SIG5 Ilī-dan DUMU Iddin-Aššur ana Ennum-Aššur išaqqal
target: From the capital on the wool that they are going to pay him, Ilī-dan son of Iddin-Aššur shall give 6.6666 minas of good silver to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB Ali-ahum DUMU Ennam-Dagān
target: Seal of Ali-ahum son of Ennam-Dagān.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šumma Ilī-dan šapir Ennam-Aššur ina rīš wool lā išqul
target: If Ilī-dan has not paid Ennam-Aššur's representatives from the capital on the wool,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN.TA ina ITU.1.KAM ana manaim ṣibtam uṣṣab
target: he shall add interest at the rate 1.5 shekels per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM Kuzallu limum Ali-ahum
target: Month Kuzallu, eponymy Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭuppī harumūtim ina Kuburnat ezib
target: I left the certified tablets in Kuburnat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: u 1 mana 7.5 GÍN ana 4 ITU.KAM išaqqal
target: And 1 mina 7.5 shekels in 4 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šumma lā išqul kīma awāt kārim ṣibtam išaqqal
target: If he has not paid he will pay interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 mana 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ana 8 ITU.KAM išaqqal
target: He will pay 1 mina 7.5 shekels of silver in 8 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Šamaš-bāni DUMU Puzur-Ištar 2 mana 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR SIG5 ana Iddin-Aššur i-ṣēr
target: Šamaš-bāni son of Puzu-Ištar owes 2 minas 15 shekels of good silver to Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.6666 mana 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR hubullu ša Iṭīb-šināti u tappā'ī-šu
target: 4.6666 minas 5 shekels of silver is the debt of Iṭīb-šināti and his partners.

source: translate Akkadian to English: u sahertam ša Hattim ana harrān sūkinim ana erābīni li-ik-nim
target: Let him bring small goods from Hattum to the Narrow Track when we arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 me-at NINDA Aššur-imittī DUMU Ataya
target: 100 breads Aššur-imittī son of Ataya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 50 NINDA DUMU Hali-abim
target: 50 breads the son of Hali-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 50 NINDA Ennam-Aššur DUMU ahī-a
target: 50 breads Ennam-Aššur, son of my brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: umma Kuzizi-āma ana Kukuwa u Ennam-Aššur
target: From Kuzizya to Kukuwa and Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: nuṣā'id-ma 5 GÍN imṭī-ma
target: We melted it down and 5 shekels were lost.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 mana KÙ.BABBAR ša Mannum-kī-ilī ublāni
target: Concerning 1 ½ mina of silver that Mannum-kī-ilī brought.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR masūh
target: The silver was of inferior quality.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭuppum ana Annanna addin
target: I gave the tablet to Anna-anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ištū hamuštim ša Innaya DUMU Amuraya ITU.1.KAM Allanātim
target: from the week of Innaya son of Amuraya, month Allanātum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 3.33333 mana 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iššiqil
target: in all 3 ⅓ minas 5 shekels of silver was paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša kīma šuāti 0.33333 mana 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣibtam ilqēū
target: so his representatives took as interest ⅓ mina 2 ½ shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭuppum ša 2.6666 mana KÙ.BABBAR
target: The tablet about 2 ⅔ minas of silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ṭuppum ša 0.33333 mana 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša Mannum-kī-ilī
target: and a tablet about ⅓ mina 2 ½ shekels of silver belonging to Mannum-kī-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 2 mana LÁ 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR Annanna ammat Ennam-Aššur tašqul
target: Thereof Anna-anna, Ennam-Aššur's maid, paid 2 minas less 5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.83333 mana KÙ.BABBAR ṣarupum ana malā tērtikunu ṭuppum ša Ištar-lamassī u Mannum-kī-ilī nilput
target: Of that, we wrote a debt-note for Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-ilī for ⅚ mina of refined silver in accordance with your instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ana Luzina u Lipit-Anum qibī-ma umma Aššur-rabi-ma
target: To Luzina and Lipit-Anum from Aššur-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭuppum u sikkan-LUGAL É Mannum-kī-Aššur nušēṣi-ā-ma
target: We brought out a tablet and some stone from Mannum-kī-Aššur's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ana Ištar-lamassī
target: and gave it to Ištar-lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 bilātim SÍG.HI.A É Mannum-kī-Aššur nušēṣi-ā-ma
target: We brought our 20 talents of wool from Mannum-kī-Aššur's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ana malā tērtikunu ammišam naš'ūnikkunu-ti
target: Following your instructions they bring it to you there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ūmūšu mal'ū
target: His terms are complete.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 mana 6.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ištū limim Šu-Suen ina libbika adi-i
target: I placed 0.6666 mina 6 ¼ shekels of silver in your possession in the eponymy Šu-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Hanunu ṣabtā-ma 1 mana 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šašqilā-šu
target: Seize Hanunu and have him pay 1 mina 1 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ana Lipit-Anum dīn-ma
target: Give the silver to Lipit-Anum

source: translate Akkadian to English: šīmām ša balāṭiya lilqē-am
target: and let him acquire a profitable purchase for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 mana KÙ.BABBAR tadmiqtam ša alahhinnim ša Tuhpiya Ilī-bāni ihibbil-ma
target: For 0.5 mina of silver, a loan by the alahhinnum of Tuhpiya, Ili-bani became indebted.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI Aššur-rabi DUMU Asuwa IGI Šu-Suen ahīka IGI Šalim-ahim
target: Witnessed by Aššur-rabi son of Asuwa, Šu-Suen, your brother, and Šalim-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ina bētika nikassī nisī
target: We settled accounts in your house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 mana AN.NA ištū ālim ina elā'ī-šu AN.NA ana alahhinnim pīšu iddin
target: He promised the alahhinnum 5 minas of tin (to be paid) when he would come up from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Kannutum aššat Ilī-bāni taṣbatanni-ma umma šīt-ma
target: Kannutum, the wife of Ili-bani, seized me saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR u KÙ.GI i-a-um
target: that silver and gold belong to me!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ina Tuhpiya iṣbutū-nī-ma
target: In Tuhpiya they seized me

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 mana AN.NA ana Zumu kaššim ša qātē alahhinnim ašqul
target: and I paid 5 minas of tin to Zumu, the kassum of the staff of the alahhinnnum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 mana KÙ.GI pašallam u 1.5 mana KÙ.BABBAR ša Anah-ilī DUMU Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur ana ālim innišū
target: Half a mina of gold and 1.5 mina of silver, which Anah-ili, son of Tab-silli-Assur, brought to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: umma Šalim-Aššur-ma ana Ennam-Aššur u Ali-ahim qibī-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭuppam ša šībē ša bāb ilim ša KÙ.BABBAR u KÙ.GI šīāūni tukallimī-ma
target: A tablet by witnesses, drawn up in the Gate of the God, to the effect that the silver and gold belong to her she showed me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 mana KÙ.BABBAR IGI Anuppiya DUMU Uṣur-ša-Aššur IGI Urad-Aššur DUMU Watrim IGI Aššur-nīšum DUMU Izkanim IGI
target: I gave her 2 minas of silver, in the presence of Anuppiya, son of Usur-sa-Assur, of Urad-Assur, son of Watrum, of Assur-nisu, son of IZkanum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN ul ēli ul ana ṣibtim nidaššū-ma
target: Either a single shekel will accrue, or we should give every shekel of silver as interest-bearing loans.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN ēli ana nakam šīāmātum-ma
target: So a profit of some shekels of silver will accrue.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ana dāš'išu bā'ānim
target: Leave in the spring.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu AN.NA lu ṣubātū malā eliūnikkuni ana šīāmātim ibašši
target: Tin as well as textiles, what accrues to you is available for purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN bulāṭūni malā amakam ibaššiū
target: As for every shekel of silver of our funds as much as is there

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN ša libbika u libbi Ali-ahim
target: as well as every shekel of silver in your possession and in Ali-ahum's

source: translate Akkadian to English: ul naṭū-ma ana ālim ul nišamma
target: it is not a good idea for us to send it to the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.33333 mana 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN pahhirā-ma anakam ...
target: Here purchases are possible and of 1.3333 mina 5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.33333 mana 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN pahhirā-ma anakam ...
target: Collect every shekel of silver so here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 (TÚG) ṣubātum ša ibaššiū ana Ali-ahim u Aluwa dīn-ma lublūnim
target: Every textile that is available give that to Ali-ahum and Aluwa so they may bring it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 62 ku-ta-ni a-na ir-i-bi-im ù šé-ep-IŠTAR e-zi-ib
target: I left 62 kutānus with Ir'ibum and Šēp-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI Aššur-ṭāb DUMU Abu-šalim
target: in the presence of Assur-tab, son of Abu-salim,

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI Aššur-rabi DUMU Innaya
target: of Assur-rabi, the son of Innaya,

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI Lā-ba-nāda DUMU Sasallim
target: of Laban-nada, son of Sasallum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI Kurkurim DUMU Aku'a
target: of Kurkurum, son of Aku'a,

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI Aššur-mālik DUMU Aššur-lamassī
target: of Assur-malik son of Assur-lamassi,

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI Šamaš-ṣulūlī DUMU Bur-Ištar
target: of Samas-sululi, son of Bur-Istar,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 30 ku-ta-ni a-na šu-pu-nu-ma-an ni-dī-in
target: We gave thereof 30 kutānus to Šuppunuman.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 TÚG a-na ra-dī-im iš-bi-a-ni-tī-im
target: 5 textiles for the guide from Išhianit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11 ku-ta-ni i-na na-ru-qá-tim du-ur-kà-ma
target: Pack 11 kutānus in the sacks

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì da-dí-a e-ez-ba
target: and leave them in Dādiya's name.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN AN.NA i-na a-al bu-u-na-tim a É wa-áb-ri a-dí-in
target: 1.5 shekel of tin in the town of Buṭātum I gave to the inn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí tí-ir-tí i-lá-kà-ni
target: until my instructions arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ši-tí ku-ta-ni-a 16 TÚG i-ši-tù-nim
target: The rest of my kutānus - 16 textiles remain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-ar-ki-a-ma a-na ši-tí-im ma-lá ta-du-nu-šu-ni a-ṣé-ri-a šé-bi-lá-šu-nu
target: After I left, with respect to the remainder, send me as much as you will sell.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN AN.NA i-na wa-zi-da a-na É ub-ri a-dí-in
target: 3 shekels of tin I gave in Wazida to the inn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im áš-qúl
target: 14 shekels of silver as price I paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN AN.NA i-na Ḧa-ni-ga wa-ṣa-i-ni a-na É ub-ri a-dí-in
target: 3 shekels of tin, when we left Hanigga, I gave to the inn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 GÍN AN.NA a-na ni-is-Ḧba-tim ša TÚG.ḦI.A i-na Ḧa-na-ak-na-ak a-dí-in
target: 6 shekels of tin I gave in Hanaknak as import-tax on the textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN AN.NA iš-tù Ḧa-na-ak-na-ak i-wa-ṣa-i-a a-na É ub-ri-ni a-dí Ḧu-lu-qá-e ni-iš-e-ú a-dí-in
target: 3 shekels of tin, when I left Hanaknak I gave to our inn, while we searched for goods lost.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN AN.NA i-na a-al ku-pì-il₅-ša-an a-dí-in
target: 3 shekels of tin I gave in the town of Kupilšan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Ḧi-dam AN.NA a-na a-lá-Ḧbi-nim ša ta-e-dí-zi-na a-dí-in
target: A bead of tin I gave to the steward of Ta'edizina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na URUDU a-né-bar-tim i-ša dur₄-Ḧbu-mì-it a-dí-in
target: 0.5 mina of copper I gave for the crossing in the area of Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN AN.NA i-na ta-pá-kà-áš a kà-ší-im a-dí-in
target: 1.5 shekel of tin I gave in Tapaggaš to the chief.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na URUDU ší-kam lu a É ub-ri lu gám-ri i-na wa-aḦ-šu-ša-na
target: 10 minas of copper for the inn and expenses in Wahšušana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 50 NINDA i li-bi₄ a-lá-Ḧbi-nim ša-áp-li-im ša tù-um-li-a
target: 50 loaves of bread owed by the lower miller of Tumliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ni-is-Ḧba-tim i-na dur₄-Ḧbu-mì-it a kà-ší-im a-dí-in
target: 3 minas of refined copper, import-tax, in Durhumit I gave to the chief.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma NINDA 1 DUG ar-ša-tim i-da-nam
target: Instead of bread, he shall give 1 jar of wheat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ i-nu-mì a-na wa-aḦ-šu-ša-na ur-ki TÚG.ḦI.A i-li-ku
target: 5 minas of refined copper I put at the disposal of Ilī-uṣranni, when he went to Wahšušana in pursuit of my textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ AN.NA ku-nu-ki ša a-šùr-i-mì-tí (d)IM-ba-ni ir-dí-a-ni
target: 4 talents of sealed tin of Aššur-imittī, Adad-bāni brought to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-na-a-šùr DUMU a-ni-nim
target: Witnessed by Enna-Aššur son of Anninum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-um-a-šùr DUMU ú-zu-a
target: Witnessed by Ennum-Aššur son of Uzua.

source: translate Akkadian to English: nu-sà-ni-iq-šu-ma
target: We checked it and

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ 6 ma-na 5 GÍN AN.NA ni-is-ni-iq
target: we checked 4 talents 6 minas 5 shekels of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.83333 ma-na ni-is-Ḧba-at AN.NA-ki-šu a-na É kà-ri-im ni-dí-in
target: From it, we gave 5/6 mina as the import-tax of his tin to the office of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA AN.NA 2 GÚ 2 0.5 ma-na ša-lim-a-šùr il₅-qé
target: From that tin, Šalim-Aššur took 2 talents 2.5 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-Ḧba-ma 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-šu-nu a-dí-šu-nu-tí
target: Furthermore, I gave them 5 shekels of silver for their food.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 41 ma-na 11.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki ša ki-ma šu-a-tí ú ku-nu-ki-a
target: 41 minas 11.5 shekels of refined silver, sealed by his representatives and by me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 né-pí-šu a-Ḧba-ma
target: In 3 packages; further.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-Ḧba-ma 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a be-a-li-im a-na šu-nu-nu
target: Furthermore, I gave 10 shekels of silver as a working-capital to Šu-Nūnu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB sú-en-na-da DUMU e-nam-a-šùr
target: Seal of Suen-nādā son of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ì-lí-áš-ra-ni ma-aḦá-ri-šu-nu-ma a-dí-in
target: And 7 shekels of silver to Ilī-ašrannī witnessed by the same men.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-du-a-sú mì-ma a-nim a-na šu-nu-nu ù ì-lí-áš-ra-ni áp-qí-id-ma
target: 0.6666 mina 1 shekel of silver, its transport tariff - all this I entrusted to Šu-Nūnu and Ilī-ašrannī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er ša-lim-a-šur a-na a-lim(ki) ub-lu
target: And they brought it to Šalim-Aššur in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-Ḧbu-wa-qar DUMU šu-IŠTAR
target: Witnessed by Ahu-waqar son of Šu-Ištar

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ba-zi-a DUMU DINGIR-ku-ru-ub
target: by Baziya son of Ilī-kurub

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku DUMU qàr-da-a
target: by Aššur-taklāku son of Qardaya

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ku-bu-um DUMU a-šur-i-dí ù i-dí-IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-na-da tap-pá-ú-a
target: Šu-Kūbum son of Aššur-idī and Iddin-Ištar son of Aššur-nādā were my (absent) partners.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave me for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí a-dí-in
target: I gave my testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú 2.25 GÍN KÙ.GI
target: 37 shekels of silver and 2 1/4 shekels of gold

source: translate Akkadian to English: IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí DAM ku-ni-li a-na lá-ma-sà-tim DAM e-lá-ma té-zi-ib
target: Ištar-lamassī, wife of Kū-ilum, left to Lamassutum, wife of Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 áb-na-tum iš-tí ku-ša-ra-a
target: 40 stones owed by Kušaraya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-na-nim DUMU a-bi₄-a
target: To Ennānum son of Abiya

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-lá-Ḧba-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šùr
target: and Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-mur-IŠTAR i-šu
target: Iddin-abum owes 13.3333 minas of refined silver to Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 25 áb-na-tum iš-tí e-na-aḦba-DINGIR
target: 25 stones owed by Enah-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-nam-a-šur DUMU me-na-a
target: By Ennam-Aššur son of Menaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma a-lá-Ḧba-um-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PÚZUR-a-šur DUMU i-ku-pí-a IGI a-mur-DINGIR DUMU šu-ku-bi-im IGI ma-ṣí-ì-lí DUMU bu-zu-zu IGI PÚZUR.IŠTAR DUMU šu-ku-bi-im
target: In the presence of Puzur-Aššur, son of Ikū-pīya, of Amur-ilī, son of Šu-Kūbum, of Maṣi-ilī, son of Buzuzu, of Puzur-Ištar, son of Šu-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ú KÙ.KI a-na en-nam-a-šur DUMU a-šùr-dan ú šu-mì-a-bi₄-a DUMU a-mu-a
target: That silver and gold entrusted to Ennam-Aššur, son of Aššur-dān, and Šumi-abiya, son of Amua.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá-ma-sà-tum DAM e-lá-ma x ú en-nam-a-šur DUMU e-lá-ma i ša-Ḧba-at um-mì-šu i-zi-iz-ma ip-qí-du
target: Lamassutum, wife of Elamma, attended by Elamma's son Ennam-Aššur, entrusted.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá té-er-tí-kà le-pu-uš
target: I shall act in accordance with your instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er ANŠE a-ni-ú-tim 3 ANŠE ù ṣú-Ḧba-ri šé-ri-a
target: Dispatch 3 donkeys and servants in addition to these donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-Ḧba-i a-ta a-ma-kam iš-tù a-wa-tù-um i-ba-tù-qú-ni tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma
target: My dear brother, send me word there after the matter has been dropped.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà le-pu-uš
target: Then I shall act in accordance with your instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-ta ù šu-IŠTAR mì-iš-lá ša-qá-lá-am lá qá-bi-a-tù-nu
target: Have you and Šu-Ištar not promised to pay each half of the silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-a-šur-ma ke-na KÙ.BABBAR mì-iš-lá ša-qá-lá-am qá-bi-a-ni-ma
target: Amur-Aššur answered: "True, we have promised to pay each half of the silver."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na i-bi-sà-e ša-li-iš-tám i-za-az
target: and that he also would be responsible for one third of the losses

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i-né-ma-li ša-li-iš-tám ša-tim áš-du-na-da i-zu-a-az
target: and also that he would receive as a share one third of the profit

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì sú-bi-ri-im ša ip-ṭí-re
target: Concerning the Subaraean, of the ransom.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-al-DU₁₀ a-na a-mur-a-šur iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Āl-ṭāb seized us against Amur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-al-DU₁₀-ma a-na a-mur-a-šur-ma
target: Āl-ṭāb said to Amur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ta-tí-a IGI a-ḥu-wa-qar IGI a-šur-(d)UTU
target: In the presence of Atatiya, of Ahu-waqar, of Aššur-šamšī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Ṭup-pu-um ša 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša be-ú-lá-at a-bu-ša-lim DUMU PÚZUR.IŠTAR
target: A tablet about 10 shekels of silver, the working capital of Abu-šalim, son of Puzur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Ṭup-pu-um ša 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša DINGIR-ma-lik DUMU a-de₈-lá-at
target: A tablet about 10 shekels of silver of Ilī-mālik, son of Adad-ellat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Ṭup-pu-um ša 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša be-ú-lá-at a-bi-a-a DUMU ú-zu-a
target: a tablet about 0.3333 mina of silver, the working capital of Abiaya, son of Uzua;

source: translate Akkadian to English: Ṭup-pu-um ša ku-nu-uk PÚZUR-a-šur
target: A tablet with Puzur-Aššur's seal

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lá i-tù-ar
target: He will not come back on 10 shekels of silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pè-er-tum ša a-lá-ḥi-im ù DUMU ku-zi-zi-a
target: a letter of Ali-ahum and the son of Kuziziya

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù Ṭup-pu-um ša 13.16666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša e-nam-sú-in DUMU a-lá-bi-im
target: and a tablet of 13.1666 shekel of silver of Ennam-Suen, son of Ali-abum;

source: translate Akkadian to English: Ṭup-pu-um ša 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša lá-qí-pí-im DUMU a-gu₅-a
target: A tablet about 10 shekels of silver of Laqēpum, son of Agua.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Ṭup-pu-um ša 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša i-na-sú-in DUMU za-ar-ni-qí-im ša be-ú-lá-tí-šu
target: A tablet about 10 shekels of silver of Ennam-Suen, son of Zarniqum, of his working capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Ṭup-pu-um ša 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša šu-ma-a
target: A tablet of 0.5 mina of silver of Šumaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 9 Ṭup-pu-ú i-na ta-ma-lá-ki-im ša i-ša-sú-ú ta-ba-ku-tum
target: In all 9 tablets in a tablet box, to be read and thrown away.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḥi-im ù i-ku-pí-a-šùr qí-bi₄-ma um-ma za-li-dí-ma
target: To Ali-ahum and Ikūn-pī-Aššur from Zalidi:

source: translate Akkadian to English: té-er-ta-kà a-ṣé-er ša ki-ma
target: Send word to your representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma lá-at-bi₄-a-ma lá-tal-kam
target: Also, send me word so I can set out and leave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ki-ma ku-a-tí Ṭup-pá-am ta-da-nam lá i-mu-ú
target: but your representatives refuse to give the tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-dí Ṭup-pì-im ša (d)UTU-ba-ni a-dí ma-lá ù ší-ni-šu ni-gi₅-ri-ma
target: Also, with respect to Šamaš-bāni's tablet we sued both once and twice.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Ṭup-pá-am ša 4 x ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR xx-ma a-na a-bi₄-ni ḥa-bu-lu
target: The tablet concerning 4 minas of silver which the agent owes to our father,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-pár-tim ú-kà-al
target: he holds as security.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.83333 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ù 0.5 ma-na a-ḥa-ma a-mu-ra-am a-na šu-a-šùr DUMU i-dí-a-šùr ḥa-bu-lá-ku
target: I owe 53 shekels of refined silver plus a further 0.5 mina of checked silver to Šu-Aššur son of Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-lí a-ta KÙ.BABBAR a-na šu-a-šùr šu-qú-ul-ma
target: My dear lord, pay the silver to Šu-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: Ṭup-pì šé-ṣí-ma
target: Get out my tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí-kà li-ib-ší-ú
target: Let it be with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: 1 mina 14 shekels of silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-is-ḥa-sú DIRI
target: the excise on it extra

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-du-a-sú ša-bu
target: the transport fee for it paid

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḥa-ma 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR
target: separately 0.5 mina of silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-is-ḥa-sú DIRI
target: the excise on it extra,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-du-a-sú ša-bu
target: the transport fee for it paid,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ik-ri-bu ku-nu-ki ša DAM.GÀR
target: temple funds, under the seals of the agent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šur a-na ir-ma-a-šur ip-qí-id-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur entrusted to Ir'am-Aššur

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lim(ki) a-na ší-a-ma-tim ú-bi-il₅
