target: Give them 7.5 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 11 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR qá-ta-at a-al-DU₁₀ a-šur-(d)UTU ú en-na-sú-in il₅-ta-ap-tù-ni
target: The guarantees of Al-ṭāb, Aššur-šamšī, and Enna-Suen for the 11 minas of silver have been recorded.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-ki-a ú ku-nu-ki ša be-lá-nim a-na DINGIR-pì-lá-ah áp-qí-id
target: Under my seal and the seal of Bēlānum I entrusted to Ilī-pilah.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er a-zu a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu
target: Azu owes 0.5 mina of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ i-na ṣé-er a-šur-(d)UTU ú en-na-sú-in i-ta-al-qé
target: If silver is taken from Aššur-šamšī and Enna-Suen,

source: translate Akkadian to English: É-bé-tum ša a-lim(ki) ša a-al-DU₁₀ e-ru-ba-at KÙ
target: the house of Al-ṭāb's daughter in the City will be the security for the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù KÙ.BABBAR a-na ḫa-ar-pé-e ú-ba-lá-am
target: The silver itself he will bring by harvest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB zu-ba DUMU en-na-nim
target: Seal of Zuba son of Ennānum

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB PUZUR₄-a-na DUMU a-šur-dan
target: seal of Puzur-Anna son of Aššur-dan

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB na-áb-sú-in DUMU PUZUR₄-we-er
target: seal of Nab-Suen son of Puzur-Wer

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB bé-lí-a DUMU DINGIR-kur-ub
target: Seal of Bēlīya son of Ilī-kurub.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 na-ru-uq ŠE-am 5 na-ru-uq ar-ša-tim 2 UDU.ḪI.A ù 20 NINDA ṣí-ba-at KÙ.BABBAR-pì-im
target: 5 sacks of barley, 5 sacks of wheat, 2 sheep and 20 loaves of bread are the interest on the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ga-al-ga-li-a IGI ša-ra-ak-šu-na
target: Witnessed by Galgaliya, by Šarakšuna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ša-lim-a-šur DUMU (d)IM.SIG₅
target: Seal of Šalim-Aššur son of Adad-damiq.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU šu-ku-bi-im
target: Seal of Ali-ahum son of Šu-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI da-da-a DUMU a-šùr-i-mì-tí
target: Witnessed by Dadaya son of Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI e-lá-lí DUMU ga-UR-wa-a
target: by Elālī son of Gawurwaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-lá-ma-sí DUMU šu-ku-bi₄-im
target: by Aššur-lamassī son of Šu-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB (d)UTU-a-bi DUMU sú-sà-nim
target: Seal of Šamaš-abī son of Sūsānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB DU₁₀-pí-a-šùr DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im
target: Seal of Ṭāb-pī-Aššur son of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DU₁₀-pí-a-šur ù (d)UTU-a-bi ša-bu-ú
target: Ṭāb-pī-Aššur and Šamaš-abī have been satisfied.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ú-ṣú-ra-nim ù en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: To Uṣurānum and Ennam-Aššur say:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ta-ar-ki-is-tí lu-zi ša e-li-a-ni sà-ar
target: Any tablet concerning 2 minas of silver from the contract of Luzi that may appear will be invalid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 2 ma-na i-na be-et DAM.GÀR-ri-im a-sí-ma
target: I have borrowed 2 minas of silver in a merchant-house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-am ša DU₁₀-pí-a-šùr ki-ma (d)UTU-a-bi a-na lu-zi i-dí-nu-ma
target: As to the 2 talents of washed copper that Ṭāb-pī-Aššur gave to Luzi on behalf of Šamaš-abī,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ṭup-pá-am ša lu-zi DU₁₀-pí-a-šur iḫ-ri-mu
target: and for which Ṭāb-pī-Aššur certified a tablet for Luzi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma URUDU i-na kà-ni-iš(ki) (d)UTU-a-bi ša ki-ma ku-a-tí il₅-qé-ú
target: If your representatives have received the copper in Kanesh from Šamaš-abī,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 1 GÚ URUDU ma-sí-im ša tal-qé-ú 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-ša-qal
target: you must pay 2 minas of silver for every talent of washed copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i-na IGI me-ra um-me-a-nim KÙ.BABBAR i ku-nu-uk a-lu-wa kà-ni-ik-ma
target: And with an affiliated trader as witness, the silver was sealed with Aluwa's seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na be-tí-a-ma i-ba-ší
target: And it is in my own house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà ša a-lu-wa ta-áš-pu-ra-ni
target: In accordance with your message which you sent with Aluwa,

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-ar-ḫa-am iš-té-en ù 2 wa-ra-am e-ri-iš-kà-ma
target: I asked you for one or two months,

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá ta-áš-me-a-ni
target: but you did not listen to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: To Itūr-ilī and Ali-ahum say:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ša-me-ma en-nam-a-šur me-et
target: I hear that Ennam-Aššur is dead.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ḫa-bu-lam
target: He owes me 17 talents of copper of good quality.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam IGI ú-ṣú-ra-nim ṭup-pì a-na pu-zu-ur-ku-nu ù a-lu-wa pí-iq-dá-ma
target: Entrust those tablets there with Uṣurānum as witness to Puzurkunu and Aluwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-ub-lu-nim
target: So they may bring them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu ṭup-pu-um ša ḫu-bu-ul ṣí-lá-(d)IM
target: the tablet concerning Ṣill-Adad's debt

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu ṭup-pu-um iš-té-en ù ší-na
target: as well as one or two other tablets

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu ṭup-pu-um ša be-lu-ba-ni i-ba-ší
target: and the tablet concerning Bēlum-bāni are available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar KÙ.BABBAR-pì lá i-ḫa-li-qú e-pu-uš
target: Act so that my silver is not lost.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.GI a-na a-mur-(d)UTU ša-áp-kà-ku
target: I have invested 2 minas of gold in Amur-Šamaš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.GI a-na a-zu-za ša-áp-kà-ku
target: I have invested 1 mina of gold in Azuza.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pì-a ta-ma-lá-kam ku-nu-ki-a IGI šu-be-lim DUMU ku-zi-zi-a IGI šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-ki-tim e-zi-ba-kum
target: I left you my tablets, a container under my seal, with Šu-Bēlum son of Kuziziya and Šu-Ištar son of Šukkutum as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.GI a-na a-mur-a-šur DUMU šu-IŠTAR
target: 1 mina of gold for Amur-Aššur son of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.GI a-na DINGIR-ku-ru-ub DUMU ì-lí-li-dí
target: 2 minas of gold for Ilī-kurub son of Ilī-liddi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.GI a-na a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU sí-ku-ḫi-im ša-áp-kà-ku
target: I have invested 1 mina of gold in Ali-ahum son of Sikuhum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ma-ma-an i-na DAM.GÀR-ri lu KÙ.BABBAR lu URUDU ú-šé-ba-lam
target: If any of the customers sends either silver or copper,

source: translate Akkadian to English: mu-ḫu-ur-ma ṭup-pì-a šé-ṣí-a-ma
target: receive it and take out my tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ku-ta-nu 9 ma-na AN.NA iš-tù 8 ša-na-at a-na PUZUR₄-sú-in a-na e-bu-ṭim a-dín
target: I gave 8 textiles and 9 minas of tin 8 years ago to Puzur-Suen as an investment loan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ AN.NA ú li-wi-sú a-na a-mur-a-šur DUMU i-dí-lim a-na e-bu-ṭim a-dín
target: I gave 1 talent of tin and its wrapping to Amur-Aššur son of Iddin-ilum as an investment loan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN ší-kam KI ku-zi-zi-a
target: 15 shekels of šikkum owed by Kuziziya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.GI KI en-um-a-šur DUMU ṣí-li-IŠTAR
target: 0.3333 mina of gold owed by Ennam-Aššur son of Ṣilli-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na IŠTAR-pí-lá-aḫ DUMU a-ni-nim lá-ma a-na a-lim(ki) ur-du-ni a-na e-bu-ṭim a-dí-šu-um
target: I gave 2 minas of silver to Ištar-pilah son of Anninum before he went down to the City as an investment loan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ta-dá-an AN.NA-ki-šu KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu en-um-a-šur i-lqé
target: When the tin is sold, Ennam-Aššur will receive its value in silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.6666600000000003 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i li-bi i-ku-pí-a en-um-a-šur i-šu
target: Ikūn-pīya owes 2.6666 minas 5 shekels of refined silver to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 1 su-pá-nu-um ša KÙ.BABBAR a-na 1 ma-na 7 GÍN
target: Also, 1 supannu-container of silver for 1 mina 7 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú iš-tù ší-im 2 ma-na 2-x GÍN AN.NA-ki-šu KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu ṣa-ḫu-ru
target: Also, after the price in silver of his 2 minas 2 + x shekels of tin has been deducted,

source: translate Akkadian to English: x GÚ AN.NA i-ku-pí-a a-na en-um-a-šur e-zi-ib
target: Ikūn-pīya will leave x talents of tin for Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta e-eb-ri a-ta
target: Please, my brother, my friend.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÚ-tim DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im
target: by Biltum son of Ali-ahum

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma a-na 1 ma-na-im KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pí-im a-šu-mì i-ku-pí-a a-na i-na-a DUMU a-mu-ra-a a-pu-ul
target: Further, I balanced for 1 mina of refined silver because of Ikūn-pīya with Innaya son of Amuraya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ta-qí-ša-šu ra-ki-sú-ma
target: You must bind him contractually for every shekel of silver you donated to him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-mì-ú-tim ú-lá a-da-ga-al
target: I do not look at the others there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-a-tí a-da-ga-lá-ku-um
target: I only look at you!

source: translate Akkadian to English: zi-ki ù šu-ku-ba-am ú-ma-kál lá i be-tu
target: As for Ziki and Šu-Kūbum, they must not stay overnight one single day.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim IGI kà-ri-im iq-bi
target: These words he spoke before the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.16666 GÍN a mu-uš-ṭá-tim dín-ma
target: Give 1/6 shekel for combs

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-uk-ma
target: and put it under seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ku-bu-um e-ri-ú-ma lá tù-šé-ba-lam
target: Do not send Šu-Kūbum here empty-handed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-ší-am
target: Let him bring it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send me 6 shekels of silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.33333 GÍN dín-ma ša-x-x-am ta-ša-am
target: and make 0.3333 shekel of it available so that one can buy ?

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-bi₄ lá tù-lá-ma-an
target: Do not disappoint me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send it to me!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša a-lim(ki)-ma a-na ṣa-ḫe-er ra-bi li-li-kam-ma
target: The tablet of the City should come to the plenary assembly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na e-ri-iš-tí-šu lu i-na ra-bi-ú-tim lu i-na ṣa-ḫu-ru-tim ma-ma-an ú-lá i-za-az
target: And no one, either among the great men or among the small men, may carry out his wishes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: da-me mì-ma ú-lá ak-bu-ús
target: I have not in any way remitted the blood-money.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um a pì-šu wa-šá-áb
target: The colony supports him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um dí-nam i-dín-ma
target: The colony passed a verdict to the effect that

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí da-mu ša DUMU ša-lim-a-šùr i-kà-šu-du-ni
target: until they acquire the blood-money for Šalim-Aššur's son

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-ba-ar ta-wi-ni-a ma-ma-an ú-lá i-kà-ba-as
target: no one may forgive the colleague from Tawniya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ra-am a-na ší-bu-tim ú-šé-lá-am
target: He shall take the colony as witness.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr lu i-na ra-bi₄-ú-tim lu i-na ṣa-ḫu-ru-tim pì-šu-nu li-ip-té-ú
target: They must make a statement before Aššur's dagger, whether they are from the great men or from the small men.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam šu-ma ša ki-ma šu-a-tí a-lam₅(ki) im-ta-aḫ-ru um-ma šu-nu-ma da-me a-ḫi-šu a-lá-ḫu-um IGI kà-ri-im ik-bu-ús
target: If his representatives have approached the city there, saying: "Ali-ahum has remitted the blood-money for his brother before the colony".

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ší-bé ša ra-bi-ú-tim i-šu-am
target: If he has witnesses among the great men against me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-nam a-qá-be
target: then what can I say?

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma dí-in kà-ri-im i-de₈-ma da-me a-ḫi-a ik-bu-ús-ma ù a-na e-ri-iš-tí-šu i-zi-iz
target: If anyone knows the verdict of the colony and yet remits my brother's blood-money or indeed carries out his wishes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṭup-pì-im ša a-lim(ki) wa-dí-a-nim ki-ma da-me ik-bu-sú ù i-tù-ru-ma a-na e-ri-iš-tí-šu i-zi-iz
target: Then make it known in a tablet of the City, namely that he has remitted the blood-money and again has carried out his wishes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-(d)UTU-ši ù da-da-a-ma
target: From Aššur-šamšī and Dādaya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku ù šu-ut i-na ṭup-pì-ni ù ší-be-ni a-ma-kam IGI a-lim(ki) lu ni-iz-ku
target: I and he should clear our affair there with our tablets and our witnesses before the City assembly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na KÙ.BABBAR lá kà-áš-da-ku
target: He said: "I have not been able to acquire the silver."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-LÁ.MA tí-ir-tí-kà šu-(d)EN.LÍL a-na KÙ.BABBAR-pì ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu ni-ṣa-ba-at-ma
target: In accordance with your instructions, we seized Šu-Illil with respect to the silver and its interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-ta ma-lá-kà
target: You must make up your mind there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-ma-am a-ša-qá-al-ma
target: Will it be acceptable if I pay 3 minas of silver today,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà ú-me-e ta-ša-kà-na-ni
target: and you then set a term for me for the rest of your silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-lá-qé-ma
target: he said: "I shall take 1 mina of silver,"

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR DUMU um-me-a-nim ke-nim e-pu-ul-ni-a-tí
target: a reliable affiliated trader guaranteed 3 minas of silver for us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a ma-lá ṭup-pu-ni bi-xx ta-am-ta-ga-ar-ni-a-tí
target: If you have agreed with us in accordance with our letter,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ni-lá-qé
target: we shall receive the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na li-bi₄ KÙ.BABBAR-pì-im a-lá-qé
target: I shall take that out of the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na gi₅-mì-li-ku-nu ša šu-(d)EN.LÍL DUMU ma-num-ki-a-šur
target: Also, as for your favours to Šu-Illil son of Mannum-kī-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i-na a-wa-tí-ni šu-ma lá ta-am-ta-ga-ar-ni-a-tí
target: But if you do not agree with us in our decision,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-lá e-pu-ul-ni-a-tí
target: then he will not have guaranteed the silver for us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma en-um-a-šur a-ḫu-šu 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-bi₄-a ḫa-bu-ul
target: and furthermore his brother Ennam-Aššur owes 1 mina of silver to my father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 ta-ma-lá-ke ša ṭup-pé a-na šu-be-lim ni-a-im e-zi-ib
target: Seven boxes with tablets I left behind to our Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 DUB ša 2 GÚ 40 ma-na URUDU ṣa-lá-mì-im
target: One tablet for 2 talents and 40 minas of black copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-ni-um ṭup-pu-um ša 15 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ša ḫu-bu-ul en-na-sú-en₆
target: A second tablet for 15 minas of refined copper, being the debt of Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 23 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ša ḫu-bu-ul a-šur-ANDUL ù dí-dí-a
target: One tablet for 23 minas of refined copper being the debt of Aššur-ṣulūlī and Didiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-na šu-be-lim e-zi-ib
target: All this I left behind to Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-sà-nim DUMU šu-be-lim
target: and of Asānum, son of Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-a-nim DUMU a-ki-a-nim
target: Seal of Šu-Anim, son of Akiānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šùr-DU₁₀ DUMU a-hu-wa-qar
target: Seal of Aššur-ṭāb, son of Ahu-waqar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-du-gul DUMU im-da-hī
target: Seal of Aššur-dugul, son of Imdī-ahī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU i-dí-ba-ni
target: Seal of Aššur-ṭāb, son of Idi-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er a-šùr-DU₁₀ DUMU i-dí-ba-ni en-na-sú-in i-šu
target: Ennam-Suen has a claim of 12 shekels of silver against Aššur-ṭāb, son of Idi-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM na-ar-ma-ak-a-šur li-mu-um e-lá-li DUMU i-ku-nim
target: Month II / III, eponymy of Elalī, son of Ikūnum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣí-ib-tám ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im kà-né-eš ú-ṣa-áb
target: He will add interest according to the regulation of the Kanesh colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7.5 GÍN ší-im-šu
target: 7.5 shekels is its price.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na bu-ú-lá-tù-šu
target: 1/3 mina is his capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 5.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI ṣí-li-IŠTAR ša ší-na-hu-tim
target: 0.5 mina 5.5 shekels of silver is with Ṣilli-Ištar of Šinahuttum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR me-eh-ra-tim a-dí-šu-um
target: I gave him 1 mina of silver as equivalent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ib-ni-(d)IM DUMU kà-a-a iš-pu-ra-ma
target: Before Ibni-Adad, son of Kaya, he sent (a message).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na AN.NA a-na me-er-i-šu ù e-mì-šu a-dí-in
target: I gave 1 mina of tin to his son and his father-in-law.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ŠÀ.BA 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: Of that, 7 shekels of silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im bi-ti i tù-wa-ri-šu i-ša-qal
target: He will pay the price of the house upon his return.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 TÚG ku-nu-ki-a ša É a-lá-hi-im e-zi-bu
target: As for the 13 textiles under my seal that I left in the house of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-um a-lá-ḫu-um DUMU i-na-aḫ-DINGIR
target: Eponymy of Alī-ahum, son of [Anah-ilī].

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na šu-be-lim-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur said to Šu-Bēlum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: al-kam ṭup-pí-a lu-kà-li-im-kà
target: Come! Let me show you my tablets!

source: translate Akkadian to English: i pí-i i-sú-ri-ik a-bi-a qá-tá-at a-bi-kà al-ta-pá-at
target: On the orders of Issu-arik, my father, I wrote myself as your father's guarantor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu i-na na-ru-qí-a KÙ.BABBAR ma-da-ma a-na ḫu-bu-ul a-bi-kà ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: and I paid a great deal of silver from my joint-stock capital for your father's debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 13 ma-na URUDU lá-mu-na-am i-ṣé-er šu-be-lim ša-lim-a-šùr i-dí-i
target: Šalim-Aššur submitted 1 talent 13 minas of bad copper as a claim on Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu i-ba-ba-tí-šu KÙ.BABBAR al-qé-ma
target: I took silver from his outstanding claims

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ḫu-bu-li-šu ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: and paid it to cover his debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PUZUR₄-a-šùr IGI en-na-nim
target: Witnessed by Puzur-Aššur, by Ennānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: we-da-am i-a-tí tù-la-ma-da-ni
target: You inform me alone.

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-dum a-ḫe-a-ma šé-a-ni
target: Sue me together with my brothers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš x i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us judges for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É-bé-tù ša ša-lim-ma šu-ma
target: That house now belongs to Šalimma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ṭup-pá-am ša ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: and we gave a tablet with our testimony before the dagger of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ší-im É-šu-nu a-šùr-DU₁₀ ù IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ša-bu-ú
target: and with the price for their house Aššur-ṭāb and Ištar-lamassī are satisfied.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É ša IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù a-šùr-DU₁₀ a-na 2.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša-lim-ma i-dí-nu-ma
target: The house of Ištar-lamassī and Aššur-ṭāb they sold to Šalimma for 2.5 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ma-an a-na É-be-tí i-tù-a-ar-ší-im
target: If anybody raises a claim against her for the house,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-DU₁₀ ù IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ú-bu-bu-ší
target: Aššur-ṭāb and Ištar-lamassī will clear her.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ší-im É-be-tí a-ni-ú-tim ša ku-nu-uk nu-a-im be-el É pá-nim a-šùr-DU₁₀ a-na ša-lim-ma i-dí-in
target: The tablet recording the payment for this house with the seal of the Anatolian who was the previous owner of the house, Aššur-ṭāb has given to Šalimma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI (d)UTU-ba-ni
target: In the presence of Šamaš-bāni

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma ṭup-pí a-ni-ú-tim a-na qá-tí am-tim e-zi-ib
target: I left all these tablets in the hands of the maid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu a-na té-er-tí-a iḫ-da
target: My dear brothers, pay attention to my instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x x lu-qú-tí KÙ.BABBAR 9 GÍN ṣa-áb-ta-šu-nu-ma
target: Seize my goods, some 9 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú šu-nu-tí KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-lá-šu-nu
target: And then make them pay the silver to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lu-lú-a dan-a-šùr ù lá-qé-ep qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To Alulaya, Dan-Aššur and Lā-qēp from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ša a-na-ku wa-áš-ba-ku-ni KÙ.BABBAR ša-qí-il₅ ú lá ša-qí-il₅ tí-ir-ta-ak-nu a-ṣé-ri-a iš-tí ḫu-ma-ša-na li-li-kam
target: As if I was staying there myself, send me word with Humašana whether the silver has been paid or not.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí am-tí-a ku-nu-ku-a li-ib-ší
target: Let the silver stay with my maid under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: er-ša-ší-ma
target: Demand them from her,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-a ep-ša-ma
target: act in accordance with my instructions,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar lá-qá-im ku-un-kà-ma
target: and seal what there is to receive

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-ib-ší
target: and let it be.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÚ 35 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-um iš-tí bé-lí-a
target: 3 talents 35 minas of washed copper is with Bēliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú e-me-ri ú al-pá-am dí-na-ma
target: Give the sheep and the ox,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu-nu lu ša-li-iṭ
target: and let the silver for them be available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI Ḫa-ta-aḫ-šu
target: 0.66666 mina 5 shekels of silver is with Hatahšu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú iš-tí en-na-nim mu-ša-ri-dim
target: 1 mina 15 shekels of silver plus its interest is with Ennānum, the caravan guide.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN iš-tí i-lá-li-iš-kán na-pá-ḫi-im
target: 10 shekels is with Ilališkan, the smith.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu u₄-mu-šu-nu e-ta-at-qú
target: My dear brothers, their terms are overdue.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-lá-šu-nu
target: Make them pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i ku-nu-ki-šu li-ib-ší
target: Let it stay under his seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ḫa-ar-pè i-ša-qal
target: He will pay at harvest time.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù Ḫa-na-ak-na-ak uš-té-bi₄-lam
target: He has sent me the silver from Hanaknak.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am 3.16666 GÍN KÙ.GI ša áb-ni-šu ku-nu-ki-a
target: 1.5 mina of refined silver, 3.1666 shekels of gold dust under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 UDU.ḪI.A 1 GU₄.ḪI.A ù 1 ṣú-ub-ra-am
target: 20 sheep, 1 ox and one slave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mí-ma a-nim ša-lim-bé-lí ù e-wa-ri-mu-ša i-ra-dí-a-ku-nu-tí
target: All this Šalim-bēlī and Ewarimuša lead to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR sà-ḫe-er-tám li-il₅-qé-ú-nim
target: Let them take small goods worth 1.5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI šu-IŠTAR ni-a-im ša ki-ma ṣí-lá-bi₄-im
target: 9 shekels of silver is with our own Šu-Ištar, Șill-abum's representative.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im am-tim pè-ru-a ḫa-bu-ul
target: Peruwa owes 0.33333 mina 5 shekels of silver, the price of a slave-girl.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí KÙ.BABBAR uk-ta-al
target: With the silver he is held.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lu-bu-šu il₅-qé
target: Two shekels of silver, his clothing allowance, he has received.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ ú-ta-ar-ma ú i-ta-lá-ak
target: When he returns the silver he can leave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-e-ma ú-dá-pì-ir
target: If he goes somewhere else

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-ga-ar-ma ig-ri sà-ri-dim ú-ma-lá
target: I will rent somebody and the wages of the donkey-driver he shall compensate.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12.5 GÍN ú-nu-sú-nu
target: 12.5 shekels for their equipment.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu 1.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 5 black donkeys cost 1.66666 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am bé-ú-lá-tim ša e-lá-ma
target: 25 shekels of refined silver, a working capital belonging to Elamma,

source: translate Akkadian to English: PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU id-na-a il₅-qé
target: Puzur-Ištar, son of Idnāya, has received.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB zi-qí-qí DUMU ì-lí-dan
target: Seal of Ziqiqi, son of Ilī-dān.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šál-ma-a-šur DUMU ú-zu-a
target: Seal of Šalim-Aššur, son of Uzua.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU id-na-a
target: Seal of Puzur-Ištar, son of Idnāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x 15.33333 GÍN.TA KÙ.BI 45.33333 ma-na 1 GÍN
target: at the rate of 15.3333 to 1: in silver 45.3333 minas 1 shekel

source: translate Akkadian to English: 50 ma-na AN.NA qá-tim
target: 50 minas of hand-tin

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 GÍN.TA KÙ.BE
target: at the rate of 13 to 1

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.83333 ma-na x GÍN
target: in silver 3.83333 minas

source: translate Akkadian to English: ... a-na 1.5 sà-ri-de₈-e x 1 ma-na 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na be-a-lim ni-dí-in
target: to 1.5 caravan drivers we gave 1 mina 12 shekels of silver as interest-free loan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 45 TÚG 3.83333 ma-na 3 GÍN it-bu-lu
target: 45 textiles cost 3.83333 minas 3 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na lu-bu-ší-šu-nu ni-dí-in
target: We gave 5 shekels of silver for their clothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 20 TÚG ša li-we-tim
target: Therein 20 textiles for wrapping.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 25 TÚG e-li-a-tum
target: 25 textiles are top-load.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ša sà-ra-tim li-mu-um i-dí-a-bu-um
target: Month Ša-sarrātim, eponymy Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 7 ma-na 7 GÍN AN.NA ša ni-ip-lá-tim ša ku-zi-a a-na ILLAT-tim ḫa-bu-lu
target: Concerning the 7 minas 7 shekels of tin from the balance payment that Kuziya owes to the caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA dan-a-šùr i-šqú-ul
target: Dan-Aššur has paid the tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ša-me-ma a-šur-DU₁₀ lá li-bi₄ i-lí-ma me-et
target: I hear that Aššur-ṭāb has unfortunately died.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ú-a be-lu-ú-a a-tù-nu
target: Please my fathers and lords.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na lu-lu-ú en-um-a-šur ù a-bu-ša-lim qí-bi-ma um-ma a-šur-DU₁₀-ma
target: Say to Lullu, Ennam-Aššur and Abu-šalim thus Aššur-ṭāb:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 GÍN.TA 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp im-dí-dan iš-tí šál-ma-a-šùr dan-a-šùr il₅-qé
target: Reckoned at the rate 1:7 Dan-Aššur has received 1 mina 10 shekels of refined silver from Imdī-dan's silver from Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-na-nim DUMU a-la-bi-im
target: Sealed by Ennānum son of Ali-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB dan-a-šùr DUMU ir-nu-id
target: By Dan-Aššur son of Irnuid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB bu-zu-a DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀
target: By Buzuwa son of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-du-da DUMU zu-ú-a
target: By Aduda son of Zuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ša ki-ma im-dí-dan ù ku-zi-a a-na šál-ma-a-šùr a-na 7 ma-na 7 GÍN AN.NA i-tù-ru
target: If Imdī-dan's representatives and Kuziya claim the 7 minas 7 shekels of tin from Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: dan-a-šùr DUMU ir-nu-id ú-ba-áb-šu
target: Dan-Aššur son of Irnuid will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN a-ma-kam lá i-kà-lá
target: Not a single shekel of silver must be retained there!

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma URUDU mì-ma a-ḫu-ur ba-tí-iq ù wa-tù-ur dí-na-ma ab-kà-nim
target: If any copper is still unsold, sell it at any price and ship it here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na (d)UTU-ši ṭup-pì ta-ša-me-a-ni lu-qú-tám lu pá-ni-tám lu ur-ki-tám za-ki-a-ma ku-un-kà-ma
target: the very day you hear my letter you must clear both the earlier and the later merchandise and put it under seal

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí pá-nim-ma a-bu-ša-lim ṭur₄-da-nim
target: and send Abu-šalim here with the first opportunity.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tí šál-ma-at
target: My merchandise is safe

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na-ku šál-ma-ku
target: and I myself am also well

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma
target: You wrote me as follows:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR e-zi-ib
target: 'I left behind 1.5 talent of silver'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-iš-lam al-qé
target: Half of it I collected

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-iš-lam ḫa-la-aq
target: half of it is lost

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš
target: Seal of the colony of Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-li-a ša-qí-il₅ da-tim ší-ip-ri-ni
target: To Kuliya, the payer of dues, our messenger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ar kà-ar-ma a-le sú-kà-li-a DUMU a-šùr-iš-tí-kál wa-áš-bu-ni ṣa-ḫe-er GAL
target: To every single colony, wherever Sukkaliya, son of Aššuriš-tikal is staying, small and big.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-IŠTAR a-na PUZUR₄-a-šùr DUMU i-tù-ur-DINGIR iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Šu-Ištar seized us against Puzur-Aššur, the son of Itūr-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma a-na PÚZUR-a-šùr-ma
target: Šu-Ištar said to Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma PÚZUR-a-šùr-ma ke-na ḫa-bu-lá-ku a-ša-qal
target: Puzur-Aššur answered: 'Indeed, I owe it, I will pay.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.GI ša ša-at-a-šùr ḫa-bu-lá-tí-ni SIG₅ DIRI
target: The 4 shekels of gold, which you owe to Šāt-Aššur are of very good quality!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣí-lu-lu ù da-da-a DUMU ub-ra-e-im IGI šu-ga-ri-a-im ša a-šùr DUB-pu-šu-nu i-dí-nu
target: Ṣilulu and Dadaya, son of Ubra-e-im, gave their tablet before the šugaria-emblem of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na LÁ 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša TÚG.ḪI.A ù AN.NA al-qé-ma
target: 3 minas 56 shekels of silver I took for textiles and tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.GI ša ib-na-a i-šu-ni
target: For the 43 shekels of gold, which Ibnaya has in his possession,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-is-ḫa-tí-šu ni-dí-in-ma
target: we paid the import-tax on it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU DINGIR-ba-ni
target: Seal of Aššur-malik son of Ilī-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-la-hi-im DUMU i-na-ah-DINGIR
target: seal of Ali-ahum son of Inah-ilī

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na 0.66666 GÍN KÙ.GI ni-iš₆-am-ma 7.66666 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu
target: and the remaining 40.6666 shekels of gold we bought at 7.66666 shekels of silver per shekel of gold;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na 11.83333 GÍN
target: its equivalent in silver was 5 minas 11.83333 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-mur-IŠTAR DUMU mì-šu-GAL
target: seal of Amur-Ištar son of Miššu-rabi

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-šu 1 ma-na 15.83333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: the rest of his silver, 1 mina 15.83333 shekels of silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ša ki-ma šu-a-tí a-dí-ma i-ša-qá-lam
target: I gave to his representative so that he will pay me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 24 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi-im a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim i-šu-ú
target: Concerning 24 minas of refined silver that Iddin-abum owes to Aššur-bēl-awātim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ha-mu-uš-tim ša li-ba-a ù ì-lí-iš-tí-kál a-na 20 ha-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Libbaya and Iliš-tikal he must pay within 20 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul
target: If he has not paid (in time),

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na ma-na-im i-na ITU.1.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
target: he must pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-ba-ni IGI lá-qé-ep
target: Witnessed by Aššur-bāni, by Lā-qēp.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ṭup-pu-šu i-lá-pu-tù
target: If they write his tablet,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ma-na KÙ.GI šu-mì a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim i-lá-pá-at
target: he must book 6 minas of gold in the name of Aššur-bēl-awātim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11.83334 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na bé-lúm-ba-ni i-dí-in
target: 11.83333 shekels of silver he gave to Bēlum-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.16666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú 0.5 GÍN ṣí-ib-ta-am i-x-x-x a-na a-ta-na-ah ni-dí-in …
target: 1.1666 shekels of silver and 0.5 as interest to Atanah we gave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi₄ a-hu-ša DUMU ku-ra
target: 0.5 shekel of silver is owed by Ahuša, son of Kura.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi₄ za-ga-al-i IR-dí-šu
target: 0.5 shekel is owed by Zagalɹu, his slave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.83334 GÍN dá-a-tí
target: 0.83333 shekel my road-tax.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na KÙ ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ha-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu i-na ILLAT šu-(d)EN.LÍL a-na i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-na e-bu-Ṧim i-dí-a-šùr i-dí-in
target: Iddin-Aššur has given 4 minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, from the caravan of Šu-Illil, to Iddin-abum as an investment loan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 0.33333 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im am-tí-im ša a-na a-ta-na-ah a-dí-nu-šu-ni
target: Of 24 shekels of silver, the price of the slave-girl, which I had given to Atanah,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-hu-qar i-dí-in
target: he gave 4 shekels of silver to Ahu-waqar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÌN KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-šur-DU₁₀ a-dí-in
target: I gave (this) 0.5 shekel of silver to Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-li-a-hu-um DUMU i-na-ah-DINGIR
target: Witnessed by Ali-ahum, son of Enah-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am KI ku-lá-ba šu-pu-na-ah-šu ú ḣa-nu-nu
target: 6 minas of refined silver is owed by Kulaba, Šupun-ahšu and Hanunu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am KI be-lúm-ba-ni DUMU kà-sí-a

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ku-ta-ni a-na ha-ra-ni-a al-qé

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-a li-dí-na-ku-nu-tí

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-tur₄-DINGIR-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-na AN.NA ša KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na ú-šé-lá-šum

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá li-bi₄ DINGIR-ma a-bu-kà me-et
target: Sadly, your father has died.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-hu-ú-a a-tù-nu ih-da
target: My dear brothers, take care

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma i-ṣé-ri-a ṣí-ib-tum lá i-lá-qé
target: so he does not take any interest from me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: bu-lá-tù ša a-bi₄-kà kà-an-ku-ma i-ba-ší-ú
target: The assets of your father have been sealed and are available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-sú iq-bi
target: He spoke his will.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-mì-a-nu mu-ut a-bi₄-kà iš-me-ú-ma
target: The investors heard of your father's death and

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma ba-áb-tám i É-tim lá i-ba-ší-ú
target: There is nothing from outstanding claims in the house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta lam-ni-iš té-pu-uš-a-ni
target: you have treated me badly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim ša i-pá-na nu-sá-li-ú-šù-nu-tí-ni a-wi-lu ma-ag-ru
target: The men agreed to that which we had earlier pleaded with them about.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku dam-qá-tim a-šé-e-a-kum
target: While I am bent on doing what is good for you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum bu-lá-tim ša a-bi₄-ku-nu a-na KÙ.BABBAR … na ki-ma … …-šù-nu e-pu …
target: Urgent: (turn) the assets of your father into silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i-a-tí be-li ki-ma NINDA e-kà-lá-ni
target: As for me, my lord is consuming me like bread.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-ma-kam tù-ša-zi-zi-ni um-ma a-ta-ma
target: As you instructed me there, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im am-tim a-na me-er-i-a lá ta-dí-ni
target: 'You must not give the price of the slave-girl to my son!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ší-a-tí a-na me-er-i-kà lá a-dí-ší
target: For that reason I have not given her to your son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI bé-li-kà-ù bé-el-tí-kà
target: Before your lord and your lady.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI wa-al-dí-lim ù kà-ar-ni-kà-šu
target: Witnessed by Waldi-ilum and Karnikašu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lim-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma (d)IM.GAL-ma
target: To Šalim-Aššur from Adad-rabi:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša tù-ùh-tù-ha-nim 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù 2 UDU.HI.A i-du-nu
target: They will give 1.5 mina of silver plus 2 sheep for the feast of Tuhtuhānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er a-li-li ù kà-ar-ší-ni wa-al-dí-lúm ù IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí i-šu-ú
target: Alili and Karšini owe 1 mina of silver to Waldi-ilum and Ištar-lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im URUDU ù KÙ.BABBAR ba-áb-tám ša nu-a-am ú-ša-zi-za-ku-ni šé-bi₄-lam-ma
target: Send me the price of the copper and the outstanding silver for which I made the native responsible to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-up-ra-am-ma a-ma-at-kà a-ša ki-ma ku-a-tí lá-dí-in
target: And send me a message then I will give your slave-girl to your representative.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma ṭup-pu-um šu-um-šu ú-lá ha-ri-im
target: They answered: 'No tablet at all was certified.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ú-šé-bi-lam-ma
target: He sent us the silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wi-li ni-iš-qú-ul
target: and we paid the men

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṭup-pí a-šu-mì i-dí-a-bi-im ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni
target: As to the tablets concerning Iddin-abum that you wrote to me about

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-ma-lik ù ša-lim-a-šur áš-al-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma
target: I asked Aššur-malik and Šalim-Aššur, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma ke-na i-sú-ri-ik i-na ma-ah-ri-ni e-ta-wu-šù-um
target: They continued: 'It is true that Issu-arik discussed with him in our presence.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-hi-kà lá-šu
target: If there is no silver belonging to your brother,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na na-ru-qí-kà šu-qúl
target: then pay out of your joint-stock capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì i-sú-ri-ik a-wa-tim ša i-dí-a-bi-im iš-tí me-ra-ni iš-tí GUDU₄ ša IŠTAR ù É za-ak-ta-a
target: When Issu-arik cleared up Iddin-abum's affairs with Merani, with the priest of Ištar and Zaktaya's firm.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-li ta-ad-mì-iq-tám i-dí-nu-šù-ni
target: And where he gave him a free loan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tim ig-mu-ru
target: At that time they finished the matters.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ha-bu-ul a-hi-kà lu a-na-kam lu i-na GÁN-lim šu-qú-ul-ma
target: He said: 'Pay the debt of your brother, both here and abroad.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-lik-ma i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-hi-kà le-qé
target: And then go and take it again out of your brother's silver.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì-šù-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša ša-qá-lim iš-qú-ul
target: At that time he paid the silver for paying.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR ṭup-pí-šu ú-ha-ri-mu
target: But did they certify his tablets for the rest of the silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša i-dí-a-bu-um ha-bu-lu-ma
target: Stating that Iddin-abum owed it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šál-ma-a-šùr qá-ta-tù-ni
target: And that Šalim-Aššur was the guarantor?

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ku-ta-num 2 šu-re-en₆ ša šu-ku-bi-im a-na 0.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-bu-ru-uš-ha-tim ta-ad-nu

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 15 ma-na URUDU a šu-mì-a ú-ṣa-hi-ru
target: And they deducted that of 15 minas of copper for my account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim ša i-sú-ri-ik i-na ma-ah-ri-šù-nu e-ta-wu-ku-ni
target: For these words which Issu-arik discussed with you in their presence

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-šé-ra-sú-nu-ma KÁ DINGIR ṭup-pá-áš-nu a-lá-q
target: I shall lead them off, and I shall receive their tablet in the Gate of the God.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA ša 25 ma-na URUDU KÙ-áp-šu a šu-mì šu-ku-bi₄-im ú-ṣa-hi-ru
target: From it they deducted the silver equivalent of 25 minas of copper for Šu-Kūbum's account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-šu 14 GÍN
target: The rest of his silver is 14 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku a-na-pá-al
target: I myself will pay 4 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na kà-ni-iš ša-lim-a-šùr i-dí-in

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.5 ma-na LÁ 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR té-pu-ul-šum
target: Of this amount you paid him 28 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ i-tu-me-li-a a-dí-šum
target: 2 shekels of silver I gave him in Tumeliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.66666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú-kúl-tí ANŠE ù da-a-sú ša a-dí wa-ah-šu-ša-na
target: 1.6666 shekel of silver fodder for the donkey and road-tax for it until Wahšušana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ni-ša-am a-ba-ra-im li-ik-šu-dam
target: It should reach me here before the suspension of traffic.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-lá-ma-ma ù kur-ub-IŠTAR-ma a-na da-da ù i-na-aḫ-DINGIR qí-bi-ma
target: Thus Elamma and Kurub-Ištar, say to Dada and Ēnah-ilī:

target: 3 shekels of silver for 30 textiles from Ulama until Burušhattum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù É wa-áb-ri
target: And for the cost of the inn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i ki-dim a-wa-at-ku-nu lá i-ša-me
target: No word of you should be heard outside!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er ha-bi-a ù a-ší-tí-šu a-lā-hu-um i-šu
target: Habiya and his wife owe 0.3333 mina 1.5 shekel of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša e-la-ma
target: The silver belongs to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša aḫ-ša-lim a-na a-bi-ku-nu ub-lá-ni
target: The 30 minas of silver that Ah-šalim brought to your father,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma 15 GÍN.TA i-ba-ší AN.NA ša-ma-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: if there is tin available at a rate of 15 shekels (to 1), then buy it and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na 15 GÍN.TA ba-tí-iq
target: If the rate is less than 15 shekels (to 1)

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-iš-lam AN.NA mì-iš-lam TÚG.ḪI.A ša-ma-ma
target: then buy for one half of it tin and for the other half textiles

source: translate Akkadian to English: i pá-ni-im-ma áb-kà-nim
target: and ship them to me with the first opportunity.

target: When you seal the tin and the textiles

target: write on the packets (with tin) and on the hem of the textiles

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša DAM.GÀR lá-pí-ta-nim
target: "Belonging to the merchant".

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma a-mur-a-šur-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Amur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú u₄-mu-a 2 ITU.KAM a-ḫu-ru
target: Also, my term still runs for 2 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ra-áb-a-šur DUMU a-šur-i-mí-tí
target: Witnessed by Rab-Aššur son of Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí KÙ.BABBAR-kà ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni
target: Concerning your silver that you wrote me about,

source: translate Akkadian to English: tap-pá-i KÙ.BABBAR uš-ta-pár-ki
target: my partner has allowed the silver to stop.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí šu-ma a-a-e-ma pu-uz-ra-am i-ṣa-ba-at
target: Until, if he takes refuge anywhere,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ba-lu-um dí-nim ù ṣa-al-tim i-ša-qá-lam
target: he shall pay 1 mina of silver without lawsuit or litigation.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù 8.33333 ma-na URUDU SIG₅
target: 12 shekels of silver plus 8.3333 minas of good copper

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ni-mar-ZU ba zi ú ni i li-bi₄ en-nam-a-šur DUMU (d)MAR.TU-ba-ni
