source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ku-ul-tí MAŠKIM a-na-ku-ma ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: I too paid for the food of the attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣí-li-a mì-ma a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-šu ú-lá i-dín
target: Ṣilliya did not give anything for his food.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x 0.5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ mu-ṣí-šu ú pu-ru-sà-e ša ra-bi₄-ṣí-im i ra-mì-ni-a áš-qú-ul
target: I personally paid x 0.5 minas of good copper, the exit-tax and the decision of the attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ki-iš-da-tí-a a-na i-dí-a-šùr DUMU dan-a-šùr i ra-mì-ni-a áš-qú-ul
target: I myself paid 0.6666 mina 7.5 shekels of refined silver, my earnings, to Iddin-Aššur son of Dan-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na KÙ.BABBAR ša É a-bi-a gám-ri a-lá-qé
target: I shall take my expenses from the silver of my father's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-dí a-wa-tim ša É a-bi-ni kà-šá-dim ú-ga-me-er
target: All this I have paid in order to conclude the matter of our father's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú iš-tù ku-bu-ur-na-at a-dí dur₄-ḫu-mì-it ni-tù-ru-ni
target: Then we returned from Kuburnat to Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ga-me-er
target: 0.5 mina 4 shekels of silver was the expense.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma sà-ba-sí-a ù tám-kà-ru-um-ma a-na pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù zi-ki-ki qí-bi-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur, Sabasiya and the merchant to Pilah-Ištar and Zikiki:

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu a-na ri-ig-ma-tim i-dí-a-šur ir-dí-ni-a-tí-ni
target: I personally spent 1 talent 40 minas (of copper) both when Iddin-Aššur led us to the court case.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu a-na ṭup-pí ša ší-bi₄ i bá-áb DINGIR-lim ú-ga-ri-mu-ni
target: and when they produced the tablet with witnesses in the gate of the God.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 40 ma-na ag-mu-ur-ma mì-iš-li-šu ṣí-li-a i-dín-nam
target: and Ṣilliya gave me half of that.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì a-na-ku ù a-ba-ba a-ṣé-er ì-lí-dan e-tí-qú-ni
target: When I and Ababa travelled to Ilī-dan

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ḫa-ra-nim lu a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim ni-is-ḫu-ru-ma
target: we were delayed on the journey until this very day

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-sú ni-ib-tù-qú-ni
target: and we dropped his case

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša tám-kà-ri-im
target: 30 minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid, belonging to a merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ni a-ta li-bi₄ zi-ki-ki lá tù-lá-ma-an
target: Our dear brother, do not make Zikiki angry.

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-tum ša-kà-nu-um lá-šu
target: There is no way to lay claim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṭup-pè-en₆ a-me-e-en₆ qá-tum ša-kà-nu-um wa-du
target: Laying claim was indicated on those two tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-tí a-lim(ki) da-nu-tù-um i-li-kam
target: A strongly worded message from the City arrived.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-p
target: Send those two tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ni-am a-na pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR pì-qí-id-ma
target: Entrust this to Pilah-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí a-wi-tí-šu e-ta-wu
target: Join it to his consignment.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-ta i-na re-ší-šu i-zi-iz-ma
target: Then you personally may serve him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN lu ṭá-ba-tí
target: Be positive over every shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ik-ri-bu ša a-šur ša tám-kà-ri-ma ku-nu-ki-šu
target: Further, 10 minas of refined silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid, votive offerings for Aššur, also belonging to a merchant and sealed by him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṣé-er ì-lí-iš-tí-kál ù pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR zi-ki-ki na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Zikiki is bringing to you destined for Iliš-tikal and Pilah-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pè-en₆ ší-na ša a-ṣé-er ì-lí-iš-tí-kál ù pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR lá-pu-tù
target: There are two tablets that were written to Iliš-tikal and Pilah-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša šé-ep zi-ki-ki iš-tí KÙ.BABBAR-ni x x-ba-šu-ni iš-tí pá-né-e-ma šé-bi₄-lá-ni-šu-nu
target: Send them together with our silver as soon as possible.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur IGI šu-ki-tim IGI en-nu-um-sú-in
target: Witnessed by Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur, by Šukkutum, by Ennam-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma ù ṣí-li-a ša ki-ma a-lá-ḫi-im a-ḫi-šu ke-na i-na li-bi₄-ni
target: Ennam-Aššur and Ṣilliya, his brother Ali-ahum's representative, answered: 'Yes, it is in our possession.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-a-šur-ma a-na ḫa-nu-nu x a-lá-ḫi-im ù e-na-na-tim qí-bi-ma
target: From Iddin-Aššur to hanunu, Ali-ahum and Ennanātum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ba ra-bi₄-ṣú-um ša šál-ma-a-šur
target: Ababa, the attorney of Šalim-Aššur,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU šál-ma-a-šur ù ṣí-li-a ša ki-ma a-lá-ḫi-im a-ḫi-šu iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: seized us against Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur and Ṣilliya, his brother Ali-ahum's representative.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ba-ba ra-bi₄-ṣú-ma a-na en-um-a-šur ù ṣí-li-a ša ki-ma a-lá-ḫi-im
target: and the attorney Ababa said to Ennam-Aššur and Ṣilliya, Ali-ahum's representative:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 22 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ i-na li-bi₄-ku-nu
target: '22 talents of good copper are in your possession.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um dur₄-ḫu-mì-it i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Durhumit colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dín
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-šu ḫa-ar-ma-am a-na-ku ú-kà-al
target: I personally have his certified tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na kà-ni-iš a-na-ku ù a-ḫi-i ni-za-ku-ma
target: In Kanesh I and my brother will make a settlement

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-li URUDU i-na li-bi₄-ni i-bu-ra-ni KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu ni-ta-dí-a-ku-um
target: and wherever copper is shown as being owed by us, we shall deposit it for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pì-im ma-ḫi-ir a-lim(ki) en-um-(d)IM a-na DAM.GÀR-ri-im ḫa-bu-ul
target: Ennam-Adad owes worth 2 minas of refined silver at the market price in the City to a merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣí-ib-tám lá ta-ga-mì-lá-šu
target: Make him no favours on the interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iḫ-da-ma ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
target: Take care to have him pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù a-li-ki-im pá-ni-e-ma šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: and send it with the very first transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: … a li-bi₄ ṭup-pè-a šu-uk-na-ma
target: Place it among my tablets

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù tí-ir-ta-ak-nu li-li-kam
target: and then send me word.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ḫu-bu-li-šu ša li-mì ša 30 ma-na iš-tí e-na-na-tim i-ba-ší
target: The tablet concerning his debt to the eponyms, concerning 30 minas, is in Ennanātum's possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša a-ma-kam a-šar lá a-bi-im ù um-mì-im na-lá-tí-ni-ma ù mu-ur-ṣa-am a-na mu-ur-ṣí-im tù-ra-du-ú
target: Why are you lying around there where there is no father and no mother, making the disease worse?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir-ma dan-a-šur a-lá-ḫu-um ù šu-IŠTAR-ma a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Man-mahir, Dan-Aššur, Ali-ahum and Šu-Ištar to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta a-ma-kam ki-ma a-we-lim ra-qí-im ša-na-at ta-ta-šá-áb
target: you have sat there for a year as an empty man

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša tí-ir-tám ù ḫu-šá-ḫa-am lá tí-šu-ú
target: without purpose or wishes

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam um-me-a-nu a-bi-ku-nu ša ki-ma i-na pá-ni-tim té-ta-ta-ri-ša-ni a-na a-ḫi-kà ú-kà-lu-ma
target: Your father's investors here offer those things to your brother which you earlier constantly asked me for.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ki-ma a-ḫu-kà we-dí-ni-ma ù a šu-mì-kà ma-ga-ra-am ú-lá i-mu-a
target: but, in fact, since your brother is alone he is of course unwilling to agree on your behalf.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ḫi-ú-tum i-ta-bu-lu-kà
target: Also, strangers may carry you away all the time.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum i-na ša-am-ší ṭup-pí-ni ta-ša-me-ú tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: Urgent, set out and come here the very day you hear our letter!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam É a-bi-ku-nu za-ki-a
target: Clear up the affairs of your father's house here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ma-an ša-li-um i-na ṣé-ri-ku-nu lá i-ša-lá
target: No evildoer should harm you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-um-šu-ma be-el a-wa-tí-ku-nu i-na a-wa-tí i-ra-de₈-ú-k
target: Until now your accusers have been pestering you with lawsuits.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta be-lí a-ta
target: My dear brother and lord

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-na-kam a-na É DINGIR tù-ru-du-ma
target: Instead of going down to the temple here,

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí DINGIR e-na-na-tim té-ta-ri-šu
target: asking mercy from the god,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù IGI i-li-kà tù-ta-na-nu-nu
target: praying constantly to your god

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ḧu-um ù eb-ru-um li-ba-am i-da-na-ku-nu
target: so that brother and friend could give you encouragement.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN lu a-na ANŠE.ḪI.A lu a-na ḫi-šá-nim gu₅-mu-ur-ma
target: Agree to some 10 shekels of silver either for donkeys or for a pole

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: and set out and come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ì-lí-dan-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Ilī-dan to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-ri-iš-tí-šu i-té-zi-iz
target: he carried out his wishes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: gi₅-mì-li-kà-a lá a-ga-mì-il₅-kà-a
target: I shall by no means show you any favours.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-tù … a-dí-i ṭup-pu lá i-mu-tù-ú
target: Let the tablets be invalid; as long as the tablets have not been invalidated at all.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù KÙ.BABBAR maš-qá-al-ta-kà mì-ma ú-la a-ša-qá-la-kum
target: And I shall not make any payments in silver to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wi-lam₅ ú-ša-sà-ḫa-am
target: I shall have the man extradited.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i li-bi ḫa-bu-a-lá ù ta-ri-ku-da
target: 1.5 mina of silver is owed by habuala and Tarikuda.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 na-ru-uq ar-šá-tum
target: 15 sacks of wheat

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 UDU ṣú-pu-ú a-ḫa-ma
target: and 2 shorn sheep separately

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu be-lu a-tù-nu a-tù-nu a-ma-kam ší-ta-lá-ma
target: so, dear brothers and lords, take counsel there

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-lúm(ki) ù É a-bi₄-a ḫa-bu-lu ep-šá-a
target: and act because the City and my father's house have been turned into debtors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-ar-ki-tám kà-ru-um SIG₅-pí-a-šur a-na ší-ip-ru-tim iš-pu-ur-ma
target: Later the colony dispatched Damiq-pī-Aššur as envoy

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-ri-iš-tí kà-ri-im ú-ta-er-ma
target: and he rejected the wishes of the colony

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-ri-iš-tí i-tur₄-DINGIR im-ḫu-ur
target: and accepted Itūr-ilī's wishes

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im-šu-nu
target: 1.5 mina of silver is their price.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ku-ta-ni SIG₅ il₅-qé-ú-ma
target: They took 3 fine kutānu-textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na sí-kà-tim a-ṣé-er be-li-šu-nu ú-šé-bi₄-lu
target: They sent them to their masters for the sikkātum-festival.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ṭup-pá-am ša i-tur₄-DINGIR a-na ta-am-ni-a-i-im ú-šé-bi₄-lu
target: also, the letter that Itūr-Ilī sent to the king of Tawniya,

source: translate Akkadian to English: SIG₅-pí-a-šur ší-ip-ru-um ša kà-ri-im iš-ta-sí-ma
target: Damiq-pī-Aššur, as the envoy of the colony, read it aloud.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam i ša-ḫa-at a-ḫa-tí-a ù me-er-a-at a-ḫi-a i-zi-za-ma
target: Assist my sister and my brother's daughter there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lam₅(ki) mu-ùḫ-ra-ma ra-bi-ṣa-am da-na-am aḫ-za-nim
target: Appeal to the City assembly and acquire a capable attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR al-qé-e a-ḫa-ma
target: From this I have received 0.5 mina of silver separately.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma da-me-e ša a-ḫi-a lá ik-šu-du
target: Since he did not acquire my brother's blood-money

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù iš-tù MU.2.ŠÈ KÙ.BABBAR-áp É a-bi₄-a ú-ṣa-li-mu-ú
target: and since he bothered me with the silver of my father's house for two years

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ḫi a-šu-mì a-mu-tí-šu sú-ri-e dí-ku-ma
target: and my brother surely was killed because of his iron

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR 5 na-ru-uq ŠE-um
target: 15 shekels of silver and 5 sacks of barley

source: translate Akkadian to English: i li-bi₄ ta-ri-ku-da
target: are owed by Tarikuda.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim iš-tí a-da-da
target: All this is with Adada.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-mur-IŠTAR DUMU mì-šar-GAL
target: Seal of Amur-Ištar son of Mīšar-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB la-qé-ep DUMU kà-a-tim
target: Seal of Lā-qēp son of Kayātum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú šu-ut 5 UDU.ḪI.A 1.66666 GÍN.TA i-dí-nam
target: And he gave me those 5 sheep at 1.66666 shekels each.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 (TÚG)ku-ta-ni a-na 0.33333 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na pá-ni-tim IGI ki-zi ù ṣú-ḫa-ri-kà a-dí-na-kum
target: I previously gave you 2 kutānu-textiles for 0.3333 mina 2 shekels of silver with Kizi and your servant as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na 17 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša kà-ṣa-ri-a i li-bi-kà i-ri-ḫa-am
target: 2 shekels of silver out of 17 shekels of silver belonging to my packer remained as a debt of yours.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ḫu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi-im
target: Concerning the debt of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi-im DUMU i-sú-rik₁₃
target: Seal of Iddin-abum son of Issu-arik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša a-mur-IŠTAR a-na 23 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Amur-Ištar he must pay within 23 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ma-lá u₄-me-šu la iš-qú-ul
target: If he has not paid within his stipulated term

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN.TA i ITU.KAM a-na ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: he must pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-dí-a-bi-im i-tur₄-DINGIR en-na-nim ù i-na-aḫ-DINGIR qí-bi-ma um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma
target: To Iddin-abum, Itūr-ilī, Ennānum and Inah-ilī from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam i-nu-mì e-ri-qá-tim a-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim iš-tí dan-a-šur DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šur a-bu-ku
target: Here, when I shipped the wagons to Purušhaddum with Dan-Aššur son of Puzur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-tù-nu mì-il₅-kà
target: You yourselves make up your minds there!

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ta-da-ga-lá-ma ḫa-ra-num a-na ú-ša pá-tí-at-ma
target: If you observe that the road to Ušša is open,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum KÙ.BABBAR šé-bi-lá
target: then please send silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-tí a-na ṣé-er ḫa-na-a i-dí-ku-bi-im ú dan-a-šur … áš-pu-ur-ma
target: I sent my instructions to hanaya, Iddin-Kūbum and Dan-Aššur,

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim ú-šé-ba-lá-ku-nu-tí
target: I shall send it to you from Purušhaddum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá i-sà-ḫu-ur
target: He should not delay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà 23.33333 ma-na 4 GÍN
target: The rest of your silver is 23 minas and 4 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-la-ḫu-um a-šur-re-ṣí en-nam-a-šùr ú da-dí-a-ma a-na e-la-ma qí-bí₄-ma
target: Thus Ali-ahum, Aššur-rēṣī, Ennam-Aššur, and Dadiya say to Elamma:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 24.33333 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: 24 minas 4 shekels of silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ 1 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-tim ni-di-in
target: thereof we gave 61 shekels of silver as excise;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ 20 ma-na 8 GÍN AN.NA ku-nu-ku
target: 4 talents 20 minas 8 shekels of tin under seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN KÙ.BABBAR-áp-kà ù ší-im KÙ.GI 26 ma-na 9 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: Total of your silver, including the yield of the gold: 26 minas 9 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.25 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu 2.6666600000000003 ma-na 5 GÍN
target: its equivalent in silver at 1: 5 1/4 is 2 2/3 minas 5 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 GÍN i-na sà-na-qí-ni im-ṭí
target: It was 0.3333 shekel less when we checked it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ti KÙ.GI 0.5 ma-na 1.3333300000000001 GÍN
target: The rest of the gold is 31.3333 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.GI a-šùr-DU₁₀ ub-lam
target: 33 shekels of gold Aššur-ṭāb brought us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ 1.3333300000000001 GÍN 7.5 ŠE ni-is-ḫa-tim ni-dí-in
target: Thereof we gave as excise 1 3/8 shekel.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 36 (TÚG)ku-ta-nu 5.83333 GÍN.TA
target: 36 textiles at 5.83333 shekels apiece.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR-šu-nu
target: Their price in silver 3.5 minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na LÁ 5 GÍN i ma-sà-im im-ṭí
target: The silver became 55 shekels less by washing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na AN.NA-ak qá-tim
target: 30 minas hand tin,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17.25 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu
target: at 17 1/4 shekels per shekel of silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 16.66666 ma-na 9 GÍN
target: its price in silver: 16 minas 49 shekels;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 33 šu-ru-tum qá-de₈ ša li-wi-tim
target: 33 dark textiles including those for wrapping.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.66666 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu-nu
target: Their silver 1 mina 44 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mu-ú 1 ma-na 17 GÍN it-bu-lu
target: 5 black donkeys cost 1 mina 17 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na bé-ú-lá-at ú-zu-a ù šu-mì
target: 1 mina, the working capitals of Uzua and Šumi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ANŠE im-ra-aṣ-ma
target: 1 donkey became ill

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-at-ra-am ni-iš-a-ma
target: and we bought an extra one

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-lá-kà-kum
target: and it is coming to you

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ḫu-um ra-bi-ṣa-am a-ba-ba e-pu-ul-šu
target: Ali-ahum answered the attorney Ababa, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-ḫu-um-ma us-kà-i-in a ṭup-pí-im ša a-lim(ki) ù ra-bi-ṣí-im ša be-li-a
target: Ali-ahum said: "I submit to the tablet of the City and the attorney of my lord."

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ma-li-ma ta-áš-a-lá-ni-ma
target: Yesterday you questioned me

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-ul-kà um-ma a-na-ku-ma
target: and I answered you, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim(ki) ú ra-bi-ṣa-am ša be-li-ni lá nu-na-aḫ
target: We shall not obstruct the tablet of the City and the attorney of our lord.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN lu-bu-šu ša-bu
target: He has been paid 2 shekels (of silver) as his clothing allowance.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ig-re ag-ri-im a-bi-a-a DUMU ú-zu-a ú-ma-lá
target: the wages of the hireling Abiaya, son of Uzua, will compensate

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-um-a-šur DUMU i-ku-pí-a
target: Seal of Ennum-Assur, son of Ikuppiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: al-kam ba-a-am ma-lá a-bi KÙ.BABBAR i ṭup-pì-im il₅-pu-tí-ni lá-áš-qúl-ma
target: Come along, let me pay as much silver as my father noted me for in the tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na a-lim(ki) lu ni-lik
target: And then let us go to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-ni-na-a DUMU DIRI-im
target: Seal of Aninaya, son of Watrum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB e-na-a-šur DUMU šu-ul-mì-šá-a-šùr
target: seal of Ennam-Assur, son of Sulmi-sa-Assur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 ma-na URUDU ší-kam i-ṣé-er en-um-a-šùr DUMU i-ku-pí-a DAM.GÀR i-šu
target: 12 minas of copper Ennum-Assur, son of Ikuppiya, owes to the creditor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù SAG ITU.KAM tí-i-na-tim a-na ITU.KAM i-ša-qal
target: Reckoning from the beginning of month X he will pay in one month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-um da-dí-a DUMU šu-(d)NIN.ŠUBUR
target: Eponymy of Dadiya, son of Su-Ilabrat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ḫi-ta-ni DUMU DINGIR-na-da
target: Seal of Hitani, son of Ili-nada.

source: translate Akkadian to English: wa-bi₄-il₅ ṭup-pì-im šu-ut DAM.GÀR
target: The bearer of the tablet is the creditor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: al-kam u₄-ma-ma KÙ.BABBAR lá-áš-qúl-ma
target: Come, let me pay the silver even today

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ba-a-ba-tim ša a-bi-ni lu-kà-li-ma
target: and then show you the outstanding claims of our father

source: translate Akkadian to English: i ša-ḫa-tí-a i-zi-iz-ma
target: so you may assist me

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR lu nu-šá-áš-qí-il₅-ma
target: and we can have the silver paid

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá ṭup-pí-im ša a-lim(ki) a-na a-lim(ki) lu ni-lik
target: and go to the City in accordance with the tablet of the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul
target: If he does not pay

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 10 ma-na na-e 0.5 ma-na.TA i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: he will add an interest of 0.5 mina per 10 minas per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-mur-a-šùr DUMU i-šar-ki-it-a-šùr
target: seal of Amur-Assur, son of Isar-kitti-Assur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ 10 ma-na URUDU ší-kam i-na a-ba-an ma-tim i-ṣé-er ku-na-na-a ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi₄-im i-šu
target: 2 talents 10 minas of copper, by the local weight standard, Kunnanaya owes to Kuliya, son of Ali-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ITU.KAM qá-ra-a-tim li-mu-um a-šùr-SIPA DUMU ì-lí-e-mu-qí
target: Reckoning from month VIII, eponymy of Assur-re'i, son of Ili-emuqi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am x i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi₄-im šu-(d)EN.LÍL i-šu
target: Iddin-abum owes 20 minas of refined silver to Šu-Illil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša li-ba-a a-na 13 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: Reckoned from the week of Libbaya he must pay in 13 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im 1.5 ma-na.TA a-na 1 GÚ-tim i-na ITU.KAM ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: In conformity with the rule of the karum, he will add an interest of 1.5 mina per talent per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-mur-IŠTAR IGI en-nam-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Amur-Ištar, by Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-a-šùr-ma a-na e-la-ma ù a-la-ḫi-im qí-bí₄-ma
target: Thus Iddin-Aššur, say to Elamma and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ÌR a-bi₄-ì-lí ù ri-ki-sú a-na 3.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR SAḪAR.BA ku-a-li DUMU a-lá-bi₄-im iš-tí (d)UTU
target: The slave Abi-ili with his fetter, Kuliya, son of Ali-abum, bought from Samas-dugul for 3.5 shekels of 'dust silver'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul
target: If he has not paid (in time),

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: he must add interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá-ma u₄-me-šu ṭup-pu-šu i-lá-pu-tù
target: If they write his tablet before his term is up,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.GI šu-mì šu-(d)EN.LÍL i-lá-pá-at
target: he shall book 5 minas of gold in the name of Šu-Illil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR sá-li-a li-dí-na-ku-ma
target: let Saliya give you that 1 mina of silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: DAM.GÀR i-šu
target: I have a creditor,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-ma-an i-pì-kà lá ú-ṣí-i
target: so let nobody hear about it from your mouth!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: Say specifically to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ṭup-pá-am ša sǐ-li-a ta al-pu-tù
target: 1 mina of silver for which you drew up Saliya's debt-note.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta gi₅-mì-lam i-ṣé-ri-a ù me-er-e-a šu-ku-un
target: Please my brother, do me and my sons this favor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na zu-ku-a qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-šur-ma
target: To Zukuwa say, thus Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 SÌLA Ì.GIŠ ša ḫa-ḫi-im x ri-ǐs-tám x ša 2 GÍN.TA
target: 1 litre of oil from hahhum, first quality, worth 2 shekels each.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na li-bi a-zu-ta-a-a DUMU e-me-me
target: is owed by Azutaya son of Ememe

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí pá-nim-ma ú-šé-ba-lam
target: I will send it with the first transport

source: translate Akkadian to English: i dur₄-ḫu-mì-it wa-áš-ba-ku
target: I stay in Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR ṭup-pì-i am-ra-ma
target: and as for the rest of the silver inspect my tablet

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ar-be-e-šu a-na sà-li-a e-sí-ir-ma
target: to discover that I have already dunned Saliya four times

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu nu-ša-bi₄-kà
target: in order to be able to pay you

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta we-da-ku
target: My dear brother, I am alone.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ḫu-ra-ma 1 ku-ta-nam i-ṣé-ri-a il₅-qé
target: He took 1 kutanam on my account in Hurama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áb-ri-tum lá i-kà-ša-da-ni
target: Winter should not catch up with me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá-ma ku-ṣí-im a-na bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim le-ru-ub
target: so I can enter Puruŝhaddum before the cold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫu-ra-ma a-dí dur₄-ḫu-mì-it 0.5 ma-na 2 GÍN.TA da-tum a-na ANŠE ik-šu-ud
target: The fees from Hurama to Durhumit amounted to 0.5 mina 2 shekels per donkey-load.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mu-ša-ki-il₅ ANŠE ú ša ba-áb-tí ú-šé-ṣa-a-ni ú-lá i-šu
target: I have no one to feed the donkey or realise the outstanding claims.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí-in i ša-ḫa-tí-a li-zi-iz-ma
target: and one can assist me

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ú-ku-ul-tí ANŠE.ḪI.A da-na-at
target: Here fodder for the donkeys is hard to get.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ṣú-ḫa-ri ša li-ba-kà i-de₈-ú šu-up-ra-ma
target: Send me 2 servants whom you know well.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí-in ANŠE.ḪI.A lu-ša-ki-il₅
target: So one can feed the donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-ra-ni le-pu-uš
target: Let me go on a trip.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ḫi-id-ma ṣú-ḫa-ri ṭur₄-da-ma
target: Take care to send me servants

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-ṣú-um lá i-kà-ša-da-ni
target: and the cold should not catch up with me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-ni-na DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim i-dí-ma
target: and he gave it to Annina son of Aššur-bel-awātim

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na wa-ar-ki-tim ṭup-pu-ú É a-ni-na
target: and later the tablets were in Annina's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na (d)UTU-ši ša ṭup-pí ta-ša-me-ú
target: The very day you hear my letter

source: translate Akkadian to English: we-da-ku ṣú-ḫa-ri ṭur₄-da-am
target: since I am alone, send the servants!

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na dur₄-ḫu-mì-it i-nu-mì a-bu-ni me-tù-ni
target: In Durhumit, when our father died,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ṣa-ar-tám ku-nu-ki ša a-bi-ni a-lá-ḫu-um ip-té-ma
target: Ali-ahum opened the strong-room sealed by our father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ AN.NA ku-nu-ki ša a-lim(ki) i-ṣé-er a-šur-DU₁₀ a-ḫu-qar i-šu
target: 1 talent of tin with seals of the city, Aššur-ṭāb owes to Ahu-waqar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ AN.NA-ak-šu a-ḫu-qar i-lá-qé
target: Ahu-waqar will get his 1 talent of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu KÙ.BABBAR lu URUDU SIG₅ lu URUDU lá-mu-nam lu ḫu-sà-ra-am lu TÚG x lu ṭup-pí ḫa-ru-mu-tim ša DAM.GÀR
target: He took out both silver, good copper, poor copper, lapis lazuli, textiles, and certified tablets concerning customers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI 3 DUMU um-me-a-ni ú-šé-ṣí-a-ma
target: And witnessed by 3 affiliated traders.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-da ú a-lá-ḫu-um a-šùr-iš-ta-ki-il₅ iš-ú-lu-ma
target: Adida and Ali-ahum questioned Aššuriš-takil as follows:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-mì-a-bi-a DUMU zu-zu-ú
target: Seal of Šumi-abiya, son of Zuzū.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB lá-ba-na-da DUMU i-dí-sú-en₆
target: Seal of Labān-nādā, son of Iddin-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šùr-DU₁₀ DUMU e-na-ma-nim
target: Seal of Aššur-ṭāb, son of Ennamānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI sà-ak-li-a DUMU na-áp-ra-kà
target: Witnessed by Sakliya son of Napraka.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PUZUR₄-a-šùr DUMU ší-ik-tí-ḫa-šu-ut
target: By Puzur-Aššur son of Šikti-hašut.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ili₅-ba-ni DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR
target: By Ilī-bāni son of Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.33333 ma-na KÙ.GI ša-lim-a-šùr a-na na-ru-qí-kà a-dí-im-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur invested 3.33333 minas of gold in your joint-stock capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR na-ru-qá-kà ú-la-pí-tám
target: and he wrote an amount of 10 minas of silver for your joint-stock capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-tù-a-ar DINGIR-šu-GAL ṣú-ḫa-ri-im ša a-šur-DU₁₀ iš-tù a-lim(ki)
target: When Ilšu-rabi, the servant of Aššur-ṭāb, returns from the city,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ri-i-iš AN.NA 5 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ma-sí-am ša-bu-ra-am a-na a-šur-DU₁₀ a-ḫu-qar i-ša-qal
target: immediately when he receives the tin, 5 talents of refined copper of good quality, in pieces, Ahu-waqar will pay to Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr i-na a-lim(ki) a-na li-mì-im ḫa-bu-ul-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur is indebted to the eponym in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ú né-ma-al-šu dí-in-ma
target: so pay the silver and the accrued profit,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er li-mì-im li-li-ik-ma
target: let it go to the eponym.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù x 3 ša-na-tim iš-tù bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim lu ta-li-kam
target: Three years ago you came from Burušhaddum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ší-ip-kà-tim ša-lim-a-šùr ad-ma-ku-ni
target: and the tablet of the investment Šalim-Aššur made to you

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am šu-wa-tí qá-tí li-mì-im ú-kà-al-ma
target: that very tablet is in the eponym's possession

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ṭup-pá-am ša ší-ip-kà-tí-kà a-na ša ki-ma ku-wa-tí li-dí-nu
target: and then he can give the tablet concerning your capital to your representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na iš-té-en ú ší-na tap-pá-e-a KÙ.BABBAR ú né-ma-al-šu ta-dí-in
target: and you have given the silver and the accrued profit to one or two of my partners.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša li-mì-im a-na ṣí-ib-tim lá i-ma-id-ma
target: The interest on the silver of the eponym must not increase.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er ki-a-am-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na ú 2 ma-na tù-uš-ta-ag-me-er-šu
target: On top of this you have caused him to have expenses of one or two minas.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku ú ša qá-ta-at a-bi-a-a na-al-pu-tù ni-ta-na-lá-kà-ku-um
target: But I and those who signed as my father's guarantors come to you time and again.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ú né-ma-al-šu ta-dá-na-am ú-lá ta-mu-a
target: But you refuse to give the silver and its accrued profit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É a-bi-a ú ší-ip-kà-tim ša a-bi ad-ma-ku-ni lá i-ta-ba-lá
target: And my father's house and the investments my father made for you must not be lost.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-at KÙ.BABBAR dí-na-ma
target: Give me the agreed amount in silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na É li-mì-im
target: Let me send it to the eponym's office.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-we-lam e-mu-qí-in e-ta-ú
target: and he has spoken harshly to the man.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma kà-ru-um a-na ú-bar-tim ša ku-bu-ur-na-at qí-bi-ma
target: From the Kanesh colony to the trading station Kuburnat say:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam me-er-ú ša-lim-a-šùr im-ḫu-ru-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Here the sons of Šalim-Aššur confronted us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-iš-tí-kál DUMU a-šur-SIPA KÙ.BABBAR a-na a-bi-ni ḫa-bu-ul
target: Aššuriš-tikal son of Aššur-rē'ī owes silver to our father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ṣa-ni a-na ša-sú-ḫi-šu
target: We take responsibility for his forced transfer.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-we-lam iš-tí šé-ep-IŠTAR ší-ip-ri-ni li-sú-ḫa-am
target: Extradite the man there together with Šēp-Ištar, our messenger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-tù-nu lu e-mu-uq ší-ip-ri-ni
target: and you must be the executive arm for our messenger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na iš-ma-a-šùr DUMU ḫi-na-a a-ta-a-a DUMU bu-ṣí-a ú en-nam-a-šùr DUMU e-lá-ma
target: To Išme-Aššur, son of hinnāya, Ataya, son of Buṣiya, and Ennam-Aššur, son of Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DUB a-ku-ú-a DUMU a-šùr-i-dí
target: Tablet of Akūa, son of Aššur-idī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-té-en a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-šu šu-ut-ma il₅-qé
target: and he has also taken one to pay for his food.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-ma-ḫi-ir šu-ku-tum ú i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Man-mahir, Šukkutum and Ikũn-pĩya to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu-nu 1.66666 ma-na 6.66666 GÍN
target: Their value in silver was 1.66666 mina 6.66666 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí ṣú-ba-tí-kà 22 TÚG 4.83334 GÍN.TA ta-ad-nu
target: The rest of your textiles, 22 pieces, were sold for 4.83334 shekels each.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 24 pí-ri-kà-ni ša ḫa-nu ub-lá-ni
target: Of the 24 textiles that hanu brought,

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-té-en ḫa-nu a-na li-tab-ší-šu il₅-qé
target: hanu has taken one for his clothes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ì-lí-áš-ra-ni ir-dí-a-kum
target: Ilī-ašrannī led it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 4.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na am-tim ni-iš-qú-ul
target: we paid 0.5 mina 4.5 shekels of silver to the maid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na lu-zi-na DUMU a-šùr-ba-ni a-dí-da DUMU wa-ar-dí-i-li-šu ú a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šùr
target: To Luzina son of Aššur-bāni, Adida son of Warad-ilišu and Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-na-su-in DUMU i-d-a-bi-im
target: Seal of Enna-Suen son of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 5 GÍN KÙ e-ri-ib-tum ša AN.NA i-na wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na PUZUR₄-a-be-eḫ il₅-qé
target: Thereof Puzur-Abeh has taken 5 shekels of silver, entrance tax for the tin, in Wahšušana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na a qá-tí-šu ni-dín
target: We gave 4 minas for his expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šu-mì a-dí-da áš-qú-ul
target: I paid 6 shekels of silver in the name of Adida.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x GÍN ṭá-áb-tí áš-qú-ul
target: I paid x shekels for my salt-fee.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU a-šur-dan
target: Witnessed by Puzur-Aššur, son of Aššur-dan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni ḫa-nu na-áš-a-kum
target: Hanu brings you the rest of your silver, 1 mina 6 shekels of silver under our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-lu-um hi-na-a ú ší-bé aṣ-ba-at
target: I seized it without hinnaya's permission and without witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma ke-na 4 GÚ lá-mu-nam aṣ-ba-at
target: Amur-Ištar answered: "Yes, I have seized 4 talents of poor copper."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur-ma ha-bu-ra-ta-i-am tal-qé
target: Šalim-Aššur said: "Did you take copper from Haburat?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša i qá-tim x-ta-šu-šu al-qé
target: I took what I could grab.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-ta lu-qú-tí ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-aṣ-ba-at
target: Amur Ištar continued: "But did you not seize my merchandise worth 10 minas of silver?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur mì-ma lá aṣ-ba-at-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur answered: "I have seized nothing."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a ṣú-ha-ri-a a za-al-pá áš-ta-pár
target: Amur-Ištar said: "I have sent my servant to Zalpa."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ha-ri li-li-kam-ma lá-ta-wu
target: When my servant comes I shall discuss further.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šál-ma-a-šùr a-ṣé-er a-mur-IŠTAR ú-ṭá-hi-ú-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur made us approach Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šál-ma-a-šur-ma a-na a-mur-IŠTAR-ma mì-šu-um ší-im TÚG-ba-tí-a URUDU ta-aṣ-ba-at
target: Šalim-Aššur said to Amur-Ištar: "Why have you seized the copper that was the proceeds from my textiles?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: And we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku a-šé-e-kà ú-ul a-ta ta-šé-e-a-ni
target: "It is I who am suing you, not you who are suing me."

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG KI ša-ha-ma
target: textile owed by Šahama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: And we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš ṣa-he-er GAL i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG KI sú-is-ha-ra šu wa-áb-ri-ni
target: 1 textile owed by Su-Ishara, our guest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB šu-ku-bi-im DUMU a-šùr-i-dí
target: Sealed by Šu-Kūbum son of Aššur-idī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-dí-IŠTAR DUMU a-šùr-i-dí
target: By Iddin-Ištar son of Aššur-idī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: sū-in-na-da DUMU en-um-a-šùr tap-pá-i-ni
target: Suen-nādā son of Ennam-Aššur was our partner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-zi-zi-a IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí na-áb-sú-in a-na-na a-mur-IŠTAR ša-lim-ar-dí ma-nu-ki-DINGIR-a qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: To Kuziziya, Ištar-lamassī, Nāb-Suen, Anna-anna, Amur-Ištar, Šalim-wardī and Mannum-kī-iliya from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì i-na wa-áš-ha-ni-a ú-kà-i-lu-ni-ni
target: When they detained me in Wašhaniya

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2-ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ha-ti tù-šé-bi-lá-kà
target: did my sister send you to me with 2 minas of silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-UTU ke-na tù-šé-bi-lá-ni-ma
target: Aššur-šamšī answered: "Sure, she sent me,"

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-lá a-dí-na-kum
target: but I did not give it to you."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma u₄-ma-am a-ha-tí ta-tù-ra-am
target: Ennam-Suen then said: "Today my sister has come back here."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-na lá-ma kà-sà-am ni-iš-tí-ú
target: Please, before we drink from the cup

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tí-im lá-ta-wu-kum
target: I want to declare something to you

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-ba-tim lá ta-ma-lá
target: do not get angry!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki ša ku-ku-wa ù ku-nu-ki-a ù 7 ANŠE.HI.A ṣa-lá-mì ú ú-nu-sú-nu
target: 1 ½ mina 5 shekels of silver sealed by Kukuwa and by me plus 7 black donkeys with their harness.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim i-a-um ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: All this belonging to me, Mannum-kī-iliya brings to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṣé-er a-šùr-UTU i-na ba-áb ha-ra-ni-šu né-ru-ub-ma
target: We entered with Aššur-šamšī when he was about to go on a journey.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-sú-in a-na a-šùr-UTU-ma
target: Ennam-Suen said to Aššur-šamšī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a me-er-i-ša ša qá-qá-ad šál-mì-šu-nu lu-up-ta-ma
target: Then write a tablet for Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-iliya, her son, with joint liability.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na am-tí-a ṭup-pá-am dí-na-ma a-dí a-lá-kà-ni
target: And give the tablet to my maid so it may remain in her possession until I come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ù ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a i-ha-šu-hu-ni KÙ.BABBAR lu i-na ša ba-áb-tí-a ta-am-hu-ra-ni lu KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na ṣé-er a-na-na ku-nu-ki-a ú-šé-bi₄-lá-ni
target: Whatever silver Ištar-lamassī and Mannum-kī-iliya ask for there, lend them silver against interest according to the rate of the colony - from what silver you have received from my outstanding claims, or silver I sent to Anna-anna under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR a-nim ša ma-nu-ki-ì-lí-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí-ni
target: In addition to this silver that Mannum-kī-iliya brings to you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-tí-šu ša ku-ku-wa a-na ma-nu-ki-a-šur DUMU MAN.IŠTAR ha-bu-lu-ni-ma
target: for the 3 minas silver and its interest that Kukuwa owes to Mannum-kī-Aššur son of Puzur-Ištar,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 GÚ SÍG.HI.A a-na ša-pá-ar-tim ú-kà-lu-ni
target: and for which he holds 20 talents of wool as security -

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí qí-bi-ma
target: say to my representatives:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-al-tám-nam
target: You have done me wrong!

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí ša iš-tù 8 ša-na-tim šé-ṣí-ma
target: Produce the silver and its interest due since eight years

source: translate Akkadian to English: dí-nam
target: and give it to me!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-UTU-ma e-ni-ma-ma a-na šé-ep a-šur-i-mì-tí am-qú-ut
target: Aššur-šamšī answered: "I threw myself down at the feet of Aššur-imittī."

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ni-na ú e-ni-iš-ta-ru-um ub-lá-ku-nu-tí
target: Annima and Eništārum brought you 10 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-hi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šùr-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na LÁ 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ù sà-hi-ir-tám ku-nu-ki-kà na-ki-ru-um ub-lam
target: They brought me 29 shekels of silver and small goods under seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi-lá-ni a-na ni-ip-lá-tí-a áš-ta-qal
target: The silver you sent me I have paid to cover my balance payments.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma a-na a-šùr-UTU-ma
target: Ennam-Suen answered Aššur-šamšī as follows:

source: translate Akkadian to English: É.GAL-lúm KÙ.BABBAR ma-dam i-ṣé-ri-a i-šu
target: The palace has a substantial silver claim on me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-hu-ú-a a-tù-nu a-ma KÙ.GI 15 GÍN ù 1 ma-na sà-am-tum ma-lá ta-le-a-ni É.GAL-lam ṭá-i-ba
target: Saying: 'Please, my brothers, here are gold, 15 shekels, and 1 mina of carnelian, appease the palace as well as you can'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-mu-ú er-ša-sú-ma ILLAT kà-al-a-at
target: The weather is bad and the caravan has been stopped.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-UTU-ma a-na en-na-sú-in-ma
target: Aššur-šamšī also said to Ennam-Suen:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na ma-dí-im i-tù-ar al-kam-ma
target: If the silver due has increased much then come here,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bé-kà la-aṣ-ba-at-ma ma-lá e-pá-ší-im ep-ša-ni
target: let me seize your witnesses and do with me what you think best!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ih-da-ma mì-li-ik lu-qú-tí-im mì-il₅-kà
target: Take care and decide about the goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-hu-a a-tù-nu i-na lu-qú-tim ša tám-kà-ri-im ṣú-ba-tù an-hu-tù-um i-ba-ší-ú
target: My dear brothers, among the goods of the merchant there are some old textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-pì x i-na ṣé-ri-a šu-uk-na
target: And deposit my silver to my debit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí tí-ir-ta-ak-nu i-lá-kà-ni ri-iš lu-qú-tim ú-kà-al
target: I hold on to the goods until your orders arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-šùr-ma-lik-ma
target: Say to Elamma, thus Aššur-mālik:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-hu-a a-tù-nu KÙ.BABBAR ší-im AN.NA x šé-bi-lá-ni-ma
target: My dear brothers, send me silver, the proceeds from the tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni ù ṭup-pè-kà a-na ma-lá té-er-tí-kà a-na a-lim(ki) uš-té-bi₄-il₅
target: The silver you sent me and your tablets I have now sent to the City following your instruction.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er KÙ.BABBAR ù 5 TÚG ša a-di-ú-ma
target: In addition to that silver and the 5 textiles that I deposited,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp lá-qé-pí-im-ma i-ší-qí-il₅
target: silver has been paid from Lā-qēpum's silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì KÙ.BABBAR ša É kà-ri-im ša a-na lá-qé-pí-im tù-šé-bi₄-lu
target: As for the silver of the colonial office that you sent for Lā-qēpum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na lá-li-im a-dí-in
target: I gave that silver to Lalum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tám a-šu-mì ni-a-tí mì-li-ik
target: You must decide on behalf of us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
target: And make him pay the silver and the interest on it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-tí-iq ù wa-tù-ur i-na ni-a-ú-tim-ma ma-na-im URUDU x-x-us-ma dí-in
target: At any price, sell for copper by our own 1-mina-weight.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-kà a-na lá-qé-pí-im li-li-ik-ma
target: Let your silver go to Lā-qēpum

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ga-ma-ar KÙ.BABBAR šu-um-kà i-na É kà-ri-im lu ni-il₅-pu-ut
target: and then, when the silver is spent we will register it in your name in the colonial office.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà mì-li-ik TÚG.HI.A ma-lá be-lúm-ba-ni e-zi-ba-ku-ni
target: Sell all the textiles that Bēlum-bāni left behind for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá i-na-dí-ú KÙ.BABBAR
target: The silver must not be stocked.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-a ha-ru-mu-tum me-eh-ru-a ú ta-ah-sí-sà-tum
target: My certified tablets, my copies and memoranda.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì KÙ.BABBAR ša a-mur-IŠTAR ša a-na lá-qé-pí-im ù ku-a-tí ha-bu-lu
target: As for the silver of Amur-Ištar, which he owes to Lā-qēpum and to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: té-er-tí lá-qé-pí-im a-ṣé-er lá-li-im ù ku-a-tí i-li-kam-ma
target: There came a message of Lā-qēpum, addressed to Lalum and you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma
target: In which he said:

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-me ṣa-áb-ta-ma
target: "Seize (him for) the days he is overdue

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá e-tí-qú-ni
target: and claim (an interest of)

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN.TA a ma-na-im ší-sí-a-ma
target: 1 shekel per mina."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tí-a ah-ša-lim DUMU bu-zu-ta-a bé-lá-num DUMU šu-a-šur ù a-šur-ták-lá-ku DUMU a-lá-hi-im ig-mu-ru-ni
target: And for which Ah-šalim, son of Buzutāya, Bēlānum, son of Šu-Aššur, and Aššur-taklāku, son of Ali-ahum settled my case.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR šu-a-tí ki-ma šu-lí ša-bu-a-tí
target: With that silver you have been satisfied as representative of Šuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-lí DUMU bu-zu-ta-a lá i-tù-ra-am
target: Šuli, son of Buzutāya, shall not raise a claim for it against me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ṭup-pí-kà a-na KÙ.BABBAR DAM.GÀR-ru-um i-šé-e-kà
target: On the basis of what your record states the merchant will sue you for the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša šu-lí ša a-wa-at-kà gám-ra-a-ni
target: With the silver of Šuli, whose affair with you has been settled,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-lí ša-bu-a-ni
target: we have satisfied Šuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma DU₁₀-ṣí-li-a-šur-ma lá-qé-ep DUMU PÚZUR-a-na ù i-šu-hu-um DUMU šu-lí a-na ir-ma-a-šur-ma
target: Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur, La-qēp, son of Puzur-Anna, and Išuhum, son of Šuli, answered I'ram-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ir-ma-a-šur a-na DU₁₀-ṣí-li-a-šur DUMU ì-lí-a-lim lá-qé-pí-im DUMU PUZUR₄-a-na ù i-šu-hi-im DUMU šu-lí ša ki-ma šu-lí iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Ir'am-Aššur seized us against Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur, son of Ilī-ālum, La-qēpum, son of Puzur-Anna, and Išuhum, son of Šuli, representing Šuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša šu-lí DUMU bu-zu-ta-a ša en-na-sú-in DUMU ì-lí-a a-na ší-a-ma-tim i-dí-na-ni-ma qá-tí ú-kà-i-lu-ma
target: "2.5 minas of silver belonging to Šuli, son of Buzutaya, which Ennam-Suen, son of Iliya, gave me for making purchases and which I kept in my possession."

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ku-da-dim DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀
target: In the presence of Kudādum, son of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI DINGIR-na-da DUMU a-šur-na-da
target: In the presence of Ilī-nādā, son of Aššur-nādā.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-nu-ki-a-šùr na-áb-sú-in a-na-na ù da-ra-áš qí-bi-ma um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma
target: To Mannum-kī-Aššur, Nab-Suen, Anna-anna and Daraš from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ha-muš-tim ša a-šur-iš-tí-kál DUMU sú-kà-li-a
target: During the week of Aššuriš-tikal, son of Sukkalliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-um ma-ṣí-ì-lí
target: Of the eponymy of Maṣi-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ù URUDU ku-nu-ki-a ša-ta-na na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Šāt-Anna brings you the silver and copper under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-tim ba-tí-iq ú-tù-ur dí-na-ma
target: Sell the slave-girls at the best available price.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na mì-ma a-nim a-na hu-bu-li-im ša da-ra-áš qá-tí a-lu-lá-a ša-ak-na-at
target: Alulaya has laid claim to all this for Daraš' debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí ma-nu-ki-a-šur li-ib-ší-ma
target: And let the silver remain with Mannum-kī-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-tim ú ṣú-hu-ur-ší-na a-na É-bé-tí-a da-ra-áš lu-šé-ri-ib-ma
target: Let Daraš bring the slave-girls and their children into my house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na-am ša-ni-am KÙ.BABBAR da-ra-áš li-iš-qú-lá-ku-nu-tí-ma
target: And let Daraš pay to you another mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a ma-nu-ki-a-šur i-na KÙ.BABBAR a-mu-ri-im lu-kà-in-ma
target: And then Mannum-kī-Aššur must confirm the silver under my seal among the checked silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-a
target: As to the 1 mina of refined silver under my seal,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ ku-nu-ki-a
target: 30 minas of good copper under my seal,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ší-ta a-ma-tim ú 2 ší-na ṣú-hu-ur-ší-na
target: 2 slave-girls plus their 2 children.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú KÙ.BABBAR áš-ra-kam-ma ša-áš-qí-lá
target: Then, have the silver paid in the same place.

source: translate Akkadian to English: pí-ri-kà-ni ša ta-ša-a-ma-
target: He must check the pirikannu-textiles that you buy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: pí-ri-kà-nu a-šar ma-nu-ki-a-šur-ma le-ru-bu
target: And the pirikannu-textiles should enter Mannum-kī-Aššur's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-té-ni-iš ša 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-ma-am ša ba-lá-ṭí-šu ša kà-ni-iš a-tù-nu ù da-ra-áš ší-ta-a-ma-ma
target: For in all 2 minas of silver you and Daraš must make a purchase in Kanesh that will benefit him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ku-zi-zi-a-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
target: From Kuziziya to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 TÚG ra-qá-tim ù hhu-sà-ra-am šé-ep-IŠTAR ù ša-lim-ÌR-dí ub-lu-nim
target: Šēp-Ištar and Šalim-wardī brought me 2 thin textiles and some lapis lazuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí pí-ri-kà-nu-um lá e-ru-ba-ni
target: As long as the pirikannu-textiles have not entered,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN a-na da-ra-áš lá tù-ša-ra
target: do not release a single shekel of silver to Daraš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: (TÚG)ra-qá-tí-kà a-šùr-e-mu-qí i-na ma-ri-it-hhi-im i-dí-ší-na-ma
target: Aššur-emūqī sold your thin textiles in Marithum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im-ší-na ù-lá ub-lam
target: but he has not brought the proceeds from their sale.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wi-il₅-tim dí-in
target: give that to the lady there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na a-lá-ki-šu ší-im-ší-na ù-šé-ba-lá-kum
target: When he comes I shall send you the proceeds from them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ITU.1.KAM ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: Per month he will add interest in conformity with the rule of the karum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na qá-tí-a lá ma-qí-it-ma
target: No silver has fallen into my hands,

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-ehh-ra-tim lá ú-šé-bi-lá-kum
target: so I did not send you a corresponding amount.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu i-na a-lá-ak ṣú-hha-ri-im ú-šé-ba-lá-kum
target: I shall send you the silver for it when the servant comes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-mur-a-šùr DUMU da-dí-a
target: Seal of Amur-Assur, son of Dadiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM áb-ša-ra-ni li-mu-um ša qá-té a-bu-ša-lim DAM.GÀR DUMU ì-lí-a-lúm
target: Month V, the eponymy of the successor of Abu-salim, the trader, son of Ili-alum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: hhu-sà-ar-kà ku-nu-ki-a
target: Your lapis lazuli is under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù 4.33333 GÍN KÙ.GI ku-nu-ki-a-ma ší-im ra-qá-tim ša pí-lá-ahh-IŠTAR
target: Šēp-Ištar and Šalim-wardī bring you 4 ⅓ shekels of gold, also under my seal, the proceeds from the thin textiles belonging to Pilah-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-lá-ma-ma a-na en-na-nim DUMU a-ku-kà um-me-a-ni-kà KÙ.BABBAR áš-qúl
target: Elamma declared: I paid the silver to Ennānum, the son of Akuka, your investor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im TÚG ša en-na-nim DUMU a-zu-a ša É-lá-ma il₅-qé-ú
target: As for the 12 shekels of silver, the price of a textile belonging to Ennānum, son of Azua, which Elamma took.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-na-núm iš-pu-ri-ma GÉME ša e-lá-ma ak-ta
target: "At Ennānum's behest I took Elamma's slave-girl as security."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-na-num-ma a-lik a-ma-sú ki-ta
target: Ennānum told (me): 'Go and take his slave-girl [as security]!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-hha-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu
target: 15 minas of silver, its excise added, his transport fee paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kàr-wa-a a-na um-mì-a-ni-a ú-bi-il₅
target: Karwāya brought to my investors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma e-lá-ma KÙ.BABBAR en-na-nim ú-ša-bi₄
target: If Elamma has paid the silver to Ennānum

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR … … na-na-a a-na e-lá-ma i-ša-qal
target: Nanaya will pay 0.5 mina of silver to [Elamm]a.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ni-ni-im DUMU šu-hhu-bur
target: witnessed by Anīnum, son of Šu-hubur

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-iš-tí-kál DUMU a-šur-SIPA
target: by Aššuriš-tikal, son of Aššur-rē'ī

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na um-mì-iš-hhara šé-bu-ul-ta-ša
target: 5 shekels of silver for Ummī-Išhara, her consignment.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša lá-ma-sà-tim a-na um-mì-iš-hhara
target: 4 shekels of silver of Lamassatum for Ummī-Išhara.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na bu-ṣú-a
target: 1 shekel of silver for Buṣua.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-šur-mu-ta-pí-il₅ ú-bi-il₅
target: all this Aššur-mūtappil brought

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.GI ni-is-hha-sú DIRI
target: 15 shekels of gold, its excise added.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-du-a-sú ša-bu
target: His transport fee paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er en-nam-a-šur a-šur-re-ṣí ú da-dí-a
target: To the address of Ennam-Aššur, Aššur-rēṣì and Dadiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a qá-tí-šu
target: 4 shekels of silver for his use.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-hha-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ú ḫa-ra-na-tí-šu ṣa-ba-at-ma
target: Get hold of the silver or what has been acquired with it during its journeys

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí dí-in
target: and give it to my representative(s)

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ma-a iš-tù 4 ša-na-té-e KÙ.BABBAR-áp A-šur ta-ma-kà-ar
target: Now, realize well that since four years you use the silver of Assur for trading purposes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim tù-uk-ta-ṣí-dá-ni
target: And that you have kept me waiting until this very day!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tí ša ta-at-wu-ú
target: As for the words you spoke,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na-ku a-wa-at ša a-ḫi eb-ri lá-IS-me-e
target: I too can listen to the words of colleagues and friends.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá ṭup-pì-im ša a-lim(ki) i-ša-ri-iq-šu-um
target: According to the tablet of the City, (if he does) it will be considered as stolen by him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam i-na be-el id-ma-tim ša ki-ma um-mì-a-né ma-ma-an mì-ma ú-lá i-ṭá-ḫi
target: Over there no one of the share-holders representing the investors shall approach anything.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šur a-na en-nam-a-šur ú a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: pí-ri-kà-nu …-lu-tim …-x ú a-ḫa-ma … 2 pí-ri-kà-an ku-nu-ki-a na-ar-bu-tim …-tim
target: and separately 2 -textiles with my seals, soft ones?

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-na a-šur-e-nam
target: all this to / for Aššur-ennam

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-al-DU₁₀ a-na kur-ub-sú-in ḫa-bu-lu-ma en-na-sú-in qá-ta-tù-ni
target: 12 shekels of silver, which Āl-ṭāb owes to Kurub-Suen and (for which) Ennam-Suen was guarantor.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i-na li-mì-im šu-da-a … ITU.KAM ku-zal-li il₅-qé
target: He collected the silver during the eponymy of Šudaya, in the month XI.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ir-am-a-šùr DUMU ì-dí-ba-ni
target: By Ir'am-Aššur, son of Idi-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ku-nu-ki-ku-nu ku-un-kà-ma
target: seal it with your seals

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na bé-tí-a a-šar ša-ṣú-ru-ni li-ni-dí
target: and let it be placed in my house where it can be well guarded.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-na-aḫ-DINGIR-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Enah-ilī to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma kur-ub-sú-in a-na a-al-DU₁₀ i-tù-wa-ar
target: If Kurub-Suen raises a claim (for it) for against Al-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ú-ba-áb-šu
target: Pilah-Ištar will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma kur-ub-sú-in pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR il₅-qé
target: Pilah-Ištar collected that silver in the name of Kurub-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-na-sú-in ki-ma a-al-DU₁₀ KÙ.BABBAR iš-qú-ul-šum
target: Ennam-Suen paid it to him in the name of Āl-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum i-na ša-am-ší ṭup-pá-am ta-ša-me-ú tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: Urgent! The very day you hear the letter you must set out and come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ku-ra DUMU na-ra-am-ZU
target: Before Kura, son of Naram-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-DU₁₀ DUMU lu-lu-ú
target: Before Assur-tab, son of Lulu.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lim-a-šùr a-bi-ku-nu
target: To your (plur.) father Šalim-Aššur

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ib-a-ma a-tal-kam
target: and set out and come here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na-kam iš-tí um-me-a-ni lu-za-ki-ku-nu
target: Also, I shall clear you here with the investors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-nam-a-šur DUMU um-ma-sá
target: Seal of Ennam-Aššur, son of Ummassa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ba-ri-ku-nu lá tù-uš-té-ṣa-a-ma
target: You must not quarrel with each other.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-ša-lá-ta …
target: you (plur.) must (not) act rashly

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú al-qé-ma
target: yes I took it

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú u₄-ma-am a-lá-qé-ma
target: and today I would (again) take it!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šur-lá-ma-sí DUMU i-tur₄-a-num tap-pá-i
target: Aššur-lamassī, son of Itūr-Anum, was my companion.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šur-DÙL DUMU a-šùr-šadí-li ki-ma ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi₄-im a-na a-šur-e-mu-qí DUMU šu-ra-ma iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Aššur-ṣulūlī, son of Aššur-šād-ilī representing Kuliya, son of Ali-abum, seized us against Aššur-emūqī, son of Šu-rama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šùr-lá-ma-sí DUMU i-tur₄-a-num
target: Seal of Aššur-lamassī, son of Itūr-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-DÙL-ma
target: and Aššur-ṣulūlī said as follows:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR be-lúm-ba-ni DAM.GÀR-ri-im ša ku-li-a tal-qé lá tal-qé-e
target: The silver of Bēlum-bāni, the agent of Kuliya, did you take it, yes or no?

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ni-e-ma i-ki-ir ú-ul kà-i-in
target: Deny or confirm before these men.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-eš TUR.GAL i-dí-na-ni
target: For this affair the plenary Kanesh 'gave' me (as witness).

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ší-bu-tí a-dí-in
target: Before Aššur's dagger I gave my testimony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šur-DÙL DUMU a-šur-ša-dí-li ša ki-ma ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi₄-im a-na a-šùr-e-mu-qí DUMU šu-ra-ma iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Aššur-ṣululī, son of Aššur-šād-ilē, who represents Kuliya, son of Ali-abum, seized us against Aššur-emūqī, son of Šu-rama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um té-ga-ra-ma i-dí-na-ni-ma
target: For this affair the plenary of Tegarama gave us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú al-qé-ma
target: yes I took it

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú u₄-ma-am a-lá-qé-ma
target: and today I would (again) take (it)!

source: translate Akkadian to English: (d)IŠKUR-ba-ni ú en-na-sú-in ni-kà-sé i-sí-ú-ma
target: Adad-bāni and Ennam-Suen settled accounts and

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na šu-ku-bi-im ma-ma-an i-tù-a-ar
target: if anyone raises claim against Šu-Kūbum

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr ú-ba-áb-šu
target: Šalim-Aššur will clear him

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-la lu-qú-tum a-na a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim i-pí-iq-du-ma
target: With regard to what goods had been entrusted to Aššur-bēl-awātim,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr ú-šé-ṣí-ú
target: and which Šalim-Aššur had taken out.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-ANDUL-ma a-na a-šur-e-mu-qí-ma
target: and Aššur-ṣululī said to Aššur-emūqī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR be-lúm-ba-ni DAM.GÀR-ri-im ša ku-li-a tal-qé lá tal-qé-e
target: Did you take the silver of Bēlum-bāni Kuliya's agent, yes or no?

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ni-e-ma i-ki-ir ú-ul kà-i-in
target: Deny or confirm it before these (witnesses)!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-na-nim a-šur-ba-ni ù a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: To Ennānum, Aššur-bāni and Ali-ahum speak:

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im
target: Witnessed by Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-i-mì-tí DUMU i-ku-pí-IŠTAR
target: By Aššur-imittī son of Ikūn-pī-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-na-sú-in DUMU šu-IŠTAR
target: By Enna-Suen son of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 48.5 ma-na URUDU en-na-sú-in i-ša-qal
target: Ennam-Suen will pay 48.5 minas of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 31.5 ma-na URUDU (d)IŠKUR-ba-ni i-ša-qal
target: Adad-bāni will pay 31.5 minas of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì AN.NA ša áš-pu-ra-ku-nu-tí-ni um-ma a-na-ku-ma
target: Concerning the tin I wrote to you about, where I said:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam be-lá-num ḫa-ra-šu iš-tí-ni
target: Bēlānum travels here together with us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA a-na be-lá-nim dí-na-ma
target: Give the tin to Bēlānum

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-lá-nu-um lu-ub-lam
target: and let Bēlānum bring it

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì KÙ.BABBAR ša ša-zu-úz-tí a-lu-lá-a iš-qú-lá-ku-nu-tí-ni
target: Concerning the silver that Alulaya's representative paid to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šál-ma-a-šur dí-na-ma
target: Give it to Šalim-Aššūr

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA ša-lim-a-šur lu-ub-lam
target: and let Šalim-Aššūr bring the tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am li-it-a-ma šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: Split that tablet and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR lu a ḫu-bu-li-a ta-áš-qú-lá-ma
target: What silver you have paid on my debt

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ḫa-ar-ma-am ša ku-nu-ki-a tù-šé-ṣí-a
target: And recovered the certified tablet with my seal

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR tí-ir-ta-ak-nu li-li-kam
target: Then send me word about the rest of the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma šu-ku-ba-am KÙ.BABBAR tù-uš-ta-áš-qí-lá
target: If you have made Šu-Kūbum pay silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-am ša ba-lá-ṭí-a ša-ma-ma šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: then make a profitable purchase for me and send it to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na a-mur-IŠTAR-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur said to Amur-Ištar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-lá-šu
target: and make him pay 0.3333 mina 1 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr a-ṣé-er a-mur-IŠTAR ú-ṭá-ḫi-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur made us approach Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù 10 ma-na URUDU ší-kam i-dí-nam
target: and he gave me 10 minas of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ URUDU lá-mu-na-am ke-na aṣ-ba-at
target: Yes, I have seized 4 talents of poor copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu-um ší-im ṣú-ba-tí-a URUDU ta-aṣ-ba-at
target: Why have you seized the copper that was the proceeds from my textiles?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-lu-um ḫi-na-a ù ší-bi aṣ-ba-at
target: I seized it without hinnaya's permission and without witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-bu-ra-ta-i-a-am tal-qé
target: Did you take copper from haburat?

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma ú-lá aṣ-ba-at
target: I have seized nothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša i-na qá-tim aḫ-ta-šu-šu al-qé
target: I took what I could grab.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta lu-qú-tí ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR lá ta-aṣ-ba-at
target: But did you not seize my merchandise worth 10 minas of silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṣú-ḫa-ri-a a-na za-al-pá áš-ta-pá-ar
target: I have sent my servant to Zalpa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ḫa-ri li-li-kam-ma lá-ta-wi
target: When my servant comes I shall discuss (further).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku a-šé-e-kà
target: It is I who am suing you

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ul a-ta ta-šé-e-a-ni
target: not you who are suing me

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-e-nam qí-bi-ma
target: and in particular to Aššur-ennam:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš-ki i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma lá-li-a-ma a-na a-šur-e-nam ù da-da-a qí-bi-ma
target: Thus Laliya, say to Aššur-ennam and Dadaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-lá-am ku-nu-ki-a ù ar-za-lam ša e-zi-ba-ku-ni
target: The antimony under my seal and the arzalum, which I left to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ḫi a-ta lu-lá-am ku-nu-ki-a ù ar-za-lam a-na da-da-a dí-in
target: please, my brother, give that antimony under my seal and the arzalum to Dadaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi-ma um-ma a-šùr-SIPA-ma
target: Say to Elamma, thus Aššur-rē'ī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-sú-re lu-lá-am ù ar-za-lam a-na da-da-a e lá ta-dí-in-ma
target: By no means fail to give the antimony and the arzalum to Dadaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-bi₄ e im-ra-aṣ
target: Lest I get angry!

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lu-lá-am ù ar-za-lam lá i-da-na-ku-um
target: If he does not give you the antimony and the arzalum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: da-na-at-kà qí-bi-šum
target: state to him your harsh condition!

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG šé-šé-ra-am i-pu-ḫu-šu ša-ni-am ú-ri-šu-uš
target: Instead of it they asked for another one.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi a-ta be-lí a-ta lá ú-nu-ú-ni
target: Please my father, my lord, they must not cheat me!

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG a pá-ni-a i-dí-ú-šu-nu
target: They deposited the textile(s) before me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 šu-lu-up-kà-ú ša ú-šé-bi-lá-ni a-šùr-mu-ta-pí-il₅ a-na 30 ma-na ma-sí-am lá-ma a-li-kà-ni il₅-qé-šu-nu
target: The 2 Šulupkaean textiles I sent you Aššur-mūtappil had taken for 30 minas of refined copper before I arrived.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR qí-bi-ma um-ma a-lu-la-a ù tám-kà-ru-um-ma
target: To Itūr-ilī from Alulaya and the merchant:

source: translate Akkadian to English: DAM.GÀR en-um-a-šur
target: Ennam-Aššur was the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma a-ša ta-ta-ú-ni um-ma a-ta-ma ar-ḫi-iš ta-ta-lá-kam
target: Now then, as for what you said: 'Leave quickly!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: té-er-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma
target: Let a message of yours come here

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im TÚG.ḪI.A li-dí-nu-nim-ma
target: so that they give me the price of the textiles

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá-tal-kam
target: then I will leave

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ri-ik-sà-am a-na en-um-a-šur dí-in-ma
target: Give the bundle to Ennam-Aššur there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù té-er-ta-kà le-zi-ba-am
target: Then let him leave a message from you for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí AN.NA ša ta-dí-nu-ni-ma
target: With respect to the tin you sold,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 27 ma-na AN.NA iš-tí-kà-ma i-ba-ší
target: 27 minas of tin are in your possession;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 ma-na AN.NA ta-dí-na-ma
target: You sold 30 minas of tin

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR i-ba-ší
target: and that is with Pilah-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wi-lu a-ni-ú-tum a tí-ir-tí am-tim ša a-mur-a-šur a-wa-tim ú-ga-me-ru-ma
target: These men concluded the matter of Amur-Aššur's maid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 16.66666 ma-na ri-ik-sà-am ku-nu-ki ša a-lu-lá-a
target: The bundle of 16.66666 minas, sealed by Alulaya,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ša-lim-ar-dí ù e-wa-ri-mu-ša ub-lu-ni-ku-ni-ma
target: that Šalim-wardī and Ewarimuša brought to you and

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-mì DAM.GÀR ú-du-ú-ma
target: for which the name of the merchant was made known,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na na-áb-ší-im nu-šé-bi-lá-ku-ni
target: and which we sent you for safe-keeping.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša a-šùr-i-mì-tí a-na 6 ITU.KAM a-na a-mur-a-šur i-ša-pu-ru-ma
target: so that they will write to Amur-Aššur within 6 months after the week of Aššur-imittī

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.66666 GÍN a-na Ì.NUN
target: 1.6666 shekel for butter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí tí-ir-tum ša a-mur-a-šur i-ba-lá-kà-ta-ni
target: and until Amur-Aššur's answer is sent across

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-an 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma ša-ni-am lá e-zi-ib
target: he will leave nothing else apart from 6 shekels of silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì ša-pli i ḫa-muš-tim 1.25 GÍN a-na UDU
target: During the bottom end of the week-eponymy 1 1/4 shekel for a sheep.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 GÍN 15 ŠE a-na 3 bi₄-il₅-té-en
target: 3/4 shekel for 3 double loads <of firewood>.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 GÍN 15 ŠE a-na um-zi-im
target: 5/12 shekel for dried meat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 GÍN a-na UDU i-nu-mì li-ma-ni
target: 2.5 shekels for a sheep at the time of our eponymy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠE a kà-ni-im ša IGI ku-ṣí-im
target: Grains for a pot-stand which is in front of the chair.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.6666600000000003 GÍN a-na-ru-uq ŠE-im
target: 2.6666 shekels for a sack of barley;

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN a-na 2 DUG GIG i-wa-li-ba-ni-ma
target: 2 shekels for two jars of wheat also in Walibani.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 DUG GIG 2.16666 GÍN
target: for 2 jars of wheat 2.1666 shekels

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN a-na 4 ki-ra-tim áš-qúl
target: 1.5 shekel I paid for 4 jars of beer.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 GÍN 15 ŠE a-na 3 bi₄-lá-tim e-ṣí ša-qí-il₅
target: 5/12 shekels paid for 3 loads of firewood.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.33333 GÍN a-na-ru-uq ŠE-im áš-qúl
target: I paid 2.3333 shekels for a sack of barley.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 DUG ŠE-um 2.33333 GÍN ša-qí-il₅
target: For 2 jars of barley, 2.3333 shekels was paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i ḫa-muš-tim áš-qúl
target: I paid it during the week-eponymy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 DUG GIG 2.33333 GÍN áš-qúl
target: For 2 jars of wheat I paid 2.3333 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 GÍN a ni-qí ša ú-ṭí-tim e-pu-šu
target: 0.3333 shekel for the grain offering that I made.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333300000000001 GÍN 15 ŠE a-na 3 bi₄-lá-tim áš-qúl
target: I paid 1 shekel 75 grains for 3 loads.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN a qá-nu-e i-wa-li-ba-ni áš-qúl
target: 0.5 shekel I paid for reed in Walibani.

target: From the week of Aššur-bēl-awātim he will add 1 1/3 shekels interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma né-er-a am-tum-ma a-na e-lá-ma qí-bi-ma
target: Thus says Ner'amtum: say to Elamma.
