source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-nim lá-aq-bi
target: To whom should I speak?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni a-wi-lu-um iḫ-tí-li-iq
target: As for the matter about which you wrote me, the gentleman has disappeared.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-qá-tám ú TÚG na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: They are bringing you a thin textile and a textile.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí lu-qú-tí-kà
target: together with your merchandise.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ší-it-ra-am a-na lá-ma-sí-tim
target: and a shawl for Lamassītum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-lá a-le-e-ma ú-lá a-pá-al
target: and I am unable to answer for it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-ba-kà x lá tù-lá-mì-in
target: Do not get angry!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ki me-er-i-a né-nu lá nu-šé-ra-áb
target: We were not to bring in someone to replace my son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku áp-lá-aḫ-ma uš-té-ri-ib
target: I became afraid and I brought one in.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫu-ša-e e-ri-šu
target: They ask for scrap.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-ni-im-ri qí-bi-ma um-ma ku-ur-bi₄-li-ma
target: Say to Aššur-nimrī, thus says Kurub-ilī:

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU ša tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni lá i-mu-ú-šu
target: They do not want the copper you sent me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-ma-ri i-na na-áb-ri-tim i-ta-ar-du
target: My donkeys have been sent to the paddock.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam sà-ḫe-er-tum i-na qá-tí-a lá-šu
target: No small goods are available for me here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam sà-ḫe-er-tum šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send me some small goods from there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma i-na ra-mì-ni-šu ú-lá i-dí-nam
target: He did not give me anything of his own.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-ku-za DUMU šu-a-nim
target: Seal of Akuza, son of Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ú-ra-a DUMU ma-na-na
target: Seal of Uraya, son of Manana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-ba-ni DUMU ša-lim-a-šùr
target: Seal of Aššur-bāni, son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí li-ip-ta-ni 2 ma-na URUDU aḫ-bu-ul-ma
target: I borrowed 2 minas of copper from Lipit-Anum

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na URUDU ša tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni il₅-té-qé
target: and he has taken it out of the copper you sent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš-ki i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dín
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šum-ma be-lí a-ta (TÚG)ṣú-ba-tí-a a-na ṣú-ub-ri-im ta-er-ma
target: If you are my lord, convert my textiles to a slave and,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ub-ru-um a-na-ma ša-bi₄ ú ṣú-ḫa-ri šé-ri-a-am
target: as for the slave, once he has been paid in full, send the servants.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša kà-ší-im
target: From the week of the kaššum-official.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na LUGAL-sú-in qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-šùr-GAL-ma
target: Say to Šarra-Suen, thus says Aššur-rabi:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ki-ma ša-zu-za-tí-kà a-mì-ša-am i-ta-al-ku-nim
target: Your representatives have left for there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-be i-lá-li-ú-ma-an a-lá-ḫi-nim tí-wa-da-i-im a-lá-ḫu-um i-šu-ú
target: Ali-ahum holds 1 mina 15 shekels of silver against Ilāli-uman, the miller from Tiwada.

source: translate Akkadian to English: (TÚG)pá-ra-kà-nu-kà ú ší-tí Ì.GIŠ a-na-kam a-dí-ni i-ba-ší-ú
target: Your parakannu-textiles and the rest of the oil are still available here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta té-er-ta-kà a-ni-tum lá a-ni-tum li-li-kam
target: My brother, let your report, whether yes or no, come to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ni-ki-iš-tum₁₀ ša kà-ri-im ša ki-ma a-na nu-a-im mì-ma ší-mì-im ma-ma-an lá i-du-nu

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN lá a-kà-al
target: I will not consume a single shekel of silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-ni DÙG-ṣí-lá-a-šùr na-áš-a-kum
target: Ṭāb-ṣilli-Aššur is bringing you 21 shekels of silver under our seal.

target: To Ali-ahum from Damiq-pī-Aššur and Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-tí-ni a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu i-li-kà-ku-um
target: We sent word to you once or twice.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ú-za-ni-ma lá ta-áp-té-té-e
target: But you have not informed us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ki-ma ni-iš-ta-na-me-ú ma-tum da-al-ḫa-at-ni
target: When we heard repeatedly here that the land is in uproar

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú tí-ir-tí kà-ri-im da-na-at-ni
target: and that the orders of the colony are strict

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu i-na ma-ṣa-ra-tim AN.NA 10 ma-na nu-šé-ra-ba-am
target: Send word whether we shall let some 10 minas of tin enter the guard-posts.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma a-na tí-ir-tí-ni i-ḫi-id
target: and pay attention to our instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na pá-ni-ni šé-bi₄-lá-am
target: Send 2 minas of silver to us en route.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-šé-bi-lá-ma
target: You did not send (it) to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí a-we-LAM ba-al-ṭù iš-tí-šu lá a-na-me-er
target: and I shall not meet with the man while he is (still) alive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ki-ma ša-lu-um KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na.TA ša na-áš-a-ni-ni
target: There, for the sake of the safety of every mina of silver that we bring,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ḫa-ra-an sú-ki-ni-im šal-ma-at
target: send us word and inform us whether the Narrow Track is safe.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tí-kà ba-tí-iq ú-tù-ur a-da-a-ma
target: I shall sell your goods at any price and then

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣí-pá-ra-tim xxx e-ki-im za-áp-ru-tim šé-bi₄-lam
target: send bronze nails and zapru items.

source: translate Akkadian to English: gi-mì-li-a ta-aḫ-bu-lu-šu-ni
target: you owe him favors for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù a-na i-dí-im a-mì-im lá e-ru-bu
target: Although I did not reach that realization.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi a-ta mì-ma li-ba-kà lá i-lá-mì-in
target: my dear father, do not be angry.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá i-na ba-a-ba-tí-kà a-ma-ḫu-ru lá-li-kam-ma
target: I shall come with whatever silver I receive from your outstanding claims

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam e-né-kà lá-a-mu-ur
target: and I shall see you there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša URUDU ší-kam ú ma-sí-am né-pé-ša-am a-né-pé-ší-im ú-ru-ú-ni
target: Since they bring šikku-copper and washed copper, one package after another.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 (TÚG)ṣú-ba-tí wa-ší-ib-ru-ba-ni na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Wašibru-bāni brings you 15 textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma a-na lá-qé-ep ú a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Šu-Bēlum to Lā-qēp and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: x-5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ig-ri-šu dí-na-šu
target: Give him his wages, x+5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA za-ku
target: The tin is cleared.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-lim-be-lí ša-dí-na
target: Make Šalim-bēli give 4 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR dì-na-ma sà-ḫi-ir-tám ša-ma-šu-um
target: Give 1 shekel of silver and buy small goods for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì 17 GÍN.TA i-zi-zu
target: When the price (for tin) stood at 1:17

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN.TA a-na-ku áš-a-am
target: I bought at 1:15

target: Give 20 minas of wool belonging to Šazuwa to Issu-arik

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ḫu-ur-ší-kà lu-bi-il₅
target: and let him bring it to your store-room.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a a-tù-nu i-na ša-ḫa-at ṣú-ḫa-ri-im i-zi-za-ma
target: My dear brothers, assist the servant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na a-šùr-iš-tí-kál en-na-nim en-um-a-šùr DUMU ú-zu-a ù en-um-a-šùr qí-bi-ma
target: From Šalim-Aššur to Aššuriš-tikal, Ennānum, Ennam-Aššur son of Uzuwa and Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR pá-ni-a-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: and then send the silver to me as soon as possible.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu 5 … ḫa-ra-ni er-sú-a-at
target: my caravan is ready.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.GI iš-tí a-lā-ḫi-im
target: gold owed by Ali-Ahum

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu iḫ-da-ma ḫa-ra-nam a-na ṣú-ḫa-ri-im dí-na-ma

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i-a-tí ḫa-ra-nam dí-na-nim
target: And then give me a caravan as well.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šùr ù a-lu-wa lu-uk-ta-i-nu-šu
target: Let Ennam-Aššur and Aluwa confirm (it to) him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB du-du-li GAL ma-ḫi-ri-im

target: Concerning the 3 marked donkeys that Babašiba and Šuppiahšu shall return.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì ṭup-pí na-áš-pá-ra-tim me-eḫ-ri ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni

target: If they do not return the marked donkeys,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ba-ba-ší-ba ú šu-pì-aḫ-šu i-ša-qú-lu

source: translate Akkadian to English: x x x a-lim(ki) ṭup-pá-am ša a-lim(ki) ša-lim-IŠTAR ší-ip-ru-um a kà-ri-im na-ší
target: Šalim-Ištar, the envoy, carries the tablet of the City to the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-lu ṭup-pu-ku-nu IGI a-lim(ki) i-ší-ik-nu-ma
target: all your tablets have been placed before the City assembly

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lu-um iš-ta-me-šu-nu-ma
target: and the City has heard them

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú dí-nam i-dí-in-ma
target: and passed a verdict

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-zu
target: 2 shekels of silver: Azu

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ša-lim-IŠTAR i-na kà-ni-iš e-ru-ba-ni ṭup-pá-am ša dí-in a-lim(ki) IGI kà-ri-im li-iš-ku-un-ma

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR MAR.TU-ba-ni
target: 5 shekels of silver: Amurru-bāni

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pì ša 1 GÚ KÙ.BABBAR ša É ú-ṣur-ša-a-šur tù-šé-li-a-ni

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR šu-ku-bu-um me-ra-šu
target: 4 shekels of silver: Šu-Kūbum, his son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šur-DU₁₀ DUMU kàr-ri-a
target: 4 shekels of silver: Aššur-ṭāb son of Karriya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ili₅-ba-ni
target: 5 shekels of silver: Ili-bāni

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN a-šur-i-mì-tí DUMU i-ku-a
target: 2 shekels: Aššur-imittī son of Ikua.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ri-ik-sú ša šu-nu-nu i-ba-ší
target: the bundle of Šununu is present.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN a-šur-dan DUMU zu-ú-a
target: 1.5 shekels: Aššur-dān son of Zua

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 GÍN KÙ.GI ku-bu-ur-ší-num šu-be-lúm DUMU a-gu-a
target: 0.5 shekels of gold: Kubur-šinum (and) Šu-Bēlum son of Agua

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma ṭup-pé-e na-áš-pá-ra-tim ša iš-tù a-lim(ki) tù-šé-ṣí-a-ni šé-bi-lam
target: You wrote me as follows: 'Send me the tablets with letters that you took along from the City'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ṣú-ḫa-ar-tim i-li-kam
target: A letter of the girl arrived here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ší-it-ma a mì-nim ṭup-pá-am lá i-dí-na-kum
target: in which she wrote: 'Why did he not give the tablet to you?'

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ITU.3.KAM áš-pu-ra-kum um-ma a-na-ku-ma KÙ.BABBAR še-bi-lam
target: I wrote you three months ago asking: send me silver!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pé-e na-áš-pá-ra-tim ša da-dí-a ú en-um-a-šùr šu-mì-a-bi-a na-áš-a-kum
target: Šumi-abiya is on his way with the tablets with letters of Dadiya and Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-bi a-ta 1 ú 2 ma-na KI a-li-ki-im pá-nim-ma šé-bi-lam-ma
target: Please, my father, send me one or two minas with the next caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: da-a-tum ma-ri-iš-tum ik-šu-ud-ni-a-tí
target: We have incurred a terribly heavy road-tax.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-qá-al-kà lá i-pá-ṭá-ar-ma
target: lest your packet is opened

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú li-ba-kà lá i-lá-mì-in
target: and you get angry

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú áb-na-am a-na bé-tí-šu i-ša-du-du-nim
target: and they must drag the stones to his house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ni-ki-li-it-UḪ.ME DUMU a-ra-wa
target: Witnessed by Nikkilet, the priest, son of Arawa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku
target: by Puzur-Ištar son of Aššur-taklāku

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ku-ku-wa na-pā-ḫi-im
target: by Kukuwa, the smith.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma um-ma a-na-a-na-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Anna-anna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pè-er-tám ša iš-tí ṣú-ḫa-ri ú-bi₄-ku-ni lá i-ḫa-li-iq
target: The missive that I dispatched with the servants must not be lost.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša ag-mu-ru ŠÀ.BA lá-pu-ut
target: In it is noted the silver I spent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim ṣú-ḫa-ri ú-šé-bi₄-lam
target: All this I sent to you with my servants.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-tur₄-DINGIR ḫa-ra-šu a-na a-lim(ki) ek-pá-at
target: As for Itūr-ilī, his journey to the City is getting close.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma mì-ma ri-ik-sú-um É-tí-šu i-ba-ší tí-ir-tí-kà li-li-kam-ma
target: Send me word whether there are any bundles in his house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lā-ḫu-um a-ḫu-kà iš-tí-kà a-ša-áp-ru-sí-im i-za-az
target: Ali-ahum, your brother, is ready to separate (him) from you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-ta-kà a-wa-tim SIG₅-tim a-na a-mur-IŠTAR šé-bi₄-lam
target: Send word with good news to Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ik áš-pu-ra-kum um-ma a-na-ku-ma
target: I wrote to you, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ṣú-ḫa-ru e-ru-bu-ni-ni ma-ma-an i ša-ḫa-tí-a lá-šu
target: Since the servants have entered there is no one to assist me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam nu-a-ú a ṣí-ib-tim e-ta-na-ri-šu-ni i-na-sú-in
target: Here the natives keep demanding silver at interest from me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i ḫu-ra-ma wa-ša-áb
target: Enna-Suen lives in hurama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum i-na ša-am-ší ṭup-pì ta-ša-me-ú
target: Urgent, the very day you hear my letter,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-uk-ma ku-nu-ki-kà
target: seal 5 minas of silver and

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ṣú-ḫa-ru-um lu-ub-lam
target: let one servant bring it under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma 16 li-me-e 40 ma-na URUDU ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A a-bu-ša-lim ÌR a-na ú-ší-na-lam ḫa-bu-ul
target: They said: The slave Abu-šalim owes 16,040 minas of copper, the price of wool, to Ušinalam.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma a-bu-ša-lim li-li-kam
target: They went on: Abu-šalim must come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ta-lá-né-en
target: 1 pair of talānu

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2-ni-šu šu-ḫu-pá-ta-an

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um i li-bi₄ ṭup-pé-kà i-ba-ší
target: that tablet is to be found among your tablets

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-na-a ù id-na-a ik-nu-ku-šu
target: hanāya and Idnāya have sealed it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-nu-nu IGI ba-ba-li … i-ṣé-er a-bu-šalim DUMU … i-ri-šum i-šu
target: Witnessed by Šu-Nūnu, by Šu-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ṭup-pí-im ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma KIŠIB a-lá-ḫi-im a-na e-lá-ma lá-pí-it
target: As for the tablet about which you wrote me as follows: 'Seal of Ali-ahum, to Elamma' is written (on it).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-na-at KÚ.BABBAR i-ša-qal
target: He will pay the silver in one year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM qá-ra-a-tum li-mu-um i-na-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im
target: Month VIII, eponymy of Ennam-Suen, son of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÚ.BABBAR šu-a-tí-i a-na-ku a-pu-ul
target: I myself have guaranteed that amount of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÚ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ma-áš-kà-tám i-ṣé-er a-sà-nim
target: 10 minas of refined silver, on which a claim rests, is owed by Asanum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x ṣú-ḫa-ri-šu ú ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi-im i-šu-ú
target: His servant, to Kuliya son of Ali-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-dí-ku-bi-im a-na-aḫ-ì-lí ú PUZUR₄-a-šùr a-na a-na-aḫ-ì-lí qí-bi-ma um-ma ku-li-a-ma
target: To Iddin-Kūbum, Anah-ilī, and Puzur-Aššūr, especially to Anah-ilī, thus says Kuliya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-té-ni-iš ša 1.3333300000000001 ma-na KÚ.BABBAR ṭup-pá-kà al-pu-ut
target: I drew up your tablet for a total of 1.3333 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 0.33333 ma-na KÚ.BABBAR ba-áb DINGIR a-na a-bi₄-ni ta-dí-i
target: Moreover, you have 0.3333 mina of silver to our father in the Gate of the god.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333300000000001 ma-na ú ṣí-ba-tí-šu KÚ.BABBAR a-na a-bu-šalim DUMU en-na-sú-in ḫa-bu-lá-tí-ma
target: You owe to Abu-šalim, son of Ennam-Suen, 1.3333 mina of silver plus its accumulated interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pé-er-tum ša a-šùr-DU₁₀ i-li-kam-ma
target: A letter of Aššur-ṭāb arrived here

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 1 ma-na KÚ.BABBAR a-wa-at-kà i-gi₅-mì-ir
target: and for an amount of 1 mina of silver your affair has been settled.

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pé-er-tám ša ku-nu-ki-a ša 1 ma-na KÚ.BABBAR tù-kà-a-al
target: You have in your possession a letter with my seal for 1 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ša-ni-tám ša 0.33333 ma-na KÚ.BABBAR tù-kà-a-al
target: And a second for 0.3333 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: táq-bi₄-a-am um-ma a-ta-ma a-li-ik-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-uk a-šùr-DU₁₀ li-qí-a-am
target: You told me as follows: Go and obtain for me a tablet sealed by Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-uk a-šùr-DU₁₀
target: the tablet sealed by Aššur-ṭāb

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta 1.3333300000000001 ma-na KÚ.BABBAR ku-nu-uk-ma a-na PUZUR₄-a-šùr pí-qí-id-ma lu-ub-lam
target: Please, my brother, put 1.3333 mina of silver under seal and entrust it to Puzur-Aššur to bring it here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA a-na e-ba-ar ša-la-aḫ-šu-wa lá ú-šé-tù-qú-nim
target: One must not ship the tin on via Šalahšuwa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-uk a-šùr-DU₁₀ al-qé-a-ku
target: I obtained for you a tablet sealed by Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša a-bu-šu ú šu-ut a-na ku-a-tí ú me-er-i-e-kà lá i-tù-ru-ni
target: stating that neither his father nor he himself will come back on you and your sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma be-lá-nu-um-ma a-na en-um-a-šur i-dí-a-šùr ù pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma
target: Thus Bēlānum, say to Ennam-Aššur, Iddin-Aššur and Pilah-Ištar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma 8 GÍN.TA a-na KÚ.BABBAR lá-šu
target: If a rate of 8 : 1 against silver is impossible

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÚ.BABBAR lá ta-da-na
target: do not sell it for silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma 8 GÍN.TA a-na KÚ.BABBAR AN.NA dí-na
target: if a rate of 8 : 1 is possible, sell the tin for silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù té-er-ták-nu li-li-kam
target: and let your report come to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ša-lá-am AN.NA-ki e-ba-ar tí-mì-il₅-ki-a-ma AN.NA a-na dur₄-ḫu-mì-it lu-šé-tí-qú
target: For the safety of the tin one must ship the tin on via Timilkiya to Durhumit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÚ AN.NA 4 TÚG.SIG₅ 3 TÚG ša qá-tim ù ANŠE ṣa-lá-ma-am
target: As for the 2 talents of tin, 4 textiles of fine quality, 3 of current quality, and a black donkey,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR iš-tù ḫa-ḫi-im ú-šé-ra-da-ni
target: which Pilah-Ištar will bring down from hahhum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ša ku-bu-ur-na-at a-ma-kam wa-áš-bu AN.NA li-ší-ib-ma
target: If people from Kuburnat are staying there let the tin be ?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ri-ik-sé a-na x-a-x-xx i-na li-bi₄ ša-áp-tim ù maške ší ta-kà-na-ma lu-šé-tí-qú
target: and put small packets inside the wool and the hides and so ship them on.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15.33333 GÍN KÚ.BABBAR ší-im URUDU i-na li-bi₄ ku-lu-ú DUMU a-šur-ma-lik
target: 15.3333 shekels of silver, the price of copper, is owed by Kullu son of Aššur-malik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.33333 GÍN 7.5 ŠE ša šu-iš-ḫa-ra ší-im 1 UDU ḫa-bu-lu
target: 3 3/8 shekels are what Šu-Išhara owes as price of one sheep.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-lá-ḫi-im kà-ṣa-ri-šu
target: Witnessed by Al-ahum his packer.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ma-nu-um-ba-lum-a-šur DUMU a-šur-re-i
target: Witnessed by Mannum-balum-Assur son of Assur-re'i.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÚ.BABBAR ša li-bi-a ŠÀ.BA
target: The 12 shekels of silver that I have in my possession, thereof:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÚ.BABBAR a-na la-ma-sí-tim a-dín
target: 1 shekel silver I gave to Lamassutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-ni-am ip-qí-dam-ma
target: He entrusted it (for shipment) to me for the second time,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-ni ú-lá al-qé
target: but I have not yet obtained it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÚ.BABBAR ša sà-li-bu ḫa-bu-lu-ni a-dí-ni ú-lá ni-im-ḫu-ur
target: The silver that Salibu owes we have not yet received.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333300000000001 ma-na KÚ.BABBAR iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša kur-ub-IŠTAR DUMU PUZUR₄.DINGIR a-šu-mì šu-IŠTAR DUMU šu-ki-tim a-na en-na-sú-in DUMU šu-IŠTAR áš-qú-ul
target: I paid 1.3333 mina of silver from the week of Kurub-Ištar son of Puzur-ilī on behalf of Šu-Ištar son of Šukkutum to Enna-Suen son of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí 3 u₄-me ma-ma-an GÁN-lam i-na ba-ri-šu-nu ú-lá i-lá-ak
target: Within 3 days no one among them may go away (from here).

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um … dí-nam i-dí-in-ma
target: The colony passed a verdict,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr ù me-er-ú i-dí-a-bi-im i-na ki-dim a-hu-um a-na a-hi-im da-na-sú i-qá-be
target: stating that Šalim-Aššur and the sons of Iddin-abum will each say binding words to each other outside (the city).

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-lá ú … KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN … lá a-be-el x …
target: at least 10 shekels of silver I do not own.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ú-ku DUMU ṣí-lu-lu a-ma-kam wa-ša-áb
target: If Uku son of Ṣilūlu lives there,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ta-ma ke-na a-pu-ul
target: You said: "Yes, I promised it."

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN il₅-qé
target: for he received every shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša a-šu-mì ku-li-a ša-du-a-tám kà-ra-am ta-pu-lu
target: It is the silver you promised to pay the colony as a tax on behalf of Kuliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-na ku-nu-ki ša ku-li-a áp-qí-da-ku-um
target: Herewith I entrust to you the silver under the seals of Kuliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ì-lí-ba-ni ù ku-li-a qí-bi-ma um-ma a-šùr-e-nam-ma
target: To Ilī-bāni and Kuliya, say, this is what Aššur-ennam says:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ša-lá-tí-wa-ar 0.83333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-šu ku-li-a i-dí-nam-ma
target: In Šalatiwar Kuliya gave me 0.83333 mina of silver under his seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na wa-ah-šu-ša-na a-na ṣé-ri-kà ub-lam-ma
target: I brought it to Wahšušana to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-nam a-na É a-bi₄-a al-qé-ma
target: What did I take from my paternal house?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-hu-kà i-tù-ra-am
target: that your brother came back on me?

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR IGI a-šùr-lá-ma-sí DUMU a-šur-ma-lik ú šu-iš-ha-ra DUMU e-na-sú-in li-me-e ri-ik-sà-am áp-qí-da-kum
target: In the presence of Aššur-lamassī, son of Aššur-mālik and of Šu-Išhara, son of Ennam-Suen, the eponyms, I entrusted the packet to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-na-at ù 6 ITU.KAM KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qal
target: He will pay within one year and six months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na al tí-im-ni-e ta-am-hu-ri-ma
target: In Al-Timniyē you approached me

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI e-na-sú-in DUMU i-sú-rik₁₃ ù IGI ú-zu-a DUMU ku-ku-lá-nim ta-áš-e-li-ma
target: and in the presence of Ennam-Suen, son of Issūrik, and of Uzua, son of Kukkulānum, you interrogated me, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ta-ma i-nu-mì KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki ša a-hi-a tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni
target: When you had me bring the silver with my brother's seals,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-num li-mu-um
target: who was then eponym?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-šùr-lá-ma-sí ú šu-iš-ha-ra li-mu-ú
target: I answered: "Aššur-lamassī and Šu-Išhara were the eponyms"

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ma-ah-ri-šu-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR áp-qí-da-kum
target: and it was in their presence that I entrusted you the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM áb-ša-ra-ni li-mu-um i-dí-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im
target: Month V, eponymy of Iddin-Suen, son of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er bé-lá-nim DUMU šu-ku-bi-im ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi-im i-šu
target: 1 mina of refined silver Belanum, son of Su-Kubum, owes to Kuliya, son of Ali-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB be-lá-nim DUMU šu-ku-bi-im
target: Seal of Belanum, son of Su-Kubum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-gu₅-a DUMU dan-na-a-šur
target: Seal of Agua, son of Dan-Assur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ú-ṣú-ur-ša-IŠTAR DUMU da-da-a
target: Seal of Usur-sa-Istar, son of Dadaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ú-me-šu ma-al-ú-tim KÙ.BABBAR bé-lá-num lá iš-qú-ul
target: If Belanum does not pay when his term is due.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na ma-na-im ṣí-ib-tám a-na ur-hi-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: In conformity with the rule of the karum he will add 1.5 shekel of interest per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 6 ur-hé KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qal
target: He will pay within 6 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ṣur-ša-IŠTAR DUMU da-da-a i-na né-eh-ri-a aṣ-ba-at-ma
target: I seized Uṣur-ša-Ištar, son of Dadaya, in Nehriya

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na ší-a-ma-tí-šu a-na 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-tù-ur-šu-ma
target: and merchandise of his worth 1 mina had become 4 minas of silver for him

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-at-ni
target: and so our affair was settled.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iští KÙ.BABBAR uk-ta-al
target: He is held by the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul
target: If he does not pay

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: he will add interest in conformity with the rule of the karum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma šu-ma a-e-ma ú-dá-pí-ir
target: If he goes away to somebody else.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-ku-pí-a DUMU pí-lá-ah-IŠTAR ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi-im i-šu-ú
target: 8 shekels of refined silver Ikuppiya, son of Pilah-Istar, owes to Kuliya, son of Ali-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-ku-pí-a DUMU pí-lá-ah-IŠTAR
target: Seal of Ikuppiya, son of Pilah-Istar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ili₅-ba-ni DUMU mu-ta-lim
target: Seal of Ili-bani, son of Mutalum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-SIPA DUMU ú-ṣú-ra-nim
target: Seal of Assur-re'i, son of Usuranum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-lá-at ku-li-a DUMU a-lá-bi-im i-na-sú-in DUMU za-ar-ni-qí-im ú-ka-al
target: 10 shekels of silver, the working-capital of Kuliya, son of Ali-abum, Ennam-Suen, son of Zarniqum holds.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 20 ha-am-ša-tim KÙ.BABBAR ša-qá-lam qá-bi-a-tí
target: You promised to pay the silver in 20 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-ku-pí-a a-bu-a e-ri-ší-im ku-da-tim šu-IŠTAR ù en-na-sú-in qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: To Ikūn-pīya, Abuwa, Erišum, Kudātum, Šu-Ištar and Enna-Suen from Ennam-Aššur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i-té-zi-ba-am
target: Has any silver been left for me?

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-mu-kà MU.4.ŠÈ e-tí-qú
target: Your terms are exceeded by 4 years.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.1.KAM-im a-na 1 ma-na-im ṣí-ib-tám tù-ṣa-ba-am
target: You will have to pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr ù i-lá-a-bi-ni lu i-dí-a-kà
target: May Aššur and the god of our fathers reject you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša i-ir-tí a-bi-a a-na pá-ra-sí-a ta-zi-zi-ni
target: since you stood ready to separate me from my father's breast!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am iš-tù ITU.KAM ša ke-na-tim li-mì-im a-šur-na-da DUMU PUZUR₄-a-na ha-bu-lá-tí-ma
target: You have owed 4 minas of refined silver since the month Ša-kēnātim, in the eponymy Aššur-nādā son of Puzur-Anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tup-pá-kà ha-ar-ma-am ú-kà-al
target: I hold your certified tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ma-na-ah-tám ta-ša-qá-lam
target: and you must pay 0.5 mina of silver as expenditures

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša a-na-kam ra-dí-ú e-ta-wu-ú um-ma šu-nu-ma
target: Why is it that the guides have been arguing here, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ha-ru-kà ú-ṭá-tám a-ba-kam lá i-mu-ú
target: Your servants refuse to ship the grain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-lá-hu-um-ma a-na ša-lim-ÌR-dí ù a-lu-wa qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Ali-ahum to Šalim-wardī and Aluwa:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí qí-bi-ma
target: Say to my representatives:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na mì-ma KÙ
target: Seize him for all this silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na da-áš-e ú-ṭá-tám šu-da-a
target: Haul the grain before spring!

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-zi-ib x ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša DUMU i-ku-nim
target: apart from x minas of silver from Ikūnum's son

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ša-al-ṭá-tí-a ša a-šé-e-ú-šu
target: and my available goods for which I sue him

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum ih-da-ma ú-ṭá-tám áb-kà-nim
target: Urgent! - take care and ship the grain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí ú-ṭí-tim áb-kà-nim
target: Ship the rest of the grain here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì a-na ha-hi-im a-li-ku
target: When I went to Hahhum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na sà-he-er-tim
target: 5 shekels of silver for small goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-kam lá a-ba-kam tí-ir-ta-ak-nu li-li-kam
target: Send me word as to whether it is shipped or not.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x-2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na É ub-ri a-dí-in
target: I gave x-2 shekels of silver for the inn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-šar ANŠE.HI.A i-zi-zu-ni a-dí-in
target: I gave 5 shekels of silver where the donkeys stood.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.33333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na sà-ri-dim
target: 4.33333 shekels of silver for the packer.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ra-bi₄-ṣí-im a-dí-in
target: I gave x shekels of silver for the bailiff.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na né-ba-ar-tim a-dí-in
target: I gave 1 shekel of silver for the ferry.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lu-bu-uš 2 ṣú-ha-ri
target: 4 shekels of silver for the clothing of 2 servants.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11.5 ma-na URUDU ší-ku-um i-ṣé-er sú-kà-lim lu-zi i-šu
target: Sukkallum owes 11.5 minas of šikum-copper to Luzi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: He must add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM áb-ša-ra-ni li-mu-um ku-bi-a
target: Month Ab-šarrāni, eponymy Kūbiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB sú-kà-lim DUMU i-dí-sú-in
target: seal of Sukkallum son of Iddin-Suen

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na id-na-a qí-bi₄-ma
target: Say (in particular) to Idnāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-mu-kà 12 ha-am-ša-tim e-tí-qú
target: your term is 12 weeks overdue.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ha-bu-lá-at
target: 3 minas of refined silver you owe (me).

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na PUZUR₄-a-šur id-na-a ù i-ku-pí-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma
target: Say to Puzur-Aššur, Idnāya and Ikūn-pī-Aššur thus Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-sí-a-šu-ma šé-ri-a-ni-šu
target: bind him and have him brought here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam DAM.GÀR-ru ša a-bu-ša-lim i li-bi₄ a-šur-i-dí a-ḫi-šu 1.5 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iṣ-bu-tù
target: Abu-šalim's customers have seized 1.5 mina 6 shekels of silver from his brother Aššur-idī here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na kà-ri-im tám-kà-ru-šu i-li-ú-ma
target: Then his customers went up to the colony and said:

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-na-kam-ma ni-lá-qé
target: "We shall take the silver here."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša-lá-tù-ar x x x x x-nu u₄-ma-kál lá a-sà-ḫu-ur
target: I must not be delayed a single day.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na dí-in kà-ri-im KÙ.BABBAR a-na kà-ni-iš KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí a-šur-i-dí i-lá-ak-ma
target: According to the verdict of the colony the silver will go to Kanesh with Aššur-idī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṭup-pì-šu e-ta-ú
target: They will discuss on the basis of his tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí ṣú-ḫa-ri a-ta-lá-kam
target: I shall come with the servants.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DUMU me-tim a-na-ku
target: I appear as heir.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR 3 a-tù-nu a-na a-bi₄-a ḫa-bu-lá-tù-nu
target: You three owe 3 minas of silver to my father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-ak-nu ḫa-ar-ma-am ša ḫu-bu-li-ku-nu a-bi₄ e-zi-ba-am
target: My father left me your certified tablet concerning your debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šál-ma-a-šur ù a-mur-IŠTAR iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur and Amur-Ištar seized us,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-na šál-ma-a-šùr-ma
target: and Amur-Ištar said to Šalim-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šál-ma-a-šur-ma ke-na 3 né-nu KÙ.BABBAR ni-ḫi-bi₄-il₅
target: Šalim-Aššur answered: "Yes, we three became indebted for the silver."

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI e-dí-na-a IGI ṣí-lá-(d)IM
target: Witnessed by Eddinaya and by Ṣill-Adad.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-kà lá-du-uk
target: so I can invalidate your tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù iš-tù KÙ.BABBAR iš-qú-lu-ni
target: Also, after they paid the silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí a-bi₄-kà a-na-me-er
target: I met with your father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ni-nam a-ṣé-er a-šur-ma-lik ù šál-ma-a-šur ša ki-ma i-a-tí KÙ.BABBAR ú-šé-bi₄-il₅-ma
target: I sent Anninum to Aššur-malik and Šalim-Aššur, my representatives, with the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma a-bi₄-kà KÙ.BABBAR iš-qú-lu
target: And they paid the silver to your father's representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma ší-bu-tí-ni ba-áb i-lim IGI pá-at-ri-im ša a-šur
target: The Kanesh colony gave us and we gave our testimony in the Gate of the God before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i pá-ni-tim am-tám a-na bu-zi-a DUMU a-sà-a a-dí-in-ma
target: Earlier I gave a slave-girl to Buziya son of Asaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-ri-kà ub-lam
target: And he brought her to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-ba-ni-ma a-ša-qá-lá-kum
target: Aššur-bāni answered: "I shall pay you."

source: translate Akkadian to English: am-tám ú-lá i-dí-na-kum-ma i-tù-ra-ma
target: He did not give you the slave-girl, but returned.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a ší-im am-tim 0.5 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṭup-pu-šu al-pu-ut
target: Here I wrote his tablet about the price of the slave-girl, 0.5 mina 5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: úz-na-tí-ni il₅-pu-ut
target: He touched our ears.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša ki-ma ku-a-tí áš-qú-ul-ma
target: I have paid the silver to your representative

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-um-kà az-ku-ur
target: and I mentioned your name.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šur a-šur-ba-ni DUMU i-du-a a-na 18 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša i-na li-bi-kà i-šu-ú
target: Ennam-Aššur said to Aššur-bāni son of Iduwa: "Regarding the 18 shekels of silver that you owe to me"

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR šu-uq-lá-am
target: pay me the silver!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ni-na DUMU a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim
target: Witnessed by Annina son of Aššur-bēl-awātim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-ba-ni DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im
target: Witnessed by Aššur-bāni son of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ri-ik-sú-um ší-im 2 ku-ta-ni-šu a-na ḫa-ti-a
target: One bundle of silver, the price paid for 2 of his textiles, for Hatiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí lá ta-áš-qú-lu-ma ù šu-mì lá ta-az-ku-ru
target: Since you did not pay the silver to my representative and did not mention my name,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ša-al-ša-am a-na KÙ.BABBAR-pí-a lá ta-ša-qá-lam₅
target: will you then not pay triple the amount of my silver?

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 né-pí-šu-um 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu i-a-um a-na um-mì-a-ni-a
target: 1 packet of 10 minas of silver, its excise added, its transport fee paid, belonging to me, for my investors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA i-ša-ú-mu-nim
target: They will buy tin for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫa-ma ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša DAM.GÀR
target: Separately 5 minas of silver, its excise added, its transport fee paid, belonging to the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-ta-ni i-ša-ú-mu-nim
target: They will buy kutānu-textiles for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ri-ik-súm 0.33333 ma-na a-na né-er-am-tim
target: 1 bundle containing 0.3333 mina for Ner'amtum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ri-ik-súm 0.5 ma-na 5 GÍN ší-im ku-ta-nim a-na i-li-a
target: One bundle containing 35 shekels of silver, the price paid for a kutānum, for Iliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ri-ik-súm 0.33333 ma-na a ší-ma-at-IŠTAR
target: One bundle containing 0.3333 mina for Šīmat-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 GÍN a-na kur-ub-IŠTAR
target: 13 shekels of silver for Kurub-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-na a-šur-lá-ma-sí áp-qí-id
target: All this I entrusted to Aššur-lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-mur-IŠTAR IGI a-šùr-na-da
target: In the presence of Amur-Ištar and Aššur-nādā.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-tur₄-DINGIR qí-bi₄-ma um-ma en-na-sú-in-ma
target: To Itūr-ilī from Enna-Suen:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar ku-wa-tí li-ib-ší-ú
target: and let them be with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: áš-pu-ra-kum um-ma a-na-ku-ma ṭup-pu-a a-šar a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur i-ba-ší-ú
target: I wrote you and said: "My tablets are with Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam um-me-a-nu-um ke-nu-um lá ša ša-ḫa-tim i-na KÙ.BABBAR-pì-a e-pu-lá-ni
target: Here a reliable agent who is not to be feared guaranteed for my silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi₄ a-ta be-li a-ta a-dí en-um-a-šur úz-ni pè-té
target: My dear father and lord, inform me with respect to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bi₄ a-ta be-li a-ta
target: My dear father and lord,

source: translate Akkadian to English: DUMU um-me-a-ni-im ke-ni-im a-gu₅-ur-ma
target: hire a reliable agent and

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-mu-tám a-ṣé-ri-a lu-ub-lu-nim
target: have him bring the iron to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù i-na ri-iš a-mu-tim ší-be šu-ku-un
target: Also, set witnesses for the iron.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-šu-mì DUMU PUZUR₄-sú-in a-mu-tám GÁN-lam₅ e-tí-qú
target: To the fact that it must pass overland in the name of Puzur-Suen's son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-li-šú-nu iš-me-ú
target: And they heard a tablet concerning 10 minas of silver, their debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-nu-pí-a ki-ma me-er-e šál-ma-a-šùr a-na ga-al-ga-li-a ù ḫa-ar-šú-nu-ma-an iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Representing the sons of Šalim-Aššur, Anupiya seized us against Galgaliya and Haršumnuman.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ga-al-ga-li-a-ma ku-nu-ku-a
target: Galgaliya answered: "They are my sealings."

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ṭup-pu-a a-šar ku-wa-tí i-ba-ší-ú
target: If my tablets are with you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-a ku-nu-ki-a pè-té-ma
target: then open my sealed tablets

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 GÍN a-mu-tum ku-nu-ku ša DUMU PUZUR₄-sú-in i-na qé-ra-áb ṭup-pè-a na-ad-a-at
target: and see that six shekels of iron sealed by Puzur-Suen's son is placed with my tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-nu-pí-a-ma ṭup-pu-um la ku-nu-ku-kà
target: Anupiya said: "Does the tablet not bear your seals?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-id a-ša-kà-na-ku-nu-tí
target: I am willing to go to the River ordeal for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na lu-qú-tim pá-ni-tim 3 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ šu-nu-nu ub-lá-kum
target: In the previous shipment Šu-Nūnu brought you 3 talents of good copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma dan-a-šur ša-lim-wa-ar-dí-e ú šu-nu-nu-ma a-na en-nam-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Dan-Aššur, Šalim-wardī and Šu-Nūnu to Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam sà-li-a ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma
target: We seized Salliya here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku ša ṭup-pí-ni šál-ma-a-šùr ú-ša-bi
target: "I personally satisfied Šalim-Aššur with the silver of our tablet."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-dí ša a-ḫi-kà sà-li-a ni-iṣ-ba-at
target: Here we seized Salliya concerning your brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-nu-pí-a-ma me-er-ú me-tim né-nu
target: Anupiya said: "We are inheritors."

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu a-na šál-ma-a-šùr KÙ.BABBAR ta-áš-qú-ul lu a-na me-er-e šál-ma-a-šùr ta-áš-qú-ul a-na a-né-e-ma ru-a-am
target: Produce evidence for this, that you have paid the silver to Šalim-Aššur or to his sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí lu-qú-tim ša a-ḫi-kà
target: concerning the goods of your brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma na-áš-pé-er-ta-am a-lá-ḫu-im bi-lá-nim-ma lu-qú-ta-am lu-šé-ra-ku-nu-tí
target: He said: "Bring me a missive then I shall release the goods to you."

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na AN.NA a-na ANŠE me-tim ku-na-a iš-ku-ni-a-tí
target: 5 minas of tin Kunnāya charged us for a donkey that had died.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 7.5 GÍN a-na ta-ší-a-tim áš-qùl
target: I paid 27.5 shekels of tin as costs of transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ma-lá-kà
target: make up your mind.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR bé-ú-la-tù-šu
target: 0.5 mina of silver was his working capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na ú-ku-ul-tum 15 GÍN qá-qá-dum ik-šu-sú
target: 2 minas of tin for food and fodder, the head-tax amounted for him to 15 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-ší-a-at 10 TÙG.ḪI.A wa-at-ru-tim 1.5 ma-na AN.NA il₅-qé
target: As costs of transport of 10 extra textiles he took 1.5 mina of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na AN.NA ni-pu-ul-šu-um
target: We made him a balance payment of 2.5 minas of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 4 GÚ AN.NA a-wi-it e-l!-ma
target: On 4 talents of tin, the declared value of Elamma('s merchandise),

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na 15 GÍN.TA da-tum
target: the road-tax at 4 minas 15 shekels tin per talent

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 ma-na AN.NA ik-šu-sú
target: amounted for him to 17 minas of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na sú-sá-a a-šu-mì a-al-DU₁₀ áš-qùl
target: 23 shekels of silver I paid to Susāya on behalf of Āl-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na tám-kà-ri-im qí-bi-ma um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma
target: To the merchant, thus says Šu-Ištar:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na pá-ni-šu tù-šé-bi₄-lu
target: The 1/3 mina of silver you sent him en route

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN.TA a-na AN.NA ŠA-dí-in-ma
target: was sold for tin at a rate of 10 shekels per mina

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim ga-am-ru-um
target: and this is the total of the expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR nu-ku-ra-im ù 1.5 ma-na AN.NA ta-ší-a-tim ša il₅-qé-ú
target: For the 5 shekels of silver that were disputed and the 1.5 mina of tin he took as transport costs

source: translate Akkadian to English: da-ni-tí a-qá-bi₄-šu-um
target: I will state to him my harsh conditions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 8.5 GÍN ḫ u-sà-ru-um a ší-mì-im ta-dí-in
target: 0.5 mina 8.5 shekels of lapis lazuli was offered for sale.

source: translate Akkadian to English: SAG.BA 1.5 ma-na 1.66666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im ḫ u-sà-ri-im
target: Therein, 1.5 mina 1.666 shekels of silver was the price of lapis lazuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫ i a-ta be-li a-ta
target: My dear brother and lord,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ša ak-lu-ú li-ba-kà lá tù-lá-ma-na-kum
target: do not let your heart be angry with me because I held back.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-a ša ší-im lu-qú-tim ša ṭ up-pì-a ḫ a-ar-mì-im na-áb-sú-in ù e-ri-mu-ša na-áš-ú-ni-ku-um
target: Nab-Suen and Ewarimuša bring you 9 minas of refined silver under my seal, from the proceeds from the goods mentioned in my certified tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-na-nim na-pá-ḫ i-im
target: In the presence of Ennānum the blacksmith,

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI en-um-a-šùr DUMU bu-ut-qí-im
target: of Ennam-Aššur son of Butqum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim DUMU zu-ba
target: and of Aššur-bēl-awātim son of Zuba.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-we-lúm lá da-am-qú-um i-na e-ni-kà a-na ba-ú-ší-a i-za-az
target: A man who is no good stands ready to defame me in your eyes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i lá i-dim URUDU 7 GÚ É kà-ri-im uš-ta-aṣ-bi₄-it
target: For no reason he caused the colony to seize some 7 talents of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ḫ a-ḫ i-im ú-nu-ut-ni nu-ša-li-ḫ a-ku-ni
target: In Hahhum we set aside our goods for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá na-ṭ ù-ma lá né-ra-áb
target: It is not appropriate for us to enter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫ i-im qí-bi-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-i-a-šur-ma ù MAN-a-šur
target: To Ali-ahum, thus says Damiq-pī-Aššur and Puzur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí kà-ri-im ú-ta-na-na-an-ma
target: I keep imploring the colony,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta-be-a-ma a-ta-lá-kam
target: and I shall set out and come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-dí-(d)IM DUMU a-šur-DU₁₀
target: Seal of Iddin-Adad son of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na za-al-pá ù a-na-kam ni-iš-ta-na-me-ma ḫ a-ra-an sú-ki-nim dan-na-at
target: In Zalpa and here we keep hearing that the Narrow Track is difficult.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šál-ma-a-šur KIŠIB ma-ma-ḫ ir
target: To Šalim-Aššur; sealed by Man-mahir.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na URUDU a-na qá-tí-šu-nu ú-ra-dí
target: I have added 1.5 mina of copper to their account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-we-lúm KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-áš-x-qá-lá-ni
target: The man wants to make me pay the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-šu-šu-um um-ma i-na-aḫ -DINGIR-ma KÙ.BABBAR šu-qú-ul
target: Inah-ilī said: "Pay the silver!"

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ma-lá ṭ up-pí-kà ḫ a-ar-mì-im šu-qú-ul
target: Pay the silver in accordance with your certified tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 10 ma-na té-pu-uš-ma tù-ub-lam
target: You have acquired and brought here some 10 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam šu-IŠTAR ù IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ik-ta-na-lu-ú-ni
target: Šu-Ištar and Ištar-lamassī keep holding me back here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma KÙ.BABBAR a-ḫ i-kà lá ta-ša-qá-al-ma lu-mu-ul-li-bi₄-im a-na a-ḫ i-kà lá ta-ra-ší
target: Do not pay your brother's silver and incur his anger!

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI kà-ba-tim DUMU a-šùr-GAL
target: Witnessed by Kabātum son of Aššur-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-dí 10 u₄-me-e lá ta-tal-kam ú-lá tí-ir-ta-kà a-na ṣé-er ša ki-ma ku-wa-tí lá i-tal-kam
target: If you have not come within 10 days or sent word to your representatives,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na i-na-aḫ -DINGIR a-ša-qal
target: I shall pay the silver to Inah-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí i-tur₄-DINGIR DUMU PUZUR₄-a-na
target: 2 shekels of silver are owed by Itūr-ilī son of Puzur-Anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ú-šé-bi₄-lam
target: If he has not sent them,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ša-qá-lam
target: he is to pay 6 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ší-ni-šu ší-né-en ša wa-aḫ -šu-ša-na SIG₅ iš-tù wa-aḫ -šu-ša-na ú-šé-ba-lam
target: He must send from Wahšušana two pairs of good shoes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-bu-um DUMU zi-a tap-pá-i-ni
target: Ali-abum son of Ziya was our companion.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭ up-pá-am li-dí-na-ku-nu-tí-ma
target: Let him give you the tablet

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí id-na-a
target: and give (it) to me

source: translate Akkadian to English: šé-bi₄-lá-ni-šu
target: and send it to me

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB zu-ba DUMU en-na-nim
target: Seal of Zuba son of Ennānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB PUZUR₄-(d)IŠKUR DUMU i-dí-IŠTAR
target: Seal of Puzur-Adad son of Iddin-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-né-áš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: For these words the Kaneš colony made us available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭ up-pá-am IGI IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: This tablet we gave as our testimony rendered before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na 5 GÍN AN.NA ta-ší-a-tum ša ša-du-im
target: 0.6666 mina 5 shekels of tin were the cost of carriage in the mountains.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.33333 ma-na 5 GÍN.TA AN.NA bi₄-il₅-tám a-dí za-al-pá ik-šu-dam
target: 4.3333 minas 5 shekels accrued (as fees) until Zalpa on each talent of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: bi₄-il₅-tum 2.5 ma-na im-ṭí
target: and 2.5 minas were missing on each talent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šalim-a-šur il₅-qé-šu
target: and Šalim-Aššur took it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ša i-sú-rik₁₃ ša i-ri-šum ub-lá-ni
target: From Issu-arik's goods that Irišum brought,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá ṭup-pì-šu ú-sà-ni-iq-šu-ma
target: I checked it in accordance with his letter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na AN.NA ša šé-ep i-ri-ší-im 2.33333 ma-na AN.NA i-na i-šé-ra-tim ša É a-lim(ki) i-tí-ra-ma
target: Of the tin transported by Irišum, 2.33333 minas of tin from the City Hall was in excess.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im DUMU šál-ma-a-šur
target: to Ali-ahum son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-nu-ki-a-šùr DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀ ù a-ḫa-tim DUMU ší-na-na-tim
target: To Mannu-kī-Aššur son of Aššur-ṭāb and Ahātum daughter of Šinanātum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ú-ṣur-ša-a-šùr DUMU šu-ku-bí-im
target: sealed by Uṣur-ša-Aššur son of Šu-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É áš-du ù wa-ar-kà-sà
target: Ašdu's house and its legacy.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-kà-sí ma-aḫ-ri-ni i-dí-a-bu-um ù ša-lim-a-šùr i-sí-ú
target: Iddin-abum and Šalim-Aššur settled accounts with us as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-dí-a-bu-um ki-ma i-sú-rik₁₃ a-na ša-lim-a-šùr i-dí-in
target: Iddin-abum gave (it) on behalf of Issu-arik to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É áš-du ù wa-ar-kà-sà ša ša-lim-a-šùr
target: Ašdu's house and its legacy (now) belongs to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na mu-lá-a 10 ma-na KÙ.GI ší-ip-kà-at i-sú-rik₁₃ ša a-na ša-lim-a-šùr ša-ap-ku
target: As compensation for 10 minas of gold, Issu-arik's investment that had been invested in Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 qá-áb-li-a-tim ša 1 ma-na.TA KÙ.BABBAR
target: 2 qablītum-containers of 1 mina silver each.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma a-na É a-bi-a ù um-mì-a a-na mì-ma šu-um-šu ú-lá ta-tù-ar
target: with the words: You shall not again claim anything from the house of my father and mother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ṭup-pí-im pá-qá-dim bi-za-lá a-na qá-tí-ša ta-zi-iz
target: When the tablet was handed over Bizala took responsibility for her share.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša bi-zi-lá ù IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí
target: 1 tablet of Bizila and Ištar-lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-sá ša IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí
target: The share of Ištar-lamassī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ni-iš a-lim(ki) ù ru-ba-im ta-mu-ú kà-i-lá
target: Keep in mind what was sworn by the City and the king!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-nu-ba-lu-um-a-šur a-šá-a-al-kà
target: Mannum-balum-Aššur, I question you:

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu i-na ší-im bé-tim lu i ši-im TÚG.ḪI.A lu i ší-im qá-áb-li-a-tim mu-šá-li-im ù ma-az-li-ki
target: neither from the price of the house, nor from the price of textiles, nor from the price of qablītum-s, the mirror, and the mazlīkum-s.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-té-et a-ḫu-úz-tum mu-šá-lá-am ša ZABAR ù ma-az-li-ki mì-ma a-nim
target: one with inlay; a bronze mirror and some mazlīkum-s.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ḫu-bu-ul (d)NIN.ŠUBUR-ba-ni a-na lu-lu áp-qí-id
target: All this I entrusted to Lullu for the debt of Ilabrat-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù nu-a-am ḫu-bu-ul (d)NIN.ŠUBUR-ba-ni tù-šá-bu-ú
target: After you will have paid the Anatolian the debt of Ilabrat-bāni,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tum KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma i-na li-bi-kà i-ší-tù i-le-e i-na li-bi-kà i-šu-ú
target: for the rest of the silver, whatever you still owe me, I have the gods as claim on you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI dan-a-šur IGI a-mur-DINGIR IGI ma-ṣí-ì-lí IGI a-šur-iš-ta-ki-il₅ IGI ḫa-pu-a-šu ša SÍG.ḪI.A IGI PÚZUR.IŠTAR
target: In the presence of Dān-Aššur, of Amur-ili, of Maṣi-ilī, of Aššuriš-takil, of Happuaša, the wool-trader, and of Puzur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ik-re-e ú-lá kà-i-ni
target: Deny or confirm it!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-la ri-ig-ma-tù-um ší-bu-tù-um
target: This is not a formal lawsuit but a witnessed statement.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-num-ba-lúm-a-šur ša ki-ma en-um-a-šur e-pu-ul
target: Mannum-balum-Aššur answered the representative of Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šur KÙ.BABBAR tám-kà-ri-šu i-šé-e
target: Ennam-Aššur sues for the silver of his merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-šu ḫa-ar-ma-am ú-kà-al
target: I have his certified tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku
target: And then I personally shall take the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma PUZUR₄-a-na-ma ma-nam lu-šá-zi-za-ku-um
target: Puzur-Anna answered: 'Who shall I appoint for you?'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-tí-šu ša a-šur-ták-lá-ku a-na PUZUR₄-a-na a-ḫi-šu ḫa-bu-lu-ú
target: The tablet concerning 5 minas of silver and its interest that Aššur-taklāku owes to his brother Puzur-Anna.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am PUZUR₄-a-na a-na na-áb-ší-im lu a-na a-bi-kà e-zi-ib lu ku-a-tí e-zi-ba-ku-um
target: Did Puzur-Anna leave the tablet for safekeeping with your father, or did he leave it with you yourself?

source: translate Akkadian to English: PUZUR₄-a-na GÁN-lam i-lá-ak-ma
target: Since Puzur-Anna would go overland,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-zi-za-am ša KÙ.BABBAR-pí-i-kà
target: 'Appoint someone responsible to me for your silver.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-num-ba-lúm-a-šur-ma a-na ša ki-ma en-um-a-šur-ma
target: Mannum-balum-Aššur said to Ennam-Aššur's representative:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR PUZUR₄-a-na DUMU šu-(d)EN.LÍL ḫa-bu-lam
target: 'Puzur-Anna son of Šu-Illil owes me 4 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 ma-na AN.NA ša ku-ni-lim a-šur-DU₁₀ ú-bi-il₅
target: Seven minas of tin belonging to Kūn-ilum Aššur-ṭāb brought away.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-ma-sú-wi-ma a-na a-šur-na-da ù en-nam-a-šùr qí-bí-ma
target: From Aššur-massu'ī to Aššur-nādā and Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI šu-ku-bi-im DUMU qá-a-tim
target: in the presence of Šu-Kūbum, son of Qa'atum

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-ḫi-im
target: and of Aššur-mālik, son of Ali-ahum

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki ša i-ku-pí-IŠTAR DUMU i-ku-a-a
target: Three minas of tin under the seals of Ikūn-pī-Ištar, son of Ikū'aya

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ì-lí-a-LIM DUMU sú-kà-li-a áp-qí-id
target: I entrusted to Ilī-ālum, son of Sukkalliya

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na lu-bu-ší-ša ù ep-ri-ša a-na mu-lá i-ta-dí-ší-im
target: Give regularly 5 shekels of silver for her clothes and her provisions to Mula.

source: translate Akkadian to English: té-er-ta-kà za-ku-tám iš-tù a-lim a-šá-pá-ra-kum
target: I shall send you a complete report from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: DAM a-šùr-na-da lu-ṭá-ib-kà
target: Aššur-nādā should satisfy you with regard to the wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma ša šé-bu-lim ú-šé-ba-lá-ku-um-ma
target: I shall send what there is to send to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ-áp-kà šu-ta-bi
target: So you can be satisfied with the silver you are entitled to.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma ṭup-pu-um ḫa-ar-mu-um ša 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul a-šur-ták-lá-ku DUMU šu-(d)EN.LÍL le-qé-ma
target: Here, take a certified tablet worth 5 minas of silver, the debt of Aššur-taklāku son of Šu-Illil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-at-kà lu šá-ak-na-at-ma
target: Lay claim to it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú le-qé-ma
target: Take the silver and the accrued interest paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-be-lúm DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im a-na PUZUR₄.IŠTAR DUMU da-da iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Šu-Bēlum son of Iddin-abum seized us in his case against Puzur-Ištar son of Dada.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-bé-lúm-ma a-na PUZUR₄.IŠTAR-ma 16 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú a-na a-bi-a ḫa-bu-lá-tí
target: Šu-Bēlum said to Puzur-Ištar: You owe 16 minas of silver and its interest to my father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma PUZUR₄.IŠTAR-ma a-bu-kà maš-ke-e il₅-ta-qé-ma KÙ.BABBAR ša-bu
target: Puzur-Ištar answered: 'Your father has already received hides so he has been paid the silver.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na KÙ ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-bi₄-im ku-la i-šu
target: Iddin-abum owes 8 minas of refined silver to Kula.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú im-tí-da-kum
target: The silver and the interest on it has become a great sum for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na-um 0.33333 ma-na i ša-tim tù-ṣa-áb
target: You pay 0.3333 mina per mina per year as interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ni-mar-IŠTAR IGI en-nam-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Nimar-Ištar, by Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-na-da DUMU šu-(d)EN.LÍL tap-pá-i-ni
target: Aššur-nādā son of Šu-Illil is our partner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma šu-bé-lim nu-ší-ib-ma
target: We sat down (to negotiate) on behalf of Šu-Bēlum

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-iš a-lim(ki) it-mu-ú-ma
target: and they swore an oath by the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 6 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-mì-ig-ru
target: and agreed on 6 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-né-eš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ma-lá u₄-me-šu a-na a-lim(ki) lá i-ta-lá-ak
target: If he has not left for the City within his stipulated term,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na-ku lá i-šá-qal
target: he must repay the silver to Kula.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-ba-ni IGI i-dí-sú-in
target: Witnessed by Aššur-bāni, by Iddin-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul
target: If he has not paid (in time),

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 1 ma-na-im 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na 1 ITU.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
target: he must pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša ḫa-pì-aḫ-šu ù sú-kà-lí-a a-na 25 ḫa-am-šá-tim a-na a-lim(ki) i-lá-ak-ma
target: Reckoned from the week of Happiahšu and Sukkalliya he must go to the City within 25 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí um-me-a-ni-šu 2 ma-na KÙ.GI šu-mì ku-lá i-lá-pá-at
target: Together with his investors he must book Kula's name for 2 minas of gold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um ù 13.5 ma-na URUDU SIG₅ i-lí-bi na-a
target: 35 shekels of refined silver and 13.5 minas of refined copper are due by Idnāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI wa-al-dí-DINGIR IGI i-na-ar
target: Witnessed by Waldi-ilum, by Inar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša am-ri-a ù e-lá-lí ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im a-na ṣí-ib-tim i-lá-ak-šum
target: They become interest-bearing for him at the rate stipulated by the colony from the week-eponymy of Amriya and Elālī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10.75 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er a-li-li tù-mì-li-a-i-im a-lā-ḫu-um i-šu
target: Alili, the man from Tumlia, owes 10.75 shekels of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-na-da DUMU a-mur-lu-sú
target: seal of Aššur-nādā, son of Amur-ilūssu

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša e-la-ma ù id-na-a ma-aḫ-ri-ni ni-kà-sé i-sí-ú-ma
target: that Elamma and Idnāya settled accounts in our presence

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-ib-tum pá-ni-tum 0.83333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR gám-ru-um ša iš-ta-pu-ru-šu-ni i li-bi₄-šu-ma
target: 1.5 mina of silver, an earlier interest, (and) 0.83333 mina of silver, expenses, about which he wrote him repeatedly, he also owes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM be-el-té-kà-lim li-mu-um ša qá-tí a-šùr-i-mì-tí ma-lá-ḫi-im
target: Month Bēlat-ekallim, in the eponymy after that of Aššur-imittī, the skipper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kà-ší-im 1 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám i-na ITU.1.KAM-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: Reckoned from the week of the kassum-official he will pay interest at the rate of 1 shekel per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma lá tù-šar
target: He said: You must not release it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 36 GÚ SÍG.ḪI.A ša ì-lí-dan ša i-na É ir-i-bi₄-im i-ba-ší-ú en-um-a-šur iṣ-ba-at
target: Ennam-Aššur has seized 36 talents of wool belonging to Ilī-dan that was in Ir’ibum's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI (d)IŠKUR-ba-ni lá-qé-ep URUDU a-na mì-šu-GAL iš-qú-ul
target: In the presence of Adad-bāni La-qēp paid the copper to Mīšur-rabi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma la ki-a-am ku-ta-nim ša-ma-ni-im
target: if not, then buy kutānu-textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 22 ma-na URUDU i-ṣé-er a-al-DU₁₀ ša tù-ùḫ-pì-a a-al-DU₁₀ DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀ i-šu
target: 22 minas of copper Āl-ṭāb from Tuhpiya owes to Āl-ṭāb, son of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma AN.NA 15 GÍN.TA ù e-li-iš 2 GÚ AN.NA ša-ma-nim
target: If the rate of the tin is 15:1 or even more, then buy 2 talents of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-re-ṣí da-dí-a ù en-nam-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma um-ma e-la-ma-ma
target: Say to Aššur-rēṣī, Dadiya and Ennam-Aššur, thus Elamma:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-la-at be-lúm-ba-ni šu-ut-ma na-ší
target: Half a mina of silver, the working capital of Bēlum-bāni, he himself has with him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 24 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki-a dan-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Dān-Aššur is on his way to you with 24 minas of refined silver, its excise added, his transport fee paid, under my seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR (TÚG)lu-bu-šé ra-qá-tim ù šu-lu-up-ki-e ša ma-nim-ma iš-tí pá-ni-e-ma šé-bi₄-la-nim
target: Use 11.66666 minas of silver to buy lubušu-garments, thin textiles and Šulupkian ones and send them with the first available caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma u₄-mu-ú e-mu-ú la ú-ṣí-a-am
target: If the weather is hot he must not leave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ik-ri-bi₄-a a-na dan-a-šur a-dín
target: I gave 5 shekels of silver of my votive offering to Dān-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er (d)UTU.DU₁₀ ḫu-dí-da tí-šu
target: Šamaš-ṭāb owes x minas of refined silver to Hudida.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM ṣí-ip-im li-mu-um e-lá-lí
target: Month Ṣip'um, eponymy Elāli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR-ri-im
target: The silver belongs to a merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-nu-mì lu-qú-tum a-ni-tum ú-ṣí-a-ni u₄-mu-ú kà-ṣú
target: If, when this merchandise leaves, the weather is cool,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-bu-ša-lim iš-tí ma-ma-an i-na a-ḫe-ni ša ú-ša-lá-ma-šu-nu pì-iq-da-šu-ma
target: then entrust Abu-šalim to the care of one of our brothers who will bring them here safely,

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-ṣa-am
target: then he can leave.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na dam-qá-a qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-at-a-na-ma
target: To Damqaya from Šāt-Anna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul
target: If he has not paid,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: he must add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša pu-šu-ke-en₆ ù PUZUR₄-a-šur
target: Reckoned from the week of Pūšu-kēn and Puzur-Aššur

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 3 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: he must pay within 3 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-dí-na-ku-ni ta-áš-pu-ra-ma um-ma a-ta-ma
target: You wrote concerning the 10 shekels of silver that I gave to you, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-ku-pí-a DUMU e-dí-na-a
target: Seal of Ikūn-pīya son of Eddinaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-ri-ší-im DUMU a-mur-(d)UTU
target: Seal of Irišum son of Amur-Šamaš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB (d)UTU.DU₁₀ DUMU am-ri-a
target: Seal of Šamaš-ṭāb son of Amriya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta ú a-na-ku ga-ma-al-kà
target: for you are my brother and I can do you favors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-am ša té-pu-šu a-na a-lim(ki) ṭá-ba-tum-ma šé-bi-lam
target: Be so kind as to send the purchase you made to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-dí-a-bi-im DUMU na-ar-me-a
target: to Iddin-abum son of Narmea.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí ša bé-ú-lá-tí-a ší-ma-am áš-a-ma
target: I made purchases together with the money from my working capital

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na pu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim ú-šé-bi-il₅
target: and sent it to Purušhaddum

target: Check my certified tablets

target: Set aside your own needs for just one or two days

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-lu-a a-tù-nu a-dí lá-qé-im na-áp-ší-a-ni

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a tù-um-li-a-i-am nam-gi₅-ra-ma

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí tù-um-li-a-i-im
target: 8 minas of silver owed by the man from Tumliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tù-um-li-a-i-im e-li-it-ma

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-dí-da a-ma-kam i-li-kam
target: If Adida has arrived there,

target: In the presence of Uṣur-ša-Aššur, of Sikile'i, and of Wardum.

target: When they come back from Zalpa,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ḫum a-ṭá-ra-dam
target: I shall send Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-ma-ru-kà lu ak-lu
target: Your donkeys should be fed.

target: Idnaya is bringing you 17 shekels of silver under my seal, the proceeds from your textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pé-a iš-tí lá-ma-sà-tim i-ba-ší-ú

target: Why has no report of yours ever reached me

source: translate Akkadian to English: úz-ni lá ta-pá-tí-
target: and do you not keep me informed?

target: My dear brothers, sell my tin for refined silver as well as you can before the caravan arrives.

target: and the proceeds from the 5 minas of tin from the votive offering must be available in silver.

target: then unpack the silver and buy for me tin at 9 shekels per (shekel of silver) or as favorably as you can

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-ma-ma li-ib-ší

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma pì-ri-kà-nu lá-šu
target: If there are no pirikannu-textiles,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i ku-nu-ki-šu li-ib-ší
target: then let the silver remain under seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí TÚG-ba-tí-kà 14 mu-ta-tum 2 e-li-té-en ku-nu-ki ša šé-ep-IŠTAR ú ša-lim-wa-ar-dí

target: In accordance with your instructions we aired your textiles

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG-ṣú-ba-tù-ku-nu šál-mu

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ku-ta-ni 12 ša a-ki-dí-e ku-nu-ki ša šál-ma-a-šùr ṣú-ḫa-ru-kà na-áš-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí

target: We entrusted 2 kutānu-textiles, 1 Akkadian one and 1 thin textile to Ali-abum and Iddin-Aššur in accordance with your instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na 4.25 GÍN it-ba-al
target: It cost 0.6666 mina 4 1/4 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi₄-lá-ni SÍG.ḪI.A ni-iš-a-ma-kum
target: For 1 mina of silver that you sent we bought wool for you.
