target: By Ṣilulu son of Uku.

source: translate Akkadian to English: en-um-a-šùr DUMU ša-lim-a-šùr a-na a-gi-a DUMU i-ku-nim iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur seized us against Agiya son of Ikūnum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šùr a-na a-gi-a-ma
target: Ennam-Aššur said as follows to Agiya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-la ta-tù-ar-ma mì-ma la ta-na-pu-uš
target: Do not raise claim and do not complain at all.

source: translate Akkadian to English: PÚZUR-a-šùr DUMU a-hu-wa-qar iš-tù ub-lu-ni-ni
target: Puzur-Aššur, son of Ahu-waqar brought here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 4 TÚG.HI.A iṣ-bi-ru-ma
target: Thereof 4 textiles were deducted.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-a-ar-tí-ma a-na en-na-sú-in qí-bi-ma
target: From Ayarti to Enna-Suen:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na kà-ni-iš ṭup-pí ša hu-bu-ul a-bi-a a-ta lu ša-zu-úz-ta-kà lu a-hu-kà kà-li-ma-ni-ma
target: Show me, either you yourself or your agent or your brother, the tablets concerning my father's debt in Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí TÚG.HI.A ú e-ma-re ṣa-lá-me-e ša-du-a-tum ú ú-ku-ul-tí e-ma-re 5 ma-na 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-qú-lu
target: For the rest of the textiles and the black donkeys, they paid 5 minas and 7.5 shekels of silver as transport-tax and food for the donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur DUMU a-li-li
target: Witnessed by Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur son of Alili.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI bé-lu-um-ba-ni DUMU kà-sí-a
target: By Bēlum-bāni son of Kasiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iz-ku-ú-šu
target: 3 minas of silver became available for him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 6 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR iz-ku-ma ku-li-a il₅-qé
target: 6 minas of silver which were cleared Kuliya took.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 e-ma-re ṣa-lá-me ú me-at 70 ma-na URUDU ša kà-ni-iš a-ba-an ma-tim ma-tim ša a-šùr ir-de₈-a-ku-nu-tí-ni
target: 3 black donkeys and 170 minas of copper of Kanesh, according to the local weight standard, which Aššur lead to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 TÚG a-na li-tab-ší-šu
target: 1 textile thereof was for his own clothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-uk a-bi-kà ú-lá ší-bi a-na ma-lá u₄-me-a ú-la ušté-li-a-ku-nu-tí
target: If I have not produced the tablet sealed by your father or the witnesses within my term.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ma-lá ṭup-pí-a ša ku-nu-uk a-bi-ni hu-bu-li-ni ú-la a-tù-ar-ma lá a-na-pu-uš
target: Then it is indeed our debt in accordance with my tablet sealed by our fathers, and I shall not raise claim and I shall not complain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim wa-bar-tum ša ša-lá-tù-wa-ar i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: For this affair the trading-station of Šalatuwar made us appear in court.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony in the presence of the dagger of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì KÙ.GI iš-tí-ku-nu i-hi-id-ma
target: Pay attention to the gold in your possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ú e-lá-lí KÙ.GI SIG₅ šé-bi-lá-nim
target: You and Elāli send me good gold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ha-at a-bi-kà me-ta-at
target: Your father's sister is dead.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma pá-ru-ur-tum-ma a-na i-dí-a-bi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Parrurtum to Iddin-abum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma ṭup-pá-am ta-áš-me-ú tí-ib-a-ma a-ta-al-kam
target: Set out and come here when you have heard the letter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ku-nu lá tù-qá-a
target: Do not wait until you leave yourself.

source: translate Akkadian to English: gi-mì-lam ra-bi-am i-ṣé-ri-a šu-ku-ma
target: Do me a great favour!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-we-lúm lá i-qá-bi um-ma šu-ut-ma KÙ.GI lá šé-bi-lá-ma
target: The man should not say: 'Do not send any gold!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-hi-id-ma KÙ.GI SIG₅ šé-bi-lá-nim
target: but do take care to send me good gold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É a-bi-kà a-na kà-nu-nim ba-li-im iš-ta-ak-nu
target: They have turned your father's house into an extinguished fireplace.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ap-lúm la-šu
target: 'There is no heir.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É-bé-tám né-nu ni-tá-ru
target: Let us take away the house.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-re-ṣí en-um-a-šur da-dí-a ú a-ta-a qí-bi₄-ma
target: Say to Aššur-rēṣī, Ennam-Aššur, Dadiya and Ataya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na URUDU ša DINGIR-ba-ni DUMU ib-ni-lí KI a-ta-a
target: 8 minas of copper belonging to Ilī-bāni, son of Ibni-ilī, is due from Ataya'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-ṣé-er ša KÙ.GI ṭí-ih-a-ma
target: And add it to that derived from the gold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 ma-na URUDU i ší-im qá-qí-ri ša É nu-ri-i-li KI a-šur-re-ṣí a-hu-ur
target: 17 minas of copper from the price for a house-plot of Nūr-ilī is still due from Aššur-rēṣī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU ma-lá i-na li-bi₄-šu-nu i-ba-ší-ú šé-ṣí-a-ma
target: Settle accounts for all the copper they still owe

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-hi a-ta i-na ša-ha-at ša-zu-úz-tí-a i-zi-iz-ma
target: Please, my brother, assist my representative(s).

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú šu-ma i-na ba-áb-tí-a mì-ma tal-qé-a
target: Moreover, if you have collected anything of my outstanding claims,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-ta-ni ša-ma-ma šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: buy kutānu-textiles and send them to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam ṭup-pá-am ší-me-ma
target: read that tablet over there,

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-ba-kà lá i-lá-mì-in
target: but do not get angry.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am na-áš-pár-tam ša a-šur-la-ma-sí ša a-šu-mì tá-ad-mì-iq-tim ša a-na a-bi₄-kà ip-qí-du na-áš-ú-ni-kum
target: The tablet with the letter of Aššur-lamassī concerning the free loan he entrusted to your father, which they are bringing to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na a-lá-ak ma-áš-kà-tí-a TÚG.HI.A iš-té-na ú ša-na šé-bi₄-lam-ma
target: And send me, when a shipment of mine starts its journey, each time one or two textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá-ag-mì-il₅-kà
target: Then I will do you a favor (in return).

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šùr …
target: And before Aššur's dagger [I gave my testimony].

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB lá-qé-pí-im DUMU i-zi-za-am-DINGIR
target: Seal of La-qēpum, son of Izzizam-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-na-ni-ma
target: For these words the Kanesh colony made me available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-áš-pu-ra-am um-ma a-ta-ma
target: You have written, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 16 ma-na KÙ ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-šùr-eš-tí-kál ù i-dí-a-bi₄-im i-sú-riki₁₃ i-šu
target: Aššur-ištikal and Iddin-abum owe 16 minas of refined silver to Issu-arik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì ba-a-ba-tí-kà ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni
target: As to your outstanding loans, that you wrote about.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i-na ku-nu-ki ša ki-ma ku-a-tí i-ba-ší
target: The silver is available under the seals of your representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lu-qú-tám sá-li-a i-na ma-ah-ri-kà lá iš-ta-kán
target: If Salliya has not placed the goods before you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša iš-tù bu-ru-uš-ha-dim tù-šé-ṣí-a-ni
target: The silver that you have brought out from Burušhaddum

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ku-nu-ki ša ki-ma i-a-tí-ma li-ni-dí
target: should be deposited under the seals of my representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša da-tí-a ni-il₅-qé
target: We received 2 minas of silver of my fees.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-a-ma-at a-lim a-šùr sá-li-a a ša-lim-a-šùr i-da-an
target: Salliya must give purchases in the City of Assur to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam i-re-ší ba-áb-tí-kà a-za-az
target: Here I keep a close watch over your outstanding loans.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ì-lí-dan aṣ-ba-at-ma
target: Here I seized Ilī-dan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ú-ša-áš-qí-il₅-šu
target: I made him pay 2 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù sú-in-na-da i-na wa-ah-šu-ša-na wa-ša-áb
target: Also, Suen-nādā is staying in Wahšušana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 né-pí-šu 15 ma-na.TA KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um šu-qú-ul-ta-áš-nu
target: 2 packages of refined silver, 15 minas each was their weight;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ni-is-ha-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu
target: its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù iš-tí-in né-pí-šu-um 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um
target: plus one package with 3 minas of refined silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ha-ma 2 né-pí-šu 13.25 ma-na.TA KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am šu-qú-ul-ta-áš-nu
target: Further, 2 packages of refined silver, 13 1/4 minas each was their weight.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-du-a-at KÙ.BABBAR a-nim šu-IŠTAR ša-bu-ú
target: Šu-Ištar has been paid the transport tariff for this silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša en-um-a-šùr
target: The silver belongs to Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 59.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-a a-na šu-IŠTAR áp-qí-id
target: In all: 59.5 minas of refined silver under my seal I entrusted to Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ṣé-er ša-lim-a-šùr ù DAM.GÀR ku-nu-ki-a ú-šé-bi-il₅-šu
target: I sent the silver under my seal with him to Šalim-Aššur and the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ša ki-ma ku-a-tí i-na 10.5 GÚ URUDU ší-ki-im a-ha-ma 40 ma-na ha-bu-ra-ta-i-im 7 ANŠE.HI.A ṣa-lá-me ù 2 ṣú-ha-ri qá-at-kà i-na KÙ.BABBAR ša sá-li-a ù ì-lí-dan ha-bu-lu-ni ú-ša-áš-ki-nu-ma
target: here your representatives made you lay claim to the 10.5 talents of copper, also 40 minas of (copper) from haburat, 7 black donkeys and 2 servants, i.e. the yield in silver that Salliya and Ilī-dan owed.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù lu-qú-tám a-na sà-ah-ri-DINGIR ù en-um-a-šur DUMU šu-be-lim ip-qí-du
target: and they have entrusted the goods to Sahri-ilī and Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a-nim a-na ma-lá ṭup-pí-im ša a-lim(ki)
target: Come on, (act) in accordance with the tablet of the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-ha-ni ra-bi-ṣa-am i-a-tí
target: Do not obstruct me, me, the attorney!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ni-iš a-lim(ki) ú ru-ba-im ta-mu-ú lu ú-kà-al
target: Keep in mind what was sworn by the City and the king!

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-bi-ṣú-um ša ša-lim-a-šùr en-um-a-šùr ú a-lá-hu-am me-er-e ša-lim-a-šùr iš-a-al
target: Šalim-Aššur's attorney questioned Ennam-Aššur and Ali-ahum, Šalim-Aššur's sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma i-sà-na-li-ú-ni-ma um-ma a-na-ku-ma ba-a-nim ri-id-a-ni
target: Since they kept petitioning me I said: 'Come on, take me (to court).'

source: translate Akkadian to English: bu-lá-tí KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-bi-ku-nu lu-šé-ra-ku-nu-tí
target: then I shall release the assets, your father's silver to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-nu a-lá-kam ú kà-lu-mì-i lá i-mu-ú-ni
target: But they refused to come, or to show me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šar bu-lá-tù KÙ.BABBAR-áp a-bi-ku-nu i-ba-ší-ú
target: Show me where the assets, your father's silver is,

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-li-ma-ni-ma lu-šé-ra-ku-nu-tí
target: then I shall release it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-ak a-na a-lim(ki)
target: I shall go to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-dí-(d)IM DUMU a-šùr-DU₁₀
target: Witnessed by Iddin-Adad son of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI tù-ur-a-a DUMU me-na-a
target: By Tūraya son of Menaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI kur-ub-a-šùr DUMU ṣí-li-a
target: By Kurub-Aššur son of Ṣilliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tù-ta-ni-ha-ni
target: You have obstructed me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá ri-ig-ma-tum ší-bu-tum
target: This is not a formal lawsuit, only a witnessed questioning.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na dí-tí-im ú-lá áš-pu-ur-kà
target: I did not send you to court.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na bu-lá-té-e ša a-bi-ni pá-hu-ri-im lu ta-li-kam
target: You did indeed come to collect our father's assets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: uš-kà-in a-na ṭup-pí-im ša a-lim(ki) ú ra-bi-ṣí-im ša be-lí-a
target: I submit to the tablet of the City and the attorney of my lord.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im NA₄.ZA.GÌN a-
target: Where are the proceeds from the lapis lazuli?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma ba-a-am a-šar bu-lá-tù ša a-bi-ni i-ba-ší-ú-ni
target: I said: 'Come on, (let's go to) where our father's assets are.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu ta-áš-e-li-ma
target: and once or twice you have questioned me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-at-kà ú-lá am-ha-ṣ
target: and I have not rejected you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na du-ur-hu-mì-it lu ni-li-ik-ma
target: Let us go to Durhumit

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu nu-pá-hi-ir
target: and let us collect it

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 (TÚG)ku-ta-ni SIG₅ a-na 0.83333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-dí-in
target: 2 good quality kutānu-textiles were given for 5/6 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí a-hu-qar
target: x minas 2 shekels of silver are with Ahu-waqar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ha-ma 1 (TÚG)ku-sí-tù a-na a-ša-at i-na-ah-DINGIR ta-dí-in
target: Further, 1 kusītu-textile was given to the wife of Inah-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 (TÚG)ku-sí-tù lu-bu-ší-im a-na 0.33333 ma-na 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na i-dí-a-šùr ta-dí-in
target: 1 kusītu-textile for clothing was given to Iddin-Aššur for 1/3 mina 8 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì TÚG.HI.A ša šé-pí-a ni-im-nu
target: When we counted the textiles shipped under my responsibility.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 (TÚG)sà-áp-tí-num É.GAL-lúm il₅-qé
target: The palace took 2 saptinnum-textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 šu-lu-up-ga-um ú 2 ku-ta-nu ha-al-qú
target: 1 šulupkaean-textile and 2 kutānu-textiles were lost.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 TÚG.HI.A il₅-tab-šu
target: Five textiles they took for their clothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 me-at 17 šu-ru-tum a-na É.GAL-lim e-ru-bu
target: 117 dark textiles entered the palace.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 2 TÚG qá-a-tí ša kur-ub-IŠTAR
target: two of which are the share of Kurub-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma bé-li-a-ma a-na en-um-a-šur ú lá-qé-ep
target: From Bēliya to Ennam-Aššur and Lā-qēp:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ni-is-ha-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu
target: As to the 8 minas of refined silver - its import duty added, its transport tariff paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tám-kà-ru-um en-um-a-šur
target: the merchant is Ennam-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tí-ir-ta-ku-nu le-zi-ba-am
target: and let him leave me a message from you (plural).

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-qú-tám ma-lá ta-áš-a-ma-šu-ni a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU ša-lim-a-šur dí-in-ma
target: Any goods you have bought for him you must give to Ennam-Aššur son of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša DAM.GÀR ša a-na ší-a-ma-tim IGI DU₁₀-a-hi ú IGI lá-qé-ep DUMU MAN-ša-du-e a-dí-na-ku-ni
target: Silver belonging to a merchant, that I gave you for purchases with Ṭāb-ahi and Lā-qēp son of Puzur-šadū'e as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-a le-pu-uš
target: and let him act in accordance with my instructions.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-na ki-ba-al dí-na-ma
target: Give the silver to Kibal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-dí-a-šùr-ma a-na a-lá-hi-im ha-nu-nu e-na-na-tim ù ki-ba-al qí-bi-ma
target: From Iddin-Aššur to Ali-ahum, Hanunu, Ennanātum and Kibal:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma AN.NA ša en-nam-(d)IM tù-ša-áš-qí-lá
target: If you have had Ennam-Adad's tin paid,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR ta-e-ra-ma
target: then convert it to silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú tí-ir-ta-ku-nu KÙ.BABBAR ma-lá ta-dí-na-šu-ni li-li-kam
target: Also, send me word about how much silver you have given him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pì-a ú hu-ur-ša-am a-tù-nu-ma ku-un-kà
target: You have to seal for my tablets and the store-room.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ma-an e is-li-ší
target: No one must deceive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e-na-na-ta-am na-hi-da-ma ba-lu-ku-nu ṭup-pè-e-a ma-ma-na lá i-pá-té
target: Give Ennanātum instructions that no one must open my tablets without your permission.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x ma-na 13 GÍN ni-ga-li DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur i-dí-nam
target: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur gave me x mina 13 shekels of sickles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.5 ma-na 0.66666 GÍN a-na a-ki-a ni-dí-in
target: Of that we gave 0.5 mina 0.6666 shekels to Akiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na KÙ.BABBAR ša tù-šé-bi-la-ni 1.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR al-qé
target: Of the silver you sent I took 1 1/4 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma be-lí a-ta iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-ni-i-ma sà-ḩe-er-tám šé-bi-lam
target: If you are indeed my lord, send me small goods with the first transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na áb-na-am ú-ba-am i ku-nu-ki-a na-áš-ú
target: They carry a weight-stone of 10 minas under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim a-šu-ú-ma-an ù ki-kà-ar-ša-an i-ra-dí-ú-ni-ku-nu-tí
target: Ašu-uman and Kikaršan lead all this to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.75 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR DU₁₀-ṣí-lá-a-šur na-áš-a-ku-um
target: Ṭāb-ṣill-Aššur brings you 2 3/4 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-um i li-bi a-šur-kà-ší-id DUMU ik-ra-a
target: 15 minas of washed copper is owed by Aššur-kāšid son of Ikraya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ak-ta-áš-dam
target: If I have not reached it,

source: translate Akkadian to English: SÍG.ḩI.A ša-li-im-tám lu-sà-ni-qú-ni-ku-nu-tí

target: But Šumi'ar has died and his sons live until today in Kunanamit, so that the copper has been tied up.

target: and for which he holds 20 talents of wool as security -

target: I answered them: '40 minas, the price of the golden bead plus 23 minas, the price of tin, together 1 talent 3 minas is what your father owes!'

target: They said: 'We will find the copper for you and then, when you swear you can take it'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN a-na PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU šu-be-lim

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN a-na lá-dí-a-ma
target: 1 shekel to Ladiya as well.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na pu-šu-ki-in
target: 10 shekels of silver to Pūšu-kēn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN a-na me-er-ì-šu
target: 1 ½ shekel to his son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN a-na en-um-a-šur DUMU šu-a-šur
target: 1 shekel to Ennam-Aššur son of Šu-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN a-na en-nam-a-šur DUMU sú-kà-li-a
target: 1 ½ shekel to Ennam-Aššur son of Sukalliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN a-na ili₅-ba-ni DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šur
target: 2 shekels to Ilī-bāni son of Puzur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN a-na i-na-a
target: 2 shekels to Innaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN a-na lá-qé-pì-im kà-ၣa-ar i-dí-sú-in
target: 2 shekels to Lā-qēp, Iddin-Suen's packer.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN a-na a-ni-nim
target: 3 shekels to Anninum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN a-na im-dí-DINGIR i-nu-mì li-tí-šu-nu a-dí-šu-nu-tí-ni
target: 2 shekels to Imdī-ilum when I gave them their garments.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-nu-mì li-ta-tí-šu a-na pu-šu-ki-in a-dí-in
target: 15 shekels of silver when I gave his garments to Pūšu-kēn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN a-na a-mur-DINGIR
target: 3 shekels to Amur-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11 GÍN iš-t1 PUZUR₄-a-šur
target: 11 shekels due from Puzur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11.25 GÍN iš-t1 a-šur-ba-ni
target: 11 1/4 shekels due from Aššur-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-eḫ-ra-tim a-dí-šu-um
target: I gave the equivalent to him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 GÍN K1.BABBAR ša DAM ḫa-ar-ša-a a-na a-šur-mu-ta-pì-il₅ ḫa-bu-la-at-ni
target: 9 shekels of silver which Haršāya's wife owes to Aššur-mŦtappil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-ta-tí-a DUMU en-na-nim
target: Seal of Atatiya, son of Ennānim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-ḫu-wa-qar DUMU a-šur-SIPA
target: Seal of Ahu-waqar, son of Aššur-rē'ī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṣé-er 12 GÍN 13 GÍN K1.BABBAR a-na a-šur-mu-ta-pì-il₅
target: In addition to 12 shekels, 13 shekels of silver for Aššur-mŦtappil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-mur-a-šur DUMU šu-iš-ḫa-ra
target: Seal of Amur-Aššur, son of Šu-Išhara.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-al-DU₁₀-ma a-na a-mur-a-šur-ma
target: Āl-ṭāb said to Amur-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša a-al-DU₁₀ a-na a-mur-a-šur iṣ-bu-tù-ni-a-tí
target: The fact that Āl-ṭāb seized us against Amur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB (d)a-šur-(d)UTU-ši DUMU ili₅-ba-ni
target: Seal of Aššur-šamšī, son of Ilī-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: K1.BABBAR a-ta ú šu-IŠTAR qá-tám mì-iš-la i-na ša ip-ṭí-ri-i ša-qá-lá-am la qá-bi₄-a-tù-nu
target: Did you and Šu-Ištar not promise to pay silver, each a half-share of the ransom?

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ka-ku-a DUMU i-dí-IŠTAR
target: Seal of Kakua, son of Iddin-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB PUZUR₄-(d)IŠKUR DUMU i-dí-IŠTAR
target: Seal of Puzur-Adad, son of Iddin-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ḫa-na-na DUMU DINGIR-kur-ub
target: Seal of Hanana, son of Ilum-kurub.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB na-ra-am-a-šùr DUMU ì-dí-ba-ni
target: Seal of Narām-Aššur, son of Iddin-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma me-er-e DINGIR-kur-ub K1.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú ḫa-na-na ša-bu
target: On behalf of the sons of Ilum-kurub, Hanana is satisfied with the silver and its interest.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 0.33333 ma-na 5 GÍN K1.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul en-na-sú-in ša e-li-a-ni sà-ar
target: The tablet concerning 1/3 mina 5 shekels of silver, the debt of Enna-Suen, which appeared, is invalid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma me-er-ú DINGIR-kur-ub a-na en-na-sú-in i-tù-ru-ú
target: If the sons of Ilum-kurub raise a claim against Enna-Suen,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-na-na ú-ba-áb-šu
target: Hanana will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-a-šur-ma ke-na qá-bi₄-a-ni
target: Amur-Aššur said: "Yes, we promised,"

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú i-na né-me-lim-x ša-li-iš-tám áš-du-na-kà i-zu-a-az
target: and he shall divide for you a one-third share of the profit

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-na i-bi₄-sà-e ša-li-iš-tám i-za-az
target: and take a one-third share of the losses."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma wa-ak-lúm-ma a-na kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš-ki qí-bí-ma
target: Thus says the Ruler to the Kanesh colony:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 5 GÍN K1.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ša ik-ri-bi ša me-er-ú DINGIR-kur-ub i-ṣé-er en-na-sú-in DUMU a-mur-(d)UTU ir-ší-ú-ni
target: Enna-Suen son of Amur-Šamaš owed 1/3 mina 5 shekels of refined silver from the votive offerings of the sons of Ilum-kurub.

source: translate Akkadian to English: K1.BABBAR ša IGI en-na-nim ù DUMU x i-dí-nu-šu-ni
target: The silver which they gave him before Ennānim and the son of [X].

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lu-um dì-nam IGI GIŠ.GAG-en GAL-en i-na ḫa-am-ri-im i-dí-ma
target: The City has passed a verdict in front of the two great pegs in the sacred precinct.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-dí-sú-in DUMU i-ba-a-a ra-bi-ṣa-am e-ḫa-az-ma
target: Iddin-Suen son of Ibaya may hire an attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-um DINGIR-šu-GAL DUMU ba-zi-a
target: The eponym is Ilšu-rabi son of Baziya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um dí-nam i-dí-in-ma
target: The colony has passed a verdict.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ku-bu-um DUMU a-šùr-i-dí ra-bi-ṣí
target: Šu-Kūbum son of Aššur-idī is my attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-šu ša-lim-a-šùr a-na šu-ku-bi-im i-da-an
target: Šalim-Aššur will give a tablet bearing his seal to Šu-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na kur-ub-IŠTAR šu-ku-bu-um ú-lá i-tù-a-ar
target: Šu-Kūbum will not raise a claim against Kurub-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 1 GÚ 2 ma-na AN.NA
target: Total: 1 talent 2 minas of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na šu-ku-bi-im ma-ma-an i-tù-a-ar
target: If anyone raises a claim against Šu-Kūbum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr ú-ba-áb-šu
target: Šalim-Aššur will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na lu-qú-tim ma-la a-na a-šùr-be-el-a-wa-tim i-pí-iq-du-ma
target: Concerning all the goods that were entrusted to Aššur-bēl-awātim,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr ú-šé-ṣí-ú
target: and which Šalim-Aššur had taken out.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma tù-ra-mì-ili₅-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr ù šu-ku-bi-ma qí-bí-ma
target: Thus says Tūram-ilī to Ennam-Aššur and Šu-Kūbum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: AN.NA lu-šé-bi-lu-nim
target: let them send me the tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 35 ma-na AN.NA i li-bi a-šùr-ma-lik ù a-ḫa-ma
target: 35 minas of tin is in the possession of Aššur-malik, and also

source: translate Akkadian to English: 27 ma-na AN.NA i li-bi a-šur-ma-lik ú šu-ku-bi-im i-ba-ší
target: 27 minas of tin is in the possession of Aššur-malik and Šu-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-IŠTAR-ma ù la-qé-pu-um-ma a-na tám-kà-ri-im qí-bí-ma
target: Thus says Šu-Ištar and Lā-qēp to the merchant:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na K1.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ku-nu-ki-kà i-dí-a-bu-um ub-lam
target: Iddin-abum brought 10 minas of silver, its nishatu-tax added, its šaddu'utu-tax paid, under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN lu-bu-šu ša-bu
target: He was paid 2 shekels for his clothing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ANŠE ṣa-lá-mu 0.66666 ma-na 6 GÍN K1.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 2 black donkeys cost 2/3 mina 6 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN K1.BABBAR wa-ṣí-tám ni-dí-in
target: We gave 5 shekels of silver for the export duty.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na K1.BABBAR be-ú-lá-at 1 sà-ri-dim i-dí-a-bu-um il₅-qé
target: Iddin-abum received 1/2 mina of silver as the working capital of one packer.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15.33333 ma-na 5 GÍN AN.NA qá-tim 15 GÍN.TA K1.BABBAR-ap-šu 1 ma-na 1.66666 GÍN
target: 15.333 minas 5 shekels of expense-tin at 15 to 1, its silver value: 1 mina 1.666 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 GÍN K1.BABBAR ú-nu-ut ANŠE
target: 5 shekels of silver: harness for the donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 GÚ 5 ma-na 6 GÍN AN.NA ku-nu-ku
target: Thereof: 1 talent 5 minas 6 shekels of sealed tin

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15.66666 GÍN.TA K1.BABBAR-ap-šu 4 ma-na 9.33333 GÍN
target: at 15.666 per (shekel of silver), its silver value: 4 minas 9.333 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN ša sà-e-tim
target: 1 shekel: for the sā'utu-tax.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 TÚG.ḫA.A ša qá-tim 2.33333 ma-na K1.BABBAR it-bu-lu
target: 40 ordinary textiles cost 2.333 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: K1.BABBAR ga-am-ra-kum
target: The silver has been spent for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim ku-nu-ki-ni i-dí-a-bu-um i-ra-dí-a-kum
target: Iddin-abum is bringing all this to you under our seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu ḫa-dí-a-ni₇
target: let us be glad

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum tí-ib-a-ni-ma a-tal-kà-nim
target: Urgent: set out and come!

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma i-ṣé-ri-a šál-ma-a-šur lá il₅-qé
target: Šalim-Aššur took nothing on my account.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É a-bi-ni a-na-ku ù a-tù-nu na-am-ra-ni
target: As for our paternal house, I and you are happy!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šur-ma a-na en-na-sú-in ù DINGIR-ba-ni qí-bí-ma
target: Thus says Ennam-Aššur to Enna-Suen and Ilī-bāni:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša i-na-sú-in LUGAL-(d)IM mì-ma lá ub-lam
target: Šar-Adad has not brought anything belonging to Enna-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN K1.BABBAR ší-tám ša DINGIR-ba-ni en-na-sú-in ub-lam
target: Enna-Suen brought 1 shekel of silver, the remainder belonging to Ilī-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí a-ba-ba ta-ma-ku
target: I have sworn together with Ababa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ma be-ú-lá-at-ku-nu ba-at-qá-tù-nu
target: Also, if you are in arrears with your working capitals,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku ú-ša-ba
target: I shall pay (them).

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-sú-rik₁₃ a-na a-lim(ki) i-lá-ak-ma
target: As Issu-arik will go to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ku-za DUMU šu-a-nim
target: Witnessed by Akuza son of Šu-Anum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI sú-kà-li-a DUMU a-mur-a-šùr
target: Witnessed by Sukkalliya son of Amur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: We gave a tablet with our testimony before the dagger of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us (verdict) for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ú-ra-a DUMU ma-na na
target: Witnessed by Uraya son of Manana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN K1.BABBAR i li-bi ku-ku-lá-nim
target: 3 shekels of silver is owed by Kukkulānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 14 mu-ta-tim 2 e-li-ta-an ku-nu-ku ša šé-ep-IŠTAR ù ša-lim-wa-ardí
target: 14 half-packs and 2 top-packs sealed by Šēp-Ištar and Šalim-wardī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: É-tí-šu ša bu-ri-im a-šar a-ni-i ša-lim-a-šùr wa-áš-bu-ni
target: He sold his houses by the well, where at present Šalim-Aššur is living.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na tù-ud-ḫa-li-a a-ḫu tù-li a-na ší-mì-im i-dí-šu-nu
target: He sold them to Tudhaliya the brother of Tuli.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-dí-a-šùr DUMU ku-zi-lá-nim
target: Witnessed by Iddin-Aššur son of Kuzilānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na DAM (d)IŠTAR-pí-lá-ah šé-ep-IŠTAR ù ša-lim-wa-ardí ip-qídu
target: Šēp-Ištar and Šalim-wardī entrusted them to the wife of Ištar-pilah.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PUZUR₄-ša-du-e a-hi a-lá-hi-im
target: Witnessed by Puzur-šadu’e brother of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-sá-num ší-pár-ni a-na ta-i-tim a-na kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš ša-pí-ir
target: Asānum, our messenger, has been sent to the Kanesh colony to deliver information.

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-ma-kàl lá i-sà-hur
target: He must not suffer a delay of even one single day!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum ki-ma tup-pí-ni ta-áš-me-a-ni iš-té-na mu-qá-ri-bé a-na a-sá-num dí-na-ma
target: Please, as soon as you have heard our letter, give an escort to Asānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ru-um kà-ri-im a-dí kà-ni-iš(ki) lu-qá-ri-bu-šu
target: Each colony must escort him to the next, all the way until Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-la-hi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma ha-nu-ma
target: To Ali-ahum speak, thus says Hanu:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-tí-šu šu-qú-ul
target: Pay the silver and its interest!

source: translate Akkadian to English: la-qé-pum DUMU šu-ašur ú-kà-al-ší
target: Lā-qēpum son of Šu-Aššur has it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-qí-il₅ da-tim ku-li-a ší-ip-ru-um ša kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš ù kà-ru-um dur₄-hu-mì-it-ma
target: Thus say the 'datu-payers,' Kuliya, the messenger of Kanesh, and the colony of Durhumit:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na kà-ar kà-ar-ma ù wa-ba-ra-tim a-dí kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš qí-bi-ma
target: speak to every single colony and trading station until the colony of Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù ITU.1.KAM bur-sú-in ú-šé-bi₄-il₅-šu-um
target: "I sent the silver to him a month ago with Būr-Suen."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá tí-ir-tí-kà šu-hu-bu-ur ù a-na-ku ni-zi-iz-ma
target: In accordance with your instructions, Šu-hubur and I stood up

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lu-lá-a ni-iṣ-ba-at-ma um-ma né-nu-ma
target: and we seized Alulaya and said

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ta-ah-sí-is-tim ša tù-ša-hi-zi-ni
target: With respect to the memorandum that you instructed me about,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lu-lá-a a-áš-al-šu-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma
target: I questioned Alulaya, and he answered:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ta-ah-sí-is-tám ili₅-ba-ni DUMU ba-ší-li ú-kà-al-ší
target: Ilī-bāni son of Baši-ilī has the memorandum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-hu-wa-qar DUMU zu-ur-zu-ur a-áš-al-ma
target: I also questioned Ahu-waqar son of Zurzur,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki ma-ṣí lu KÙ.BABBAR lu pì-ri-kà-ni-kà 5 GÍN.TA a-lá-qé
target: I shall take enough, either in silver or from your pirikannu-textiles at 5 shekels per piece.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ba-áb ha-ra-ni-kà KÙ.BABBAR ú ṣí-ba-sú a-kà-na-kà-ma
target: He said further: "At the start of your journey I shall seal the silver and its interest for you."

source: translate Akkadian to English: u₄-ma-am ta-áš-ta-na-me ki-ma ší-mu-um kà-sú
target: Today you keep hearing that trade is at a standstill.

source: translate Akkadian to English: me-er-ú me-tim né-nu
target: We are inheritors (sons of a dead man).

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-mì a-da-ma
target: I shall sell my goods,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta-be-a-ma a-ta-lá-kam
target: set out and come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ší-li-ip-kà-im šu-kà-tám aṣ-ba-at-ma
target: Regarding the šilipka’um-textile I seized Šukkutum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ší-li-ip-kà-um i-ba-ší
target: and he answered: "The šilipka’um is available."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma me-er-e šál-ma-a-šur a-na qá-ta-tim a-da-ku-nu
target: Representing the sons of Šalim-Aššur I hand you over to guarantors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu ša pá-e a-na ša-lim-a-šur tí-šu
target: If you have oral witnesses against Šalim-Aššur,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-ni-ma be-lí a-ta a-ma-kam tù-na-hi-da-ni um-ma a-ta-ma
target: It still is, and you cautioned me there, my lord, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na u₄-me-šu ú-šé-ra-kum
target: "I have released them to you for its term."

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu a-na a-ba-e-ni tí-šu-ú
target: or if you have some against our fathers

source: translate Akkadian to English: tup-pá-am ša ša-lá-ša-at a-tù-nu ha-bu-lá-tù-nu-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR i qá-qá-ad šál-mì-ku-nu ra-ak-sú nu-kà-al
target: We have in our possession a tablet stating that you three owe silver and that you are jointly liable.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu ší-be-e tí-šu
target: or if you have witnesses

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu tup-pá-am ša ša-ba-e ša ku-nu-uk a-ba-e-ni tù-kà-al
target: or if you hold a tablet of satisfaction with the seal of our fathers

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-né-en-ma ru-a-ma mì-nam ni-qá-bi₄
target: Then produce the evidence to these men, and what can we then say?

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-ba-ar-ni-a-tí
target: Do not drag us to court.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ší-im AN.NA-ki-kà ša i-na tí-me-el-ki-a al-qé-ú
target: 2 minas of silver from the proceeds on your tin which I received in Timelkiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na PUZUR₄-a-šur ša šu-ì-lí-a áš-qúl
target: Thereof I paid 0.5 mina of silver to Puzur-Aššur of Šu-Iliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na sà-áp-tí-nim a-na am-tí-kà a-dí-in
target: I gave 5.5 shekels of silver for a saptinnu-textile to your maid-servant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10.33333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a be-a-lim ta-dí-nu-šu-ni a-na šé-ep-IŠTAR a-dí-in
target: I gave 10.33333 shekels of silver, which you gave him for use, to Šēp-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-na a-bu-a áš-qú-lu-ni
target: 2 shekels of silver which I paid to my father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša na-pá-hu iš-qú-lu-ni-ni
target: Of the 4 minas of silver that the smiths paid to me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.83333 ma-na 3.33333 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ma-sú-ha-am qá-dum 3.33333 GÍN mu-ṭá-e i-na li-bi-šu-nu a-hu-ur
target: 0.83333 mina 3.3333 shekels of silver of inferior quality together with 3.3333 shekels underweight remain as owed by them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1 GÚ 50 ma-na URUDU ù 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša hu-bu-ul PUZUR₄-(d)EN.LÍL
target: Of the 1 talent 50 minas of copper and 10 shekels of silver that are the debt of Puzur-Enlil,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR KI ša-lim-a-šùr DUMU up-ha-qí-im aṣ-ba-at
target: thereof I seized 1 mina of silver from Šalim-Aššur, son of Uphāqum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.25 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-šu-mì šé-ep-IŠTAR a qá-tí-kà tù-ṭá-hi-ú
target: 5.25 shekels of silver which you added to your share on account of Šēp-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ir-i-bi₄-im áš-qúl
target: I paid 0.66666 mina 5 shekels of silver to Ir-ibum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na AN.NA ù 3 ku-ta-ni i li-bi₄-kà i-šu
target: I have a claim of 5 minas of tin and 3 kutānu-textiles against you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša hu-bu-ul PUZUR₄-(d)EN.LÍL ša tup-pí-šu ha-ar-mì-im
target: Of the 4 minas of silver that are the debt of Puzur-Enlil, recorded in his certified tablet,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša a-ha-ma a-dí-šu-ni
target: and of the 0.5 mina of silver I had given him separately,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 4.5 GÚ 4.5 ma-na URUDU al-qé
target: thereof I obtained 4.5 talents 4.5 minas of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: tup-pá-am ša a-lim(ki) ta-áš-me
target: You have heard the tablet from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-ap ša-lim-a-šur ú-pá-ha-ar
target: I collect Šalim-Aššur's silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-ha-ni
target: Do not obstruct me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na me-er-e ša-lim-a-šur la ta-tù-ar
target: and you must not raise claim against Šalim-Aššur's sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá ga-me-er a-wa-tí-ni
target: as much as those who settled our case

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma a-wi-lu a-ni-ú-tum lu i-de₈-ú
target: Indeed, may these men know!

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na na-áš-pè-er-tí-šu-nu … ú-ša-hi-it-kà
target: I have cleared you with their missive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ba ra-bi-ṣú-um ša É ša-lim-a-šur en-um-a-šur ù ṣí-li-a ša ki-ma a-la-hi-im a-na i-dí-a-šur iṣ-ba-at-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Ababa, the attorney of Šalim-Aššur's firm, Ennam-Aššur and Ṣilliya, Ali-ahum's representative, seized us against Iddin-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-ba-ba ra-bi-ṣú-ma a-na i-dí-a-šur-ma
target: The attorney Ababa said to Iddin-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: na-áš-pé-er-tám ša um-me-a-ni IGI a-ni-ú-tim ší-me-ma
target: Listen to the missive from the investors before these witnesses,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na me-er-e ša-lim-a-šur lá ta-tù-ar
target: and do not raise claim against Šalim-Aššur's sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-dí-a-šur ra-bi₄-ṣa-am ša É ša-lim-a-šur en-um-a-šur ù ṣí-li-a ša
target: Iddin-Aššur answered the attorney of Šalim-Aššur's firm, Ennam-Aššur and Ṣilliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 40 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ša um-me-a-ni ša-lim-a-šur ta-pu-lu-ni a-na ma-lá na-áš-pè-er-tí-šu-nu iš-tù ITU.1.KAM hu-bu-ur li-mu-um a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-hi-im
target: I have received the 40 talents of good copper about which you reached an agreement with Šalim-Aššur's investors, in accordance with their missive dated month Hubur, eponymy Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ma-na hu-ša-e i-na kà-ṣí-im a-na ta-ší-a-tim
target: 5 minas of scrap (copper) in the steppe for transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù na-áš-pé-er-tám ša um-me-a-ni ša-lim-a-šur iš-tù ITU.KAM hu-bu-ur li-mì-im a-šur-ma-lik DUMU a-lá-hi-im ub-lá-kum
target: also, I brought you a missive from Šalim-Aššur's investors from the month Hubur, eponymy of Aššur-malik son of Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 40 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ip-qí-du-ni-ku-ni tù-šé-ra-am
target: stating that you must release 40 talents of good copper that they entrusted to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù qá-ṭá-ra a-dí ha-mì-za-nim 0.33333-ma-na AN.NA a-ta-ší-a-tim
target: From Qaṭṭarā until hamizānum 0.3333 mina of tin for transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù bu-ra-li-im a-dí bi-ir-tù-im 17 GÍN AN.NA a-na ta-ší-a-tim
target: From Burallum until Birtu'um 17 shekels of tin for transport.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ANŠE uš-pá-il₅-ma 1-ma-na 15 GÍN AN.NA a-pu-ul
target: I replaced a donkey and had to balance 1 mina and 15 shekels of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 GÍN AN.NA iš-tù a-al kà-ni-ší-e a-dí tí-mì-il₅-ki-a a-na ig-re e-re-qí-im
target: 7 shekels of tin from the Town of the Kaneshites until Timilkiya as hire for a wagon.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na áb-na-tí-ni i-ša-qú-lu
target: They must pay using our weight stones.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.KAM hu-bu-ur li-mu-um i-dí-a-bum
target: Month hubur eponymy Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 ma-na URUDU ma-sí-a-am i-ṣé-er ú-nu-ba ú a-ší-a-at wa-ar-dí ša dan-a-šur lu-zi i-šu
target: Unuba and Ašiat, Dan-Aššur's slaves, owe 15 minas of washed copper to Luzi.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-dí-a-bi₄-im DUMU i-tur₄-DINGIR
target: Seal of Iddin-abum son of Itūr-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-lu
target: If they have not paid (in time)

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣú-bu
target: they must add interest in accordance with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im ú i-ku-pì-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma a-li-a-ma
target: To Alāhum and Ikūn-pī-Aššur, speak: thus (says) Aliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ha-mu-uš-tim ša (d)MAR.TU-ba-ni ú a-šur-na-da a-na 4 ha-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
target: Reckoned from the week of Amurrum-bāni and Aššur-nādā they must pay within 4 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí ù bé-lá-nim
target: To my representatives and Bēlānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-ú ša a-bi₄-ni iš-té-en-x ta-ma-lá-kum ku-nu-ku-a ù ku-nu-ku-ú ša a-gu₅-a
target: The tablets of our father are in one tablet-container, under my seal and Aguwa's seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5.5 TÚG.ḪI.A en-nam-a-šur i-na-pá-al
target: Ennam-Aššur will pay 5.5 textiles as balance.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 3 TÚG.ḪI.A kà-ṣa-ru-um il₅-qé
target: Thereof the packer took 3 textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.5 TÚG.ḪI.A ù 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-tum ik-šu-sú
target: 3.5 textiles and 1.5 shekels of silver, the nisḫātum-tax, reached him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí TÚG.ḪI.A 61.5 TÚG.ḪI-tù-šu iz-ku-ú-nim
target: The remainder of the textiles, 61.5 textiles of his, were cleared.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 TÚG.ḪI.A É kà-ri-im i-na-pu-lu-šum
target: The office of the kārum will pay him 4 textiles as balance.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 TÚG.ḪI.A ša ší-mì-im ik-šu-sú
target: 7 textiles for the price reached him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.75 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na-pu-lu-šum
target: 1.75 shekels of silver they will pay him as balance.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 75 ku-ta-ni ša en-na-sú-in ša i-na a-lim(ki) a-na lá-ta-a ip-qí-du-ni
target: Of the 75 kutānus belonging to Enna-Suen that they entrusted to Lataya in the City,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 6 ku-ta-ni i-na tí-me-el-ki-a e-zi-ib
target: thereof he left 6 kutānus in Timelkiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí TÚG.ḪI.A 69 ku-ta-ni ša en-na-sú-in 3 ku-ta-nu ša kà-ṣa-ri-im
target: The remainder of the textiles, 69 kutānus of Enna-Suen and 3 kutānus of the packer,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 72 ku-ta-nu ša en-na-sú-in a-na É.GAL-lim e-ru-bu
target: in total 72 kutānus of Enna-Suen, entered the palace.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí TÚG.ḪI-tí-šu 49 ku-ta-ni a-na im-dí-lim lá-qé-pì-im ù ṣí-lu-uš-da-ga-an a-na ša ki-ma i-ku-pì-a áp-qí-id
target: The remainder of his textiles, 49 kutānus, I entrusted to Imdī-ilum, Lā-qēpum, and Ṣilluš-Dagan for my representatives and Ikūn-pīya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ḫa-ar-kà SÍG il₅-qé
target: Your servant took the wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-kà li-dí-nam
target: Let him give me the silver under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma a-li-a-ma
target: To Alāhum, speak: thus (says) Aliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i pá-ni-tí áš-pu-ra-kum um-ma a-na-ku-ma
target: I wrote to you previously, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-na ILLAT pu-šu-ki-in LUGAL-sú-in na-dí
target: 13.3333 minas of silver in the caravan of Pūšu-kēn, Šar-Suen deposited.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8.33333 ma-na 4.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ILLAT pu-šu-ki-in a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku il₅-qé
target: 8.3333 minas 4.5 shekels of silver of the caravan of Pūšu-kēn, Aššur-taklāku took.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN a-na kà-ší-im
target: 1 shekel for the official.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam-ma
target: and then let your message come to me

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá-tal-kam
target: so I may depart

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 ma-na ù 2 ma-na SIG₅-x-x i-ra-dí
target: He will bring 1 mina or 2 minas of good silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta-ta me-ra-šu iš-tí a-mur-ša-ra-sà a-mì-šam i-ta-al-kam
target: His son Atata has come there with Amur-šarrassa.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na É wa-áb-ri i-na ḫu-ru-ma
target: 1 shekel of silver for the inn in Hurama.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 4 ma-na 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na šu-a-šur a-na 1.3333300000000001 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ša-pár-tim ti-dí-i
target: As for the tablet of 4 minas 12 shekels of silver, you know (it was given) to Šu-Aššur for 1.3333 minas 3 shekels of silver as a pledge.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na tí-mì-il₅-ki-a a-na É wa-áb-ri
target: 1 shekel of silver in Timelkiya for the inn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na kà-né-eš áb-ri-ma
target: In Kanesh I passed (time).

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ku-ul
target: I consumed 10 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù wa-aḫ-šu-ša-na a-dí kà-né-eš da-tum 1.3333300000000001 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ik-šu-dí
target: From Wahšušana to Kanesh, the road-tax reached 1.3333 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: bē-lu-a a-tù-nu
target: You are my lords.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na ḫa-ḫi-im a-na É wa-áb-ri
target: 2 shekels of silver in Hahhum for the inn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-na bu-ru-lim a-na É wa-áb-ri
target: 1 shekel of silver in Burullum for the inn.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù kà-né-eš a-di a-lim(ki) a-na ú-ku-ul-tí-a ag-mu-ur
target: 10 shekels of silver from Kanesh to the City I spent for my food.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma a-bu-šalim li-li-kam
target: They said: 'Abu-šalim must come.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ší-ip-ri ša a-lim(ki) ù kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš ṣa-ḫe-er-GAL qí-bi-ma
target: To the envoys of the City and the plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony, speak:

source: translate Akkadian to English: be-lí a-ta a-ṣé-er ṭup-pí-im ša i-ṭí-áb-ší-na-tí ša iš-tí-kà i-ba-ší-ú
target: My dear lord, in addition to the tablet of Iṭī-abšināti that is with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù ṭup-pu-um ša ḫu-bu-ul i-ṭí-ib-ší-na-tí-ma ša 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR
target: I hold the tablet of the debt of Iṭī-abšināti of 3 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša iš-tù li-mì-im ib-ni-(d)IM i ša-tim 0.5 ma-na.TA ú-ša-qú-lu a-na-ku ú-kà-al
target: Of which he will pay 0.5 mina per year from the eponymy of Ibni-Adad.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-bu-šalim lá-šu be-el-šu li-li-kam
target: If Abu-šalim is not (here), his master must come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 30 li-me URUDU ša nam-e-dim ša e-kál-lim ḫa-bu-lu
target: Regarding the 30,000 minas of copper that they owe to the palace,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ší-na-lam ú-ṣa-li-im
target: he has angered Ušinalam.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma 16 li-me 40 ma-na URUDU ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A a-bu-šalim ÌR a-na ú-ší-na-lam ḫa-bu-ul
target: They said: 'The slave Abu-šalim owes 16,040 minas of copper, the price of wool, to Ušinalam.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-na na-áp-šatí-ni ù KÙ.BABBAR-áp x x a-bu-šalim ni-ša-ḫu-ut
target: Here we fear for our lives and the silver of Abu-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-tù-nu-ma a-li-ik-ma ú-ší-na-lam tù-ṭá-áb
target: And you said: 'Go and satisfy Ušinalam!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ip-ru ša a-lim ku-lu-šu-nu-ma ù kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš ṣa-ḫe-er GAL ṭup-pí iš-ta-me-ú-ma
target: All of the envoys of the City and the plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony heard the tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam i-na ma-ṭá KÙ.BABBAR MAN-a-šur e-pu-lu
target: Here they satisfied Puzur-Aššur for the deficit of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša SIG₅-pì-a-šur
target: The silver belongs to Damqia-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a-dí ša-ḫu-tí-a e-pu-lu
target: They will pay the silver until my clearing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi₄-ma um-ma SIG₅-pí-a-šur ù MAN-a-šur
target: To Alāhum, speak: thus (says) Damqia-Aššur and Puzur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR šu-mì ṭá-ḫu
target: The silver is added to my name.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a qá-tí ili₅-ba-ni ḫu-ra-ṣa-num DUB.SAR ša kà-ri-im bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim
target: To Ilī-bāni, the scribe of the Burušhaddum colony

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ki-ma tal-qé-ú ir-ta-kà a-šar
target: Where your message (indicates) when you have received the silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šùr-ma-lik ù ša-lim-a-šur a-na ša-lim-a-šur qí-bi-ma
target: From Aššur-malik and Šalim-Aššur to Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša kà-ri-im bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim ṣa-ḫe-er GAL ù ṭup-pá-am ša ú-ší-na-lam
target: The son of Ibaya, the scribe of the Burušhaddum colony, and the servant of Ušinalam brought a tablet of the plenary assembly of the Burušhaddum colony and a tablet of Ušinalam

source: translate Akkadian to English: DUB.SAR ša kà-ri-im bu-ru-uš-ḫa-dim DUMU i-ba-a ù ṣú-ḫa-ru-um ša ú-ší-na-lam
target: The son of Ibaya, the scribe of the Burušhaddum colony, and the servant of Ušinalam brought a tablet of the plenary assembly of the Burušhaddum colony and a tablet of Ušinalam

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na kà-ri-im kà-ni-iš ṣa-ḫe-er GAL a-šu-mì a-bu-šalim ÌR ub-lu-nim-ma
target: to the plenary assembly of the Kanesh colony concerning the slave Abu-šalim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ni a-ta
target: You are our brother

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR x wa-li-a kà-ṣa-ru-um ša a-šur-be-el-ša-du-i
target: so that Waliya, the packer of Aššur-bēl-šadu'ē, (pays) the silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lim(ki) ir-de₈-šu-nu-ma
target: he led them to the City assembly, and

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.2.KAM-ma šu-be-lúm i pá-ni a-šur-ša-du-e i-li-kam-ma
target: Šu-Bēlum came two months before Aššur-šadue.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù né-nu a-wa-tám nu-ta-er-ma
target: then we ourselves rebuffed the matter and

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá-ma ṭup-pí-kà ub-lá-ni
target: and before he brought your letter

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma né-nu-ma a-wa-tù-šu-nu gám-ra
target: we said: "Their case is closed."

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-be-lúm šu-ku-ba-am DUMU a-šur-be-el-a-wa-tim ù a-ḫi-šu iṣ-ba-at-ma
target: Šu-Bēlum seized Šu-Kūbum son of Aššur-bēl-awātim and his brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ša ni-iš a-lim(ki) i-tù-a-ar
target: He is reopening a matter which has been sworn by the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lúm(ki) dí-nam i-dí-in-ma
target: The City assembly passed a verdict, and

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-tur₄-DINGIR ù ku-a-tí a-na šu-be-lim ú-kà-an
target: He will confirm to Šu-Bēlum regarding Itūr-ilī and you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-be-lúm ù DUMU.MÍ i-sú-rik₁₃ a-na šu-ku-bi-im ù a-ḫi-šu lá i-tù-ru
target: Šu-Bēlum and Issu-arik's daughter must not raise claim against Šu-Kūbum and his brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ku-bu-um a-na kà-ni-iš i-lá-ak-ma
target: Šu-Kūbum will go to Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma lu-qú-tám ip-qí-da-ku-nu-tí-ni
target: that he entrusted the merchandise to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: SAG ITU.1.KAM be-el-tí-É.GAL-lim
target: Beginning of the month Bēlat-ekallim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-um e-lá-lí DUMU i-ku-nim
target: eponymy of Elāli, son of Ikūnum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša a-na gám-ra-tim a-na ša ni-iš a-lim(ki) i-tù-ra-ku-ni
target: Because he raised claim against you for the final settlement that had been sworn by the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum ṭup-pí-kà ší-bi-kà da-a-a-ni-kà
