target: If he asks for more there,

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-ša-zi-za-ku-nu-tí-ma ú ra-ki-sà-šu-ma
target: then let him appoint a stand-in for you and bind him over.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam ša li-bi₄-ni pá-zu-ur-tù-šu ú 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: Here he has been paid his smuggled goods and 1 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-bu-ú
target: plus 0.3333 mina 1 shekel of silver from what we had available.

source: translate Akkadian to English: la-a aq-bi₄-a-ku-um um-ma a-na-ku-ma 2 ú-me-e la ta-sà-ḫu-ra-am
target: Have I not told you as follows: "Do not delay by two days"?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam šu-ma a-li-kum kà-li-i
target: If the traveling party is detained there,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ku-la a-ḫu-ú šu-ku-tim
target: Seal of Kula brother of Šukkutum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB PUZUR₄-tí-a-am-tim DUMU IŠTAR-pá-li-il₅
target: Seal of Puzur-Ti'amtum son of Ištar-pālil.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-um-a-šur DUMU kà-ri-a
target: Seal of Ennam-Aššur son of Karria.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-na-sú-in DUMU i-dí-a-bi-im
target: Seal of Enna-Suen son of Iddin-abum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-nu-li a-ḫi-šu
target: Seal of Anuli his brother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: sà-ḫi-ar-tí na-áp-ra-is ú ma-áš-ki ša-pá-tí-a la té-zi-ba-am
target: You did not leave me my small goods, a chisel and my woollen fleeces.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na ma-ṣa-ra-tí-im dí-na-ma
target: Give 3 shekels of silver to the guards.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ku-ú ṭù-ur-da-ni-im
target: Send Uku to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lu da-at a-bu-a lu gám-ru-um ša a-na-kam
target: 8 shekels of silver was either Abuwa's fees or expenses here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: PUZUR₄-a-šur DUMU i-ku-pí-a en-um-a-šur DUMU i-dí-sú-en₆ ù a-ḫu-šu i-dí-IŠTAR DUMU aḫ-ša-lim IŠTAR-ba-ni ma-ṣí-ì-lí en-nam-a-šur DUMU a-šur-dan šu-ma-a-bi₄-a ša ki-ma DUMU-e ku-ni-lim
target: Puzur-Aššur, son of Ikūn-pīya, Ennam-Aššur, son of Iddin-Suen, and his brother, Iddin-Ištar, son of Ah-šalim, Ištar-bāni, Maṣi-ilī, Ennam-Aššur, son of Aššur-dān, Šumi-abiya - representing the sons of Kūn-ilum -

source: translate Akkadian to English: i pu-ùḫ-ri-šu-nu gám-ram ša bi-ki-tí-šu-nu ù ku-sí-im ša IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí
target: collectively paid the expenses of bewailing them and of Ištar-lamassī's chair

source: translate Akkadian to English: i KÙ.BABBAR ša i É DAM e-lá-ma ib-ší-ú ig-mu-ru
target: from the silver that was in the house of Elamma's wife.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pì-a-ma a-na ib-ni-lí be-kà-a ú en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya to Ibnī-ilī, Bekaya and Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 1 ma-na 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú 9 GÍN a-ḫa-ma ša-áp-ra-tim e-zi-ba-kum
target: I left surety worth 1 mina 7 shekels of silver plus 9 shekels with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi₄-ma 1.66666 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ḫa-bu-lá-kum
target: Specifically to Ennam-Aššur: I owe you 1.6666 mina 6 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 1.3333300000000001 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR tal-qé
target: In all you have received 1 mina 24 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 2 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà
target: The rest of your silver is 22 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ AN.NA e-zi-ba-kum
target: I left 1 talent of tin with you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫa-bu-lá-ku-ni iš-tí a-šur-ba-ni ú-šé-ba-lá-kum
target: 2.5 minas of silver that I owe you I shall send with Aššur-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-lá-kam-ma a-ṣa-ba-sú
target: When he comes, I shall seize him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma na-áš-pé-er-tum iš-tù a-lim ú-ub-lu-nim
target: Ask whether they have brought a missive from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3.5 ma-na 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR qá-sú ša ku-ni-lim
target: 3 minas 37 shekels of silver, the share of Kūnilum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá na-áš-pè-er-tí-kà i-ri-šu-um i-na dur₄-ḫu-mì-it u₄-ma-am ú-ra-am a-da-gal
target: In accordance with your missive I expect Erišum in Durhumit today or tomorrow.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.5 ma-na-… GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ḩa-ma
target: 4.5 minas [x] shekels separately;

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ší-mu-um lá ša-im
target: If no purchase has been made,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-am ša ba-lá-ṭí-a lu (TÚG)tí-sà-pì ša ḫa-ḫi-im lu sà-áp-tí-ni-ma ša tal-ḫa-at
target: then make a purchase for my profit, either tisāpu-textiles of Hahhum or saptinnu-textiles of Talhat.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu i ša-ḫa-at en-um-a-šur i-zi-za-ma
target: My dear brothers, assist Ennam-Aššur in this.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-ma-nim kà-ni-kà-ma iš-tí a-šur-ba-ni šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: Buy for me, seal it and send it to me with Aššur-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣí-ba-at 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR
target: 12 shekels of silver, the interest on 2 minas of silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i li-bi tù-um-li-a-i-im
target: is owed by the man from Tumliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ší-im 9 ku-ta-ni ù 2 šu-ru-tim
target: x minas of silver, the price of 9 kutānu-textiles and 2 dark textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma bu-zu-ma a-na e-me-ni
target: From Buzu to Emeni:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-lá wa-ta-ar
target: The balance was not in excess.

source: translate Akkadian to English: áš-qöl
target: I have paid it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-ku-kà i-na KÙ.BABBAR a-ni-im ša 3 ša-na-at ni-ba-kam
target: Under your seal we shall dispatch it out of this silver from the last three years.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na lá-ma-sà-tim ú ša-lim-ma qí-bi-ma um-ma um-mì-iš-ḩa-ra-ma
target: To Lamassutum and Šalimma, thus says Ummī-Išhara:

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ma-sí-ḩa-ma
target: The silver is refined

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí-i na-áš-pé-er-tim ša ta-áš-pu-ri-ni um-ma a-tí-ma mì-šu-um ma-ma-an lá i-ṩa-ra-dam
target: As for the letter you sent me, in which you wrote: 'Why does he not send someone to me?'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-pá-ar-šu i-li-kam-ma
target: A messenger of his did arrive,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku aṭ-ru-ud
target: but it was me who sent him away.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wi-lúm a-wa-tim i-ta-aḩ-dar
target: The gentleman has become very annoyed by the matter.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu aq-bi-šu-ma
target: I talked to him several times,

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-bu-šu i-ta-na-aṣ-ra-áp
target: but every time he bursts out.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša a-ša-pá-ru-ší-ni-BA i-ṣé-er na-áš-pé-ra-tí-a iš-té-et ú ší-ta ša i-li-kà-ší-ni
target: Could what I write her now really surpass the messages that already reached her several times?

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-ḩa-tí a-tí a-wa-tim sà-ra-tim lá ta-áš-ta-na-pá-ri-im
target: If you are my sister, do not keep writing me things that are not true.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-dí ma-lá ú ší-ni-šu na-áš-pé-er-tí i-li-ik-ší-im-ma
target: Several letters of mine went to her,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-lá-kam lá ta-mu-a
target: but she refused to come here!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na KÙ.BABBAR mì-ma lá ta-ša-pá-ri-šu-um
target: And certainly do not write him for silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma iš-tù a-lá-kam lá ta-mu-ú lá ta-tù-ri-ma lá ta-qá-bi-im
target: and said: 'Since she refuses to come, you must not again speak to me!'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ul i-na ba-áb-tí-a KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN lá i-ba-ší
target: Are there no ten shekels of silver available from my outstanding claims?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú šu-ma i-na ba-áb-tí-a lá-šu KÙ.BABBAR 10 GÍN ma-lá gám-ri
target: And if they are not, let her ask ten shekels of silver for her expenses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ḩa-nu-nu šu-IŠTAR ù a-šur-ma-lik a-wa-tí-ší-na ag-mu-ur-ma
target: I have concluded their matter with Hanunu, Šu-Ištar and Aššur-malik as witnesses.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na DUMU ḩa-šu-ú-ma-an šu-uq-lá-ma
target: Pay to Haššu-uman's son.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šu-mì KÙ.BABBAR aq-bi-šu-ma
target: I talked to him because of the silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma ma-lá-ma-a KÙ.BABBAR 0.5 ma-na gám-ri-ša gi₅-mì-lam₅ i-ṣé-er um-mì-ša ú-ul a-ḩi-ša lá-áš-ku-un
target: he said: 'Should I really oblige her mother or her brothers for no less than half a mina of silver for her expenses?'

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ṭúp-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-šu ú ku-nu-uk um-mì-šu ù a-ḩi-šu ḩi-ir-ma-ma
target: and then certify a tablet with his seal and the seals of his mother and brother

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-dí ṭúp-pì ša a-bi₄-ni x x i a-na KÙ.BABBAR a-pu-ul-šu-ma
target: and I reimbursed him for the tablets of our father.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-bu-ma
target: and he has been paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN lá i-ru-qí-ni-ma
target: so that not a single shekel of silver will elude me

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša lá-ma-sú-tum a-na-na ù áb-ša-lim a-na ḩa-šu-ú-ma-an i-ḩi-ib-lá-ni-ma
target: For the 1 mina of silver for which Lamassutum, Anna-anna and Ab-šalim have become indebted to Haššu-uman,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭúp-pì ša a-bi₄-ni a-na ša-pá-ar-tim i-dí-a-šu-ni
target: and for which they have given him tablets belonging to our father as security.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma a-na en-na-sú-in ú a-lá-ḩi-im qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Šu-Bēlum to Enna-Suen and Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḩu-a a-tù-nu be-lu-a a-tù-nu
target: My dear brothers and lords,

source: translate Akkadian to English: iḩ-da-ma ṭúp-pá-am da-na-am le-qé-a-nim
target: take care and get hold of a strong tablet.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ig-ri-šu-nu dí-na-šu-nu-tí
target: Give them their wages, 10 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11 TÚG qá-du-um ša ṣú-ḩa-ri-im ú ší-na ma-áš-ku-nu
target: Zuba and Adad-bāni, the smugglers, bring you 11 textiles, including those belonging to the servant, and two covers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-we-lá-tim ú ṭúp-pì ša a-bi₄-ni ú-šé-ṣí-a-ni-ma
target: stating that I have redeemed the women and our father's tablets,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR a ḩu-bu-ul a-we-lá-tim a-na-ku i-na ra-mì-ni-a áš-qú-lu
target: and that I have personally out of my own funds paid silver to cover the debt of the women.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum TÚG.ḩI.A ma-lá ta-le-e-a-ni dí-na-šu-nu
target: Urgent, as for the textiles, sell them as well as you can.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-ni-in ú šé-na-tim
target: Buy shoes for 1 shekel of silver and some shoes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša sí-ni-iš-tim ša-ma-ma šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: Send them for women.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḩu-ú-a a-tù-nu lu-lu TÚG.ḩI.A a-ḩi-ú-tim uš-té-né-ra-áb
target: My dear brothers, Lulu keeps having textiles belonging to strangers brought in.

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG.ḩI.A lu 50 lu lu-šé-tí-qám
target: so he may send 50 textiles here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣú-ḩa-ru-um lá i-sà-ḩa-ur ṭù-ur-da-ni
target: the servant must not be delayed - send him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-tù-nu iš-tí-šu nam-gi₅-ra-ma
target: so you must reach an agreement with him

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí ṣú-ḩa-ri-im ṣú-ḩa-ar-šu le-tí-qám-ma
target: that his servant travels here with the servant

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma a-na šu-be-lim ù en-na-sú-in-ma
target: and said to Šu-Bēlum and Enna-Suen:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḩa-ma 2 ma-na URUDU ší-kam a-na šé-né-en šu-ḩu-pá-tim SIG₅-tim a-dí-šu-um
target: Further, I gave him 2 minas of siktum-copper for fine shoes and boots.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 (TÚG)a-bar-ni-a-am 1 (TÚG)bu-ra-a-am a-na ku-ku-zi DUMU sà-aḩri-ì-lí ša ša-lá-tù-a-ar a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-dí-in
target: I gave 1 Abarnian textile, 1 burā'u-textile to Kukuzi son of Sahri-ilī from Šalatuwar for purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÚ ù 2 GÚ a-na ḩu-bu-ul a-bi₄-ku-nu i-na na-ru-qí-a ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: I have paid some 1 or 2 talents of silver for your father's debt out of my joint-stock capital.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ba-a-nim ṭúp-pè-e ša ḩu-bu-ul a-bi₄-ku-nu am-ra-ma
target: Come on, look at the tablets concerning your father's debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-pì šu-uq-lá-nim
target: Pay me my silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša eq-lim a-na-ku pá-ḩu-ra-am qá-bi₄-a-ku
target: I have personally promised to collect the silver that is in Anatolia.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma ke-na al-qé
target: šu-Bēlum answered: "Yes, I took it."

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma-ba i li-bi₄ a-bi₄-ni ta-áb-tù-ra-am ša-al-ma-am i-na a-lim(ki) lá-qá-am lá ta-mu-a
target: If indeed you can establish anything as owed by our father, will you refuse to take it complete in the City?

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu-um iš-tí DUMU da-da KÙ.BABBAR i-na ḩa-ḩi-im tal-qé
target: Why have you taken silver from Dada's son in Hahhum?

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-nu-ma ṭúp-pu me-eḩ-ru ša a-bi₄-ni i-na ku-nu-uk šu-(d)EN.LÍL a-mur-IŠTAR ù šu-a-nim kà-an-ku-ma
target: They said: "Our father's tablets and copies were sealed with the seals of Šu-Illil, Amur-Ištar and Šu-Anum."

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na a-lim(ki) i-ba-ší-ú
target: They are in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma al-qé a-dá-gal-šu
target: "I shall look whether I took any,

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá i-ba-ší
target: but there is nothing."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú en-na-sú-in iš-al-ma um-ma šu-ut-ma
target: So he asked Enna-Suen, saying:

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu-um i tí-me-el-ki-a KÙ.BABBAR tal-qé
target: "Why have you taken silver in Timel-kiya?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bu-tí-ni IGI GÍR ša a-šùr ni-dí-in
target: We gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 ku-ta-ni ša qá-tim
target: 4 kutānu-textiles of ordinary quality.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na AN.NA
target: 3 minas of tin

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 (TÚG)tí-sà-bi ša na-aḩri-a
target: 3 tēsabu-textiles from Nahria.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 (TÚG)ni-ib-ra-ru ša za-al-pá
target: 5 nibrāru-textiles from Zalpa

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-ku-za IGI lá-li IGI šu-ku-bi₄-im IGI
target: Witnessed by Akuza, by Lalum, by šu-Kūbum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-wi-li a-ni-ú-tim
target: Witnessed by these men.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim tám-kà-ru-um a-na šu-IŠTAR …
target: all this the merchant gave to Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ku-ra IGI a-šur-(d)UTU-ši
target: Witnessed by Kura, by Aššur-šamšī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10.66666 GÍN a-šùr-ma-lik i-lá-qé
target: 10.6666 shekels Aššur-mālik will take

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḩa-ma 2 ší-it-ru 4.5 TÚG wa-dí-ú-tum ša a-na-na a-na šu-IŠTAR a-na ší-a-ma-tim ta-dí-in
target: Further, 2 undergarments, 4.5 textiles belonging to Anna-anna were given to Šu-Ištar for purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-díd-a-bu-um-ma a-na en-um-a-šur ù a-lá-hi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Iddin-abum to Ennam-Aššur and Alāhum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam 3 GÚ 55 ma-na URUDU ṣa-lá-ma-am qá-at-ku-nu É kà-ri-im al-qé
target: Here I have taken 3 talents 55 minas of black copper on your account in the colony office.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šuma lá ki-am ma-lá um-me-a-ni ú-ra-ki-sú-ni-ni li-ba-ak-nu i-ma-ra-aṣ
target: If this does not happen, you will be sorry about everything the investors have contracted with me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na šu-a-šùr ù du-ma-na qí-bí-ma um-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma
target: To Šu-Aššur and Dumana say, thus Ikūn-pīya:

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí sà-ah-ra-ku KÙ.BABBAR li-im-qú-tá-am
target: The silver must arrive with me while I am staying here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-hi a-ta i-na ša-ha-at du-ma-na i-zi-iz-ma
target: Please, my brother, assist Dumana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-hi-id-ma i-na ší-mì-šu-nu KÙ.BABBAR SIG₅ DIRI e-pu-uš
target: and take care to get as payment for them silver of extra good quality.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-hu-a a-tù-nu a-na URUDU ša um-me-an a-bi-ku-nu a-pu-lu a-ma-kam ih-da-ma um-me-a-ni ṭá-i-ba-ma i-a-tí ša-hi-ṭá
target: My dear brothers, take care to satisfy the investors there for the copper that I have balanced with the investors of your father, and withdraw mine.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-hi a-ta ší-im ší-it-re ša ik-ri-bi iš-tí a-li-ki-im pá-ni-ma šé-bi-lam
target: Please, my brother, send me the price that the scarfs of the temple-fund yield with the first caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR x a-šur-DU₁₀ ša-bu
target: With that silver Aššur-ṭāb has been satisfied.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku a-šur-DU₁₀ i-šu-ú
target: 0.3333 mina of refined silver Aššur-taklāku owed to Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 (TÚG)tí-sà-bu ša a-al-DU₁₀ x ni-ib-ra-ru SIG₅ x ší-it-ru
target: 2 textiles of Āl-ṭāb [x] of good quality, [x] scarfs.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 (TÚG)ší-it-ru-um ša ik-ri-bi ša sú-in ú (d)UTU
target: One of which belongs to temple-funds of (the gods) Suen and Šamaš.

source: translate Akkadian to English: du-ma-na na-áš-a-ku-um
target: Dumana is bringing you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na.TA i-na ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: He will pay 0.6666 mina per year.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ì-lí-áš-ra-ni IGI DUMU du-ur-a-šur
target: In the presence of Ilī-ašranni son of Tūr-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša hu-bu-ul a-šur-ta-ak-lá-ku ša e-li-a-ni sá-ar
target: The tablet recording a debt of 0.3333 mina of silver owed by Aššur-taklāku which turns up is invalid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 2 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ṣé-er en-na-nim DUMU a-zu-a e-la-ma i-šu
target: That Ennānum, son of Azua, owes 2 minas of refined silver to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI e-na-a-nim IGI la-qé-pì-im
target: In the presence of En(n)ānum, of Lā-qēpum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šuma lá iš-qúl 1.5 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám a-na 1 ma-na-im i ITU.1.KAM ú-ṣa-áb
target: if he does not pay he will add an interest of 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ša ke-na-tim li-mu-um ša qá-tí a-šùr-SIG₅ DUMU a-bar-sí-sí-im
target: Month III, eponymy of the successor of Aššur-damiq, son of Abarsisum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ha-muš-tum ša a-šur-mì-tí DUMU a-ta-a
target: Week eponymy of Aššur-imittī, son of Atāya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ṣí-ip-um li-mu-um PUZUR₄-(d)MU
target: Month VII, eponymy of Puzur-Nirah.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šuma lá uk-ta-in-šu-nu 0.33333 ma-na 5 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am a-na e-lá-ma a-šùr-la-ma-sí i-ša-qal
target: If he does not confirm their liability Aššur-lamassī will pay to Elamma 25 shekels of silver apiece.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 11 (TÚG)ku-ta-ni a-mur-IŠTAR ù a-la-hi-im a-na e-la-ma a-šùr-la-ma-sí a-na ITU.5.KAM ú-kà-an
target: For 11 textiles Aššur-lamassī will confirm to Elamma (the liability of) Āmur-Ištar and Ali-ahum within 5 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 18 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša en-um-a-šur i li-bi a-šur-ba-ni
target: 18 shekels of silver belonging to Ennam-Aššur is owed by Aššur-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-bu-sa-lim DUMU i-dí-ìr-ra
target: In the presence of Abu-šalim son of Iddin-Erra.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-dí-a-šùr DUMU pu-ur-sí-sí-im
target: In the presence of Iddin-Aššur, son of Bursa / isum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša hi-na-a e-lá-ma a-na i-dí-sú-en₆ ú-šé-bi₄-il₅
target: 1 mina of silver belonging to hinnāya Elamma dispatched to Iddin-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13.5 ma-na URUDU ší-ku-um ša en-um-a-šur
target: 13 ½ minas of copper belonging to Ennam-Aššur

source: translate Akkadian to English: i li-bi₄ e-nu-re-ṣí-im
target: is owed by Ennam-rēṣum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṣé-eh-ri-lí ú-bi₄-il₅
target: Ṣeher-ilī brought it away.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 1 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṭup-pá-am ha-ar-ma-am ša hu-bu-ul e-nu-re-ṣí-im a-na i-ku-pí-a e-zi-ib
target: Concerning 1 mina 5 shekels of silver he has left a certified tablet about the debt of Ennam-rēṣum to Ikūn-pīya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI na-ni-a IGI a-šur-DU₁₀
target: Witnessed by Naniya, by Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 TÚG.HI.A ša li-wi-tim IGI a-šùr-SIPA a-dí-šu-um
target: 7 textiles for wrapping I gave him in the presence of Aššur-rē'ī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI DU₁₀-a-šur IGI šu-IŠTAR
target: In the presence of Ṭāb-Aššur, of Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šuma lá iš-qú-lu 1.5 GÍN.TA i ITU.KAM-im ú-ṣú-bu
target: If they do not pay they will add (an interest of) 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 37 ku-ta-ni 34 (TÚG)šu-ru-tum a-na la-qé-pí-im áp-qí-id
target: 37 textiles (and) 34 dark textiles I entrusted to Lā-qēpum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-dí-(d)IŠKUR IGI i-dí-a-šur DUMU sú-e-ta-ta
target: In the presence of Iddin-Adad and of Iddin-Aššur, son of Suettata.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ì-lí-a i bu-ul-ṭí-šu i qá-tí-šu il₅-qé
target: From that silver Iliya, when he was still alive, took 7 shekels from his share.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ha-muš-tim ša a-šùr-i-dí ù šu-IŠTAR
target: From the week of Aššur-idī and Šu-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-um (d)IŠKUR-ba-ni
target: Eponymy year of Adad-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 4 ha-am-ša-tim i-ša-qú-lu
target: They will pay within 4 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na KÙ.BABBAR-áp IŠTAR-lá-ma-sí ša a DUMU-e-ša ta-dí-nu-ma
target: From the silver of Ištar-lamassī that she gave to her sons,

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR i-na É e-lá-ma a-na-áb-šé-em ib-šé-ú
target: and which silver rested as safe deposit in Elamma's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-na ma-na-im ša a-mur-(d)UTU ba-lúm du-na-e i-ta-ki-is
target: 0.6666 mina of refined silver - he cut it off with the (1-)mina weight of Amur-Šamaš, without surcharge.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ṣé-er ir-ma-a-šùr i-ri-šá-im ù il₅-me-ta-ku ú-ṣur-ša-a-šùr i-šu
target: Ir'am-Aššur, Irišum and Ilī-wedāku owe to Uṣur-ša-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 (TÚG)ku-ta-num a-na am-tí-kà i-nu-mì a-na a-lá-ni ta-li-ku
target: 1 textile for your maid when you went to the villages.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x x lá ta-dí-in [...] [...]
target: You have not sold.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù DUMU-ú ku-ni-lim me-tù
target: After the sons of Kūn-ilum had died,

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu a-na bi-ki-tí-šu-nu lu a-ku-sí-im ša um-mì-šu-nu ṭá-bu-im a-hu-ni e-ru-bu-ni-ma
target: (when) our brothers arrived for bewailing them and for removing the chair of their mother.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pu-um i-ṣé-er ili₅-ba-ni DUMU i-a-a
target: 3 shekels of refined silver owed by Ilī-bāni son of Yaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR KI a-wi-il₅-tim
target: 1.5 shekels of silver with the lady.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 4.16666 GÍN 7 0.5 ŠE KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí-šu-ma
target: Further, 4.1666 shekels 7.5 grains of silver owed by him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na URUDU iš-tí a-mur-a-šùr
target: 2 minas of copper with Amur-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na 5 GÍN URUDU iš-tí a-bi-a
target: 3 minas 5 shekels of copper with Abi-ya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.16666 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tí a-mur-IŠTAR
target: 0.16666 shekels of silver with Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma a-na lá-qé-ep ù a-na-na qí-bi-ma
target: From Ennam-Aššur to Lā-qēp and Anna-anna, say:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na LÁ 0.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR lu a-bi₄-ki-tí-šu-nu lu a-na ku-sí-im ša um-mì-šu-nu
target: 19.5 shekels of silver both for bewailing them and for the chair of their mother,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a šu-mì i-lí-a 7.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a hu-bu-li-šu i-ší-qí-il₅
target: and 7.5 shekels of silver to the Anatolian, because of Iliya for his debt, were paid.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR a-ṣé-er a-ha-tí-šu-nu DUMU.MÍ ku-ni-lim a-na a-lim(ki) i-lá-ak
target: The rest of the silver was sent to address of their sister, the daughter of Kūn-ilum, to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ma-bi-a ša ki-ma DUMU-e ku-ni-lim ú-šé-bi₄-lu
target: by son of Aššur-dān and Šumi-abiya, the representatives of Kūn-ilum's sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum iḫ-da-ma ṣú-ḫa-ri-a ṭù-ur-da-nim
target: Urgent, take care to send me my servants.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta i-na a-lá-ki-a li-bi lá i-ma-ra-ṣa-kum
target: My dear brother, so that I do not get angry at you when I arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-dí a-lá-kà-ni ku-nu-ku-kà-ma iš-tí-ša li-ib-ší-ú
target: And let them remain with her under your seal until I arrive.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-lá-tum lá i-ba-ší
target: There must be no misconduct.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša ṣú-ḫa-ru-a a-dí u₄-mì-im a-nim a-ma-kam wa-áš-bu-ni
target: Why have my servants stayed there until this day?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na-ku a šu-mì-šu-nu a-na-kam sà-aḫ-ra-ku-ni
target: so that I am delayed here because of them?

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR lu ša-li-iṭ-ma
target: So that the silver is at hand

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tí-ša-ma li-bi-ší
target: and let it be with her.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ba-ba-tí-a iḫ-da-ma
target: Also, take care with the silver from my outstanding claims.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí a-lá-ki-a lu ú-ṭá-tám lu e-ṣí ša nu-a-e pá-ḫi-ra
target: Collect both grain and firewood from the Anatolians before I come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ša-me-ma en-na-sú-in iš-tù a-lim(ki) e-li-am
target: I hear that Enna-Suen has come up from the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na x x-ri a-lim(ki) šup-ra-nim-ma lá-tal-kam
target: Write me about the City so I can come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.33333 ma-na 2.5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR dan-a-šur ub-lam
target: 4.33333 minas 2.5 shekels of silver Dān-Aššur brought.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ma i-tur₄-DINGIR e-ki-ip-ma ḫa-ra-šu a-na a-lim(ki) i-ta-lá-ak
target: Also, if Itūr-ilī is about to go or has already gone to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 11 GÍN a-na ni-is-ḫa-tim ni-dín
target: We gave 11 shekels as excise.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333300000000001 GÍN té-ṣú-be né-pu-ul
target: We paid 1.33333 shekel as addition.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4.33333 GÍN ša-du-a-tám a-na dan-a-šur ni-dín
target: We gave 4.33333 shekels as transport fee to Dān-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ke-na-ma e-li-am za-ku-sà
target: If he has really come up,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na mì-ma tí-ir-tí-a iš-tí ba-tí-qí-im šup-ra-nim-ma
target: send me a report concerning all my merchandise ordered with an express caravan

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà 4 ma-na 5.83334 GÍN
target: The remainder of your silver is 4 minas 5.83334 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-ni-nu-um ub-lam
target: 17 minas and 4 shekels of silver Anīnum brought here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-li-a-ma a-šur-re-ṣí en-nam-a-šur ù da-dí-a a-na e-lá-ma qí-bí₄-ma
target: Thus Iliya, Aššur-rēṣī, Ennam-Aššur, and Dadiya, say to Elamma:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 0.66666 ma-na 2.5 GÍN a-na ni-is-ḫa-tim ni-dín
target: Thereof we paid 0.66666 minas 2.5 shekels as excise.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà 16.33333 ma-na LÁ 0.5 GÍN
target: There remain of your silver 16.33333 minas minus 0.5 shekel.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN KÙ.BABBAR-pì-kà 20.33333 ma-na 5.5 GÍN
target: The total of your silver amounts to 20.33333 minas 5.5 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ku-ta-nu 0.66666 ma-na 6.5 GÍN it-bu-lu
target: 10 kutānu-textiles cost 0.66666 mina 6.5 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR be-ú-lá-at ma-ṣi-ì-lí
target: 0.5 mina of silver, the working capital of Maṣi-ilī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 7 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i ma-sá-im im-ṭí
target: 0.33333 mina 7 shekels of silver loss due to washing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 šu-ru-tum ša li-wi-tim 0.33333 ma-na 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR-šu-nu
target: 8 dark textiles for wrapping, their price in silver 0.33333 mina 8 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ANŠE.ḪI.A ṣa-lá-mu 0.66666 ma-na LÁ 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR-šu-nu
target: 2 black donkeys, their price in silver 0.66666 mina minus 4 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 20 ma-na AN.NA-ak qá-tim
target: 20 minas tin for expenses

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN.TA 1.3333300000000001 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR
target: at a rate of 15 shekels : 1 makes 1.33333 mina of silver

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 GÍN lu-bu-šu
target: 2 shekels his clothing allowance.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ 20 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ku
target: 4 talents 20 minas of sealed tin,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15.33333 GÍN 15 ŠE.TA KÙ.BABBAR-áp-šu 17.83333 ma-na 2 GÍN
target: at a rate of 15.33333 shekels 15 grains : 1 the silver for it was 17.83333 minas 2 shekels.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: 1 shekel of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB dan-a-a DUMU a-ta-a
target: Seal of Dannaya, son of Ataya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šur ù a-lá-ḫi-im me-er-e šál-ma-a-šur
target: to Ennam-Aššur and Al-ahum, sons of Šalim-Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB la-qé-pì-im DUMU a-šur-ma-lik
target: Seal of Lā-qēpum, son of Aššur-mālik.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.66666 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR im-dí-DINGIR il₅-qé
target: Imdī-ilum received 1.66666 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB pu-šu-ke-en₆ DUMU sú-e-a
target: Seal of Pūšu-kēn son of Sueyya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB (d)MAR.TU-ba-ni DUMU ma-na-na
target: Seal of Amurrum-bāni son of Manana.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dì-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma um-me-a-nu i-ku-pì-IŠTAR ú-la me-er-ú-šu a-na e-lá-ma i-tù-ru
target: If the investors of Ikūn-pī-Ištar or his sons raise a claim against Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: im-dí-DINGIR ú-ba-áb-šu
target: Imdī-ilum will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB im-dí-DINGIR DUMU šu-lá-ba-an
target: Seal of Imdī-ilum, son of Šu-Labān,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša 10 ma-na AN.NA ša i-ku-pì-IŠTAR a-na e-lá-ma i-di-nu
target: for the 10 minas of tin that Ikūn-pī-Ištar had given to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša (d)a-šùr ší-bu-tí-ni ni-dín
target: And we gave our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma 0.5 LUGAL-ki-in-ma
target: Thus 0.5 [mina] of Šarrum-kēn:

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-tí É.GAL-lim-ma 4 DUMU um-mì-a-nim iṣ-ba-at-ma
target: The hand of the palace itself seized four traders.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na wa-áš-ḫa-ni-a ni-na-me-er-ma
target: When we met in Wašhaniya

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šur-na-da sú-in-il₅-šu ù en-na-su-in qí-bi-ma
target: To Aššur-nādā, Suen-ilšu, and Ennam-Suen, say:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-nu-mì ú-šé-ṣú-ú-ni
target: When it removed them

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku lá-šu-a-ku
target: I was not present

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG.ḪI.A É.GAL-lúm ú-la it-ba-al
target: It was not the palace that took the textiles away.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta-ma ta-at-ba-al-šu-nu
target: It was you who took them away!

source: translate Akkadian to English: É-tí ú-na-dí-du-ma
target: They searched my house

source: translate Akkadian to English: TÚG.ḪI-tí-kà ú-šé-ṣú-ú
target: and removed your textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-bé-a a-na ba-áb DINGIR ú-šé-ra-da-ma
target: I will lead my witnesses down to the Gate of the god.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am a ší-a-tí a-TI-a-kum
target: Therefore I drew up a tablet for you

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ší-bé-a az-ku-ra-kum
target: and I named my witnesses for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-ku-nu ša 4 šu-nu-tí ta-lá-qé
target: So that you can acquire a tablet with your seals, those of these four men.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta ša a-wa-tim né-nu
target: Please my brother, are we for legal procedures?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-aṣ-a-tí-ma a-ma-kam lu ni-ta-wu
target: You have taken the initiative, so let us discuss over there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-a ša tù-kà-lu-ú a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí dín
target: Give the tablet with my seal that you have in your possession to my representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma la ta-da-an
target: If you do not wish that,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-sí-ḫi-ma lu-ma lá-li-kam
target: have me transferred here, so that I can come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na ma-mì-tim ta-pá-li-li mu-ru-úṣ li-bi-kà a-na ša ki-ma ku-a-tí lá-pí-ta-ma lu-ta-mì-ú-ni
target: If you wish to start a judicial procedure to make me swear, write down your grievances for your representatives, so that they can make me swear.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ma-na KÙ.GI 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-zi-zi-a ub-lam
target: Kuziziya brought 2 minas of gold and 8 minas of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim bé-lá-num ú (d)IM-ba-ni i-ra-dí-ú-ni-kum
target: Bēlānum and Adad-bāni lead all this to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.GI-kà ta-dín
target: Your gold has been sold

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ITU.6.KAM 6 … i-ša-qal
target: And he will pay in 6 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na ku-zi-zi-a ki-a-ma i-lá-qé-ú-ma i-ša-qú-lu
target: Also, they will receive in this way for Kuziziya and pay.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iš-tù ḫa-muš-tim ša en-na-nim ku-zi-zi-a il₅-qé-ma
target: Kuziziya received x shekels of silver in the week of Ennānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kur-ub-IŠTAR DINGIR ša-pá-tám i-li-ik
target: received the silver since the week of Kurub-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš-ma a-na ša-qí-il₅ da-tim
target: Thus (says) the Kanesh colony to the payers of the datu-tax.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.3333300000000001 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ri-ik-sú i-na É-bé-tí-šu ḫI-li-qú-ni i-dí-a-šùr i-ša-qal
target: Iddin-Aššur will pay 1.33333 shekel of silver concerning a package that was lost in his house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-qá-bi₄ um-ma šu-ut-ma KÙ.AN ša a-wi-lim ša NÍG.KA-sí
target: If the person in question protests and declares: 'The meteoric iron belongs to a man with an account'.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-li-a ší-ip-ri-ni kà-ri-im dur₄-hu-mi-it ha-tù-uš ta-am-ni-a tù-ùh-pí-a a-dí ni-na-ša-a qí-bi₄-ma
target: Say to our messenger Kuliya, (to) Durhumit, Hattuš, Tamnia, and Tuhpiya, (all the way) until Nenašša:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ma-an KÙ.AN a-na ší-mì-im a-na É.GAL-lim i-dí-nu
target: Whoever has sold meteoric iron to a palace

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu a-dí-ni lá i-dí-in-ma na-ší
target: or, having not yet sold it, still carries it with him

source: translate Akkadian to English: i (d)UTU-ši țup-pì-ni ta-ša-me-a-ni
target: As soon as you hear our letter

source: translate Akkadian to English: GÍR ša a-šur šé-ṣí-a-ma ik-ri-ba-am šu-uk-na-ma
target: produce the dagger of Aššur and impose an oath.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10-tim ša KÙ.AN ú 1 ma-na um 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-du-a-sú ṣa-áb-ta-ma
target: Seize (from him) the tithe on the meteoric iron and his tax of 3 shekels silver per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-li-a i pá-ni-šu li-ni-iš-a-am
target: Let Kuliya personally take it along.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-da-ma IGI ku-li-a ší-ip-ri-ni GÍR ša a-šur šé-ṣí-a-ma
target: Do not fail to produce Aššur's dagger in the presence of Kuliya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-hu-um pá-ni a-hi-im ú-lá ú-ba-al
target: People shall not spare each other!

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10-tim ú ša-du-a-tám li-qé-a-ma
target: Still take the tithe and the tax.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ba-ri-ni li-li-kam-ma GÍR ša a-šur li-it-ma-ma
target: And let one come here to swear an oath by Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-du-a-tám nu-ta-ar-šu-um
target: Then we will give him back the tax.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-qá-be um-ma šu-ut-ma
target: If he protests, saying: "I will go to clear myself in Kanesh", still make him pay the silver and let him come here afterwards in order to clear accounts with us.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-qá-be um-ma šu-ut-ma
target: He shall not make trouble against (us) here, he must pay the silver (t)here!

source: translate Akkadian to English: țup-pu-um ša 0.33333 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša hu-bu-ul a-bi-kà
target: A tablet of 1/3 mina of silver, being the debt of your father,

source: translate Akkadian to English: i kà-né-eš i-li-a-am
target: has turned up in Kanesh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-ma-an ha-ra-an sú-ki-nim e-ma-re ṣé-er-dam ú-šé-ri-ba-ni-ma a-ma-kam uš-té-bu-lu-ni lu wa-ší-ib kà-ri-im
target: Whoever has brought in loaded donkeys via the side-road in order to do business over there, even when he is a resident of a colony,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na-um 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-áš-qí-lá-šu-ma
target: make him pay 3 shekels of silver per mina

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-li-a i pá-ni-šu li-ni-iš-a-am

source: translate Akkadian to English: a re-eš₁₅ țup-pí-im ša hu-bu-ul a-bi-kà ku-nu-uk a-bi-kà a-mu-ur-ma
target: Inspect the seal of your father at the top of your father's debt-note.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù KÙ.BABBAR ù ṣí-ba-sú šu-qú-ul
target: And then pay the silver and the interest on it.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-na KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN e-né-ki a-hi-e-iš ra-ki-is
target: Your eyes are fixed together on every shekel of silver there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma la-ma-sí-ma a-na a-la-hi-im qí-bi₄-ma
target: From Lamassī to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni um-ma a-ta-ma
target: Why have you written me as follows:

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-mu-úa DUMU ha-am-ha-am-tim
target: In the presence of Amua, son of Hamhamtum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-da-da-a DUMU a-bi₄-a DUMU be-be-e
target: In the presence of Adadaya, son of Abiya, son of Bebē.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-ut-ma šu-ma-BA țup-pá-am ša hu-bu-ul a-bi-a tù-kà-al
target: He answered: "If you really have in your possession a debt-note with the seal of my father"

source: translate Akkadian to English: ku-nu-uk a-bi-a a-ma-ar-ma
target: I will inspect it

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-nam a-qá-bi₄
target: how could I protest?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ša-qal hu-bu-ul a-bi₄-a
target: I will pay, (for) it is my father's debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ke-e a-bi₄-i i-na re-ší-a i-ze-zi-im ù qá-qí-dí-a na-ṣa-ri-im e-zi-ba-ši
target: Certainly, my father left her to assist me and guard my life.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN e-né-a a-na-ší-ma ù ú-ša-ra-ši

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us for these proceedings.

target: We gave the tablet with our testimony before Aššur's dagger.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu-um a-ma-kam um-ma kà-lá-na-šar a-hu-kà É a-bi₄-ni a-na ha-lu-qí-im i-tí-zi-iz
target: Why does Kalanašar say there: "Your brother stood ready to destroy our father's house?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB IŠTAR-ba-ni DUMU ás-qú-dim

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB ku-lu-ma-a DUMU a-ta-a

source: translate Akkadian to English: x x-tí-a bé-lu-a a-tù-nu gi-im-lá-ni-ma ih-da

target: From Atata, Šu-Anum, Dannaya and Lamassī to Ali-ahum:

target: In accordance with your instructions we got a tablet of the City for you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá-hu-um a-ha-am ú-ša-áš-me-ú
target: As one brother has made the other hear.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ša li-bi₄ a-hi-kà ša-áš-qí-la-šu-ma
target: and have paid the silver that is in your brother's possession

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na dí-in a-lim(ki) ṭup-pá-am ša a-na ì-lí-a DUMU e-lá-lí pá-aq-du a-na ra-bi-ṣí-im ú-šu-ru-ma
target: Following the verdict of the City they must release the tablet that was entrusted to Iliya son of Elāli to the attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ba ra-bi₄-iṣ-ni
target: Ababa is our attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ša-ha-at ra-bi₄-ṣí-im i-za-az
target: must assist the attorney.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ší-ma-tí-ku-nu a-ta-wa
target: and discuss about the testament concerning you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ša-ha-at ra-bi₄-ṣí-im i-zi-iz-ma
target: and assist the attorney,

source: translate Akkadian to English: x a-na ra-bi-ṣí-im dí-na-ma
target: and give it to the attorney

target: Damiq-pī-Aššur gave him 0.3333 mina 8 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB (d)IŠKUR-pí-la-ah DUMU a-ni-nim

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-lá-ma-sí DUMU la-qé-eb

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB na-zi DUMU PUZUR₄-ba-ni-ni

target: 3 minas of refined silver Aššur-lamassī, son of Lā-qēp, owes to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB DINGIR-ba-ni DUMU ib-ni-lí

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na u₄-me-šu ma-al-ú-tim lá i-šqú-ul
target: If he does not pay when his term is up,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN.TA a-na 1 ma-na-im i-na ITU.KAM-im ṣí-ib-tám ú-ṣa-áb
target: he will add as interest 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-mu-um ša qá-té ba-zi-a DUMU šé-ep-a-lim
target: Eponymy of the successor of Baziya, son of Šēp-ālim.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB i-dí-a-šur DUMU PUZUR₄-a-be-eh
target: seal of Iddin-Aššur, son of Puzur-Abeh.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB a-šur-ma-lik DUMU PUZUR₄-a-šur
target: seal of Aššur-mālik, son of Puzur-Aššur

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR i-ṣé-er šu-li DUMU PUZUR₄-a-be-eh e-lá-ma i-šu
target: 8 minas of refined silver Šuli, son of Puzur-Abeh, owes to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN.TA ṣí-ib-tám i-na ITU.KAM-im a-na 1 ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: He will add as interest 1.5 shekel per mina per month.

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ha-muš-tim ša a-šur-re-ṣí a-na 14 ha-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: He will pay within 14 weeks from the week of Aššur-rēṣī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÚ 32 ma-na URUDU ha-bu-ra-ta-am i-ṣé-er i-dí-a-šur DUMU PUZUR₄-a-be-eh e-lá-ma i-šu
target: 4 talents 32 minas of copper from Haburata Iddin-Aššur, son of Puzur-Abeh, owes to Elamma.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá i-šqúl
target: If he does not pay

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-wa-at kà-ri-im ṣí-ib-t
target: he will add interest in conformity with the rule of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ni-na a-na be-ĺ-nim iᅣ-ba-at-ni-a-t̀-ma
target: Annina seized us against Bēlānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na da-tum ik-ᅡu-da-ni
target: 0.5 minas of datu-tax reached me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na wa-ar-ki-im i-nu-m bi-x-ki-im a-na wa-aᄣ-ᅡu-ᅡa-na a-li-ku-
target: Later, when they were going to Wahšušana,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ANᅡE.ᄣI.A lu SIGႅ
target: The donkeys should be good.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ᅡa-du-a-s ᅡa-bu
target: He was paid the transport tariff.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu tām-kār abī-ya attā
target: Or you are my father's merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lᇂ tᇂ-na-ᄓa-ni
target: Do not obstruct me,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ᇂ Kᇂ.BABBAR ma-dam lᇂ tᇂ-ᅑa-ag-ma-ra-ni
target: and do not make me expend a lot of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku a-d mu-ᅣ-im p-al-ᄣba-ku-ma
target: And as for me, I was afraid because of the exit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na q-q-d-a na-p-ᅡ-t lu-q-t-k a-na bu-ru-uᅡ-ᄣba-dim e-ra-ba-am -l a-mu-a
target: And because of fear for my own head and the welfare of your goods I will not enter Burušhaddum.

target: With regard to the iron that you promised to the exit.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ᅟ-am l t-ᅟ-biႜ-la-ni-ma
target: Without sending any iron.

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-bi a-we-lam l t-na-e-ᄓu
target: And thereby not calming the man's heart.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ANᅡE i-na ANᅡE-ri-a uᅡ-ta-ba
target: He also wanted to recoup a donkey from my donkeys.

source: translate Akkadian to English: pu-ᄣ-ᅡu ANᅡE ᅡa i-d-nu me-et
target: and the donkey he gave in its place is dead!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma kᅩa-ru-ma i-ba-a-ba-at a-lim(ki) na-ru-qᅳ-um ma-a-tum iᄣ-li-iq-ma
target: The harnesser declared: 'In the outskirts of the City one large bag (with textiles) got lost'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ku-a-tim iᅡ-ta-kᅩ-an
target: and he reckoned it as yours.

source: translate Akkadian to English: t-er-t a-er a-ur-na-da a-ur-lu-li i-li-ik a-a-s-im i-t-u
target: An instruction of mine went to Aššur-nādā and Aššur-ᅣulšlģ to settle accounts with him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 ma-na 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i-dí-IŠTAR ub-lam
target: 7 minas 12 shekels of silver Iddin-Ištar brought here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 GÍN im-ṭí
target: and it was 7 shekels less

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma e-la-ma ù a-šur-dan-ma a-na a-mur-IŠTAR a-šur-na-da ù ku-ni-lim qí-bi₄-ma
target: Thus Elamma and Aššur-dān, say to Amur-Ištar, Aššur-nādā, and Kūnilum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 13 GÍN i ma-sà-im im-ṭí
target: 13 shekels loss by purifying.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a pá-ni IŠTAR-pì-lá-aḫ ra-dí ú-nu-tim ša ḫi-na-a nu-šé-bi₄-il₅
target: We sent 1.5 mina silver to meet Ištar-pilah, the transporter of Hinnaya's goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.33333 ma-na 0.5 GÍN KÙ
target: 20.5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na DUMU a-ḫa-tim ra-dí ú-nu-tim ša ku-ni-lim nu-šé-bi₄-il₅
target: 1.5 mina of silver we sent for the son of Aḫātum, the transporter of Kūnilum's goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na a-na bur-sú-in ra-dí ú-nu-tim ša DAM.GÀR-ri-im e-lá-ma ú-šé-bi₄-il₅
target: Elamma sent 1 mina for Būr-Suen, the transporter of the merchant's goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na a-na a-šur-dan ra-dí ú-nu-tim ša ḫi-na-a e-lá-ma-ma ú-šé-bi₄-il₅
target: 0.5 mina of silver for Aššur-dān, the transporter of Hinnaya's goods, Elamma also sent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ku-ku-zi-a lá-qé-ep ù a-na-a-na qí-bi-ma um-ma en-um-a-šùr-ma
target: To Kukuziya, Lā-qēp and Anna-anna from Ennam-Aššur:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫa-ra-ni i-ṣé-er
target: I am on my way

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫu-ur-ší-a e-ku-nu li-li-ik
target: keep an eye on my store-room

source: translate Akkadian to English: al-kam ṭup-pì-a lu-kà-li-im-kà-ma
target: Come! Let me show you my tablets!

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma šu-be-lúm-ma mì-nam we-dam i-a-tí tù-lá-ma-da-ni
target: Šu-Bēlum answered: 'Why do you inform only me?'

source: translate Akkadian to English: kà-ṣa-ru-um ša ḫi-na-a ša iš-tù a-lim(ki) is-ri-da-ni
target: As for Hinnaya's harnesser who took care of the transport from the City,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 TÚG-tí-šu a-na bé-ú-lá-tí-šu ú-ša-qí-il₅-ni-a-tí-ma
target: he paid us for his 3 textiles

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 GÍN 22.5 ŠE KÙ.BABBAR ni-pu-ul-šum
target: and we balanced him 4 1/8 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.5 ma-na 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR a-na i-dí-sú-in kà-ṣa-ar kàr-wa-a i-na a-wa-tim i-bu-ni-a-tí-ma ni-dí-šum
target: 33 shekels of silver for Iddin-Suen, the harnesser of Karwaya - we gave it to him because he over us in a conflict.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ni-ip-lá-tim ša ILLAT-at a-šur-iš-ta-kál DUMU sú-kà-li-a ù 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša li-bi₄-šu a-ni-pì-il₅-tí-šu-ma e-ta-kál
target: From the balance payment of the caravan of Aššur-ištikal, son of Sukkalliya, and 10 shekels of silver he owes.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma a-na šu-be-lim-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur said to Šu-Bēlum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: i pì i-sú-SUD a-bi₄-a qá-ta-at a-bi₄-kà al-ta-pá-at
target: 'On the orders of Issu-arik, my father, I wrote myself as your father's guarantor.'

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-la ú-ša-ḫi-zu-ku-nu-tí-ni šu-ma a-lu-wa ù a-šé-e iš-tù ḫa-na-ak-na-ak i-ta-ṣú-nim
target: As I instructed you, if Aluwa and Ašē'e have left Hanaknak,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma-lá KÙ.BABBAR ú-šé-ri-ú-ni-ni pí-ri-kà-ni na-ar-bu-tim ú-lá ší-ma-am ša ki-ma ta-da-ga-lá-ni-ma KÙ.BABBAR 1 GÍN e-li-ú
target: then buy soft textiles for what silver they conduct; or make the best purchase you can,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-ma-ma a-dí a-lá-kà-ni ší-mu-um li-ib-ší
target: and until I come the purchase should remain.

source: translate Akkadian to English: qá-dí a-ḫi-a-ma šé-a-ni
target: Sue me together with my brothers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu i ba-a-ba-tí-šu KÙ.BABBAR al-qé-ma a-na ḫu-bu-li-šu ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: I took silver from his outstanding claims and paid to cover his debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu i-na na-ru-qí-a KÙ.BABBAR ma-da-ma a-na ḫu-bu-ul a-bi₄-kà ú-ša-qí-il₅
target: I paid a great deal of silver from my joint-stock capital for your father's debt.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr ù šu-be-lúm DUMU i-dí-a-bi₄-im ni-kà-sí ma-aḫ-ri-ni i-sí-ú-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur and Šu-Bēlum son of Iddin-abum settled accounts before us,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 13 ma-na URUDU lá-mu-nam i-ṣé-er šu-be-lim ša-lim-a-šùr i-dí
target: and Šalim-Aššur set down 1 talent 13 minas of bad copper as a claim on Šu-Bēlum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI PUZUR₄-a-šur IGI en-na-nim
target: Witnessed by Puzur-Aššur, by Ennānum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-wa-tim a-ni-a-tim kà-ru-um kà-ni-iš i-dí-ni-a-tí-ma
target: The Kanesh colony gave us (verdict) for these proceedings.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI GÍR ša a-šur ni-dí-in
target: We gave testimony before the dagger of Aššur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-nam-a-šùr DUMU me-na-a
target: seal of Ennam-Aššur son of Menaya

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša a-mur-IŠTAR ù a-šùr-i-mì-tí
target: Concerning Amur-Ištar and Aššur-imittī.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá iš-qú-ul
target: If he has not paid in time,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.5 GÍN.TA i-na ITU.KAM a-na ma-na-im ú-ṣa-áb
target: he must pay interest at the rate 1.5 shekel per month per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 10 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki-a en-um-a-šùr na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Ennam-Aššur brings you 10 minas of silver under my seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma i-ku-pí-a-ma a-na en-um-a-šùr i-d-i-a-bi-im ù lá-qé-ep qí-bi-ma
target: From Ikūn-pīya to Ennam-Aššur, Iddin-abum and Lā-qēp:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ḫu-bu-ul i-dí-a-bi-im 13 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am
target: Concerning the debt of Iddin-abum of 13 minas of refined silver:

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù ḫa-mu-uš-tim ša kàr-ri-a a-na 36 ḫa-am-ša-tim i-ša-qal
target: reckoned from the week of Karriya he must pay within 36 weeks.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ḫu-sà-ru-um ik-ri-bu ša a-šùr ḫa-al-qú
target: the lapis lazuli that was the votive offering to Aššur has been lost.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ṣé-er 40 ma-na AN.NA ša en-um-a-šùr ú-šé-ba-lá-ni
target: In addition to 40 minas of tin, add my silver and buy worth 2 minas of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú i-na KÙ.BABBAR-pì-a ša 2 ma-na AN.NA-ak-šu a-ṣé-er ma-na-im ša-a-ma a-d-í x ší-mì ta-ša-a-ma-ni
target: And until you make purchases for me, set aside the tin and send it as soon as possible.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta be-lí a-ta
target: My dear brother and lord,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí a-lá-ak ṣú-ḫa-ri-a
target: Until my servant arrives,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pì-a sà-áp-tí-ni x-bi SIG₅ ša tal-ḫa-at pí-ri-kà-ni na-ar-bu-tim
target: with the rest of my silver make a profitable purchase of good textiles and soft pirikannu,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-ma-am ša ba-lá-ṭí-a ša-ma-nim-ma šé-bi-lá-nim
target: and send them to me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na kur-ub-IŠTAR i-ku-pì-a šu-IŠTAR a-d-í-da ù a-mur-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma
target: To Kurub-Ištar, Ikūn-piya, Šu-Ištar, Adida and Amur-Ištar from Šalim-Aššur;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-ú-a be-lu-a a-tù-nu
target: My dear brothers and lords,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá dí-in a-lim(ki) a-li ra-bi₄-ṣú-um i-pá-li-lu
target: Wherever the attorney interrogates according to the verdict.

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-ta-me ù ú-nu-tám lu-na-d-í-id
target: He may impose an oath and search the goods.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na u₄-mu-ú e-ṭá-ri-im eṭ-ra-ni
target: save me while I can still be saved.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù šu-ma ba-tí-qum ma-ma-an e-tí-iq
target: Also, if anyone has departed with an express caravan,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ra-bi₄-ṣú-um le-tí-iq-ma ú-nu-tám ša ba-tí-qí-im lu-na-d-í-id
target: the attorney will travel and search the goods of that caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: gi-mì-lam i-ṣé-er a-šùr ù i-ṣé-ri-a šu-uk-na
target: Do this favour for Aššur and for me.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-ma a-šùr-be-el-ša-du-e KÙ.BABBAR a-ni-na il₅-qé
target: Annina has received the silver on behalf of Aššur-bēl-šadu'e.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1.66666 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ki ša šu-ḫu-bur a-na a-lá-ḫi-im e-zi-bu
target: Concerning the 1.6666 mina 5 shekels of sealed silver that Šu-hubur left with Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša dí-in a-lim(ki) a-ta ù ILLAT-kà ší-im-a-ma
target: Listen to the City's verdict, assist the attorney and servant,

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ḫu-sà-ru-um e-ta-li-a-am ku-un-kà-šu-ma a ma-lá dí-in a-lim(ki) ḫu-sà-ra-am ù en-na-sú-in ta-i-ra-nim
target: and if the lapis lazuli appears, return it and Enna-Suen according to the verdict.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-um-a-šur qí-bi-ma um-ma lá-qé-ep-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Lā-qēp:

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma li-ba-kà lá i-pá-ri-id
target: Do not worry at all.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šur-ba-ni DUMU ku-ta-a
target: Witnessed by Aššur-bāni son of Kutaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ili₅-ba-ni DUMU a-mur-IŠTAR
target: By Ilī-bāni son of Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-na KÙ.BABBAR a-nim ma-ma-an a-na a-lá-ḫi-im i-tù-aar
target: If anyone raises claim against Ali-ahum for this silver,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ni-na DUMU MAN-a-na ú-ba-áb-šu
target: Annina son of Puzur-Anna will clear him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-ku ú en-na-num a-na É ḫu-ur-ší-kà né-ru-ma UD.KA.BAR-kà ù ṭup-pì-kà nu-šé-ṣí-ma
target: I and Ennānum entered your storeroom and brought out your bronze and the tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na É i-tur₄-DINGIR i-ba-ší-ú
target: They are in Itūr-ilī's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma KÙ.BABBAR i-na qá-tí-kà lá ma-qí-it a-ni-tám lá a-ni-tám tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: Send me word whether or not any silver has fallen into your hands.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-ḫi-id-ma tí-ir-ta-kà li-li-kam
target: Take care to send me word.

source: translate Akkadian to English: e a-ta-lá-ak-ma
target: If I do not depart,

source: translate Akkadian to English: li-ba-kà e tù-lá-mì-nam

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na-sú-in a-na dan-a-šur ir-gu₅-um

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu a-ni-a-ma a-he-e i-šu
target: So may it be like this: I have brothers.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB en-na-sú-in DUMU i-ku-a
target: Sealed by Enna-Suen son of Ikuwa

source: translate Akkadian to English: KIŠIB sà-li-a DUMU i-dí-a-šùr

source: translate Akkadian to English: lá tù-na-ha-ni

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-kà du-uk

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ni-pì-il₅-tí-a

target: A letter of our father to Salim-Assur (son of Ili-bani).

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-šur-na-da-ma x x ša me-er-ú i-a-a ù me-er-ú e-ri-ší-im lá i-ma-hu-ru-ni-ni
target: Aššur-nādā answered: "As the sons of Yaya and the sons of Erišum do not approach me."

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pá-am ša ku-nu-ki-kà ta-da-nam
target: Give me the tablet under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù KÙ.BABBAR 0.5 ma-na lá-dí-na-ku-um
target: Then I shall give you at least 0.5 mina of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ku-nu-uk PÚZUR-a-šur DUMU a-hu-qar
target: A tablet (with the seal) of Puzur-Assur (son of Ahuqar).

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša a-na i-a-tí a-šùr-ták-lá-ku ù a-bi-a-a lá i-tu-ru
target: That he will not come back on me, Assur-taklaku and Abiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša ba-áb i-lim ša ka-nu-tim
target: A tablet concerning the gate of the god of the Kanutu-woman.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na ha-ra-nim ni-lá-ak-ma
target: We will go on a trip.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma da-da-a-ma a-na a-šur-na-da-ma
target: Dadaya said as follows to Aššur-nādā:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša hu-bu-li-kà É wa-áb-ri-a i-ba-ší
target: The tablet concerning your debt is in my guest-house.

target: And together with your tablet concerning some 10 minas of silver the tablets concerning Erišum are in my guest-house.

target: A tablet about 1 mina of silver, the working capital of Assur-taklaku, son of Dadanum.
