target: A tablet concerning the wife of Adaya about the price paid for a house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša be-ú-lá-at a-šùr-ták-lá-ku DUMU a-šùr-ma-lik DUMU a-ri-a
target: A tablet about 1 mina of silver the working capital of Assur-taklaku, son of Assur-malik, son of Ariya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 12 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša a-zi-da-a DUMU šál-ma-a-šur
target: A tablet about 12 shekels of silver of Azida, son of Salim-Assur.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 12.5 ma-na UR
target: A tablet about 12.5 minas of copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 8 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša i-ku-pí-a DUMU ša ṣa-al-me-e
target: A tablet about 8 shekels of silver of Ikuppiya, the son of Salme.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 0.33333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR
target: A tablet about 0.3333 (and 5 shekels) of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša be-ú-lá-at a-bu-ša-lim ú e-dí-na-a a-hi-šu
target: The working capital of Abu-salim and his brother Edinaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-šùr-ni-im-ri ù a-lá-hi-im qí-bi-ma um-ma a-hi-a-ma
target: To Aššur-nimrī and Ali-ahum from Ahiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú ṭup-pì-a i-na ku-nu-ki-ku-nu ku-un-kà
target: and seal my tablets with your seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum ṭup-pè-e šé-bi₄-lá-nim
target: Urgent, send the tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-ú ku-nu-ku ša i-na hu-ur-ší-im ša li-pì-it-IŠTAR i-na ma-ak-ni-ki-im i-na e-ra-bi-ku-nu-ma
target: As to the sealed tablets that are in Lipit-Ištar's safe in a sealed container, right when you arrive

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na ṣé-ri-šu qá-at-ku-nu lu ša-ak-nu
target: your claim should be made to them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pí ki-lá-li-ma ku-un-kà
target: Seal both of the tablets;

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú i ṣí-li-a-ni šé-ri-a-šu-nu-ma a-na (d)UTU.SIPA dí-na-ma
target: also, take them in the containers and give them to Šamaš-rē'ī

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu-ub-lam
target: so he may bring them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pì e ták-lá-a-ma
target: Do not hold back the tablets

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wi-lúm É a-bi₄-a e it-ba-al
target: lest the man ruins my father's house.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ba-ú-a be-lu-ú-a a-tù-nu u₄-um e-ṭá-ri-im iṭ-ra-ni
target: My dear fathers and lords, save me while I can still be saved.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-na ṭup-pì-a a-tí-kil₅-ma lu-qú-ut
target: Confident of my tablets I seized Aššur-taklāku's goods here.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šùr-ták-lá-ku aṣ-ba-at-ma ù sí-ku-šu ú-kà-al
target: I also detain him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ṭup-pé-en ša a-šùr-ták-lá-ku DUMU ma-lá-kà-a
target: 2 tablets concerning Aššur-taklāku son of Malakaya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ṭup-pu-um ša 2 ma-na 10 GÍN ù ša-ni-um ša 5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ta-ar-ki-is-tim
target: 1 tablet concerning 2 minas 10 shekels and a second one concerning 5 minas of silver, a debt-note.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na li-bi₄ ṭup-pè-e i-ba-ší-ú
target: are among the tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ut ṭup-pè-e i-tí-ki-ir
target: He, on the other hand, contests the tablets.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù um-ma šu-ut-ma šu-ma ṭup-pì-a lá ta-tab-al a ma-lá ta-ar-gu₅-ma-ni ta-ša-qá-al
target: So he says: "If you do not bring my tablets, you will pay in accordance with what you claimed from me."

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR i li-be ṣú-li-a a-lá-hu-um i-šu
target: Ṣulliya owes 3 shekels of silver to Ali-ahum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ma-ma-hi-ir ú SIG₅-pí-a-šur-ma a-na a-lá-hi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Man-mahir and Damiq-pī-Aššur to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 10 ma-na AN.NA ku-nu-ki-kà SIG₅-pí-a-šur ub-lam
target: Damiq-pī-Aššur brought 1 talent 10 minas of tin under your seal.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 GÍN.TA ni-dí-in-šu-ma
target: We sold it at the rate 7:1.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na AN.NA ni-ik-bu-us
target: We subtracted 1 mina of tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 7 ma-na 14 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ú 16.75 GÍN KÙ.GI ší-im AN.NA-ki-kà iz-ku-am-ma
target: 7 minas 14 shekels of silver and 16.75 shekels of gold was cleared as the price of your tin.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 12 GÚ URUDU SIG₅ ú 1 GÚ lu-lu-um SIG₅-pí-a-šur ub-lam
target: Damiq-pī-Aššur brought 12 talents of good copper and 1 talent of lulum-copper.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša-du-at AN.NA ú e-ri-ib-tim a bé-et kà-ri-im ni-dí-in
target: We gave 15 shekels of silver as the transport tariff and the entrance fee for the tin to the colony office.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU nu-sá-ni-iq-ma
target: We checked the copper,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ-tum 1 ma-na.TA im-ṭí
target: and one mina was missing on each talent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-ma-am ku-nu-ki-kà ni-is-ni-iq-ma
target: Today we checked your seal,

source: translate Akkadian to English: 8 GÍN im-ṭí
target: and 8 shekels were missing.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 0.83333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ší-im lu-lu-im
target: The price of the lulum-copper was 55 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na.TA URUDU-kà 1 GÍN.TA a-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-dí-šu
target: We sold your copper for one shekel of silver per mina.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 ma-na 10 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ma-ma-hi-ir il₅-qé
target: and of that Man-mahir took 1 mina 10 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 22 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR SIG₅-pí-a-šur il₅-qé
target: Damiq-pī-Aššur took 22 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà lu ší-im URUDU lu ší-im lu-lu-im 12.83333 ma-na 5 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR iz-ku-am-ma
target: The total of your silver, both the price of the copper and of the lulum-copper was cleared as 12.83333 minas 5 shekels of silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 17 GÍN lu ša-du-ú-tum lu e-ri-ib-tum a-na É kà-ri-im ni-dí-in
target: 17 shekels was either the transport tariff or the entrance fee - we paid it to the office of the colony.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma lá ú-kà-i-na-šu-nu 0.33333 ma-na 5 GÍN.TA KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-ša-qal
target: If he does not confirm them he shall pay 25 shekels of refined silver apiece.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ITU.1.KAM ṣí-ip-um li-mu-um PUZUR₄-(d)MUŠ
target: Month VII, eponymy of Puzur-Nirah.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-tí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà 11 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ku-nu-ki-ni SIG₅-pí-a-šur na-áš-a-kum lu
target: The remainder of your silver, 11 minas 6 shekels of refined silver, under our seals, Damiq-pī-Aššur brings to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI i-dí-a-šur DUMU bu-sú-sú
target: In the presence of Iddin-Aššur, son of Pususu,

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-bu-ša-lim DUMU i-dí-èr-ra
target: of Abu-šalim, son of Iddin-Erra.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na 11 (TÚG)ku-ta-ni ša e-lá-ma
target: Concerning 11 textiles, belonging to Elamma,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-šur-lá-ma-sí a-na e-lá+lá-x-ma ITU.5.KAM ú-kà-na-šu-nu
target: Aššur-lamassī shall confirm the liability for Elamma within 5 months.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu ša DAM.GÀR-ri-im a-dí-na-kum
target: I gave you 3 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, belonging to a merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na i-ku-pí-a li-bi-IŠTAR a-lá-ḫi-im ù a-šur-ma-lik
target: To Ikūn-pīya, Libbi-Ištar, Ali-ahum and Aššur-malik;

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na li-bi-IŠTAR qí-bi-ma um-ma PUZUR₄-a-na-ma
target: specifically to Libbi-Ištar from Puzur-Anna:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma i-na ša 10 TÚG-tum 1 TÚG wa-at-ru-ú-tim i-na É.GAL-lim il₅-qé-ŠU
target: If one has taken extra pieces in the palace, on top of the tithe on textiles,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ki-iš-dá-tí-šu a-na e-lá-ma i-na TÚG.ḪI-tí-šu i-ṣa-bi-ir-šum
target: what accrues from it to Elamma will be deducted for him from his textiles

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ILLAT la-qé-ep DUMU qá-a-a-tim
target: of the caravan of Lā-qēp, son of Qa'atum.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫi a-ta KÙ.BABBAR ù ší-a-ma-tim KÙ.BABBAR ma-la ta-na-dí-ú a-na ša ki-ma i-a-tí dí-in
target: My dear brother, give whatever silver and purchases you will deposit to my representatives.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na a-wa-tí-ni ší-a-ma-at a-lim(ki)
target: According to our agreement you will give from the purchase in the City

source: translate Akkadian to English: lu 1 ma-na-um 0.66666 ma-na lu 1 ma-na-um 0.5 ma-na a-na DAM.GÀR-ri-im ta-da-an
target: either 0.6666 mina or 0.5 mina per mina to the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ku-zi-zi-a-ma ù a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-na a-lá-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Kuziziya and Amur-Ištar to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma ší-ma-am i-da-na-ku-nu-tí
target: If he gives you purchased goods,

source: translate Akkadian to English: la ta-ma-ḫa-ra-šu
target: do not receive them

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù tí-ir-ta-ku-nu li-li-kam
target: but send me word.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ta 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu i-a-tí ki-ma DAM.GÀR ta-da-nam-ma
target: Then, you will personally give 4 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for, to me, on behalf of the merchant.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-na-ku DAM.GÀR-ru-um i-na e-la-i-a-ma iš-tù a-lim(ki) a-da-na-kum
target: And then I shall personally be the merchant; when I come up (to Anatolia) from the City I shall give it to you.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-ta 4 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu šé-bi₄-lam-ma
target: Also, you must personally send me 4 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR ma-la a-ta ta-da-na-ni ù a-na-ku i-na e-lá-i-a ki-am la-dí-na-kum
target: And whatever silver you give to me I shall personally give to you in this way when I come up.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na 15 TÚG ša a-mur-IŠTAR e-zi-bu
target: Of the 15 textiles that Amur-Ištar left behind

source: translate Akkadian to English: iš-tù a-mur-IŠTAR i-tù-ra-ni 2 TÚG i-ni-id-nu
target: two textiles have been sold after Amur-Ištar returned.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù a-dí-ni 2 TÚG ší-ma-sú i-ba-ší-ú
target: So, until now the 2 textiles agreed by him are (still) outstanding.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 TÚG ša a-bi-a-nu-um ú-šé-bi-lá-ni
target: 4 textiles that Abī-Anum sent.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú 4 TÚG ku-a-ú-tim
target: and your own 4 textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠU.NÍGIN 8 TÚG i li-bi-a
target: In all 8 textiles are in my possession.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša a-na 6 TÚG.ḪI.A ša a-bi-a-nim ša ta-áš-pu-ra-ni a-lá-an 4 TÚG ša ú-šé-bi₄-lá-ni mì-ma wa-at-ra-am lá ú-šé-bi₄-lam
target: Why is it that as for the 6 textiles belonging to Abī-Anum that you wrote about, apart from the 4 textiles he sent he has not sent anything else?

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na TÚG.ḪI.A a-ni-ú-tim mì-ma a-mur-IŠTAR ú-lá il₅-qé
target: Amur-Ištar has not taken any of these textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: šu-ma a-we-lu i-na sí-kà-tim wa-áš-bu
target: If the men are staying in the sikkātum,

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ma-kam a-lu-a ša-il₅ ša TÚG.ḪI.A ub-lá-ni
target: Ask Aluwa there, who brought the textiles.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ší-im 4 TÚG ša a-bi-A-nim ú ší-im ku-a-ú-tim
target: About the price of Abī-Anum's 4 textiles and that of yours.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 kà-sà-tum ù tù-dí-na-tum šu-qú-ul-ta-áš-na 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ku-a
target: 3 cups and toggle pins, their weight in silver 1 mina, under my seals.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫa-ma 0.33333 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ku-nu-ku-a-ma ik-ri-bu ša e-lá-ma
target: separately 26 shekels of silver also under my seals, of Elamma

source: translate Akkadian to English: 2 ṭup-pu-ú ša 2 ma-na 15 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul nu-a-im
target: 2 tablets of 2 minas 15 shekels of silver, being in the debt of the Anatolian.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 1.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul na-ni-a
target: 1 tablet of 1.5 mina of silver, being the debt of Naniya

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 1 ma-na 6 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul bur-sú-en₆
target: 1 tablet of 1 mina and 6 shekels of silver, being the debt of Būr-Suen.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na ir-ma-a-šùr a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-dí-in
target: 1 mina of silver (that) I gave to Ir'am-Aššur for making purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR a-na aḫ-ša-lim a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-dí-in
target: 1 mina of silver I gave to Ah-šalim for making purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ṭup-pu-um ša 0.33333 ma-na 4 GÍN KÙ.BABBAR ša ḫu-bu-ul il₅-tap-pá
target: 1 tablet of 24 shekels of silver being the debt of Ilī-tappā.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ma a-nim lá-ma-sà-tum DAM e-lá-ma té-zi-ib
target: All this, Lamassutum, the wife of Elamma, left behind.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 9 (TÚG)pí-ri-kà-ni ù 1 (TÚG)a-bar-ni-am a-na pí-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR a-na ší-a-ma-tim a-d-in
target: 9 textiles and 1 Abarnian one, (which) I gave to Pilah-Ištar for making purchases.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ma-lá ší-ma-tí-šu-nu me-er-i-tí NIN.DINGIR
target: And there my daughter, the priestess, and my sons will act in accordance with the testamentary dispositions applying to them.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 4 sà-ma-lá-tim … lá i-ḫa-li-qú …
target: 4 cups should not be lost.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 5 ÌR-du ù 5 a-ma-tum
target: 5 slaves and 5 slave-girls,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ŠÀ.BA 1 am-tum i-a-an-tal-ga
target: of whom 1 slave-girl, named Iyantalga,

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša ì-lí-na DUMU.SAL a-šur-DU₁₀
target: is for Ilina, daughter of Aššur-ṭāb.

source: translate Akkadian to English: IŠTAR-pá-lil₅ en-na-sú-en₆ ù ma-ṣí-ì-lí ša ki-ma lá-ma-sà-tum a-na DUMU um-mì-a-nim ù ma-ri-ša i-pá-qí-du-ma
target: Ištar-pālil, Ennam-Suen and Maṣi-ilī, Lamassutum's representative(s), will entrust it to an affiliated trader and to her sons.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lim(ki) ú-bu-lu-ú-ma
target: They will bring it to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu ú iḫ-da-ma AN.NA-kam da-am-qám wa-at-ra-am ma-ḫi-ir i-za-zu
target: My dear brothers, buy tin of extra-fine quality according to the market price.

source: translate Akkadian to English: x KÙ.GI pá-ša-lam da-am-qám ša ba-ri-ni pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR na-áš-a-ku-nu-ti
target: Pilah-Ištar brings you x fine gold belonging to us jointly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ḫu-a a-tù-nu ú iḫ-da-ma KI pá-ni-im wa-ṣí-im lu-qú-ti áb-kà-nim
target: My dear brothers, dispatch my goods with the first leaving caravan.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 1 GÚ 35 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ni-is-ḫa-sú DIRI ša-du-a-sú ša-bu-ú pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR ù ú-zu-a na-áš-a-ku-nu-tí
target: Pilah-Ištar and Uzuwa bring you 1 talent 35 minas of silver, its import duty added, its transport tariff paid for.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma en-nam-a-šur-ma a-na a-la-ḫi-im qí-bi-ma
target: From Ennam-Aššur to Ali-ahum:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-ḫa-ma 40 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am ša a-na šu-mì É a-bi₄-a a-na pì-lá-aḫ-IŠTAR áp-qí-id
target: Also, I further entrusted 40 minas of refined silver in the name of our father's house to Pilah-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú a-ta-ma a-ma-kam lu za-ku-a-tí
target: Then you too must be cleared there.

source: translate Akkadian to English: URUDU lá-mu-nam a-na SIG₅ ta-e-er
target: Convert bad copper to good.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum ša ša-ni-ú-tim la ta-áš-ta-na-me-e
target: Urgent! Do not listen to others all the time.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu ša áš-ta-na-me-ú-ma a-wa-at a-ḫi-ú-tim ta-áš-ta-na-me-ú
target: Why is it that I keep hearing that you always listen to what strangers say?

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-pu-tum la ta-ša-lá-at
target: Urgent! Do not act rashly.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-wa-tum i-ma-qú-ut-ma a-dí 5 u₄-me-e
target: The matter will fail, and within 5 days.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-du-um 3.5 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ša i-na a-lim(ki) a-bu-ni i-ṣé-er ú-ṣur-ša-IŠTAR il₅-qé-ú
target: Concerning 3.5 minas of silver that our father took on Uṣur-ša-Ištar's account in the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a ší-a-tí kà-áb-sà-ni
target: For that we are pardoned.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na-kam a-du um-me-a-an a-bi-ni a-we-lu-ú 2 ší-na im-ta-ag-ru-ni
target: Here 2 men have reached an agreement with me concerning our father's investors.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-ša-al KÙ.BABBAR ma-ḫri-šu a-šà-kà-an-ma
target: I shall place half of the silver before him.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na a-lim(ki) ší-ni-šu i-lá-ak-ma
target: It will go twice to the City.

source: translate Akkadian to English: KÙ.BABBAR-pí-šu-nu uš-ta-bu-ú
target: They will satisfy themselves with their silver.

source: translate Akkadian to English: 3 ma-na KÙ.BABBAR ṣa-ru-pá-am i-na ší-im SÍG.ḪI.A ša ú-ší-na-lam i-lá-áš-ra-ni DUMU sú-kà-li-a il₅-qé
target: Ilī-ašrannī son of Sukkalliya has received 3 minas of refined silver from the proceeds of Ušinalam's wool.

source: translate Akkadian to English: mì-šu-um ší-im 10 (TÚG)ku-ta-ni ša kà-ru-um dur₄-ḫu-mì-it a-dí-nu tal-qé
target: Why have you taken the proceeds from 10 kutānu-textiles that I sold in the Durhumit colony?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ša-lim-a-šùr a-na a-mur-IŠTAR ú-ṭá-bi-ni-a-tí-ma
target: Šalim-Aššur made us approach Amur-Ištar.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma ke-na 4 GÚ URUDU lá-mu-na-am al-qé
target: Amur-Ištar said: "Yes, I have taken 4 talents of copper of poor quality."

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI a-šùr-ba-ni DUMU kur-bi-a-a
target: Witnessed by Aššur-bāni son of Kurbiya.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma a-ta-ba lu-qú-tí lá ta-aṣ-ba-at
target: Amur-Ištar said: "It is not you who have taken my merchandise?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: ú-lá a-kà-lá-ma ta-al-qé
target: "I hold nothing, yet you have taken it."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma ša-lim-a-šùr-ma mì-ma lu-qú-ut-kà ú-lá aṣ-ba-at
target: Šalim-Aššur answered: "I have taken none of your merchandise."

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-mur-IŠTAR-ma qá-i ÌR li-li-kam
target: Amur-Ištar then said: "Wait until the slave has come here."

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-na en-nam-a-šùr qí-bi-ma um-ma IŠTAR-ra-bi₄-at-ma
target: To Ennam-Aššur from Ištar-rabi'at:

source: translate Akkadian to English: ma li-li-kam
target: Sure, let him come.

source: translate Akkadian to English: i-na pí-i ÌR-dí-kà-ma i-a-tí ta-a-bi-ta-ni
target: Then it will be me you can pressure on the basis of what your own slave says.

source: translate Akkadian to English: um-ma a-na-ku-ma ma-té-e ṣí-lá-(d)IM lá-mì-id
target: I said: "When will Ṣill-Adad be informed?"

source: translate Akkadian to English: IGI ú-ra-a IGI (d)MAR.TU-ba-ni
target: Witnessed by Uraya, by Amurrum-bāni.

source: translate Akkadian to English: bu-zu-ta-a tap-pá-i-ni
target: Buzutaya was our (absent) partner.

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-dí KÙ.BABBAR-pí-kà ša ḫa-bu-lá-ku-ni
target: With respect to your silver that I owe you,

source: translate Akkadian to English: DUMU a-ta li-ba-kà lá i-pá-ri-id
target: my dear son, do not worry!

source: translate Akkadian to English: a-ta ṣí-lá-(d)IM u₄-mì-im ṣú-ḫa-ri ša i-šu-ú lá ṣú-ḫa-ru-kà
target: As for you - thinking of Ṣill-Adad - are not the servants I have to-day (also) your servants?

source: translate Akkadian to English: ù KÙ.BABBAR ša a-šu-mì i-dí-a-bi₄-im ša ta-al-qé-ú ṭup-pá-am ḫa-ar-ma-am ú-kà-lu
target: "And for the silver that you have taken concerning Iddin-abum I hold the certified tablet."
